<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador resiliente e higienizador de estilos CSS para blocos e elementos (SOLID - SRP).
 */
class ElementStyleRenderer implements ElementStyleRendererInterface
{
    public function renderStyleString(array $data): string
    {
        $rules = [];

        // Margem e Padding
        if (!empty($data['margin'])) {
            $rules[] = 'margin: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['margin']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['padding'])) {
            $rules[] = 'padding: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['padding']);
        }

        // Flex & Flexbox
        if (!empty($data['display'])) {
            $rules[] = 'display: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['display']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_direction'])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-direction: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_direction']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['justify_content'])) {
            $rules[] = 'justify-content: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['justify_content']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['align_items'])) {
            $rules[] = 'align-items: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['align_items']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_wrap'])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-wrap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_wrap']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['gap'])) {
            $rules[] = 'gap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap']);
        }

        // Dimensões & Visual
        if (!empty($data['width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['max_width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'max-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['max_width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['min_height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'min-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['min_height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['background'])) {
            $rules[] = 'background: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['background']);
        }
        $resolvedTextColor = !empty($data['text_color']) ? (string)$data['text_color'] : (!empty($data['color']) ? (string)$data['color'] : '');
        if ($resolvedTextColor !== '') {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($resolvedTextColor);
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-text-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($resolvedTextColor);
        }
        if (!empty($data['heading_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-heading-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['heading_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['link_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-link-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['link_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['link_hover_color'])) {
            $rules[] = '--ds-local-link-hover-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['link_hover_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_width'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_width']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_style'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-style: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_style']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_color'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_color']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['border_radius'])) {
            $rules[] = 'border-radius: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['border_radius']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['box_shadow'])) {
            $rules[] = 'box-shadow: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['box_shadow']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['opacity']) && $data['opacity'] !== '1' && $data['opacity'] !== 1) {
            $rules[] = 'opacity: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['opacity']);
        }

        // Tipografia
        if (!empty($data['font_family'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-family: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_family']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_size'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-size: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_size']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_weight'])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-weight: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_weight']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['line_height'])) {
            $rules[] = 'line-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['line_height']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['letter_spacing'])) {
            $rules[] = 'letter-spacing: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['letter_spacing']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['text_transform'])) {
            $rules[] = 'text-transform: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_transform']);
        }
        if (!empty($data['text_align'])) {
            $rules[] = 'text-align: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_align']);
        }

        return !empty($rules) ? implode('; ', $rules) . ';' : '';
    }

    public function getResponsiveVisibilityClasses(array $data): string
    {
        $classes = [];
        if (!empty($data['hide_desktop']) && $data['hide_desktop'] !== 'false' && $data['hide_desktop'] !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-desktop';
        }
        $hideLaptop = $data['hide_laptop'] ?? $data['hide_1024'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideLaptop) && $hideLaptop !== 'false' && $hideLaptop !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-laptop';
        }
        $hideTablet = $data['hide_tablet'] ?? $data['hide_768'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideTablet) && $hideTablet !== 'false' && $hideTablet !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-tablet';
        }
        $hideMobile = $data['hide_mobile'] ?? $data['hide_375'] ?? false;
        if (!empty($hideMobile) && $hideMobile !== 'false' && $hideMobile !== '0') {
            $classes[] = 'ds-hide-mobile';
        }

        return implode(' ', $classes);
    }

    public function parse4Sides(string $spacing): array
    {
        $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($spacing));
        if ($parts === false || empty($parts) || $parts[0] === '') {
            return ['top' => '0px', 'right' => '0px', 'bottom' => '0px', 'left' => '0px'];
        }

        return match (count($parts)) {
            1 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[0], 'bottom' => $parts[0], 'left' => $parts[0]],
            2 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[0], 'left' => $parts[1]],
            3 => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[2], 'left' => $parts[1]],
            default => ['top' => $parts[0], 'right' => $parts[1], 'bottom' => $parts[2], 'left' => $parts[3]],
        };
    }

    public function sanitizeCssValue(string $value): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($value);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Bloqueia expressões maliciosas de CSS (expression, javascript:, vbscript:)
        $lower = strtolower($trimmed);
        if (
            str_contains($lower, 'expression(') ||
            str_contains($lower, 'javascript:') ||
            str_contains($lower, 'vbscript:') ||
            str_contains($lower, '@import')
        ) {
            return '';
        }

        // Higienização contra injeção de CSS ou quebra de sintaxe
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', '', $trimmed) ?? '';
        return htmlspecialchars($sanitized, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }

    public function renderResponsiveStyles(string $elementSelector, array $data): string
    {
        $devices = [
            'laptop' => [
                'media' => '@media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px)',
                'class' => ".ds-laptop-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-1024 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
            'tablet' => [
                'media' => '@media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px)',
                'class' => ".ds-tablet-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-768 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
            'mobile' => [
                'media' => '@media (max-width: 480px)',
                'class' => ".ds-mobile-mode {$elementSelector}, .ds-device-375 {$elementSelector}",
            ],
        ];

        $output = '';

        foreach ($devices as $dev => $config) {
            $rules = $this->buildDeviceRules($data, $dev);
            if (empty($rules)) {
                continue;
            }

            $rulesStr = implode("; ", $rules) . ";";
            
            // Regras adicionais em cascata para elementos de texto internos (headings e parágrafos)
            $textRules = [];
            foreach ($rules as $r) {
                if (
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-size:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-weight:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'font-family:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'text-align:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'line-height:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'letter-spacing:') ||
                    str_starts_with($r, 'color:')
                ) {
                    $textRules[] = $r;
                }
            }
            $textCascadeStr = '';
            if (!empty($textRules)) {
                $textInnerRules = implode("; ", $textRules) . ";";
                $textSelector = "{$elementSelector} h1, {$elementSelector} h2, {$elementSelector} h3, {$elementSelector} h4, {$elementSelector} h5, {$elementSelector} h6, {$elementSelector} p, {$elementSelector} .ds-block-heading, {$elementSelector} .ds-block-paragraph";
                $textCascadeStr = " {$textSelector} { {$textInnerRules} }";
            }

            $mediaQuery = $config['media'];
            $classSelector = $config['class'];

            $output .= "{$mediaQuery} { {$elementSelector} { {$rulesStr} }{$textCascadeStr} } ";
            $output .= "{$classSelector} { {$rulesStr} } ";
        }

        return trim($output);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    private function buildDeviceRules(array $data, string $device): array
    {
        $rules = [];
        $suffix = "_{$device}";

        // Margem e Padding
        if (!empty($data['margin' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'margin: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['margin' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['padding' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'padding: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['padding' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Flex & Flexbox
        if (!empty($data['display' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'display: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['display' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['flex_direction' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'flex-direction: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['flex_direction' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['justify_content' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'justify-content: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['justify_content' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['align_items' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'align-items: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['align_items' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['gap' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'gap: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['gap' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Dimensões
        if (!empty($data['width' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['width' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['max_width' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'max-width: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['max_width' . $suffix]);
        }

        // Tipografia, Cores & Alinhamento
        if (!empty($data['font_size' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-size: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_size' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_weight' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'font-weight: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_weight' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['font_family' . $suffix])) {
            $ff = $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['font_family' . $suffix]);
            $resolved = match ($ff) {
                'secondary' => 'var(--font-secondary, monospace)',
                'tertiary'  => 'var(--font-tertiary, sans-serif)',
                'primary'   => 'var(--font-primary, sans-serif)',
                default     => $ff,
            };
            $rules[] = 'font-family: ' . $resolved;
        }
        if (!empty($data['color' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['color' . $suffix]);
        } elseif (!empty($data['text_color' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'color: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['text_color' . $suffix]);
        }
        $textAlign = !empty($data['text_align' . $suffix]) ? (string)$data['text_align' . $suffix] : (!empty($data['align' . $suffix]) ? (string)$data['align' . $suffix] : '');
        if ($textAlign !== '') {
            $rules[] = 'text-align: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue($textAlign);
        }
        if (!empty($data['line_height' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'line-height: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['line_height' . $suffix]);
        }
        if (!empty($data['letter_spacing' . $suffix])) {
            $rules[] = 'letter-spacing: ' . $this->sanitizeCssValue((string)$data['letter_spacing' . $suffix]);
        }

        return $rules;
    }
}

            : null;

        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getBorderStyle(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['border_style']) ? (string)$this->styleData['border_style'] : null;
    }

    public function getBorderWidth(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['border_width'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getBorderRadius(): ?DimensionValue
    {
        $raw = $this->styleData['border_radius'] ?? null;
        return $raw !== null ? DimensionValue::fromString((string)$raw) : null;
    }

    public function getShadowPreset(): string
    {
        return (string)($this->styleData['shadow_preset'] ?? ShadowContractInterface::SHADOW_NONE);
    }

    public function getBoxShadowCss(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['box_shadow']) ? (string)$this->styleData['box_shadow'] : null;
    }

    public function getHoverEffect(): ?string
    {
        return isset($this->styleData['hover_animation']) 
            ? (string)$this->styleData['hover_animation'] 
            : (isset($this->styleData['hover_effect']) ? (string)$this->styleData['hover_effect'] : null);

    }

    public function getTimingFunction(): ?string
    {
        return (string)($this->styleData['timing_function'] ?? 'ease');
    }

    public function getStyleProperties(): array
    {
        return $this->styleData;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/ColorValue.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use JsonSerializable;

/**
 * Value Object imutável que representa uma cor CSS tipada (Design Token, Hex, RGBA, Gradiente ou Transparente).
 * Garante a filosofia "Token-First" e higienização estrita contra injeção de CSS (SOLID - Ring 0).
 */
final class ColorValue implements JsonSerializable
{
    public const TYPE_TOKEN       = 'token';
    public const TYPE_HEX         = 'hex';
    public const TYPE_RGB         = 'rgb';
    public const TYPE_GRADIENT    = 'gradient';
    public const TYPE_TRANSPARENT = 'transparent';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $type,
        private readonly string $value,
        private readonly ?string $tokenName = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromToken(string $tokenName, ?string $fallback = null): self
    {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($tokenName));
        $clean = preg_replace('/^var\(--|\)$/', '', $clean) ?? $clean;

        if (str_contains($clean, ',')) {
            $parts = explode(',', $clean, 2);
            $clean = trim($parts[0]);
            if ($fallback === null) {
                $fallback = trim($parts[1]);
            }
        }

        $clean = ltrim($clean, '-');

        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9_-]+$/', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Nome de Design Token inválido: '{$tokenName}'.");
        }

        if ($fallback !== null && $fallback !== '') {
            $sanitizedFallback = preg_replace('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', '', $fallback) ?? '';
            return new self(self::TYPE_TOKEN, "var(--{$clean}, {$sanitizedFallback})", $clean);
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_TOKEN, "var(--{$clean})", $clean);
    }

    public static function fromHex(string $hex): self
    {
        $clean = trim($hex);
        if (!preg_match('/^#([a-f0-9]{3,4}|[a-f0-9]{6}|[a-f0-9]{8})$/i', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Formato hexadecimal de cor inválido: '{$hex}'.");
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_HEX, $clean);
    }

    public static function fromRgba(int $r, int $g, int $b, float $a = 1.0): self
    {
        $r = max(0, min(255, $r));
        $g = max(0, min(255, $g));
        $b = max(0, min(255, $b));
        $a = max(0.0, min(1.0, $a));

        $val = $a < 1.0 ? "rgba({$r}, {$g}, {$b}, {$a})" : "rgb({$r}, {$g}, {$b})";
        return new self(self::TYPE_RGB, $val);
    }

    public static function transparent(): self
    {
        return new self(self::TYPE_TRANSPARENT, 'transparent');
    }

    public static function fromGradient(string $gradient): self
    {
        $clean = trim($gradient);
        // Higieniza contra injeção
        if (preg_match('/[;<>{}\\\\]/', $clean) || !preg_match('/^(linear|radial|conic)-gradient\(.+\)$/i', $clean)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Declaração de gradiente CSS inválida.");
        }

        return new self(self::TYPE_GRADIENT, $clean);
    }

    /**
     * Faz o parse automático de uma string de cor (Token, Hex, RGBA, Gradiente ou Palavra-chave).
     */
    public static function fromString(string $raw): self
    {
        $clean = trim($raw);
        if ($clean === '' || $clean === 'transparent') {
            return self::transparent();
        }

        // Caso 1: Design Token explícito ex: var(--primary)
        if (str_starts_with($clean, 'var(--') && str_ends_with($clean, ')')) {
            $token = substr($clean, 6, -1);
            return self::fromToken($token);
        }

        // Caso 2: Hexadecimal (#fff, #45f3ff)
        if (str_starts_with($clean, '#')) {
            return self::fromHex($clean);
        }

        // Caso 3: Nome de token sem var() ex: "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "color-primary", "text_main"
        $knownTokens = [
            'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'background', 'surface', 'text_main', 'text_muted', 'border', 'accent',
            'color-primary', 'color-secondary', 'color-tertiary', 'color-background', 'color-surface',
            'color-text-main', 'color-text-muted', 'color-border', 'color-accent',
            'text-main', 'text-muted', 'bg-color',
        ];
        if (in_array(strtolower($clean), $knownTokens, true)) {
            return self::fromToken($clean);
        }

        // Caso 4: RGB / RGBA / HSL
        if (preg_match('/^(rgba?|hsla?)\([0-9.,% ]+\)$/i', $clean)) {
            return new self(self::TYPE_RGB, $clean);
        }

        // Caso 5: Gradiente
        if (preg_match('/^(linear|radial|conic)-gradient\(/i', $clean)) {
            return self::fromGradient($clean);
        }

        // Caso 6: Palavras-chave CSS permitidas
        if (in_array(strtolower($clean), ['currentcolor', 'inherit', 'initial'], true)) {
            return new self(self::TYPE_TRANSPARENT, strtolower($clean));
        }

        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Formato de cor não suportado: '{$raw}'.");
    }

    public function getType(): string
    {
        return $this->type;
    }

    public function isToken(): bool
    {
        return $this->type === self::TYPE_TOKEN;
    }

    public function getTokenName(): ?string
    {
        return $this->tokenName;
    }

    public function toCss(): string
    {
        return $this->value;
    }

    public function getCssValue(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'type'       => $this->type,
            'value'      => $this->value,
            'token_name' => $this->tokenName,
            'is_token'   => $this->isToken(),
        ];
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return $this->toArray();
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/CssUnit.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

/**
 * Unidades CSS suportadas pelo construtor visual com tipagem forte (SOLID - Ring 0).
 */
enum CssUnit: string
{
    // Absolutas / Pixels
    case PX = 'px';
    case CM = 'cm';
    case MM = 'mm';
    case PT = 'pt';
    case IN = 'in';

    // Relativas ao Container / Layout
    case PERCENT = '%';
    case AUTO = 'auto';
    case FIT_CONTENT = 'fit-content';
    case MIN_CONTENT = 'min-content';
    case MAX_CONTENT = 'max-content';

    // Relativas à Viewport (Tela)
    case VH = 'vh';
    case VW = 'vw';
    case VMIN = 'vmin';
    case VMAX = 'vmax';

    // Tipográficas / Escalares
    case REM = 'rem';
    case EM = 'em';
    case CH = 'ch';

    /**
     * Tenta identificar a unidade a partir de uma string (ex: "px", "%", "vh").
     */
    public static function tryFromString(string $raw): ?self
    {
        $clean = strtolower(trim($raw));
        return self::tryFrom($clean);
    }

    /**
     * Retorna se a unidade é de valor numérico dimensional.
     */
    public function isNumeric(): bool
    {
        return !in_array($this, [self::AUTO, self::FIT_CONTENT, self::MIN_CONTENT, self::MAX_CONTENT], true);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Styles/Values/DimensionValue.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\Values;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use JsonSerializable;

/**
 * Value Object imutável que representa uma dimensão CSS tipada (largura, altura, margem, etc.).
 * Segue Ring 0 e valida todas as unidades sem risco de injeção CSS.
 */
final class DimensionValue implements JsonSerializable
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly float $amount,
        private readonly CssUnit $unit
    ) {}

    public static function px(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::PX);
    }

    public static function percent(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::PERCENT);
    }

    public static function rem(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::REM);
    }

    public static function em(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::EM);
    }

    public static function vh(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::VH);
    }

    public static function vw(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::VW);
    }

    public static function cm(float $amount): self
    {
        return new self($amount, CssUnit::CM);
    }

    public static function auto(): self
    {
        return new self(0.0, CssUnit::AUTO);
    }

    public static function fitContent(): self
    {
        return new self(0.0, CssUnit::FIT_CONTENT);
    }

    /**
     * Faz o parse seguro de uma string CSS dimensional (ex: "100vh", "50%", "24px", "2.5cm", "auto").
     */
    public static function fromString(string $raw): self
    {
        $clean = trim($raw);
        if ($clean === '' || $clean === '0') {
            return new self(0.0, CssUnit::PX);
        }

        $lower = strtolower($clean);

        // Keywords sem número
        if ($lower === 'auto') return self::auto();
        if ($lower === 'fit-content') return self::fitContent();
        if ($lower === 'min-content') return new self(0.0, CssUnit::MIN_CONTENT);
        if ($lower === 'max-content') return new self(0.0, CssUnit::MAX_CONTENT);

        // Extrai número e unidade via regex seguro
        if (preg_match('/^([+-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*([a-z%]*)$/i', $clean, $matches)) {
            $amount = (float)$matches[1];
            $unitStr = strtolower(trim($matches[2]));

            if ($unitStr === '') {
                $unit = CssUnit::PX; // Default para pixels
            } else {
                $unit = CssUnit::tryFromString($unitStr);
                if ($unit === null) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unidade CSS não suportada: '{$unitStr}'.");
                }
            }

            return new self($amount, $unit);
        }

        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Valor de dimensão CSS inválido: '{$raw}'.");
    }

    public function getAmount(): float
    {
        return $this->amount;
    }

    public function getUnit(): CssUnit
    {
        return $this->unit;
    }

    public function toCss(): string
    {
        if (!$this->unit->isNumeric()) {
            return $this->unit->value;
        }

        // Formata float removendo zeros à direita desnecessários (ex: 2.0 -> 2, 2.5 -> 2.5)
        $formatted = (string)(fmod($this->amount, 1.0) === 0.0 ? (int)$this->amount : $this->amount);
        return $formatted . $this->unit->value;
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->toCss();
    }

    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'amount' => $this->amount,
            'unit'   => $this->unit->value,
            'css'    => $this->toCss(),
        ];
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return $this->toArray();
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Support/BaseUrlResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;

/**
 * Resolvedor padrão de URLs públicas baseado na configuração de ambiente / BASE_URL.
 */
class BaseUrlResolver implements PublicUrlResolverInterface
{
    private ?string $explicitBaseUrl;

    public function __construct(?string $explicitBaseUrl = null)
    {
        $this->explicitBaseUrl = $explicitBaseUrl !== null ? rtrim($explicitBaseUrl, '/') : null;
    }

    public function getBaseUrl(): string
    {
        if ($this->explicitBaseUrl !== null) {
            return $this->explicitBaseUrl;
        }

        return defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim((string)BASE_URL, '/') : '';
    }

    public function resolve(string $path = ''): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($path);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            $base = $this->getBaseUrl();
            return $base !== '' ? $base . '/' : '/';
        }

        // URLs absolutas ou âncoras permanecem intactas
        if (
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'http://') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'https://') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, '//') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, '#') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'mailto:') ||
            str_starts_with($trimmed, 'tel:')
        ) {
            return $trimmed;
        }

        $base = $this->getBaseUrl();
        if ($base !== '' && str_starts_with($trimmed, $base . '/')) {
            return $trimmed;
        }

        return $base . '/' . ltrim($trimmed, '/');
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Support/MenuTreeBuilder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuTreeBuilderInterface;

/**
 * Construtor de Árvore Hierárquica de Menus e Submenus (Walker SOLID).
 *
 * Suporta tanto hierarquia por `parent_id` (banco relacional) quanto por
 * `depth` sequencial (estilo wpNavMenu drag-and-drop) ou arrays `children` pré-aninhados.
 */
final class MenuTreeBuilder implements MenuTreeBuilderInterface
{
    public function buildTree(array $items): array
    {
        if (empty($items)) {
            return [];
        }

        // Normaliza cada item garantindo chaves padrões
        $normalized = [];
        $hasExplicitParentIds = false;
        $hasExplicitDepths = false;

        foreach (array_values($items) as $idx => $raw) {
            if (!is_array($raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $id = isset($raw['id']) && (int)$raw['id'] > 0 ? (int)$raw['id'] : ($idx + 1);
            $parentId = isset($raw['parent_id']) && (int)$raw['parent_id'] > 0 ? (int)$raw['parent_id'] : null;
            $depth = isset($raw['depth']) ? max(0, (int)$raw['depth']) : 0;

            if ($parentId !== null) {
                $hasExplicitParentIds = true;
            }
            if ($depth > 0) {
                $hasExplicitDepths = true;
            }

            $children = [];
            if (!empty($raw['children']) && is_array($raw['children'])) {
                $children = $this->buildTree($raw['children']);
            }

            $normalized[] = [
                'id'          => $id,
                'parent_id'   => $parentId,
                'depth'       => $depth,
                'title'       => (string)($raw['title'] ?? ''),
                'url'         => (string)($raw['url'] ?? '#'),
                'page_id'     => !empty($raw['page_id']) ? (int)$raw['page_id'] : null,
                'target'      => (string)($raw['target'] ?? '_self'),
                'css_classes' => (string)($raw['css_classes'] ?? ''),
                'order_index' => isset($raw['order_index']) ? (int)$raw['order_index'] : $idx,
                'children'    => $children,
            ];
        }

        // Se existir parent_id explícito, monta a árvore por referência de ID pai
        if ($hasExplicitParentIds) {
            return $this->buildByParentId($normalized);
        }

        // Se existir depth sequencial (> 0), monta a árvore por pilha de profundidade (wpNavMenu)
        if ($hasExplicitDepths) {
            return $this->buildByDepthStack($normalized);
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function buildByParentId(array $items): array
    {
        $byId = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $byId[(int)$item['id']] = $item;
        }

        $tree = [];
        foreach ($byId as $id => &$node) {
            $parentId = $node['parent_id'];
            if ($parentId !== null && $parentId !== $id && isset($byId[$parentId])) {
                $byId[$parentId]['children'][] = &$node;
            } else {
                $tree[] = &$node;
            }
        }
        unset($node);

        return $tree;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function buildByDepthStack(array $items): array
    {
        $root = [];
        /** @var array<int, array<string, mixed>> $stack */
        $stack = [];

        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $depth = (int)$item['depth'];
            if ($depth <= 0 || empty($stack)) {
                $item['depth'] = 0;
                $root[] = $item;
                $stack = [0 => &$root[ count($root) - 1 ]];
                continue;
            }

            // Garante que a profundidade não salte mais que 1 nível em relação ao último pai válido
            $parentDepth = min($depth - 1, max(array_keys($stack)));
            while (count($stack) > $parentDepth + 1) {
                array_pop($stack);
            }

            $parent = &$stack[$parentDepth];
            $parent['children'][] = $item;
            $newChildIdx = count($parent['children']) - 1;
            $stack[$parentDepth + 1] = &$parent['children'][$newChildIdx];
            unset($parent);
        }

        return $root;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Support/SafeHtmlSanitizer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;

/**
 * Sanitizador de HTML inline contra XSS (atributos on*, javascript:, vbscript:, data:).
 */
class SafeHtmlSanitizer implements HtmlSanitizerInterface
{
    private const ALLOWED_TAGS = '<strong><b><em><i><u><a><code><br><span>';

    public function sanitizeInlineHtml(string $html): string
    {
        if (trim($html) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // 1. Mantém apenas a whitelist de tags inline
        $stripped = strip_tags($html, self::ALLOWED_TAGS);

        // 2. Sanitiza atributos dentro de cada tag sobrevivente
        $sanitized = preg_replace_callback(
            '/<(\/?)([a-zA-Z0-9]+)([^>]*)>/s',
            function (array $matches): string {
                $closing = $matches[1];
                $tag = strtolower($matches[2]);
                $rawAttrs = $matches[3];

                if ($closing === '/') {
                    return "</{$tag}>";
                }

                if ($tag === 'br') {
                    return '<br>';
                }

                $safeAttrs = $this->sanitizeAttributes($tag, $rawAttrs);
                return $safeAttrs !== '' ? "<{$tag} {$safeAttrs}>" : "<{$tag}>";
            },
            $stripped
        );

        return $sanitized ?? '';
    }

    private function sanitizeAttributes(string $tag, string $rawAttrs): string
    {
        if (trim($rawAttrs) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        $cleanPairs = [];
        // Captura pares nome="valor", nome='valor' ou nome=valor
        if (preg_match_all('/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'|([^\s"\'=<>`]+))/s', $rawAttrs, $attrMatches, PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
            foreach ($attrMatches as $attr) {
                $name = strtolower($attr[1]);
                $value = $attr[2] !== '' ? $attr[2] : ($attr[3] !== '' ? $attr[3] : ($attr[4] ?? ''));

                // Bloqueia incondicionalmente qualquer evento inline (onclick, onmouseover, onerror, etc.)
                if (str_starts_with($name, 'on')) {
                    continue;
                }

                if ($tag === 'a' && in_array($name, ['href', 'target', 'rel', 'title', 'class'], true)) {
                    if ($name === 'href') {
                        if (!$this->isSafeUrl($value)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                    $escaped = htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                    $cleanPairs[] = "{$name}=\"{$escaped}\"";
                } elseif (in_array($name, ['class', 'title'], true)) {
                    $escaped = htmlspecialchars($value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                    $cleanPairs[] = "{$name}=\"{$escaped}\"";
                } elseif ($name === 'style') {
                    $safeStyle = $this->sanitizeInlineStyle($value);
                    if ($safeStyle !== '') {
                        $escaped = htmlspecialchars($safeStyle, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                        $cleanPairs[] = "style=\"{$escaped}\"";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return implode(' ', $cleanPairs);
    }

    public function sanitizeUrl(string $url, string $fallback = '#'): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($url);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            return $fallback;
        }

        if (!$this->isSafeUrl($trimmed)) {
            return $fallback;
        }

        return $trimmed;
    }

    private function isSafeUrl(string $url): bool
    {
        $decoded = html_entity_decode($url, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
        // Remove caracteres de controle e espaços invisíveis
        $normalized = trim(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x20]+/', '', $decoded) ?? '');
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $lower = strtolower($normalized);

        // Bloqueia URLs protocol-relative (//dominio-externo) ou com barras invertidas de evasão
        if (str_starts_with($lower, '//') || str_contains($lower, '\\')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Se possuir esquema explícito (ex: http:, https:, mailto:, javascript:, data:, file:), exige whitelist positiva
        if (preg_match('/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*):/i', $lower, $matches)) {
            $scheme = strtolower($matches[1]);
            if (!in_array($scheme, ['http', 'https', 'mailto', 'tel'], true)) {
                return false;
            }
            if (in_array($scheme, ['http', 'https'], true) && !preg_match('/^https?:\/\/[a-z0-9]/i', $normalized)) {
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Se contiver dois-pontos antes de qualquer '/', '?' ou '#' (tentativa de esquema ofuscado), bloqueia
        $firstColon = strpos($lower, ':');
        if ($firstColon !== false) {
            $firstSlash = strpos($lower, '/');
            $firstQuery = strpos($lower, '?');
            $firstHash  = strpos($lower, '#');
            $firstDelimiter = min(array_filter([$firstSlash, $firstQuery, $firstHash], static fn($v) => $v !== false) ?: [PHP_INT_MAX]);
            if ($firstColon < $firstDelimiter) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function sanitizeInlineStyle(string $style): string
    {
        $decoded = strtolower(html_entity_decode($style, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8'));
        if (
            str_contains($decoded, 'expression(') ||
            str_contains($decoded, 'javascript:') ||
            str_contains($decoded, 'vbscript:') ||
            str_contains($decoded, 'url(') ||
            str_contains($decoded, '@import')
        ) {
            return '';
        }

        return preg_replace('/[<>\\\\{}]/', '', trim($style)) ?? '';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Tree/LayerTreeBuilder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Tree;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayerTreeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;

/**
 * Construtor da Árvore de Camadas e Hierarquias (Layers / Navigator).
 * 
 * Implementa o contrato LayerTreeInterface para fornecer a estrutura em árvore completa
 * de seções, colunas e blocos, no padrão Navigator do Elementor.
 */
class LayerTreeBuilder implements LayerTreeInterface
{
    private ?LayoutGridInterface $gridRenderer;
    private ?BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry;

    public function __construct(
        ?LayoutGridInterface $gridRenderer = null,
        ?BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry = null
    ) {
        $this->gridRenderer = $gridRenderer;
        $this->blockRegistry = $blockRegistry;
    }

    public function buildTree(ThemePartInterface $part): array
    {
        $sections = $part->getSections();
        $sectionNodes = [];
        $totalColumns = 0;
        $totalBlocks = 0;

        foreach ($sections as $sIdx => $sec) {
            $presetKey = (string)($sec['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
            $secTitle = (string)($sec['title'] ?? ('Seção ' . ($sIdx + 1)));
            $secId = (string)($sec['id'] ?? ('sec_' . $sIdx));
            $containerSettings = (array)($sec['container_settings'] ?? []);
            $columnsData = (array)($sec['columns_data'] ?? []);

            $numCols = 1;
            if ($this->gridRenderer !== null) {
                $presets = $this->gridRenderer->getPresets();
                if (isset($presets[$presetKey]['columns'])) {
                    $numCols = (int)$presets[$presetKey]['columns'];
                }
            } elseif (preg_match('/^(\d+)_col/', $presetKey, $m)) {
                $numCols = (int)$m[1];
            }

            $columnNodes = [];
            for ($cIdx = 0; $cIdx < $numCols; $cIdx++) {
                $totalColumns++;
                $blocksInCol = (array)($columnsData[$cIdx] ?? []);
                $blockNodes = [];

                foreach ($blocksInCol as $bIdx => $bData) {
                    $totalBlocks++;
                    $bType = (string)($bData['type'] ?? 'unknown');
                    $bMeta = $this->resolveBlockMeta($bType);

                    $blockNodes[] = [
                        'id'         => "{$secId}_col_{$cIdx}_block_{$bIdx}",
                        'type'       => 'block',
                        'block_type' => $bType,
                        'name'       => $bMeta['name'],
                        'icon'       => $bMeta['icon'],
                        'sec_index'  => $sIdx,
                        'col_index'  => $cIdx,
                        'block_index'=> $bIdx,
                        'data'       => (array)($bData['data'] ?? []),
                    ];
                }

                $columnNodes[] = [
                    'id'          => "{$secId}_col_{$cIdx}",
                    'type'        => 'column',
                    'index'       => $cIdx,
                    'name'        => 'Célula ' . ($cIdx + 1),
                    'total_blocks'=> count($blockNodes),
                    'children'    => $blockNodes,
                ];
            }

            $sectionNodes[] = [
                'id'                 => $secId,
                'type'               => 'section',
                'index'              => $sIdx,
                'name'               => $secTitle,
                'preset'             => $presetKey,
                'container_settings' => $containerSettings,
                'total_columns'      => count($columnNodes),
                'children'           => $columnNodes,
            ];
        }

        return [
            'id'       => 'part_' . $part->getId(),
            'type'     => 'root',
            'name'     => $part->getTitle(),
            'category' => $part->getType(),
            'counts'   => [
                'sections' => count($sectionNodes),
                'columns'  => $totalColumns,
                'blocks'   => $totalBlocks,
            ],
            'children' => $sectionNodes,
        ];
    }

    public function getCounts(ThemePartInterface $part): array
    {
        $tree = $this->buildTree($part);
        return $tree['counts'];
    }

    public function validateDepth(string $partType, int $sectionCount): bool
    {
        $max = match ($partType) {
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER => self::MAX_SECTIONS_HEADER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER => self::MAX_SECTIONS_FOOTER,
            default                         => self::MAX_SECTIONS_DEFAULT,
        };

        return $sectionCount <= $max;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{name: string, icon: string}
     */
    private function resolveBlockMeta(string $type): array
    {
        if ($this->blockRegistry !== null) {
            $block = $this->blockRegistry->get($type);
            if ($block !== null) {
                return [
                    'name' => $block->getName(),
                    'icon' => $block->getIcon(),
                ];
            }
        }

        $fallbacks = [
            'heading'     => ['name' => 'Título', 'icon' => '🔤'],
            'paragraph'   => ['name' => 'Texto', 'icon' => '📄'],
            'image'       => ['name' => 'Imagem', 'icon' => '🖼️'],
            'cta_button'  => ['name' => 'Botão CTA', 'icon' => '🚀'],
            'nav_menu'    => ['name' => 'Menu de Navegação', 'icon' => '🧭'],
            'logo'        => ['name' => 'Logotipo', 'icon' => '🏷️'],
            'divider'     => ['name' => 'Divisor', 'icon' => '➖'],
            'video'       => ['name' => 'Vídeo', 'icon' => '🎥'],
            'shortcode'   => ['name' => 'Shortcode', 'icon' => '⚡'],
            'copyright'   => ['name' => 'Copyright', 'icon' => '©️'],
            'custom_code' => ['name' => 'HTML / Código', 'icon' => '💻'],
        ];

        return $fallbacks[$type] ?? ['name' => ucfirst($type), 'icon' => '📦'];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/Parts/Validation/ThemePartValidator.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Validation;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartValidatorInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Validador estrutural de partes visuais do Flex Builder.
 *
 * Garante que tipo, presets, seções, colunas, blocos, compatibilidade por área
 * e limites de profundidade/tamanho sejam estritamente verificados antes de qualquer gravação.
 */
final class ThemePartValidator implements ThemePartValidatorInterface
{
    public const MAX_TITLE_LENGTH = 255;
    public const MAX_ID_LENGTH = 128;
    public const MAX_SECTIONS = 50;
    public const MAX_COLUMNS_PER_SECTION = 12;
    public const MAX_BLOCKS_PER_COLUMN = 100;
    public const MAX_DATA_DEPTH = 10;

    private ?BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry;
    private ?LayoutGridInterface $layoutGrid;

    public function __construct(
        ?BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry = null,
        ?LayoutGridInterface $layoutGrid = null
    ) {
        $this->blockRegistry = $blockRegistry;
        $this->layoutGrid = $layoutGrid;
    }

    public function validate(array $payload): void
    {
        // 1. Validação do ID (quando informado)
        if (isset($payload['id']) && $payload['id'] !== '') {
            if (!is_string($payload['id']) && !is_numeric($payload['id'])) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O identificador da parte visual (id) deve ser uma string válida.');
            }
            $id = trim((string)$payload['id']);
            if ($id !== '') {
                if (strlen($id) > self::MAX_ID_LENGTH || !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.\-]+$/', $id)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException('Identificador da parte visual (id) contém caracteres inválidos ou excede o tamanho máximo.');
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Validação estrita do tipo da parte
        $type = (string)($payload['type'] ?? ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        $validTypes = [
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
        ];
        if (!in_array($type, $validTypes, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de parte visual inválido: '{$type}'. Valores permitidos: header, footer, section.");
        }

        // 3. Validação do título
        if (isset($payload['title'])) {
            if (!is_scalar($payload['title'])) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O título da parte visual deve ser um texto válido.');
            }
            $title = trim((string)$payload['title']);
            if (mb_strlen($title, 'UTF-8') > self::MAX_TITLE_LENGTH) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O título da parte visual excede o limite de ' . self::MAX_TITLE_LENGTH . ' caracteres.');
            }
        }

        // 4. Validação do estilo e alinhamento do toggle mobile
        if (isset($payload['mobile_toggle_style']) && $payload['mobile_toggle_style'] !== '') {
            $toggleStyle = (string)$payload['mobile_toggle_style'];
            if (!in_array($toggleStyle, MobileToggleStyleInterface::ALL_TOGGLE_STYLES, true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Estilo de toggle mobile inválido: '{$toggleStyle}'.");
            }
        }

        if (isset($payload['mobile_toggle_align']) && $payload['mobile_toggle_align'] !== '') {
            $toggleAlign = (string)$payload['mobile_toggle_align'];
            if (!in_array($toggleAlign, ['left', 'center', 'right'], true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Alinhamento de toggle mobile inválido: '{$toggleAlign}'.");
            }
        }

        // 5. Validação do preset principal
        $rootPreset = (string)($payload['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
        $this->validatePreset($rootPreset);

        // 6. Validação de container_settings e columns_data raiz
        if (isset($payload['container_settings']) && !is_array($payload['container_settings'])) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo container_settings deve ser um array.');
        }

        if (isset($payload['columns_data'])) {
            if (!is_array($payload['columns_data'])) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo columns_data deve ser um array.');
            }
            $this->validateColumnsData($payload['columns_data'], $type);
        }

        // 7. Validação das seções (sections)
        if (isset($payload['sections'])) {
            if (!is_array($payload['sections'])) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo sections deve ser uma lista de seções.');
            }
            if (count($payload['sections']) > self::MAX_SECTIONS) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('O documento excede o limite máximo de ' . self::MAX_SECTIONS . ' seções.');
            }

            foreach ($payload['sections'] as $secIndex => $section) {
                if (!is_array($section)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("A seção na posição {$secIndex} possui formato inválido.");
                }

                $secPreset = (string)($section['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
                $this->validatePreset($secPreset);

                if (isset($section['container_settings']) && !is_array($section['container_settings'])) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("O campo container_settings da seção {$secIndex} deve ser um array.");
                }

                if (isset($section['columns_data'])) {
                    if (!is_array($section['columns_data'])) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException("O campo columns_data da seção {$secIndex} deve ser um array.");
                    }
                    $this->validateColumnsData($section['columns_data'], $type);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function validatePreset(string $preset): void
    {
        if (trim($preset) === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O preset de layout não pode ser vazio.');
        }

        if ($this->layoutGrid !== null) {
            $presets = $this->layoutGrid->getPresets();
            if (!empty($presets) && !array_key_exists($preset, $presets)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Preset de layout inexistente ou não suportado: '{$preset}'.");
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int|string, mixed> $columnsData
     */
    private function validateColumnsData(array $columnsData, string $partType): void
    {
        if (count($columnsData) > self::MAX_COLUMNS_PER_SECTION) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A seção excede o limite máximo de ' . self::MAX_COLUMNS_PER_SECTION . ' colunas.');
        }

        foreach ($columnsData as $colIndex => $blocksList) {
            if (!is_array($blocksList)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Os blocos da coluna {$colIndex} devem ser fornecidos em uma lista.");
            }
            if (count($blocksList) > self::MAX_BLOCKS_PER_COLUMN) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("A coluna {$colIndex} excede o limite máximo de " . self::MAX_BLOCKS_PER_COLUMN . " blocos.");
            }

            foreach ($blocksList as $blockIndex => $blockDef) {
                if (!is_array($blockDef)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Definição de bloco inválida na coluna {$colIndex}, posição {$blockIndex}.");
                }

                $blockType = trim((string)($blockDef['type'] ?? ''));
                if ($blockType === '') {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Bloco sem tipo ('type') na coluna {$colIndex}, posição {$blockIndex}.");
                }

                $blockData = $blockDef['data'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($blockData)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("O campo 'data' do bloco '{$blockType}' deve ser um array.");
                }

                $this->assertArrayDepth($blockData, 1);

                if ($this->blockRegistry !== null) {
                    $block = $this->blockRegistry->get($blockType);
                    if ($block === null) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException("Bloco desconhecido ou não registrado: '{$blockType}'.");
                    }

                    $allowedPartTypes = $block->getAllowedPartTypes();
                    if (!empty($allowedPartTypes) && !in_array($partType, $allowedPartTypes, true)) {
                        throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                            "O bloco '{$blockType}' não é compatível com partes do tipo '{$partType}'."
                        );
                    }

                    $schema = $block->getSchema();
                    $schemaFields = (array)($schema['fields'] ?? []);
                    foreach ($schemaFields as $fieldKey => $fieldSpec) {
                        if (!array_key_exists($fieldKey, $blockData) || $blockData[$fieldKey] === null) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        $val = $blockData[$fieldKey];
                        if (is_object($val) || is_resource($val)) {
                            throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                                "O campo '{$fieldKey}' do bloco '{$blockType}' possui um tipo de valor inválido."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<mixed> $data
     */
    private function assertArrayDepth(array $data, int $currentDepth): void
    {
        if ($currentDepth > self::MAX_DATA_DEPTH) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('A estrutura de dados do bloco excede a profundidade máxima permitida (' . self::MAX_DATA_DEPTH . ').');
        }

        foreach ($data as $value) {
            if (is_array($value)) {
                $this->assertArrayDepth($value, $currentDepth + 1);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/SafeThemeResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface;

/**
 * Resolvedor seguro de diretórios de temas.
 * Suporta múltiplos diretórios de busca (raiz /themes e /src/Plugins/flextheme/themes)
 * e previne falhas 404 caso o tema configurado não exista fisicamente no disco.
 */
class SafeThemeResolver implements ThemePathResolverInterface
{
    /** @var array<string> */
    private array $searchPaths = [];

    /**
     * @param string|array<string> $themesBasePath Um ou mais caminhos base de temas
     */
    public function __construct(string|array $themesBasePath)
    {
        $paths = is_array($themesBasePath) ? $themesBasePath : [$themesBasePath];
        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            $this->searchPaths[] = rtrim($path, '/\\');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolve o caminho absoluto do tema solicitado, com fallback resiliente para 'default'.
     */
    public function resolveThemePath(string $requestedTheme): string
    {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $requestedTheme);

        if (!empty($sanitized)) {
            foreach ($this->searchPaths as $basePath) {
                $candidate = $basePath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $sanitized;
                if (is_dir($candidate)) {
                    return $candidate;
                }
            }
        }

        // Fallback 1: Tema 'default' em qualquer um dos caminhos de busca
        foreach ($this->searchPaths as $basePath) {
            $defaultPath = $basePath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'default';
            if (is_dir($defaultPath)) {
                return $defaultPath;
            }
        }

        // Fallback 2: Primeiro tema válido encontrado nos diretórios
        foreach ($this->searchPaths as $basePath) {
            $dirs = glob($basePath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . '*', GLOB_ONLYDIR);
            if (!empty($dirs)) {
                return $dirs[0];
            }
        }

        return !empty($this->searchPaths) ? $this->searchPaths[0] : '';
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se um tema específico existe fisicamente nos diretórios configurados.
     */
    public function themeExists(string $themeName): bool
    {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $themeName);
        if (empty($sanitized)) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($this->searchPaths as $basePath) {
            $candidate = $basePath . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $sanitized;
            if (is_dir($candidate)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/ShortcodeManager.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ShortcodeManagerInterface;

class ShortcodeManager implements ShortcodeManagerInterface
{
    /**
     * @var array Registros de shortcodes no formato:
     * [
     *     'tag' => [
     *         'callback' => callable,
     *         'description' => 'Descrição do que faz',
     *         'attributes' => ['attr1' => 'descrição do attr1'],
     *         'category' => 'Geral'
     *     ]
     * ]
     */
    private array $shortcodes = [];
    private ?ContainerInterface $container;

    public function __construct(?ContainerInterface $container = null)
    {
        $this->container = $container;
    }

    /**
     * Registra um novo shortcode.
     */
    public function add(string $tag, callable|array $callback, string $description = '', array $attributes = [], string $category = 'Geral'): void
    {
        $this->shortcodes[$tag] = [
            'callback' => $callback,
            'description' => $description,
            'attributes' => $attributes,
            'category' => $category,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Retorna a lista de todos os shortcodes registrados e suas documentações.
     * Ideal para criar um "Catálogo de Shortcodes" no painel admin.
     *
     * @return array
     */
    public function getRegisteredShortcodes(): array
    {
        return $this->shortcodes;
    }

    /**
     * Procura shortcodes em uma string e os substitui pelo resultado de seus callbacks.
     *
     * @param string $content O conteúdo bruto (HTML do Tema).
     * @return string O conteúdo processado com as injeções feitas.
     */
    public function parse(string $content): string
    {
        if (empty($this->shortcodes)) {
            return $content;
        }

        // Ordenar tags por tamanho decrescente para que 'modal_perfil' não dê match em 'modal'
        $tagNames = array_keys($this->shortcodes);
        usort($tagNames, function($a, $b) { return strlen($b) - strlen($a); });
        
        $tags = implode('|', array_map('preg_quote', $tagNames));
        
        // Match: [tag attr="val"] inner content [/tag] ou apenas [tag attr="val"]
        $pattern = '/\[(' . $tags . ')(?=\s|\])([^\]]*?)\](?:(.*?)\[\/\1\])?/s';

        return preg_replace_callback($pattern, [$this, 'processTag'], $content);
    }

    /**
     * Callback interno usado pelo preg_replace_callback para processar uma tag encontrada.
     */
    private function processTag(array $matches): string
    {
        $tag = $matches[1];
        $attributesString = $matches[2] ?? '';
        $innerContent = isset($matches[3]) ? $matches[3] : null;
        
        // Parse attributes
        $attributes = $this->parseAttributes($attributesString);
        
        // Recursão: se o contêiner tem shortcodes filhos dentro dele, processa os filhos primeiro!
        if ($innerContent !== null) {
            $innerContent = $this->parse($innerContent);
        }

        if (isset($this->shortcodes[$tag])) {
            $callback = $this->shortcodes[$tag]['callback'];
            
            // Suporte para resolução via DI Container
            if (is_array($callback) && is_string($callback[0])) {
                if ($this->container) {
                    $callback[0] = $this->container->make($callback[0]);
                }
            }

            // Executa o shortcode passando os atributos e o conteúdo interno processado
            return call_user_func($callback, $attributes, $innerContent);
        }

        return $matches[0];
    }

    /**
     * Função auxiliar para transformar 'color="dark" id="12"' num array associativo.
     */
    private function parseAttributes(string $text): array
    {
        $attributes = [];
        $pattern = '/(\w+)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"(?:\s|$)|(\w+)\s*=\s*\'([^\']*)\'(?:\s|$)|(\w+)\s*=\s*([^\s\'"]+)(?:\s|$)|"([^"]*)"(?:\s|$)|(\S+)(?:\s|$)/';
        
        if (preg_match_all($pattern, $text, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER)) {
            foreach ($matches as $match) {
                if (!empty($match[1])) {
                    $attributes[strtolower($match[1])] = stripcslashes($match[2]);
                } elseif (!empty($match[3])) {
                    $attributes[strtolower($match[3])] = stripcslashes($match[4]);
                } elseif (!empty($match[5])) {
                    $attributes[strtolower($match[5])] = stripcslashes($match[6]);
                }
            }
        }
        return $attributes;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/ThemeActivator.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeActivatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use Throwable;

class ThemeActivator implements ThemeActivatorInterface
{
    private string $basePath;
    private SafeThemeResolver $resolver;
    private ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher;

    public function __construct(string $basePath, ?SafeThemeResolver $resolver = null, ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null)
    {
        $this->basePath = rtrim($basePath, '/\\');
        $this->resolver = $resolver ?? new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->basePath . '/themes',
            $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);
        $this->dispatcher = $dispatcher;
    }

    public function getResolver(): SafeThemeResolver
    {
        return $this->resolver;
    }

    public function getActiveTheme(): string
    {
        $configFile = $this->basePath . '/config/active_theme.json';
        if (file_exists($configFile)) {
            $data = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
            if (!empty($data['active_theme'])) {
                return (string)$data['active_theme'];
            }
        }

        return getenv('ACTIVE_THEME') ?: ($_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME'] ?? 'default');
    }

    public function activate(string $themeFolder): array
    {
        $sanitized = basename(trim($themeFolder));

        if (empty($sanitized)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Nome do tema não informado.'
            ];
        }

        if (!$this->resolver->themeExists($sanitized)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "O tema '{$sanitized}' não foi encontrado no servidor."
            ];
        }

        $configDir = $this->basePath . '/config';
        if (!is_dir($configDir)) {
            @mkdir($configDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $payload = [
            'active_theme' => $sanitized,
            'status' => 'live',
            'activated_at' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s')
        ];

        file_put_contents(
            $configDir . '/active_theme.json',
            json_encode($payload, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES)
        );

        // Atualiza variáveis em memória
        putenv("ACTIVE_THEME={$sanitized}");
        $_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME'] = $sanitized;
        putenv("SITE_STATUS=live");
        $_ENV['SITE_STATUS'] = 'live';

        // Atualiza .env se existir e for gravável
        $this->updateEnvFile($sanitized);

        if ($this->dispatcher !== null) {
            $this->dispatcher->dispatch('theme.activated', $sanitized);
        }

        return [
            'success' => true,
            'message' => "Tema '{$sanitized}' ativado com sucesso!",
            'theme' => $sanitized
        ];
    }

    private function updateEnvFile(string $theme): void
    {
        $envPath = $this->basePath . '/.env';
        if (!file_exists($envPath) || !is_writable($envPath)) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $content = (string)file_get_contents($envPath);

            if (preg_match('/^ACTIVE_THEME=.*$/m', $content)) {
                $content = preg_replace('/^ACTIVE_THEME=.*$/m', "ACTIVE_THEME=\"{$theme}\"", $content);
            } else {
                $content .= "\nACTIVE_THEME=\"{$theme}\"";
            }

            if (preg_match('/^SITE_STATUS=.*$/m', $content)) {
                $content = preg_replace('/^SITE_STATUS=.*$/m', "SITE_STATUS=\"live\"", $content);
            } else {
                $content .= "\nSITE_STATUS=\"live\"";
            }

            file_put_contents($envPath, $content);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Não aborta a requisição caso o .env não possa ser modificado
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Theme/ThemeManager.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Theme;

use Exception;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;

class ThemeManager implements ThemeManagerInterface
{
    private string $activeThemePath;
    public ?EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher = null;
    private ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null;
    private ?\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface $partRenderer = null;

    public function __construct(string $activeThemePath, ?ShortcodeManager $shortcodeManager = null, ?\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface $partRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->activeThemePath = rtrim($activeThemePath, '/\\');
        $this->shortcodeManager = $shortcodeManager;
        $this->partRenderer = $partRenderer;
    }

    public function setPartRenderer(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface $renderer): void
    {
        $this->partRenderer = $renderer;
    }

    public function setActiveThemePath(string $path): void
    {
        $this->activeThemePath = rtrim($path, '/\\');
    }

    public function getActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        return $this->activeThemePath;
    }

    public function setDispatcher(EventDispatcherInterface $dispatcher): void
    {
        $this->dispatcher = $dispatcher;
    }

    public function render(string $template, array $args = [], ?string $pluginViewsDir = null): string
    {
        // 1. Verifica se há uma seção modular do FlexBuilder atribuída diretamente a este template
        $renderer = $this->resolvePartRenderer();
        $assignedSection = '';
        if ($renderer !== null) {
            $themeFolder = basename($this->activeThemePath);
            $cleanTemplate = str_replace(['templates/', '.php'], '', $template);
            $assignedSection = $renderer->renderTemplateSection($themeFolder, $cleanTemplate, $args);
        }

        $file = $this->activeThemePath . '/' . ltrim($template, '/') . '.php';
        $realFile = realpath($file);
        $realThemePath = realpath($this->activeThemePath);

        if ($realFile !== false && $realThemePath !== false && str_starts_with($realFile, $realThemePath)) {
            $fileToInclude = $realFile;
        } else {
            $fileToInclude = null;
        }

        if (!$fileToInclude || !file_exists($fileToInclude)) {
            if ($pluginViewsDir !== null) {
                $file = $pluginViewsDir . '/' . basename($template) . '.php';
                $realFile = realpath($file);
                $realPluginDir = realpath($pluginViewsDir);
                if ($realFile !== false && $realPluginDir !== false && str_starts_with($realFile, $realPluginDir)) {
                    $fileToInclude = $realFile;
                }
            }
            if (!$fileToInclude || !file_exists($fileToInclude)) {
                if (trim($assignedSection) !== '') {
                    return $this->shortcodeManager !== null ? $this->shortcodeManager->parse($assignedSection) : $assignedSection;
                }
                throw new \Exception("Template '{$template}' not found in theme or plugin.");
            }
        }

        $args['assignedSection'] = $assignedSection;
        extract($args, EXTR_SKIP);
        
        $obLevel = ob_get_level();
        ob_start();
        try {
            include $fileToInclude;
            $content = ob_get_clean();
        } catch (\Throwable $t) {
            while (ob_get_level() > $obLevel) {
                ob_end_clean();
            }
            throw $t;
        }

        // Se uma seção foi atribuída e o template não a imprimiu internamente, concatena abaixo
        if (trim($assignedSection) !== '' && !str_contains($content, $assignedSection)) {
            $content .= "\n" . $assignedSection;
        }
        
        if ($this->shortcodeManager !== null) {
            $content = $this->shortcodeManager->parse($content);
        }
        
        return $content;
    }

    public function get_header(array $args = []): string
    {
        try {
            $renderer = $this->resolvePartRenderer();
            if ($renderer !== null) {
                $themeFolder = basename($this->activeThemePath);
                $html = $renderer->renderHeader($themeFolder, $args);
                if (trim($html) !== '') {
                    echo $html;
                    return $html;
                }
            }

            $html = $this->render('header', $args);
            echo $html;
            return $html;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    public function get_footer(array $args = []): string
    {
        try {
            $renderer = $this->resolvePartRenderer();
            if ($renderer !== null) {
                $themeFolder = basename($this->activeThemePath);
                $html = $renderer->renderFooter($themeFolder, $args);
                if (trim($html) !== '') {
                    echo $html;
                    return $html;
                }
            }

            $html = $this->render('footer', $args);
            echo $html;
            return $html;
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    private function resolvePartRenderer(): ?\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface
    {
        if ($this->partRenderer !== null) {
            return $this->partRenderer;
        }

        if (isset($GLOBALS['app'])) {
            try {
                $c = $GLOBALS['app']->getContainer();
                if ($c->has(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface::class)) {
                    $this->partRenderer = $c->make(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface::class);
                    return $this->partRenderer;
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function getAvailableThemes(): array
    {
        $themesDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes';
        $validThemes = [];
        
        if (is_dir($themesDir)) {
            foreach (scandir($themesDir) as $folder) {
                if ($folder !== '.' && $folder !== '..' && is_dir($themesDir . '/' . $folder)) {
                    if ($this->validateThemeContract($themesDir . '/' . $folder)) {
                        $manifestPath = $themesDir . '/' . $folder . '/theme.json';
                        $manifest = json_decode(file_get_contents($manifestPath), true) ?: [];
                        $validThemes[$folder] = [
                            'folder' => $folder,
                            'name' => $manifest['name'] ?? $folder,
                            'version' => $manifest['version'] ?? '1.0.0',
                            'author' => $manifest['author'] ?? 'Desconhecido',
                            'description' => $manifest['description'] ?? ''
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return $validThemes;
    }

    private function validateThemeContract(string $themePath): bool
    {
        // 1. theme.json é Obrigatório
        if (!file_exists($themePath . '/theme.json')) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 2. index.php é Obrigatório (Fallback)
        if (!file_exists($themePath . '/index.php')) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 3. assets/ é Obrigatório (garante diretório se ausente)
        if (!is_dir($themePath . '/assets')) {
            @mkdir($themePath . '/assets', 0777, true);
        }
        if (!is_dir($themePath . '/assets')) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // 4. templates/ é Obrigatório (O OS precisa saber onde injetar as views das páginas)
        if (!is_dir($themePath . '/templates')) {
            return false;
        }

        // 5. pages/ é Obrigatório (Páginas estáticas autônomas, por contrato OS 2.0)
        if (!is_dir($themePath . '/pages')) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function getAvailableTemplates(?string $themeName = null): array
    {
        if ($themeName) {
            $themeDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . basename($themeName) . '/templates';
        } else {
            $themeDir = $this->activeThemePath . '/templates';
        }
        
        $files = [];
        if (is_dir($themeDir)) {
            foreach (glob($themeDir . '/*.php') as $file) {
                $files[] = basename($file);
            }
        }
        return $files;
    }

    public function getAvailablePages(?string $themeName = null): array
    {
        if ($themeName) {
            $pagesDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . basename($themeName) . '/pages';
        } else {
            $pagesDir = $this->activeThemePath . '/pages';
        }
        
        $files = [];
        if (is_dir($pagesDir)) {
            $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pagesDir));
            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                if ($file->isFile() && in_array($file->getExtension(), ['php', 'html'])) {
                    $files[] = 'pages/' . str_replace('\\', '/', str_replace($pagesDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, '', $file->getPathname()));
                }
            }
        }
        return $files;
    }
}
