/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/CoreHealthCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\RouterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SchemaDoctorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\InstalledStateProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HealthReport;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Verificação de saúde pós-atualização do núcleo (executada em requisição HTTP nova).
 */
final class CoreHealthCheck implements HealthCheckInterface
{
    private string $rootPath;
    private ContainerInterface $container;
    private InstalledStateProviderInterface $installedState;
    private ?UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore;
    private ?SchemaVerifierInterface $schemaVerifier;
    private ?UpdateManifestParserInterface $manifestParser;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    public function __construct(
        string $rootPath,
        ContainerInterface $container,
        InstalledStateProviderInterface $installedState,
        ?UpdateStateStoreInterface $stateStore = null,
        ?SchemaVerifierInterface $schemaVerifier = null,
        ?UpdateManifestParserInterface $manifestParser = null,
        ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null,
    ) {
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->installedState = $installedState;
        $this->stateStore = $stateStore;
        $this->schemaVerifier = $schemaVerifier;
        $this->manifestParser = $manifestParser;
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
    }

    public function run(UpdateTarget $target): HealthReport
    {
        $checks = [];
        $allOk = true;

        $state = $this->stateStore?->load($target);
        $expectedVersion = $state?->release?->version ?? $target->installedVersion;
        $activeVersion = $this->installedState->coreVersion();

        // 1. Versão ativa carregada == versão alvo
        if ($activeVersion === $expectedVersion) {
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'core_version',
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: sprintf('Versão do núcleo carregada com sucesso (%s).', $activeVersion),
            );
        } else {
            $allOk = false;
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'core_version',
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf(
                    'Versão ativa (%s) diverge da versão alvo esperada (%s).',
                    $activeVersion,
                    $expectedVersion
                ),
            );
        }

        // 2. Contratos essenciais resolvem no Container
        $requiredContracts = [
            RouterInterface::class,
            SessionManagerInterface::class,
            DatabaseConnectionInterface::class,
            SchemaDoctorInterface::class,
        ];

        $missingContracts = [];
        foreach ($requiredContracts as $contract) {
            try {
                if (!$this->container->has($contract)) {
                    $missingContracts[] = $contract;
                    continue;
                }
                $resolved = $this->container->make($contract);
                if (!is_object($resolved)) {
                    $missingContracts[] = $contract;
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                $missingContracts[] = $contract;
            }
        }

        if ($missingContracts === []) {
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'container_contracts',
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: 'Todos os contratos vitais do Kernel resolveram no Container.',
            );
        } else {
            $allOk = false;
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'container_contracts',
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf('Falha ao resolver contratos no Container: %s.', implode(', ', $missingContracts)),
            );
        }

        // 3. Conexão com o banco de dados responde
        $dbOk = false;
        try {
            if ($this->container->has(DatabaseConnectionInterface::class)) {
                /** @var DatabaseConnectionInterface $conn */
                $conn = $this->container->make(DatabaseConnectionInterface::class);
                $stmt = $conn->getPdo()->query('SELECT 1');
                $dbOk = $stmt !== false;
            }
        } catch (Throwable) {
            $dbOk = false;
        }

        if ($dbOk) {
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'database_connection',
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: 'Conexão com o banco de dados ativa e respondendo.',
            );
        } else {
            $allOk = false;
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'database_connection',
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: 'Falha ao consultar a conexão ativa com o banco de dados.',
            );
        }

        // 4. SchemaVerifier (se houver manifest disponível na quarentena ou no contexto)
        if ($this->schemaVerifier !== null && $this->manifestParser !== null && $state !== null) {
            $extractedPath = isset($state->context['extracted_path']) && is_string($state->context['extracted_path'])
                ? $state->context['extracted_path']
                : null;
            $manifestFile = $extractedPath !== null ? rtrim($extractedPath, '/\\') . '/manifest.json' : null;

            if ($manifestFile !== null && is_file($manifestFile)) {
                try {
                    $manifest = $this->manifestParser->parse((string)file_get_contents($manifestFile));
                    $verification = $this->schemaVerifier->verify($manifest);
                    if ($verification->ok) {
                        $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                            id: 'schema_verifier',
                            level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                            message: 'Estrutura do banco de dados verificada conforme o manifest.',
                        );
                    } else {
                        $allOk = false;
                        $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                            id: 'schema_verifier',
                            level: CheckLevel::Block,
                            message: 'Divergência na verificação de schema pós-atualização.',
                        );
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    $allOk = false;
                    $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                        id: 'schema_verifier',
                        level: CheckLevel::Block,
                        message: 'Erro ao verificar schema pós-atualização: ' . $e->getMessage(),
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        // 5. config/plugins.json legível
        $pluginsFile = $this->rootPath . '/config/plugins.json';
        if (is_file($pluginsFile) && is_readable($pluginsFile)) {
            $pluginsData = $this->jsonStore->read($pluginsFile, []);
            if ($pluginsData !== []) {
                $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                    id: 'plugins_config',
                    level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                    message: 'Arquivo config/plugins.json íntegro e legível.',
                );
            } else {
                $allOk = false;
                $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                    id: 'plugins_config',
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: 'Arquivo config/plugins.json está vazio ou corrompido.',
                );
            }
        } else {
            $allOk = false;
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: 'plugins_config',
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: 'Arquivo config/plugins.json não encontrado ou ilegível.',
            );
        }

        return new HealthReport(
            ok: $allOk,
            checks: $checks,
        );
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/CoreProtectedPaths.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ProtectedPathsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;

/**
 * Política local de caminhos protegidos e raízes permitidas para atualização do núcleo e de plugins.
 *
 * Esta política reside no sistema instalado e jamais pode ser alterada pelo pacote recebido.
 */
final class CoreProtectedPaths implements ProtectedPathsInterface
{
    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function protectedPaths(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug): array
    {
        return [
            '.env',
            '.maintenance',
            'config/',
            'database.sqlite',
            'storage/',
            'temp/',
            'uploads/',
            'public/uploads/',
            'token/',
            'scratch/',
            'auditoria/',
            'src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd',
            'src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/rachidd/',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function allowedRoots(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug): array
    {
        if ($kind === UpdateKind::Plugin) {
            $cleanSlug = trim($slug, '/\\');
            return [
                'src/Plugins/' . $cleanSlug . '/',
            ];
        }

        return [
            'src/',
            'public/',
            'themes/',
            'vendor/',
            'bin/',
            'tools/',
            'release/',
            'bootstrap.php',
            'os-cli.php',
            'composer.json',
            '.htaccess',
            'LICENSE',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se um caminho relativo normalizado está dentro das raízes permitidas.
     * Arquivos em `config/` só são aceitos quando o modo de entrada no manifest é `default_if_missing`.
     */
    public function isAllowedPath(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug, string $relativePath, string $mode = 'replace'): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return false;
        }

        if ($kind === UpdateKind::Core && $mode === 'default_if_missing' && str_starts_with($normalized, 'config/')) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach ($this->allowedRoots($kind, $slug) as $root) {
            $normRoot = str_replace('\\', '/', $root);
            if (str_ends_with($normRoot, '/')) {
                if (str_starts_with($normalized, $normRoot) && strlen($normalized) > strlen($normRoot)) {
                    return true;
                }
            } else {
                if ($normalized === $normRoot) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Verifica se um caminho relativo normalizado está na lista de caminhos protegidos.
     */
    public function isProtectedPath(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug, string $relativePath): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return true;
        }

        foreach ($this->protectedPaths($kind, $slug) as $protected) {
            $normProt = str_replace('\\', '/', $protected);
            if (str_ends_with($normProt, '/')) {
                $prefix = rtrim($normProt, '/');
                if ($normalized === $prefix || str_starts_with($normalized, $normProt)) {
                    return true;
                }
            } else {
                if ($normalized === $normProt || str_starts_with($normalized, $normProt . '/')) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/CurlHttpClient.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HttpClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\TransportException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HttpResponse;

final class CurlHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    private const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;
    private const USER_AGENT = 'DomainSystem-Updater/1.0 (+https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system)';

    private HostAllowlist $allowlist;

    /**
     * @var (Closure(string, array<string, string>, int, ?string, ?int): HttpResponse)|null
     */
    private ?Closure $transportOverride;

    /**
     * @param (Closure(string, array<string, string>, int, ?string, ?int): HttpResponse)|null $transportOverride
     */
    public function __construct(?HostAllowlist $allowlist = null, ?Closure $transportOverride = null)
    {
        $this->allowlist = $allowlist ?? new HostAllowlist();
        $this->transportOverride = $transportOverride;
    }

    public function get(string $url, array $headers = [], int $timeoutSeconds = 10): HttpResponse
    {
        return $this->executeWithRedirects($url, $headers, $timeoutSeconds, null, null);
    }

    public function download(
        string $url,
        string $destinationFile,
        int $maxBytes,
        array $headers = [],
        int $timeoutSeconds = 60,
    ): HttpResponse {
        if ($maxBytes <= 0) {
            throw new TransportException('O limite máximo de bytes ($maxBytes) deve ser positivo.');
        }

        $dir = dirname($destinationFile);
        if (!is_dir($dir) && !@mkdir($dir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($dir)) {
            throw new TransportException("Não foi possível criar o diretório de destino para download: {$dir}");
        }

        try {
            return $this->executeWithRedirects($url, $headers, $timeoutSeconds, $destinationFile, $maxBytes);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if (is_file($destinationFile)) {
                @unlink($destinationFile);
            }
            if ($e instanceof TransportException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new TransportException('Falha durante o download: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida estritamente se a URL utiliza HTTPS, não contém userinfo, usa porta padrão e pertence à allowlist.
     *
     * @throws TransportException
     */
    public function validateUrl(string $url): void
    {
        $trimmed = trim($url);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new TransportException('URL vazia fornecida ao cliente HTTP.');
        }

        // Rejeita userinfo explícito antes mesmo de parse_url ambíguo
        if (preg_match('#^https?://[^/]*@#i', $trimmed) === 1) {
            throw new TransportException("URL com userinfo não é permitida: {$url}");
        }

        $parts = parse_url($trimmed);
        if (!is_array($parts)) {
            throw new TransportException("URL malformada: {$url}");
        }

        $scheme = strtolower((string)($parts['scheme'] ?? ''));
        if ($scheme !== 'https') {
            throw new TransportException("Apenas protocolo HTTPS é permitido: {$url}");
        }

        if (isset($parts['user']) || isset($parts['pass'])) {
            throw new TransportException("Credenciais na URL (userinfo) não são permitidas: {$url}");
        }

        if (isset($parts['port']) && (int)$parts['port'] !== 443) {
            throw new TransportException("Porta não padrão não é permitida: {$url}");
        }

        $host = (string)($parts['host'] ?? '');
        if (!$this->allowlist->isAllowed($host)) {
            throw new TransportException("Host fora da allowlist de segurança: {$host}");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolve e valida uma URL de redirecionamento contra a allowlist.
     *
     * @throws TransportException
     */
    public function resolveRedirectUrl(string $currentUrl, string $location): string
    {
        $target = trim($location);
        if ($target === '') {
            throw new TransportException('Cabeçalho Location de redirecionamento vazio.');
        }

        if (str_starts_with($target, '/')) {
            $parts = parse_url($currentUrl);
            $host = (string)($parts['host'] ?? '');
            $target = 'https://' . $host . $target;
        }

        $this->validateUrl($target);
        return $target;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $headers
     */
    private function executeWithRedirects(
        string $url,
        array $headers,
        int $timeoutSeconds,
        ?string $destinationFile,
        ?int $maxBytes,
    ): HttpResponse {
        $currentUrl = $url;
        $hops = 0;

        while (true) {
            $this->validateUrl($currentUrl);

            $response = $this->transportOverride !== null
                ? ($this->transportOverride)($currentUrl, $headers, $timeoutSeconds, $destinationFile, $maxBytes)
                : $this->performCurlRequest($currentUrl, $headers, $timeoutSeconds, $destinationFile, $maxBytes);

            if (in_array($response->statusCode, [301, 302, 303, 307, 308], true)) {
                $hops++;
                if ($hops > self::MAX_REDIRECTS) {
                    throw new TransportException('Limite máximo de redirecionamentos (' . self::MAX_REDIRECTS . ') excedido.');
                }

                $location = $response->headers['location'] ?? '';
                $currentUrl = $this->resolveRedirectUrl($currentUrl, $location);
                continue;
            }

            if ($destinationFile !== null && $maxBytes !== null && is_file($destinationFile)) {
                $size = (int)filesize($destinationFile);
                if ($size > $maxBytes) {
                    @unlink($destinationFile);
                    throw new TransportException("Arquivo baixado excedeu o limite de {$maxBytes} bytes.");
                }
            }

            return $response;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $headers
     */
    private function performCurlRequest(
        string $url,
        array $headers,
        int $timeoutSeconds,
        ?string $destinationFile,
        ?int $maxBytes,
    ): HttpResponse {
        if (!function_exists('curl_init')) {
            throw new TransportException('A extensão cURL do PHP não está disponível neste servidor.');
        }

        $ch = curl_init($url);
        if ($ch === false) {
            throw new TransportException('Falha ao inicializar sessão cURL.');
        }

        $responseHeaders = [];
        $formattedHeaders = ['Accept: application/vnd.github+json'];
        foreach ($headers as $name => $value) {
            $formattedHeaders[] = "{$name}: {$value}";
        }

        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $formattedHeaders);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, self::USER_AGENT);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, false);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, min(10, max(1, $timeoutSeconds)));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, max(1, $timeoutSeconds));
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);
        if (defined('CURLPROTO_HTTPS')) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS, CURLPROTO_HTTPS);
        }

        curl_setopt(
            $ch,
            CURLOPT_HEADERFUNCTION,
            static function ($curl, string $headerLine) use (&$responseHeaders): int {
                $len = strlen($headerLine);
                $parts = explode(':', $headerLine, 2);
                if (count($parts) === 2) {
                    $name = strtolower(trim($parts[0]));
                    $val = trim($parts[1]);
                    if ($name !== '') {
                        $responseHeaders[$name] = $val;
                    }
                }
                return $len;
            }
        );

        $fileHandle = null;
        $writtenBytes = 0;
        $exceededMaxBytes = false;

        if ($destinationFile !== null) {
            $fileHandle = @fopen($destinationFile, 'wb');
            if ($fileHandle === false) {
                curl_close($ch);
                throw new TransportException("Não foi possível abrir o arquivo para gravação: {$destinationFile}");
            }

            curl_setopt(
                $ch,
                CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION,
                static function ($curl, string $chunk) use ($fileHandle, $maxBytes, &$writtenBytes, &$exceededMaxBytes): int {
                    $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                    $writtenBytes += $chunkLen;
                    if ($maxBytes !== null && $writtenBytes > $maxBytes) {
                        $exceededMaxBytes = true;
                        return 0; // Aborta transferência cURL imediatamente
                    }
                    $written = fwrite($fileHandle, $chunk);
                    return $written === false ? 0 : $written;
                }
            );
        } else {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        }

        $result = curl_exec($ch);
        $errno = curl_errno($ch);
        $errorMsg = curl_error($ch);
        $statusCode = (int)curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($fileHandle !== null) {
            fclose($fileHandle);
        }

        if ($exceededMaxBytes) {
            if ($destinationFile !== null && is_file($destinationFile)) {
                @unlink($destinationFile);
            }
            throw new TransportException("Download abortado: tamanho excedeu o limite de {$maxBytes} bytes.");
        }

        if ($result === false || $errno !== 0) {
            if ($destinationFile !== null && is_file($destinationFile)) {
                @unlink($destinationFile);
            }
            throw new TransportException("Erro de transporte cURL ({$errno}): {$errorMsg}");
        }

        if ($statusCode < 100 || $statusCode > 599) {
            if ($destinationFile !== null && is_file($destinationFile)) {
                @unlink($destinationFile);
            }
            throw new TransportException("Código de status HTTP inválido recebido: {$statusCode}");
        }

        // Se for redirecionamento durante um download, limpa arquivo vazio/intermediário antes do próximo salto
        if ($destinationFile !== null && in_array($statusCode, [301, 302, 303, 307, 308], true) && is_file($destinationFile)) {
            @unlink($destinationFile);
        }

        $body = is_string($result) ? $result : '';
        $etag = $responseHeaders['etag'] ?? null;

        return new HttpResponse(
            statusCode: $statusCode,
            headers: $responseHeaders,
            body: $body,
            etag: $etag,
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/FileMaintenanceMode.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MaintenanceModeInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Implementação de `MaintenanceModeInterface` baseada no arquivo `<raiz>/.maintenance`.
 */
final class FileMaintenanceMode implements MaintenanceModeInterface
{
    private string $lockFilePath;
    private bool $wasAlreadyEnabled = false;

    public function __construct(string $rootPath)
    {
        $this->lockFilePath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/') . '/.maintenance';
        $this->wasAlreadyEnabled = is_file($this->lockFilePath);
    }

    public function enable(string $message = 'maintenance', ?string $adminBypassToken = null): void
    {
        $this->wasAlreadyEnabled = $this->isEnabled();
        $content = trim($message) !== '' ? $message : 'maintenance';

        if (@file_put_contents($this->lockFilePath, $content) === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf(
                'Não foi possível ativar o modo de manutenção em "%s".',
                $this->lockFilePath
            ));
        }
    }

    public function disable(): void
    {
        if (is_file($this->lockFilePath)) {
            @unlink($this->lockFilePath);
        }
    }

    public function isEnabled(): bool
    {
        return is_file($this->lockFilePath);
    }

    /**
     * Indica se o modo de manutenção já estava ativo antes da chamada a `enable()`.
     */
    public function wasAlreadyEnabled(): bool
    {
        return $this->wasAlreadyEnabled;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/FileUpdateLock.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateLockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;

final class FileUpdateLock implements UpdateLockInterface
{
    private string $stateDir;

    /**
     * @var Closure(): int
     */
    private Closure $clock;

    /**
     * @param (Closure(): int)|null $clock
     */
    public function __construct(string $rootPath, ?Closure $clock = null)
    {
        $normalizedRoot = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->stateDir = $normalizedRoot . '/storage/state';
        $this->clock = $clock ?? static fn(): int => time();
    }

    public function acquire(UpdateTarget $target, int $ttlSeconds): bool
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->stateDir) && !@mkdir($this->stateDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($this->stateDir)) {
            return false;
        }

        $lockFile = $this->resolveLockPath($target);
        $fp = @fopen($lockFile, 'c+b');
        if ($fp === false) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!@flock($fp, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            @fclose($fp);
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $now = ($this->clock)();
            rewind($fp);
            $raw = (string)stream_get_contents($fp);

            if (trim($raw) !== '') {
                $existing = json_decode($raw, true);
                if (is_array($existing)) {
                    $expiresAt = (int)($existing['expires_at'] ?? 0);
                    if ($expiresAt > $now) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }

            $payload = json_encode([
                'target'      => $target->slug,
                'acquired_at' => $now,
                'expires_at'  => $now + max(1, $ttlSeconds),
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);

            ftruncate($fp, 0);
            rewind($fp);
            fwrite($fp, (string)$payload);
            fflush($fp);

            return true;
        } finally {
            @flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            @fclose($fp);
        }
    }

    public function release(UpdateTarget $target): void
    {
        $lockFile = $this->resolveLockPath($target);
        if (!is_file($lockFile)) {
            return;
        }

        $fp = @fopen($lockFile, 'c+b');
        if ($fp !== false) {
            if (@flock($fp, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
                ftruncate($fp, 0);
                fflush($fp);
                @flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
            }
            @fclose($fp);
        }

        @unlink($lockFile);
    }

    public function resolveLockPath(UpdateTarget $target): string
    {
        if ($target->kind === UpdateKind::Core) {
            return $this->stateDir . '/update-core.lock';
        }

        $safeSlug = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '_', $target->slug) ?: 'plugin';
        return $this->stateDir . '/update-plugin-' . $safeSlug . '.lock';
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/FilesystemInstalledState.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\InstalledStateProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\InstalledPlugin;

final class FilesystemInstalledState implements InstalledStateProviderInterface
{
    private string $rootPath;
    private ?string $coreVersionOverride;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    public function __construct(
        string $rootPath,
        ?string $coreVersionOverride = null,
        ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null,
    ) {
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->coreVersionOverride = $coreVersionOverride;
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
    }

    public function coreVersion(): string
    {
        if ($this->coreVersionOverride !== null && trim($this->coreVersionOverride) !== '') {
            return $this->coreVersionOverride;
        }

        $bootstrapFile = $this->rootPath . '/bootstrap.php';
        if (is_file($bootstrapFile)) {
            $source = (string)file_get_contents($bootstrapFile);
            if (preg_match("/define\\(\\s*['\"]DS_VERSION['\"]\\s*,\\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\\s*\\)/", $source, $m) === 1) {
                return $m[1];
            }
        }

        if (defined('DS_VERSION') && is_string(DS_VERSION) && DS_VERSION !== '') {
            return DS_VERSION;
        }

        return '2.3.0';
    }

    public function plugins(): array
    {
        $pluginsDir = $this->rootPath . '/src/Plugins';
        if (!is_dir($pluginsDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $activeMap = $this->jsonStore->read($this->rootPath . '/config/plugins.json', []);
        $entries = scandir($pluginsDir) ?: [];
        sort($entries);

        $installed = [];
        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }

            $manifestPath = $pluginsDir . '/' . $entry . '/plugin.json';
            if (!is_file($manifestPath)) {
                continue;
            }

            $data = $this->jsonStore->read($manifestPath, []);
            if ($data === []) {
                continue;
            }

            $slug = trim((string)($data['name'] ?? $entry));
            $version = trim((string)($data['version'] ?? '1.0.0'));
            $osVersion = trim((string)($data['os_version'] ?? '2.3'));
            $isCore = (bool)($data['core'] ?? false);
            $isActive = !empty($activeMap[$entry]) || !empty($activeMap[$slug]);

            if ($slug === '' || $version === '' || $osVersion === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $installed[$entry] = new InstalledPlugin(
                slug: $entry,
                version: $version,
                osVersion: $osVersion,
                isCore: $isCore,
                isActive: $isActive,
            );
        }

        return $installed;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/GitHubReleaseSource.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HttpClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ReleaseSourceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\VersionComparatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\SourceUnavailableException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\TransportException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final class GitHubReleaseSource implements ReleaseSourceInterface
{
    private const MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES = 157_286_400; // 150 MB
    private const MAX_SHA256_BYTES = 4_096;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly HttpClientInterface $httpClient,
        private readonly VersionComparatorInterface $versionComparator,
        private readonly int $maxPackageBytes = self::MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES,
    ) {
    }

    public function latest(UpdateTarget $target, ?string $knownEtag = null): ?ReleaseInfo
    {
        $url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' . $target->repository . '/releases/latest';
        $headers = [];
        if ($knownEtag !== null && trim($knownEtag) !== '') {
            $headers['If-None-Match'] = $knownEtag;
        }

        $response = $this->httpClient->get($url, $headers, 15);
        if ($response->isNotModified()) {
            return null;
        }

        if ($response->statusCode !== 200) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException(
                "GitHub API retornou código HTTP {$response->statusCode} para {$target->repository}."
            );
        }

        $payload = json_decode($response->body, true);
        if (!is_array($payload)) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException('Resposta JSON da GitHub API malformada.');
        }

        if (!empty($payload['draft']) || !empty($payload['prerelease'])) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException('A Release retornada pelo GitHub é rascunho ou pré-lançamento.');
        }

        $tag = trim((string)($payload['tag_name'] ?? ''));
        if ($tag === '') {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException('Campo tag_name ausente na Release do GitHub.');
        }

        try {
            $version = $this->versionComparator->normalize($tag);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException("Tag da Release não é SemVer válida ({$tag}): " . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        $publishedAt = trim((string)($payload['published_at'] ?? ''));
        if ($publishedAt === '') {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException('Campo published_at ausente na Release do GitHub.');
        }

        $changelog = (string)($payload['body'] ?? '');
        $assets = is_array($payload['assets'] ?? null) ? $payload['assets'] : [];

        $expectedZipName = 'domain-system-' . $version . '.zip';
        $expectedShaName = $expectedZipName . '.sha256';

        $zipAsset = null;
        $shaAsset = null;
        $fallbackZipAsset = null;

        foreach ($assets as $asset) {
            if (!is_array($asset)) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = (string)($asset['name'] ?? '');
            if ($name === $expectedZipName) {
                $zipAsset = $asset;
            } elseif ($name === $expectedShaName) {
                $shaAsset = $asset;
            } elseif ($name === 'domain-system-core.zip') {
                $fallbackZipAsset = $asset;
            } elseif ($fallbackZipAsset === null && str_ends_with(strtolower($name), '.zip')) {
                $fallbackZipAsset = $asset;
            }
        }

        $isNewerThanInstalled = $this->versionComparator->isNewer($version, $target->installedVersion);

        if (!$isNewerThanInstalled && ($zipAsset === null || $shaAsset === null)) {
            $chosenAsset = $zipAsset ?? $fallbackZipAsset;
            $legacyAssetName = is_array($chosenAsset) && !empty($chosenAsset['name'])
                ? (string)$chosenAsset['name']
                : $expectedZipName;
            $legacyUrl = is_array($chosenAsset) && !empty($chosenAsset['browser_download_url'])
                ? (string)$chosenAsset['browser_download_url']
                : ('https://github.com/' . $target->repository . '/releases/tag/' . $tag);
            $legacySize = is_array($chosenAsset) && (int)($chosenAsset['size'] ?? 0) > 0
                ? (int)$chosenAsset['size']
                : 1;

            return new ReleaseInfo(
                version: $version,
                tag: $tag,
                publishedAt: $publishedAt,
                changelog: $changelog,
                assetUrl: $legacyUrl,
                assetName: $legacyAssetName,
                sizeBytes: $legacySize,
                sha256: str_repeat('0', 64),
                etag: $response->etag,
            );
        }

        if ($zipAsset === null) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException("Asset obrigatório '{$expectedZipName}' ausente na Release {$tag}.");
        }
        if ($shaAsset === null) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException("Asset de integridade '{$expectedShaName}' ausente na Release {$tag}.");
        }

        $zipUrl = trim((string)($zipAsset['browser_download_url'] ?? ''));
        $shaUrl = trim((string)($shaAsset['browser_download_url'] ?? ''));
        $sizeBytes = (int)($zipAsset['size'] ?? 0);

        if ($zipUrl === '' || $shaUrl === '' || $sizeBytes <= 0) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException("Metadados de download incompletos na Release {$tag}.");
        }

        $shaResponse = $this->httpClient->get($shaUrl, [], 10);
        if ($shaResponse->statusCode !== 200 || strlen($shaResponse->body) > self::MAX_SHA256_BYTES) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException("Não foi possível obter o arquivo de hash '{$expectedShaName}'.");
        }

        $sha256 = $this->extractSha256FromContent($shaResponse->body);

        return new ReleaseInfo(
            version: $version,
            tag: $tag,
            publishedAt: $publishedAt,
            changelog: $changelog,
            assetUrl: $zipUrl,
            assetName: $expectedZipName,
            sizeBytes: $sizeBytes,
            sha256: $sha256,
            etag: $response->etag,
        );
    }

    public function fetchPackage(ReleaseInfo $release, string $destinationDir): DownloadedPackage
    {
        $normalizedDir = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $destinationDir), '/');
        if (!is_dir($normalizedDir) && !@mkdir($normalizedDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($normalizedDir)) {
            throw new TransportException("Não foi possível criar o diretório de download: {$normalizedDir}");
        }

        $archivePath = $normalizedDir . '/' . $release->assetName;
        $response = $this->httpClient->download(
            url: $release->assetUrl,
            destinationFile: $archivePath,
            maxBytes: $this->maxPackageBytes,
            headers: [],
            timeoutSeconds: 120,
        );

        if ($response->statusCode !== 200 || !is_file($archivePath)) {
            if (is_file($archivePath)) {
                @unlink($archivePath);
            }
            throw new TransportException("Falha ao baixar o pacote {$release->assetName} (HTTP {$response->statusCode}).");
        }

        $actualSize = (int)filesize($archivePath);
        if ($actualSize <= 0) {
            @unlink($archivePath);
            throw new TransportException("O pacote baixado {$release->assetName} está vazio.");
        }

        return new DownloadedPackage(
            release: $release,
            archivePath: $archivePath,
            sizeBytes: $actualSize,
        );
    }

    private function extractSha256FromContent(string $raw): string
    {
        $trimmed = trim($raw);
        if (preg_match('/^([a-fA-F0-9]{64})(?:\s+.*)?$/', $trimmed, $matches) !== 1) {
            throw new SourceUnavailableException('Conteúdo do asset .sha256 não contém um hash SHA-256 hexadecimal válido de 64 caracteres.');
        }

        return strtolower($matches[1]);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/HostAllowlist.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

final readonly class HostAllowlist
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private array $patterns;

    /**
     * @param list<string>|null $patterns
     */
    public function __construct(?array $patterns = null)
    {
        $default = [
            'api.github.com',
            'github.com',
            'objects.githubusercontent.com',
            'release-assets.githubusercontent.com',
            '*.githubusercontent.com',
        ];

        $normalized = [];
        foreach ($patterns ?? $default as $pattern) {
            $clean = strtolower(trim($pattern));
            if ($clean !== '') {
                $normalized[] = $clean;
            }
        }

        $this->patterns = array_values(array_unique($normalized));
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $host): bool
    {
        $candidate = strtolower(trim($host, ". \t\n\r\0\x0B"));
        if ($candidate === '') {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($this->patterns as $pattern) {
            if ($pattern === $candidate) {
                return true;
            }

            if (str_starts_with($pattern, '*.')) {
                $suffix = substr($pattern, 1); // ex.: ".githubusercontent.com"
                $bareDomain = substr($pattern, 2); // ex.: "githubusercontent.com"
                if (
                    $candidate !== $bareDomain
                    && str_ends_with($candidate, $suffix)
                ) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function patterns(): array
    {
        return $this->patterns;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/JsonUpdateStateStore.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use Throwable;

final class JsonUpdateStateStore implements UpdateStateStoreInterface
{
    private string $stateDir;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    public function __construct(string $rootPath, ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null)
    {
        $normalizedRoot = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->stateDir = $normalizedRoot . '/storage/state';
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
    }

    public function load(UpdateTarget $target): UpdateState
    {
        $filePath = $this->resolveFilePath($target);
        $data = $this->jsonStore->read($filePath, []);

        if ($data === []) {
            return UpdateState::idle($target);
        }

        try {
            return UpdateState::fromArray($data, $target);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return UpdateState::idle($target);
        }
    }

    public function save(UpdateState $state): void
    {
        $filePath = $this->resolveFilePath($state->target);
        $this->jsonStore->write($filePath, $state->toArray());
    }

    public function resolveFilePath(UpdateTarget $target): string
    {
        if ($target->kind === UpdateKind::Core) {
            return $this->stateDir . '/update-core.json';
        }

        $safeSlug = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '_', $target->slug) ?: 'plugin';
        return $this->stateDir . '/update-plugin-' . $safeSlug . '.json';
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/DiskSpaceCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class DiskSpaceCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $rootPath,
        private readonly ?int $freeBytesOverride = null,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'disk_space';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $manifestBytes = 0;
        foreach ($package->manifest->files as $file) {
            $manifestBytes += $file['size'];
        }

        $baseSize = max($package->release->sizeBytes, $manifestBytes, 1);
        $requiredBytes = $baseSize * 3;

        $freeSpace = $this->freeBytesOverride;
        if ($freeSpace === null) {
            $probed = @disk_free_space($this->rootPath);
            $freeSpace = $probed !== false ? (int)$probed : null;
        }

        if ($freeSpace === null) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Warn,
                    message: 'Não foi possível aferir o espaço livre em disco no servidor.',
                ),
            ];
        }

        if ($freeSpace < $requiredBytes) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf(
                        'Espaço em disco insuficiente: livre %d bytes, exigido no mínimo %d bytes (3x o tamanho do pacote).',
                        $freeSpace,
                        $requiredBytes
                    ),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: sprintf('Espaço livre em disco suficiente (%d bytes disponíveis).', $freeSpace),
            ),
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/DowngradeCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\VersionComparatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class DowngradeCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly VersionComparatorInterface $comparator,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'downgrade';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $candidate = $package->manifest->version;
        $installed = $target->installedVersion;

        if (!$this->comparator->isValid($candidate) || !$this->comparator->isValid($installed)) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf('Versão inválida para comparação SemVer (%s -> %s).', $installed, $candidate),
                ),
            ];
        }

        if ($this->comparator->isNewer($candidate, $installed)) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                    message: sprintf('Progressão de versão válida (%s -> %s).', $installed, $candidate),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf(
                    'Downgrade ou reinstalação da mesma versão bloqueado (instalada: %s, pacote: %s).',
                    $installed,
                    $candidate
                ),
            ),
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/ExtensionsCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class ExtensionsCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    /** @var Closure(string): bool */
    private Closure $extensionLoadedDetector;

    /**
     * @param (callable(string): bool)|null $extensionLoadedDetector
     */
    public function __construct(?callable $extensionLoadedDetector = null)
    {
        $this->extensionLoadedDetector = $extensionLoadedDetector !== null
            ? Closure::fromCallable($extensionLoadedDetector)
            : static fn(string $ext): bool => extension_loaded($ext)
                || ($ext === 'zip' && class_exists(\PharData::class) && extension_loaded('zlib'));
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'extensions';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $required = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
            ['curl', 'zip'],
            $package->manifest->requires['extensions'],
        )));

        $missing = [];
        foreach ($required as $ext) {
            if (!($this->extensionLoadedDetector)($ext)) {
                $missing[] = $ext;
            }
        }

        if ($missing === []) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                    message: sprintf('Todas as extensões PHP obrigatórias estão ativas (%s).', implode(', ', $required)),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf('Extensões PHP obrigatórias ausentes: %s.', implode(', ', $missing)),
            ),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class PhpVersionCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $currentPhpVersion = PHP_VERSION,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'php_version';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $requiredPhp = ltrim(trim($package->manifest->requires['php']), '>=vV ');
        if ($requiredPhp === '') {
            $requiredPhp = '8.1.0';
        }

        if (version_compare($this->currentPhpVersion, $requiredPhp, '>=')) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                    message: sprintf('Versão do PHP compatível (%s >= %s).', $this->currentPhpVersion, $requiredPhp),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf(
                    'Versão do PHP incompatível: atual %s, mínimo exigido pelo pacote %s.',
                    $this->currentPhpVersion,
                    $requiredPhp
                ),
            ),
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/PluginCompatibilityCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\InstalledStateProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

/**
 * Emite aviso (CheckLevel::Warn) para plugins instalados que não fazem parte do pacote
 * e declaram `os_version` de versão maior diferente da versão alvo do núcleo.
 */
final class PluginCompatibilityCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly InstalledStateProviderInterface $installedState,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'plugin_compatibility';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $targetMajor = explode('.', $package->manifest->version)[0] ?? '2';

        $bundledPluginSlugs = [];
        foreach ($package->manifest->files as $file) {
            if (preg_match('#^src/Plugins/([^/]+)/#', $file['path'], $m) === 1) {
                $bundledPluginSlugs[$m[1]] = true;
            }
        }

        $warnings = [];
        foreach ($this->installedState->plugins() as $slug => $plugin) {
            if (isset($bundledPluginSlugs[$slug])) {
                continue;
            }

            $pluginMajor = explode('.', $plugin->osVersion)[0] ?? '';
            if ($pluginMajor !== $targetMajor) {
                $warnings[] = new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Warn,
                    message: sprintf(
                        'O plugin "%s" (os_version %s) não faz parte do pacote e pode ser incompatível com o núcleo %s.',
                        $plugin->slug,
                        $plugin->osVersion,
                        $package->manifest->version
                    ),
                );
            }
        }

        if ($warnings !== []) {
            return $warnings;
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: 'Todos os plugins instalados são compatíveis com a versão alvo do núcleo.',
            ),
        ];
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class ProtocolCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateManifestParserInterface $manifestParser,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'protocol';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $supported = $this->manifestParser->supportedProtocols();
        $maxSupported = $supported !== [] ? max($supported) : 1;

        if ($package->manifest->minUpdaterProtocol <= $maxSupported) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                    message: sprintf(
                        'Protocolo do atualizador compatível (mínimo exigido: v%d, suportado: v%d).',
                        $package->manifest->minUpdaterProtocol,
                        $maxSupported
                    ),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Block,
                message: sprintf(
                    'Este pacote exige protocolo de atualizador >= v%d (atual suporta até v%d). Atualize manualmente.',
                    $package->manifest->minUpdaterProtocol,
                    $maxSupported
                ),
            ),
        ];
    }
}
