// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/SchemaPlanCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaPlannerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use Throwable;

final class SchemaPlanCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SchemaPlannerInterface $schemaPlanner,
    ) {
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'schema_plan';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        try {
            $plan = $this->schemaPlanner->plan($package->manifest, $package->extractedPath);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf('Falha no planejamento de schema: %s', $e->getMessage()),
                ),
            ];
        }

        if ($plan->blocked !== []) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf(
                        'O banco de dados possui migrações já executadas que não existem neste pacote (%s). Downgrade de banco bloqueado.',
                        implode(', ', $plan->blocked)
                    ),
                ),
            ];
        }

        $checks = [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: sprintf('Plano de schema validado (%d migração(ões) pendente(s)).', count($plan->pending)),
            ),
        ];

        if ($plan->destructive) {
            $checks[] = new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id() . '_destructive',
                level: CheckLevel::Warn,
                message: 'O pacote inclui migrações marcadas como destrutivas; backup de banco de dados é obrigatório.',
            );
        }

        return $checks;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Preflight/WritablePathsCheck.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ProtectedPathsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\CheckLevel;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\PreflightCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;

final class WritablePathsCheck implements PreflightCheckInterface
{
    /** @var Closure(string): bool */
    private Closure $writableCheck;

    /**
     * @param (callable(string): bool)|null $writableCheck
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $rootPath,
        private readonly ProtectedPathsInterface $protectedPaths,
        ?callable $writableCheck = null,
    ) {
        $this->writableCheck = $writableCheck !== null
            ? Closure::fromCallable($writableCheck)
            : static function (string $path): bool {
                $current = $path;
                while (!file_exists($current) && dirname($current) !== $current) {
                    $current = dirname($current);
                }
                return is_writable($current);
            };
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return 'writable_paths';
    }

    public function run(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target): array
    {
        $root = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $this->rootPath), '/');
        $candidates = array_merge(
            ['', 'storage', 'temp', 'config'],
            $this->protectedPaths->allowedRoots($target->kind, $target->slug),
        );

        $notWritable = [];
        foreach ($candidates as $rel) {
            $cleanRel = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rel), '/');
            $fullPath = $cleanRel === '' ? $root : $root . '/' . $cleanRel;

            if (!($this->writableCheck)($fullPath)) {
                $notWritable[] = $cleanRel === '' ? '.' : $cleanRel;
            }
        }

        $notWritable = array_values(array_unique($notWritable));
        if ($notWritable !== []) {
            return [
                new PreflightCheck(
                    id: $this->id(),
                    level: CheckLevel::Block,
                    message: sprintf(
                        'Sem permissão de escrita nos caminhos obrigatórios: %s.',
                        implode(', ', $notWritable)
                    ),
                ),
            ];
        }

        return [
            new PreflightCheck(
                id: $this->id(),
                level: CheckLevel::Ok,
                message: 'Todos os diretórios de destino, storage, temp e config possuem permissão de escrita.',
            ),
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/Sha256PackageVerifier.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ProtectedPathsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdatePackageVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\InvalidManifestException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

/**
 * Verificador de integridade criptográfica (SHA-256) e estrutural do pacote de atualização.
 */
final class Sha256PackageVerifier implements UpdatePackageVerifierInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly UpdateManifestParserInterface $manifestParser,
        private readonly ProtectedPathsInterface $protectedPaths,
        private readonly ZipPackageExtractor $extractor,
        private readonly string $quarantineBaseDir,
    ) {
    }

    public function verify(DownloadedPackage $package): VerifiedPackage
    {
        if (!is_file($package->archivePath) || !is_readable($package->archivePath)) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                'Pacote baixado não encontrado para verificação: "%s".',
                $package->archivePath
            ));
        }

        $actualZipSha256 = hash_file('sha256', $package->archivePath);
        if ($actualZipSha256 === false) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Não foi possível calcular o hash SHA-256 do pacote ZIP.');
        }

        if (!hash_equals(strtolower($package->release->sha256), strtolower($actualZipSha256))) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                'O hash SHA-256 do arquivo ZIP (%s) diverge do esperado na Release (%s).',
                $actualZipSha256,
                $package->release->sha256
            ));
        }

        $quarantineDir = rtrim($this->quarantineBaseDir, '/\\')
            . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR
            . 'quarantine-' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', $package->release->version)
            . '-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));

        $this->extractor->extract($package->archivePath, $quarantineDir);

        try {
            $manifestPath = $quarantineDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'manifest.json';
            if (!is_file($manifestPath) || !is_readable($manifestPath)) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException('Arquivo manifest.json ausente na raiz do pacote.');
            }

            $manifestJson = file_get_contents($manifestPath);
            if ($manifestJson === false) {
                throw new InvalidManifestException('Não foi possível ler o arquivo manifest.json.');
            }

            $manifest = $this->manifestParser->parse($manifestJson);

            if ($manifest->version !== $package->release->version) {
                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                    'A versão declarada no manifest.json (%s) diverge da versão da Release (%s).',
                    $manifest->version,
                    $package->release->version
                ));
            }

            $expectedFilesMap = [];
            foreach ($manifest->files as $entry) {
                $relPath = $entry['path'];
                $this->extractor->assertSafeRelativePath($relPath);

                if ($relPath === 'manifest.json') {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException('O arquivo manifest.json não deve ser listado em "files".');
                }

                if (!$this->isPathWithinAllowedRoots($manifest->kind, $manifest->slug, $relPath, $entry['mode'])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Arquivo listado no manifest está fora das raízes permitidas: "%s".',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                if (isset($expectedFilesMap[$relPath])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Arquivo duplicado no manifest.json: "%s".',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                $fullPath = $quarantineDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $relPath);
                if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Arquivo listado no manifest.json está ausente no pacote extraído: "%s".',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                $actualSize = filesize($fullPath);
                if ($actualSize === false || $actualSize !== $entry['size']) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Tamanho do arquivo "%s" (%s bytes) diverge do manifest (%d bytes).',
                        $relPath,
                        (string)$actualSize,
                        $entry['size']
                    ));
                }

                $actualHash = hash_file('sha256', $fullPath);
                if ($actualHash === false || !hash_equals(strtolower($entry['sha256']), strtolower($actualHash))) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Hash SHA-256 do arquivo "%s" diverge do declarado no manifest.json.',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                $expectedFilesMap[$relPath] = true;
            }

            foreach ($manifest->removed as $removedPath) {
                $this->extractor->assertSafeRelativePath($removedPath);
                if (!$this->isPathWithinAllowedRoots($manifest->kind, $manifest->slug, $removedPath, 'replace')) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Caminho em "removed" está fora das raízes permitidas: "%s".',
                        $removedPath
                    ));
                }
            }

            $extractedFiles = $this->listExtractedRelativeFiles($quarantineDir);
            foreach ($extractedFiles as $extractedRelPath) {
                if ($extractedRelPath === 'manifest.json') {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!isset($expectedFilesMap[$extractedRelPath])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Arquivo extra não declarado no manifest.json encontrado no pacote: "%s".',
                        $extractedRelPath
                    ));
                }
            }

            return new VerifiedPackage(
                release: $package->release,
                manifest: $manifest,
                extractedPath: $quarantineDir,
            );
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($quarantineDir);
            if ($e instanceof PackageIntegrityException || $e instanceof InvalidManifestException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Falha ao verificar integridade do pacote: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    private function isPathWithinAllowedRoots(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug, string $relPath, string $mode): bool
    {
        if ($this->protectedPaths instanceof CoreProtectedPaths) {
            return $this->protectedPaths->isAllowedPath($kind, $slug, $relPath, $mode);
        }

        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        if ($kind === UpdateKind::Core && $mode === 'default_if_missing' && str_starts_with($normalized, 'config/')) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach ($this->protectedPaths->allowedRoots($kind, $slug) as $root) {
            $normRoot = str_replace('\\', '/', $root);
            if (str_ends_with($normRoot, '/')) {
                if (str_starts_with($normalized, $normRoot) && strlen($normalized) > strlen($normRoot)) {
                    return true;
                }
            } elseif ($normalized === $normRoot) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function listExtractedRelativeFiles(string $quarantineDir): array
    {
        $files = [];
        $baseLen = strlen(rtrim($quarantineDir, '/\\')) + 1;

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($quarantineDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if ($item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                $rel = substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen);
                $files[] = str_replace('\\', '/', $rel);
            }
        }

        sort($files);
        return $files;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/StagedUpdateApplier.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ProtectedPathsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateApplierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\ApplyException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\RollbackFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ApplyResult;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupRecord;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\UpdateTarget;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\VerifiedPackage;
use Throwable;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Aplicador em estágios dos arquivos do pacote de atualização sobre a árvore instalada.
 *
 * Ordem de escrita:
 *   1. `vendor/`
 *   2. `src/`
 *   3. `themes/`
 *   4. demais arquivos permitidos
 *   5. `public/index.php` e `bootstrap.php` (por último)
 */
final class StagedUpdateApplier implements UpdateApplierInterface
{
    private string $rootPath;
    private ProtectedPathsInterface $protectedPaths;
    private BackupInterface $backup;
    private ZipPackageExtractor $pathValidator;
    /** @var list<string> */
    private array $lastWritten = [];

    public function __construct(
        string $rootPath,
        ProtectedPathsInterface $protectedPaths,
        BackupInterface $backup,
        ?ZipPackageExtractor $pathValidator = null,
    ) {
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->protectedPaths = $protectedPaths;
        $this->backup = $backup;
        $this->pathValidator = $pathValidator ?? new ZipPackageExtractor();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function lastWrittenFiles(): array
    {
        return $this->lastWritten;
    }

    public function apply(VerifiedPackage $package, UpdateTarget $target, BackupRecord $backup): ApplyResult
    {
        $this->lastWritten = [];
        $extractedBase = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $package->extractedPath), '/');
        $sortedFiles = $this->sortManifestFiles($package->manifest->files);

        // Pré-validação completa de todos os caminhos em files[] e removed[] (defesa em profundidade)
        foreach ($sortedFiles as $entry) {
            $relPath = $entry['path'];
            $mode = $entry['mode'] ?? 'replace';
            $this->assertValidAndAllowedPath($target->kind, $target->slug, $relPath, $mode);
        }

        foreach ($package->manifest->removed as $removedPath) {
            $this->assertValidAndAllowedPath($target->kind, $target->slug, $removedPath, 'replace');
            if ($this->isProtected($target->kind, $target->slug, $removedPath)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Tentativa bloqueada de remover caminho protegido: "%s".',
                    $removedPath
                ));
            }
        }

        $written = [];
        $removed = [];
        $skippedProtected = [];

        foreach ($sortedFiles as $entry) {
            $relPath = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $entry['path']), '/');
            $mode = $entry['mode'] ?? 'replace';
            $expectedSha = strtolower($entry['sha256']);

            $sourcePath = $extractedBase . '/' . $relPath;
            $destPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;

            if (!is_file($sourcePath) || !is_readable($sourcePath)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Arquivo de origem ausente na quarentena durante aplicação: "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            $isProtected = $this->isProtected($target->kind, $target->slug, $relPath);

            if ($isProtected) {
                if ($mode === 'default_if_missing') {
                    if (file_exists($destPath)) {
                        $skippedProtected[] = $relPath;
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    $skippedProtected[] = $relPath;
                    continue;
                }
            } elseif ($mode === 'default_if_missing' && file_exists($destPath)) {
                $skippedProtected[] = $relPath;
                continue;
            }

            // Pula arquivo se já existir em disco com o mesmo hash SHA-256
            if (is_file($destPath)) {
                $currentHash = @hash_file('sha256', $destPath);
                if ($currentHash !== false && hash_equals($expectedSha, strtolower($currentHash))) {
                    continue;
                }
            }

            $parentDir = dirname($destPath);
            if (file_exists($parentDir) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'O caminho pai de "%s" é um arquivo existente e impede a criação do diretório.',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Não foi possível criar diretório de destino para "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            $permissions = $this->resolvePermissions($relPath, $destPath);
            $tmpFile = $parentDir . '/.' . basename($destPath) . '.dsnew';

            if (!@copy($sourcePath, $tmpFile)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Falha ao gravar arquivo temporário ".dsnew" para "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            @chmod($tmpFile, $permissions);

            if (DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR === '\\' && is_file($destPath)) {
                if (!@unlink($destPath)) {
                    @unlink($tmpFile);
                    throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                        'Não foi possível remover arquivo anterior antes da troca em "%s".',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }
            }

            if (!@rename($tmpFile, $destPath)) {
                @unlink($tmpFile);
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Falha ao renomear arquivo temporário para "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            @chmod($destPath, $permissions);
            $written[] = $relPath;
            $this->lastWritten[] = $relPath;
        }

        foreach ($package->manifest->removed as $removedRaw) {
            $relPath = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $removedRaw), '/');
            $destPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;

            if (is_dir($destPath)) {
                throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                    'Remoção de diretório inteiro em "removed" não permitida: "%s".',
                    $relPath
                ));
            }

            if (is_file($destPath)) {
                if (!@unlink($destPath)) {
                    throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                        'Falha ao remover arquivo obsoleto "%s".',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }
                $removed[] = $relPath;
            }
        }

        if (function_exists('opcache_reset')) {
            @opcache_reset();
        }

        return new ApplyResult(
            backup: $backup,
            written: $written,
            removed: $removed,
            skippedProtected: $skippedProtected,
        );
    }

    public function revert(ApplyResult $result): void
    {
        try {
            $backupFilesMap = $this->readBackupFileSet($result->backup->codePath);

            $this->backup->restore($result->backup);

            $candidatesToClean = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($result->written, $this->lastWritten)));
            foreach ($candidatesToClean as $writtenRel) {
                $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $writtenRel), '/');
                if (!isset($backupFilesMap[$normalized])) {
                    $fullPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $normalized;
                    if (is_file($fullPath)) {
                        @unlink($fullPath);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (function_exists('opcache_reset')) {
                @opcache_reset();
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($e instanceof RollbackFailedException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new RollbackFailedException('Falha ao reverter aplicação do pacote: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array{path: string, sha256: string, size: int, mode: string}> $files
     * @return list<array{path: string, sha256: string, size: int, mode: string}>
     */
    private function sortManifestFiles(array $files): array
    {
        usort($files, function (array $a, array $b): int {
            $prioA = $this->stagePriority($a['path']);
            $prioB = $this->stagePriority($b['path']);
            if ($prioA !== $prioB) {
                return $prioA <=> $prioB;
            }
            return strcmp($a['path'], $b['path']);
        });

        return $files;
    }

    private function stagePriority(string $relPath): int
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');

        if ($normalized === 'public/index.php') {
            return 40;
        }
        if ($normalized === 'bootstrap.php') {
            return 41;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, 'vendor/')) {
            return 10;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, 'src/')) {
            return 20;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, 'themes/')) {
            return 30;
        }

        return 35;
    }

    private function assertValidAndAllowedPath(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug, string $relPath, string $mode): void
    {
        try {
            $this->pathValidator->assertSafeRelativePath($relPath);
        } catch (PackageIntegrityException $e) {
            throw new ApplyException($e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        $allowed = false;
        if ($this->protectedPaths instanceof CoreProtectedPaths) {
            $allowed = $this->protectedPaths->isAllowedPath($kind, $slug, $relPath, $mode);
        } else {
            $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
            if ($kind === UpdateKind::Core && $mode === 'default_if_missing' && str_starts_with($normalized, 'config/')) {
                $allowed = true;
            } else {
                foreach ($this->protectedPaths->allowedRoots($kind, $slug) as $root) {
                    $normRoot = str_replace('\\', '/', $root);
                    if (str_ends_with($normRoot, '/')) {
                        if (str_starts_with($normalized, $normRoot) && strlen($normalized) > strlen($normRoot)) {
                            $allowed = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    } elseif ($normalized === $normRoot) {
                        $allowed = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!$allowed) {
            throw new ApplyException(sprintf(
                'Caminho fora das raízes permitidas na aplicação: "%s".',
                $relPath
            ));
        }
    }

    private function isProtected(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug, string $relPath): bool
    {
        if ($this->protectedPaths instanceof CoreProtectedPaths) {
            return $this->protectedPaths->isProtectedPath($kind, $slug, $relPath);
        }

        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        foreach ($this->protectedPaths->protectedPaths($kind, $slug) as $protected) {
            $normProt = str_replace('\\', '/', $protected);
            if (str_ends_with($normProt, '/')) {
                $prefix = rtrim($normProt, '/');
                if ($normalized === $prefix || str_starts_with($normalized, $normProt)) {
                    return true;
                }
            } elseif ($normalized === $normProt || str_starts_with($normalized, $normProt . '/')) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function resolvePermissions(string $relPath, string $destPath): int
    {
        if (is_file($destPath)) {
            $perms = @fileperms($destPath);
            if ($perms !== false) {
                return $perms & 0777;
            }
        }

        if ($relPath === 'os-cli.php' || str_starts_with($relPath, 'bin/')) {
            return 0755;
        }

        return 0644;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, bool>
     */
    private function readBackupFileSet(string $zipPath): array
    {
        $map = [];
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::RDONLY) === true) {
            for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
                $name = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
                if (is_string($name) && !str_ends_with($name, '/')) {
                    $map[ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $name), '/')] = true;
                }
            }
            $zip->close();
        }
        return $map;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/UpdateConfig.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final class UpdateConfig
{
    private string $configFile;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;

    /**
     * @var array{core_repository: string, channel: string, check_ttl_hours: int, auto_rollback: bool}|null
     */
    private ?array $cached = null;

    public function __construct(string $rootPath, ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null)
    {
        $normalizedRoot = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->configFile = $normalizedRoot . '/config/update.json';
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
    }

    public function coreRepository(): string
    {
        return $this->load()['core_repository'];
    }

    public function channel(): string
    {
        return $this->load()['channel'];
    }

    public function checkTtlHours(): int
    {
        return $this->load()['check_ttl_hours'];
    }

    public function autoRollback(): bool
    {
        return $this->load()['auto_rollback'];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{core_repository: string, channel: string, check_ttl_hours: int, auto_rollback: bool}
     */
    public function load(): array
    {
        if ($this->cached !== null) {
            return $this->cached;
        }

        $defaults = [
            'core_repository' => 'hadelrachid/domain-system',
            'channel'         => 'stable',
            'check_ttl_hours' => 12,
            'auto_rollback'   => true,
        ];

        $raw = $this->jsonStore->read($this->configFile, $defaults);

        $repo = (string)($raw['core_repository'] ?? $defaults['core_repository']);
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/', $repo) !== 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Repositório inválido em config/update.json: {$repo}");
        }

        $channel = trim((string)($raw['channel'] ?? $defaults['channel']));
        if ($channel === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo channel em config/update.json não pode ser vazio.');
        }

        $ttlHours = (int)($raw['check_ttl_hours'] ?? $defaults['check_ttl_hours']);
        if ($ttlHours < 1) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('O campo check_ttl_hours em config/update.json deve ser >= 1.');
        }

        $autoRollback = isset($raw['auto_rollback']) ? (bool)$raw['auto_rollback'] : true;

        $this->cached = [
            'core_repository' => $repo,
            'channel'         => $channel,
            'check_ttl_hours' => $ttlHours,
            'auto_rollback'   => $autoRollback,
        ];

        return $this->cached;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\NotificationManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\CoreUpdaterInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\DatabaseBackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HealthCheckInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HttpClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\InstalledStateProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MaintenanceModeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\MigrationRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\PreflightInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ProtectedPathsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\ReleaseSourceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaMigratorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaPlannerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaProbeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\SchemaVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateApplierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateCheckerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateLockInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateManifestParserInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdatePackageVerifierInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateStateStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\UpdateTargetResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\VersionComparatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\PdoMigrationRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\PdoSchemaProbe;
use DomainSystem\Core\Database\Update\RunnerSchemaMigrator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\DiskSpaceCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\DowngradeCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\ExtensionsCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\PhpVersionCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\PluginCompatibilityCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\ProtocolCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\SchemaPlanCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Preflight\WritablePathsCheck;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\CoreUpdater;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\JsonUpdateManifestParser;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\Preflight;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SchemaPlanner;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SchemaVerifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\SemverComparator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateChecker;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateNotifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\UpdateTargetResolver;
use Throwable;

final class UpdateServiceBinder
{
    public static function bind(OsRuntimeInterface|ContainerInterface $runtime, string $rootPath): void
    {
        $normalizedRoot = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateConfig::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): UpdateConfig {
            $jsonStore = self::resolveOptional($c, JsonStoreInterface::class);
            return new UpdateConfig($normalizedRoot, $jsonStore);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(HttpClientInterface::class, static function (): HttpClientInterface {
            return new CurlHttpClient(new HostAllowlist());
        });

        $runtime->singleton(VersionComparatorInterface::class, static function (): VersionComparatorInterface {
            return new SemverComparator();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): UpdateStateStoreInterface {
            $jsonStore = self::resolveOptional($c, JsonStoreInterface::class);
            return new JsonUpdateStateStore($normalizedRoot, $jsonStore);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateLockInterface::class, static function () use ($normalizedRoot): UpdateLockInterface {
            return new FileUpdateLock($normalizedRoot);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(InstalledStateProviderInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): InstalledStateProviderInterface {
            $jsonStore = self::resolveOptional($c, JsonStoreInterface::class);
            return new FilesystemInstalledState($normalizedRoot, null, $jsonStore);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateTargetResolverInterface::class, static function ($c): UpdateTargetResolverInterface {
            /** @var UpdateConfig $config */
            $config = $c->make(UpdateConfig::class);
            /** @var InstalledStateProviderInterface $installed */
            $installed = $c->make(InstalledStateProviderInterface::class);

            return new UpdateTargetResolver(
                installedState: $installed,
                coreRepository: $config->coreRepository(),
                channel: $config->channel(),
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ReleaseSourceInterface::class, static function ($c): ReleaseSourceInterface {
            return new GitHubReleaseSource(
                httpClient: $c->make(HttpClientInterface::class),
                versionComparator: $c->make(VersionComparatorInterface::class),
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateCheckerInterface::class, static function ($c): UpdateCheckerInterface {
            /** @var UpdateConfig $config */
            $config = $c->make(UpdateConfig::class);
            $notifications = self::resolveOptional($c, NotificationManagerInterface::class);

            return new UpdateChecker(
                releaseSource: $c->make(ReleaseSourceInterface::class),
                versionComparator: $c->make(VersionComparatorInterface::class),
                stateStore: $c->make(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                ttlHours: $config->checkTtlHours(),
                clock: null,
                notifications: $notifications,
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateNotifier::class, static function ($c): UpdateNotifier {
            $notifications = self::resolveOptional($c, NotificationManagerInterface::class);
            return new UpdateNotifier(
                stateStore: $c->make(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                notifications: $notifications,
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ProtectedPathsInterface::class, static function (): ProtectedPathsInterface {
            return new CoreProtectedPaths();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateManifestParserInterface::class, static function (): UpdateManifestParserInterface {
            return new JsonUpdateManifestParser();
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdatePackageVerifierInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): UpdatePackageVerifierInterface {
            return new Sha256PackageVerifier(
                manifestParser: $c->make(UpdateManifestParserInterface::class),
                protectedPaths: $c->make(ProtectedPathsInterface::class),
                extractor: new ZipPackageExtractor(),
                quarantineBaseDir: $normalizedRoot . '/temp/updates',
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(MigrationRegistryInterface::class, static function ($c): MigrationRegistryInterface {
            return new PdoMigrationRegistry($c->make(DatabaseConnectionInterface::class));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(SchemaProbeInterface::class, static function ($c): SchemaProbeInterface {
            return new PdoSchemaProbe($c->make(DatabaseConnectionInterface::class));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(SchemaPlannerInterface::class, static function ($c): SchemaPlannerInterface {
            return new SchemaPlanner($c->make(MigrationRegistryInterface::class));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(SchemaMigratorInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): SchemaMigratorInterface {
            return new RunnerSchemaMigrator(
                $c->make(DatabaseConnectionInterface::class),
                $normalizedRoot,
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(SchemaVerifierInterface::class, static function ($c): SchemaVerifierInterface {
            return new SchemaVerifier(
                $c->make(SchemaProbeInterface::class),
                $c->make(MigrationRegistryInterface::class),
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(PreflightInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): PreflightInterface {
            return new Preflight([
                new PhpVersionCheck(),
                new ExtensionsCheck(),
                new DiskSpaceCheck($normalizedRoot),
                new WritablePathsCheck($normalizedRoot, $c->make(ProtectedPathsInterface::class)),
                new ProtocolCheck($c->make(UpdateManifestParserInterface::class)),
                new DowngradeCheck($c->make(VersionComparatorInterface::class)),
                new PluginCompatibilityCheck($c->make(InstalledStateProviderInterface::class)),
                new SchemaPlanCheck($c->make(SchemaPlannerInterface::class)),
            ]);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(BackupInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): BackupInterface {
            $jsonStore = self::resolveOptional($c, JsonStoreInterface::class);
            return new ZipDirectoryBackup($normalizedRoot, null, $jsonStore);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(MaintenanceModeInterface::class, static function () use ($normalizedRoot): MaintenanceModeInterface {
            return new FileMaintenanceMode($normalizedRoot);
        });

        $runtime->singleton(UpdateApplierInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): UpdateApplierInterface {
            return new StagedUpdateApplier(
                $normalizedRoot,
                $c->make(ProtectedPathsInterface::class),
                $c->make(BackupInterface::class),
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(HealthCheckInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): HealthCheckInterface {
            $jsonStore = self::resolveOptional($c, JsonStoreInterface::class);
            return new CoreHealthCheck(
                rootPath: $normalizedRoot,
                container: $c,
                installedState: $c->make(InstalledStateProviderInterface::class),
                stateStore: $c->make(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                schemaVerifier: $c->make(SchemaVerifierInterface::class),
                manifestParser: $c->make(UpdateManifestParserInterface::class),
                jsonStore: $jsonStore,
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(CoreUpdaterInterface::class, static function ($c) use ($normalizedRoot): CoreUpdaterInterface {
            /** @var UpdateConfig $config */
            $config = $c->make(UpdateConfig::class);

            return new CoreUpdater(
                targetResolver: $c->make(UpdateTargetResolverInterface::class),
                checker: $c->make(UpdateCheckerInterface::class),
                releaseSource: $c->make(ReleaseSourceInterface::class),
                manifestParser: $c->make(UpdateManifestParserInterface::class),
                packageVerifier: $c->make(UpdatePackageVerifierInterface::class),
                preflight: $c->make(PreflightInterface::class),
                schemaPlanner: $c->make(SchemaPlannerInterface::class),
                backup: $c->make(BackupInterface::class),
                databaseBackup: $c->make(DatabaseBackupInterface::class),
                maintenanceMode: $c->make(MaintenanceModeInterface::class),
                applier: $c->make(UpdateApplierInterface::class),
                schemaMigrator: $c->make(SchemaMigratorInterface::class),
                schemaVerifier: $c->make(SchemaVerifierInterface::class),
                healthCheck: $c->make(HealthCheckInterface::class),
                stateStore: $c->make(UpdateStateStoreInterface::class),
                lock: $c->make(UpdateLockInterface::class),
                tempUpdatesDir: $normalizedRoot . '/temp/updates',
                autoRollback: $config->autoRollback(),
                events: self::resolveOptional($c, EventDispatcherInterface::class),
                notifications: self::resolveOptional($c, NotificationManagerInterface::class),
            );
        });
    }

    private static function resolveOptional(mixed $container, string $abstract): mixed
    {
        if (!is_object($container) || !method_exists($container, 'make')) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            if (method_exists($container, 'has') && !$container->has($abstract)) {
                return null;
            }
            return $container->make($abstract);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/ZipDirectoryBackup.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\JsonStoreInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\BackupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Storage\AtomicJsonStore;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\RollbackFailedException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupRecord;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Backup e restauração de código e configuração em arquivos ZIP (`storage/backups/`).
 *
 * Para `BackupScope(core)`:
 * - Inclui: `src/`, `public/` (exceto `uploads`), `themes/`, `vendor/`, `bin/`, `tools/`,
 *   arquivos da raiz e `config/*.json`.
 * - Exclui: `storage/`, `temp/`, `.git/`, `.env`, `database.sqlite`, `uploads/`, `public/uploads/`.
 */
final class ZipDirectoryBackup implements BackupInterface
{
    private const CORE_INCLUDED_DIRS = [
        'src',
        'public',
        'themes',
        'vendor',
        'bin',
        'tools',
        'release',
    ];

    private const EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = [
        'storage/',
        'temp/',
        '.git/',
        'uploads/',
        'public/uploads/',
    ];

    private const EXCLUDED_EXACT = [
        '.env',
        'database.sqlite',
        '.git',
        '.DS_Store',
        'Thumbs.db',
    ];

    private string $rootPath;
    private string $backupsBaseDir;
    private JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore;
    private ZipPackageExtractor $extractor;

    public function __construct(
        string $rootPath,
        ?string $backupsBaseDir = null,
        ?JsonStoreInterface $jsonStore = null,
        ?ZipPackageExtractor $extractor = null,
    ) {
        $this->rootPath = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $rootPath), '/');
        $this->backupsBaseDir = $backupsBaseDir !== null
            ? rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $backupsBaseDir), '/')
            : $this->rootPath . '/storage/backups';
        $this->jsonStore = $jsonStore ?? new AtomicJsonStore();
        $this->extractor = $extractor ?? new ZipPackageExtractor();
    }

    public function create(BackupScope $scope, string $label): BackupRecord
    {
        $this->ensureBackupsRootProtected();

        $id = gmdate('Ymd_His') . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
        $scopeDir = $this->resolveScopeDirectory($scope) . '/' . $id;

        if (!is_dir($scopeDir) && !@mkdir($scopeDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($scopeDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de backup: "%s".', $scopeDir));
        }

        $zipPath = $scopeDir . '/code.zip';

        $filesToBackup = $scope->kind === UpdateKind::Core
            ? $this->collectCoreFiles()
            : $this->collectPluginFiles($scope->slug);

        if (class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            $zip = new ZipArchive();
            if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
                throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo ZIP de backup: "%s".', $zipPath));
            }

            foreach ($filesToBackup as $relPath) {
                $fullPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                if (is_file($fullPath) && !is_link($fullPath)) {
                    $zip->addFile($fullPath, $relPath);
                }
            }

            // Garante que o arquivo ZIP seja gravado mesmo se a árvore tiver apenas marcador vazio
            if ($filesToBackup === []) {
                $zip->addFromString('.ds_empty_backup', '');
            }

            if (!$zip->close()) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao finalizar gravação do arquivo code.zip no backup.');
            }
        } elseif (class_exists(\PharData::class)) {
            @unlink($zipPath);
            $phar = new \PharData($zipPath, 0, null, \Phar::ZIP);
            $fileMap = [];
            foreach ($filesToBackup as $relPath) {
                $fullPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                if (is_file($fullPath) && !is_link($fullPath)) {
                    $fileMap[$relPath] = $fullPath;
                }
            }

            if ($fileMap === []) {
                $phar->addFromString('.ds_empty_backup', '');
            } else {
                $phar->buildFromIterator(new \ArrayIterator($fileMap));
            }
        } else {
            throw new RuntimeException('A extensão PHP "zip" ou PharData é obrigatória para criar backups.');
        }

        $record = new BackupRecord(
            id: $id,
            scope: $scope,
            label: $label,
            createdAt: gmdate('c'),
            codePath: $zipPath,
            dumpPath: null,
        );

        $this->jsonStore->write($scopeDir . '/meta.json', $record->toArray());

        return $record;
    }

    /**
     * Associa um caminho de dump de banco de dados ao registro de backup e atualiza `meta.json`.
     */
    public function attachDumpPath(BackupRecord $record, string $dumpPath): BackupRecord
    {
        $updated = new BackupRecord(
            id: $record->id,
            scope: $record->scope,
            label: $record->label,
            createdAt: $record->createdAt,
            codePath: $record->codePath,
            dumpPath: $dumpPath,
        );

        $metaPath = dirname($record->codePath) . '/meta.json';
        $this->jsonStore->write($metaPath, $updated->toArray());

        return $updated;
    }

    public function restore(BackupRecord $record): void
    {
        if (!is_file($record->codePath) || !is_readable($record->codePath)) {
            throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                'Arquivo de backup não encontrado ou ilegível: "%s".',
                $record->codePath
            ));
        }

        $stagingDir = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/.restore-staging-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));

        try {
            $this->extractor->extract($record->codePath, $stagingDir);

            $marker = $stagingDir . '/.ds_empty_backup';
            if (is_file($marker)) {
                @unlink($marker);
            }

            $baseLen = strlen($stagingDir) + 1;
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($stagingDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
            );

            foreach ($iterator as $item) {
                if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                    continue;
                }

                $relPath = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
                $this->extractor->assertSafeRelativePath($relPath);

                if ($this->isExcludedRelativePath($relPath)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $destPath = $this->rootPath . '/' . $relPath;
                $destDir = dirname($destPath);
                if (!is_dir($destDir) && !@mkdir($destDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destDir)) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Não foi possível criar diretório "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $destDir
                    ));
                }

                $tmpPath = $destDir . '/.' . basename($destPath) . '.dsrestore.' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3));
                if (!@copy($item->getPathname(), $tmpPath)) {
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Falha ao copiar arquivo temporário para "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }

                if (DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR === '\\' && is_file($destPath)) {
                    @unlink($destPath);
                }

                if (!@rename($tmpPath, $destPath)) {
                    @unlink($tmpPath);
                    throw new RollbackFailedException(sprintf(
                        'Falha ao substituir "%s" durante a restauração.',
                        $relPath
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($e instanceof RollbackFailedException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new RollbackFailedException('Erro ao restaurar backup de código: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        } finally {
            ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($stagingDir);
        }
    }

    public function list(?BackupScope $scope = null): array
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->backupsBaseDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $scopeDirs = [];
        if ($scope !== null) {
            $dir = $this->resolveScopeDirectory($scope);
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                $scopeDirs[] = $dir;
            }
        } else {
            $coreDir = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/core';
            if (is_dir($coreDir)) {
                $scopeDirs[] = $coreDir;
            }
            $pluginsBase = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/plugins';
            if (is_dir($pluginsBase)) {
                foreach (scandir($pluginsBase) ?: [] as $slug) {
                    if ($slug === '.' || $slug === '..') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $pDir = $pluginsBase . '/' . $slug;
                    if (is_dir($pDir)) {
                        $scopeDirs[] = $pDir;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $records = [];
        foreach ($scopeDirs as $sDir) {
            foreach (scandir($sDir) ?: [] as $entry) {
                if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                    continue;
                }
                $metaPath = $sDir . '/' . $entry . '/meta.json';
                if (!is_file($metaPath)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $data = $this->jsonStore->read($metaPath, []);
                if ($data === []) {
                    continue;
                }
                try {
                    $records[] = BackupRecord::fromArray($data);
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }

        usort(
            $records,
            static function (BackupRecord $a, BackupRecord $b): int {
                $cmp = strcmp($b->createdAt, $a->createdAt);
                return $cmp !== 0 ? $cmp : strcmp($b->id, $a->id);
            }
        );

        return $records;
    }

    public function prune(BackupScope $scope, int $keep): int
    {
        $keep = max(0, $keep);
        $records = $this->list($scope);

        if (count($records) <= $keep) {
            return 0;
        }

        $toRemove = array_slice($records, $keep);
        $removedCount = 0;

        foreach ($toRemove as $record) {
            $backupDir = dirname($record->codePath);
            if (is_dir($backupDir)) {
                ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($backupDir);
                $removedCount++;
            }
        }

        return $removedCount;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectCoreFiles(): array
    {
        $files = [];

        // 1. Arquivos soltos na raiz
        foreach (scandir($this->rootPath) ?: [] as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            $full = $this->rootPath . '/' . $entry;
            if (is_file($full) && !is_link($full) && !$this->isExcludedRelativePath($entry)) {
                $files[] = $entry;
            }
        }

        // 2. config/*.json
        $configDir = $this->rootPath . '/config';
        if (is_dir($configDir)) {
            foreach (glob($configDir . '/*.json') ?: [] as $jsonFile) {
                if (is_file($jsonFile) && !is_link($jsonFile)) {
                    $files[] = 'config/' . basename($jsonFile);
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Diretórios do núcleo
        foreach (self::CORE_INCLUDED_DIRS as $dirName) {
            $dirFull = $this->rootPath . '/' . $dirName;
            if (!is_dir($dirFull)) {
                continue;
            }

            $baseLen = strlen($this->rootPath) + 1;
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dirFull, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
                RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
            );

            foreach ($iterator as $item) {
                if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                    continue;
                }
                $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
                if (!$this->isExcludedRelativePath($rel)) {
                    $files[] = $rel;
                }
            }
        }

        sort($files);
        return array_values(array_unique($files));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function collectPluginFiles(string $slug): array
    {
        $cleanSlug = trim($slug, '/\\');
        $pluginDir = $this->rootPath . '/src/Plugins/' . $cleanSlug;
        if (!is_dir($pluginDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        $files = [];
        $baseLen = strlen($this->rootPath) + 1;
        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pluginDir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            if (!$item->isFile() || $item->isLink()) {
                continue;
            }
            $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($item->getPathname(), $baseLen));
            if (!$this->isExcludedRelativePath($rel)) {
                $files[] = $rel;
            }
        }

        sort($files);
        return $files;
    }

    private function isExcludedRelativePath(string $relPath): bool
    {
        $normalized = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relPath), '/');
        if ($normalized === '') {
            return true;
        }

        $basename = basename($normalized);
        if (in_array($normalized, self::EXCLUDED_EXACT, true) || in_array($basename, ['.DS_Store', 'Thumbs.db'], true)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (
            str_ends_with($normalized, '.phar')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.sqlite')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.zip')
            || str_ends_with($normalized, '.sha256')
        ) {
            return true;
        }

        foreach (self::EXCLUDED_PREFIXES as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($normalized, $prefix)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private function resolveScopeDirectory(BackupScope $scope): string
    {
        if ($scope->kind === UpdateKind::Core) {
            return $this->backupsBaseDir . '/core';
        }

        return $this->backupsBaseDir . '/plugins/' . preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', $scope->slug);
    }

    private function ensureBackupsRootProtected(): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($this->backupsBaseDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->backupsBaseDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $htaccess = $this->backupsBaseDir . '/.htaccess';
        if (!is_file($htaccess)) {
            @file_put_contents(
                $htaccess,
                "<IfModule mod_authz_core.c>\n    Require all denied\n</IfModule>\n<IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>\n    Deny from all\n</IfModule>\n"
            );
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Infrastructure/ZipPackageExtractor.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Extrator seguro de pacotes ZIP em diretório de quarentena.
 *
 * Aplica defesas contra:
 * - Zip-Slip (`..`, caminhos absolutos, barras invertidas, letras de unidade, bytes nulos)
 * - Links simbólicos (atributos Unix S_IFLNK no cabeçalho ZIP ou link criado em disco)
 * - Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive (`Foo.php` vs `foo.php`)
 * - Zip-Bomb (limite de quantidade de arquivos, tamanho total descompactado e razão de compressão)
 */
final class ZipPackageExtractor
{
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_FILES = 20000;
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 157286400; // 150 MB
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO = 100.0;
    private const RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES = 1024;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly int $maxFiles = self::DEFAULT_MAX_FILES,
        private readonly int $maxTotalBytes = self::DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES,
        private readonly float $maxCompressionRatio = self::DEFAULT_MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Extrai todos os arquivos do ZIP para `$destinationDir`.
     * Em caso de qualquer violação, remove `$destinationDir` antes de lançar `PackageIntegrityException`.
     *
     * @throws PackageIntegrityException
     */
    public function extract(string $archivePath, string $destinationDir): void
    {
        if (!is_file($archivePath) || !is_readable($archivePath)) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Arquivo ZIP de pacote não encontrado ou ilegível: %s', $archivePath));
        }

        if (!class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
            if (class_exists(\PharData::class)) {
                $this->extractWithPharData($archivePath, $destinationDir);
                return;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('A extensão PHP "zip" (ZipArchive) ou PharData é obrigatória para extrair pacotes de atualização.');
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $openResult = $zip->open($archivePath, ZipArchive::RDONLY);
        if ($openResult !== true) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Falha ao abrir arquivo ZIP (código %s).', (string)$openResult));
        }

        if (!is_dir($destinationDir) && !@mkdir($destinationDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destinationDir)) {
            $zip->close();
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de quarentena: %s', $destinationDir));
        }

        try {
            $numFiles = $zip->numFiles;
            if ($numFiles > $this->maxFiles) {
                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                    'O pacote excede o limite máximo de entradas permitido (%d > %d).',
                    $numFiles,
                    $this->maxFiles
                ));
            }

            $totalUncompressedBytes = 0;
            $seenLowerPaths = [];

            for ($i = 0; $i < $numFiles; $i++) {
                $stat = $zip->statIndex($i);
                if (!is_array($stat) || !isset($stat['name'])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível ler metadados da entrada #%d do ZIP.', $i));
                }

                $entryName = (string)$stat['name'];
                $this->assertSafeRelativePath($entryName);

                $opsys = 0;
                $attr = 0;
                if ($zip->getExternalAttributesIndex($i, $opsys, $attr)) {
                    $unixMode = ($attr >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                    if (($unixMode & 0xF000) === 0xA000) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                            'Link simbólico detectado e bloqueado no pacote: "%s".',
                            $entryName
                        ));
                    }
                }

                // Diretório puro
                if (str_ends_with($entryName, '/')) {
                    $dirPath = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, rtrim($entryName, '/'));
                    if (!is_dir($dirPath) && !@mkdir($dirPath, 0755, true) && !is_dir($dirPath)) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Falha ao criar diretório na quarentena: "%s".', $entryName));
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                $lowerKey = strtolower($entryName);
                if (isset($seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive detectada no pacote: "%s" e "%s".',
                        $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey],
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }
                $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey] = $entryName;

                $declaredUncompressed = (int)($stat['size'] ?? 0);
                $declaredCompressed = (int)($stat['comp_size'] ?? 0);

                if ($declaredUncompressed < 0 || $declaredCompressed < 0) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Tamanho negativo inválido na entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                if ($declaredUncompressed >= self::RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES) {
                    if ($declaredCompressed === 0) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Suspeita de Zip-Bomb na entrada "%s" (comp_size=0).', $entryName));
                    }
                    $ratio = (float)$declaredUncompressed / (float)$declaredCompressed;
                    if ($ratio > $this->maxCompressionRatio) {
                        throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                            'Suspeita de Zip-Bomb na entrada "%s": razão de compressão %.1f excede o limite de %.1f.',
                            $entryName,
                            $ratio,
                            $this->maxCompressionRatio
                        ));
                    }
                }

                if (($totalUncompressedBytes + $declaredUncompressed) > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de tamanho descompactado (%d bytes).',
                        $this->maxTotalBytes
                    ));
                }

                $targetFile = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $entryName);
                $parentDir = dirname($targetFile);
                if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório pai para "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $stream = $zip->getStream($entryName);
                if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível abrir stream da entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $out = @fopen($targetFile, 'wb');
                if (!is_resource($out)) {
                    fclose($stream);
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo extraído "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $writtenForFile = 0;
                try {
                    while (!feof($stream)) {
                        $chunk = fread($stream, 65536);
                        if ($chunk === false) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de leitura ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                        $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                        if ($chunkLen === 0) {
                            break;
                        }

                        $writtenForFile += $chunkLen;
                        $totalUncompressedBytes += $chunkLen;

                        if ($totalUncompressedBytes > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                'Limite máximo descompactado (%d bytes) excedido durante a extração de "%s".',
                                $this->maxTotalBytes,
                                $entryName
                            ));
                        }

                        if ($writtenForFile >= self::RATIO_MIN_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES && $declaredCompressed > 0) {
                            $liveRatio = (float)$writtenForFile / (float)$declaredCompressed;
                            if ($liveRatio > $this->maxCompressionRatio) {
                                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                    'Suspeita de Zip-Bomb em streaming na entrada "%s" (razão %.1f).',
                                    $entryName,
                                    $liveRatio
                                ));
                            }
                        }

                        $written = fwrite($out, $chunk);
                        if ($written === false || $written !== $chunkLen) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de escrita ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    fclose($out);
                    fclose($stream);
                }

                if ($writtenForFile !== $declaredUncompressed) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Tamanho extraído (%d) diverge do cabeçalho ZIP (%d) para "%s".',
                        $writtenForFile,
                        $declaredUncompressed,
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }

                if (is_link($targetFile)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Link simbólico detectado após extração: "%s".', $entryName));
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $zip->close();
            self::removeDirectory($destinationDir);
            if ($e instanceof PackageIntegrityException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Erro ao extrair pacote ZIP: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        $zip->close();
    }

    private function extractWithPharData(string $archivePath, string $destinationDir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($destinationDir) && !@mkdir($destinationDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($destinationDir)) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório de quarentena: %s', $destinationDir));
        }

        try {
            $phar = new \PharData($archivePath);
            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator($phar, RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY);
            $fileCount = 0;
            $totalUncompressedBytes = 0;
            $seenLowerPaths = [];

            foreach ($iterator as $entry) {
                $fileCount++;
                if ($fileCount > $this->maxFiles) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de entradas permitido (%d > %d).',
                        $fileCount,
                        $this->maxFiles
                    ));
                }

                $entryName = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $iterator->getSubPathName()), '/');

                $this->assertSafeRelativePath($entryName);

                $lowerKey = strtolower($entryName);
                if (isset($seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey])) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Colisão de caminhos case-insensitive detectada no pacote: "%s" e "%s".',
                        $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey],
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }
                $seenLowerPaths[$lowerKey] = $entryName;

                $declaredUncompressed = (int)$entry->getSize();
                if (($totalUncompressedBytes + $declaredUncompressed) > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'O pacote excede o limite máximo de tamanho descompactado (%d bytes).',
                        $this->maxTotalBytes
                    ));
                }

                $targetFile = $destinationDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $entryName);
                $parentDir = dirname($targetFile);
                if (!is_dir($parentDir) && !@mkdir($parentDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($parentDir)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar diretório pai para "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $stream = @fopen($entry->getPathname(), 'rb');
                if (!is_resource($stream)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível abrir stream da entrada "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $out = @fopen($targetFile, 'wb');
                if (!is_resource($out)) {
                    fclose($stream);
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Não foi possível criar arquivo extraído "%s".', $entryName));
                }

                $writtenForFile = 0;
                try {
                    while (!feof($stream)) {
                        $chunk = fread($stream, 65536);
                        if ($chunk === false) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de leitura ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                        $chunkLen = strlen($chunk);
                        if ($chunkLen === 0) {
                            break;
                        }
                        $writtenForFile += $chunkLen;
                        $totalUncompressedBytes += $chunkLen;

                        if ($totalUncompressedBytes > $this->maxTotalBytes) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                                'Limite máximo descompactado (%d bytes) excedido durante a extração de "%s".',
                                $this->maxTotalBytes,
                                $entryName
                            ));
                        }

                        $written = fwrite($out, $chunk);
                        if ($written === false || $written !== $chunkLen) {
                            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Erro de escrita ao extrair "%s".', $entryName));
                        }
                    }
                } finally {
                    fclose($out);
                    fclose($stream);
                }

                if ($writtenForFile !== $declaredUncompressed) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                        'Tamanho extraído (%d) diverge do cabeçalho ZIP (%d) para "%s".',
                        $writtenForFile,
                        $declaredUncompressed,
                        $entryName
                    ));
                }

                if (is_link($targetFile)) {
                    throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Link simbólico detectado após extração: "%s".', $entryName));
                }
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            self::removeDirectory($destinationDir);
            if ($e instanceof PackageIntegrityException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Erro ao extrair pacote ZIP: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Valida que o caminho da entrada do ZIP é seguro e relativo.
     *
     * @throws PackageIntegrityException
     */
    public function assertSafeRelativePath(string $path): void
    {
        if ($path === '' || str_contains($path, "\0")) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Caminho de arquivo vazio ou contendo byte nulo no pacote.');
        }

        if (str_contains($path, '\\')) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Barra invertida não permitida no caminho do pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        if (str_starts_with($path, '/')) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Caminho absoluto não permitido no pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z]:/', $path) === 1) {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf('Letra de unidade não permitida no caminho do pacote: "%s".', $path));
        }

        $trimmed = rtrim($path, '/');
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new PackageIntegrityException('Entrada de diretório raiz "/" inválida no pacote.');
        }

        $segments = explode('/', $trimmed);
        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '' || $segment === '.' || $segment === '..') {
                throw new PackageIntegrityException(sprintf(
                    'Segmento de caminho inválido ("%s") detectado em "%s".',
                    $segment,
                    $path
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Remove recursivamente um diretório de quarentena.
     */
    public static function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }

        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
            new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir, RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
            RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST
        );

        foreach ($iterator as $item) {
            $itemPath = $item->getPathname();
            if ($item->isDir() && !$item->isLink()) {
                @rmdir($itemPath);
            } else {
                @unlink($itemPath);
            }
        }

        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Core/Update/Service/CoreUpdater.php
