            $router->addRoute('POST', '/aluno/aulas/{id}/notes', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'saveLessonNote'], 'academy');
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/aluno/aulas/{id}/notes', [StudentDashboardController::class, 'getLessonNote'], 'academy');
        });

        // 4. Shortcode: [hub_de_cursos]
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $manager) use ($runtime) {
            $manager->add('hub_de_cursos', function ($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseCatalogRendererInterface $renderer */
                    $renderer = $runtime->make(CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class);
                    return $renderer->render(is_array($attrs) ? $attrs : []);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    return "<div style='text-align:center; padding:30px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:8px; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>Hub de Cursos em configuração.</div>";
                }
            });
        });

        // 5. Integração com Pagamentos / Webhooks (DIP & Event-driven): ativa matrícula automaticamente
        $runtime->onHook('payment.approved', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));
            $orderRef = isset($payload['order_ref']) ? (string)$payload['order_ref'] : null;
            $expiresAt = isset($payload['expires_at']) && $payload['expires_at'] instanceof \DateTimeImmutable
                ? $payload['expires_at']
                : null;

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    /** @var CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService */
                    $enrollmentService = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentInterface::class);
                    $enrollmentService->enroll($userId, $courseId, $expiresAt, $orderRef);
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    // Proteção de isolamento de falhas
                }
            }
        });

        // 5b. Revogação de Matrícula por Reembolso (T13):
        $runtime->onHook('payment.refunded', function ($payload) use ($runtime) {
            if (!is_array($payload)) {
                return;
            }
            $userId = (int)($payload['user_id'] ?? 0);
            $courseId = (int)($payload['course_id'] ?? ($payload['item_id'] ?? 0));

            if ($userId > 0 && $courseId > 0) {
                try {
                    if ($runtime->has(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class)) {
                        /** @var CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo */
                        $enrollmentRepo = $runtime->make(CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($userId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
                    }
                } catch (Throwable $e) {
                    error_log('[Academy] Falha ao revogar matrícula por reembolso: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }
            }
        });

        // 6. Conexão com o Commerce (Padrão Adapter): expõe cursos como itens vendíveis
        $runtime->onHook('commerce.register_item_resolvers', function ($resolver) use ($runtime) {
            if ($resolver instanceof PurchasableItemResolverInterface) {
                $resolver->registerResolver('course', function (int $id) use ($runtime) {
                    try {
                        /** @var CourseRepositoryInterface $repo */
                        $repo = $runtime->make(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
                        $course = $repo->findById($id);
                        return $course ? new CoursePurchasableAdapter($course) : null;
                    } catch (Throwable $e) {
                        return null;
                    }
                });
            }
        });

        // 7. Registro de Blocos Semânticos no Flex Builder via Contrato (SOLID - OCP / DIP)
        $registerAcademyBlocks = function ($registry) use ($runtime) {
            if (is_object($registry) && method_exists($registry, 'has') && !$registry->has('user_auth')) {
                $session = null;
                try {
                    $session = $runtime->getLink('core.session');
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

                $provider = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Blocks\AcademyBlockProvider(
                    null,
                    null,
                    null,
                    $session
                );
                $provider->registerBlocks($registry);
            }
        };

        $runtime->onHook('theme.blocks.register', $registerAcademyBlocks);
        $runtime->onHook('flexbuilder.register_blocks', $registerAcademyBlocks);
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db');
        new PdoCourseRepository($db);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($db);
        $structureRepo->ensureTables();
        $enrollmentRepo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($db);
        $enrollmentRepo->ensureTable();
        $progressRepo = new PdoStudentProgressRepository($db);
        $progressRepo->ensureTable();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência de matrículas (SQLite e MySQL / ANSI SQL).
 */
class PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository implements CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTable();
        }
    }

    public function ensureTable(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $sql = "
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ";

        // Ajuste sintático para MySQL/MariaDB caso não seja SQLite
        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $sql = "
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_enrollments (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                    expires_at DATETIME NULL,
                    order_ref VARCHAR(128) NULL,
                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_course (user_id, course_id),
                    INDEX idx_status (status)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ";
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec($sql);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_academy_enrollments_uc ON academy_enrollments(user_id, course_id)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_enrollments_st ON academy_enrollments(status)");
            }
            $this->tableEnsured = true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia falha se já existir
        }
    }

    public function findByStudentAndCourse(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return is_array($row) ? $row : null;
    }

    public function findActiveByStudent(int $studentId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE user_id = ? 
              AND status = 'active'
              AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?)
            ORDER BY id DESC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $now]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function saveEnrollment(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        string $status = 'active',
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $existing = $this->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
        $expiresStr = $expiresAt ? $expiresAt->format('Y-m-d H:i:s') : null;
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        if ($existing) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                UPDATE academy_enrollments 
                SET status = ?, expires_at = ?, order_ref = ?, updated_at = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            ");
            return $stmt->execute([$status, $expiresStr, $orderRef, $now, (int)$existing['id']]);
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_enrollments (user_id, course_id, status, expires_at, order_ref, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        try {
            return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId, $status, $expiresStr, $orderRef, $now, $now]);
        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            // Em caso de colisão concorrente de chave única, atualiza o registro existente
            return $this->updateStatus($studentId, $courseId, $status);
        }
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $studentId, int $courseId, string $status): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_enrollments 
            SET status = ?, updated_at = ?
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$status, $now, $studentId, $courseId]);
    }

    public function countEnrolledInCourse(int $courseId): int
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as total 
            FROM academy_enrollments 
            WHERE course_id = ? AND status = 'active'
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return (int)($row['total'] ?? 0);
    }

    public function countActiveEnrollments(): int
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        try {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM academy_enrollments WHERE status = 'active'");
            return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;

class PdoCourseRepository implements CourseRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTableExists();
        }
    }

    public function findAll(): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT * FROM academy_courses ORDER BY id DESC");
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE slug = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findByExternalProductId(string $externalProductId): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE external_product_id = ? LIMIT 1");
        $stmt->execute([$externalProductId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublished(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $status = $filters['status'] ?? null;
        $limit = isset($filters['limit']) ? (int)$filters['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        if (!empty($status)) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute([$status]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_courses WHERE status IN ('published', 'soon') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {$limit}");
            $stmt->execute();
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function create(array $data): int
    {
        $this->ensureTableExists();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_courses (title, slug, thumbnail, description, status, link, price, is_free, max_installments, external_platform, external_product_id, external_checkout_url)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0),
            isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : ((float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0) > 0 ? 0 : 1),
            isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
            $data['external_platform'] ?? null,
            $data['external_product_id'] ?? null,
            $data['external_checkout_url'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function update(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTableExists();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            UPDATE academy_courses
            SET title = ?, slug = ?, thumbnail = ?, description = ?, status = ?, link = ?, price = ?, is_free = ?, max_installments = ?, external_platform = ?, external_product_id = ?, external_checkout_url = ?
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([
            $data['title'],
            $data['slug'],
            $data['thumbnail'] ?? null,
            $data['description'] ?? null,
            $data['status'] ?? 'draft',
            $data['link'] ?? null,
            (float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0),
            isset($data['is_free']) ? (int)(bool)$data['is_free'] : ((float)($data['price'] ?? 0.0) > 0 ? 0 : 1),
            isset($data['max_installments']) && (int)$data['max_installments'] > 0 ? (int)$data['max_installments'] : 12,
            $data['external_platform'] ?? null,
            $data['external_product_id'] ?? null,
            $data['external_checkout_url'] ?? null,
            $id
        ]);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_courses WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    public function ensureTableExists(): void
    {
        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000001_create_academy_courses.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN is_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN max_installments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_platform VARCHAR(50) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_product_id VARCHAR(100) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_courses ADD COLUMN external_checkout_url VARCHAR(255) NULL");
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

class PdoCourseStructureRepository implements CourseStructureRepositoryInterface
{
    private const VALID_STATUSES = ['draft', 'published'];
    private const VALID_SOURCE_TYPES = ['theme_file', 'content'];
    private const VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES = ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'];

    private static array $accentMap = [
        'á'=>'a','à'=>'a','ã'=>'a','â'=>'a','ä'=>'a',
        'é'=>'e','è'=>'e','ê'=>'e','ë'=>'e',
        'í'=>'i','ì'=>'i','î'=>'i','ï'=>'i',
        'ó'=>'o','ò'=>'o','õ'=>'o','ô'=>'o','ö'=>'o',
        'ú'=>'u','ù'=>'u','û'=>'u','ü'=>'u',
        'ç'=>'c','ñ'=>'n',
        'Á'=>'a','À'=>'a','Ã'=>'a','Â'=>'a','Ä'=>'a',
        'É'=>'e','È'=>'e','Ê'=>'e','Ë'=>'e',
        'Í'=>'i','Ì'=>'i','Î'=>'i','Ï'=>'i',
        'Ó'=>'o','Ò'=>'o','Õ'=>'o','Ô'=>'o','Ö'=>'o',
        'Ú'=>'u','Ù'=>'u','Û'=>'u','Ü'=>'u',
        'Ç'=>'c','Ñ'=>'n'
    ];

    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTables();
        }
    }

    public function getModules(int $courseId): array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_modules 
            WHERE course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function createModule(int $courseId, string $title, int $position = 0, ?string $folderSlug = null): int
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_modules (course_id, title, position, folder_slug) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $title, $position, $folderSlug]);
        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateModule(int $moduleId, array $data): bool
    {
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        if (isset($data['title'])) {
            $fields[] = 'title = ?';
            $values[] = $data['title'];
        }
        if (isset($data['position'])) {
            $fields[] = 'position = ?';
            $values[] = (int)$data['position'];
        }
        if (array_key_exists('folder_slug', $data)) {
            $fields[] = 'folder_slug = ?';
            $values[] = $data['folder_slug'];
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $moduleId;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_modules SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteModule(int $moduleId): bool
    {
        // Ao excluir módulo, desvincula as aulas para não perdê-las (ou exclui dependendo da regra)
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET module_id = NULL WHERE module_id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$moduleId]);

        $del = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE id = ?");
        return $del->execute([$moduleId]);
    }

    public function getLessons(int $courseId, ?int $moduleId = null): array
    {
        if ($moduleId !== null) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? AND module_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId, $moduleId]);
        } else {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
                SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
                WHERE course_id = ? 
                ORDER BY position ASC, id ASC
            ");
            $stmt->execute([$courseId]);
        }

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function getLessonById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {

        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getPublishedLessonBySlug(int $courseId, string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'");
        $stmt->execute([$courseId, $slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function findPublishedLessonGloballyBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT * FROM academy_lessons 
            WHERE slug = ? AND status = 'published' 
            ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$slug]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function createLesson(array $data): int
    {
        $sourceType = (string)($data['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
        $status = (string)($data['status'] ?? 'published');
        $mobileProfile = (string)($data['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer');
        if (!in_array($mobileProfile, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true)) {
            $mobileProfile = 'drawer';
        }

        $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

        $rawSlug = trim((string)($data['slug'] ?? ''));
        $rawTitle = trim((string)($data['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
        $slug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $rawTitle, (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lessons (
                course_id, module_id, title, slug, source_type, source, content, mobile_profile, position, status
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");

        $stmt->execute([
            $data['course_id'],
            $data['module_id'] ?? null,
            $rawTitle !== '' ? $rawTitle : 'Aula',
            $slug,
            $sourceType,
            $data['source'] ?? null,
            $data['content'] ?? null,
            $mobileProfile,
            $data['position'] ?? 0,
            $status,
        ]);

        return (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
    }

    public function updateLesson(int $id, array $data): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists('source_type', $data) || array_key_exists('status', $data)) {
            $sourceType = array_key_exists('source_type', $data) ? (string)$data['source_type'] : 'theme_file';
            $status = array_key_exists('status', $data) ? (string)$data['status'] : 'published';
            $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);
        }

        if (array_key_exists('mobile_profile', $data)) {
            $mp = (string)$data['mobile_profile'];
            $data['mobile_profile'] = in_array($mp, self::VALID_MOBILE_PROFILES, true) ? $mp : 'drawer';
        }

        if (array_key_exists('slug', $data)) {
            $data['slug'] = $this->sanitizeSlug((string)$data['slug'], (int)($data['position'] ?? 1));
        }

        $allowed = ['title', 'slug', 'module_id', 'source_type', 'source', 'content', 'mobile_profile', 'position', 'status'];
        $fields = [];
        $values = [];

        foreach ($allowed as $col) {
            if (array_key_exists($col, $data)) {
                $fields[] = "{$col} = ?";
                $values[] = $data[$col];
            }
        }

        if (empty($fields)) {
            return false;
        }

        $values[] = $id;
        $sql = "UPDATE academy_lessons SET " . implode(', ', $fields) . " WHERE id = ?";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        return $stmt->execute($values);
    }

    public function deleteLesson(int $id): bool
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE id = ?");
        return $stmt->execute([$id]);
    }

    /**
     * Sincroniza a estrutura do curso por diff (H-04), preservando os IDs existentes de módulos
     * e aulas quando correspondem por ID (ou por slug do curso) e validando os campos (M-10).
     */
    public function replaceCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        return $this->syncCourseStructure($courseId, $structure);
    }

    public function syncCourseStructure(int $courseId, array $structure): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $existingModules = [];
            foreach ($this->getModules($courseId) as $m) {
                $existingModules[(int)$m['id']] = $m;
            }

            $existingLessonsById = [];
            $existingLessonsBySlug = [];
            foreach ($this->getLessons($courseId) as $l) {
                $lId = (int)$l['id'];
                $existingLessonsById[$lId] = $l;
                $existingLessonsBySlug[(string)$l['slug']] = $l;
            }

            $keptModuleIds = [];
            $keptLessonIds = [];
            $usedSlugs = [];

            $modulePos = 1;
            $lessonPosGlobal = 1;

            foreach ($structure as $modData) {
                $modTitle = trim((string)($modData['title'] ?? 'Módulo Geral'));
                if ($modTitle === '') {
                    $modTitle = 'Módulo Geral';
                }
                $folderSlug = isset($modData['folder_slug']) && trim((string)$modData['folder_slug']) !== ''
                    ? trim((string)$modData['folder_slug'])
                    : null;

                $candidateModId = isset($modData['id']) ? (int)$modData['id'] : 0;
                if ($candidateModId > 0 && isset($existingModules[$candidateModId]) && !in_array($candidateModId, $keptModuleIds, true)) {
                    $this->updateModule($candidateModId, [
                        'title'       => $modTitle,
                        'position'    => $modulePos++,
                        'folder_slug' => $folderSlug ?? ($existingModules[$candidateModId]['folder_slug'] ?? null),
                    ]);
                    $moduleId = $candidateModId;
                } else {
                    $moduleId = $this->createModule($courseId, $modTitle, $modulePos++, $folderSlug);
                }
                $keptModuleIds[] = $moduleId;

                $lessons = $modData['lessons'] ?? [];
                if (!is_array($lessons)) {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                    $pos = $lessonPosGlobal++;
                    $title = trim((string)($lesson['title'] ?? 'Aula'));
                    if ($title === '') {
                        $title = 'Aula ' . $pos;
                    }

                    $sourceType = (string)($lesson['source_type'] ?? 'theme_file');
                    $status = (string)($lesson['status'] ?? 'published');
                    $this->assertValidLessonEnums($sourceType, $status);

                    $rawSlug = trim((string)($lesson['slug'] ?? ''));
                    $baseSlug = $this->sanitizeSlug($rawSlug !== '' ? $rawSlug : $title, $pos);
                    $slug = $this->deduplicateSlugInBatch($baseSlug, $usedSlugs);
                    $usedSlugs[$slug] = true;

                    $matchedLessonId = 0;
                    $candidateLessonId = isset($lesson['id']) ? (int)$lesson['id'] : 0;
                    if ($candidateLessonId > 0 && isset($existingLessonsById[$candidateLessonId]) && !in_array($candidateLessonId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                        $matchedLessonId = $candidateLessonId;
                    } elseif (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug])) {
                        $bySlugId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$baseSlug]['id'];
                        if (!in_array($bySlugId, $keptLessonIds, true)) {
                            $matchedLessonId = $bySlugId;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se vai atualizar ou criar com um slug que já pertence a outra aula do curso ainda no BD,
                    // limpa temporariamente o slug conflitante caso a outra aula vá ser removida/renomeada.
                    if (isset($existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]) && (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'] !== $matchedLessonId) {
                        $conflictId = (int)$existingLessonsBySlug[$slug]['id'];
                        $tmpStmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE academy_lessons SET slug = ? WHERE id = ?");
                        $tmpStmt->execute(['__tmp_' . $conflictId . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(3)), $conflictId]);
                    }

                    $mobileProfile = (string)($lesson['mobile_profile'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['mobile_profile'] ?? 'drawer') : 'drawer'));

                    $lessonPayload = [
                        'course_id'      => $courseId,
                        'module_id'      => $moduleId,
                        'title'          => $title,
                        'slug'           => $slug,
                        'source_type'    => $sourceType,
                        'source'         => $lesson['source'] ?? $lesson['theme_file'] ?? $lesson['file_path'] ?? null,
                        'content'        => $lesson['content'] ?? ($matchedLessonId > 0 ? ($existingLessonsById[$matchedLessonId]['content'] ?? null) : null),
                        'mobile_profile' => $mobileProfile,
                        'position'       => $pos,
                        'status'         => $status,
                    ];

                    if ($matchedLessonId > 0) {
                        $this->updateLesson($matchedLessonId, $lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $matchedLessonId;
                    } else {
                        $newLessonId = $this->createLesson($lessonPayload);
                        $keptLessonIds[] = $newLessonId;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Remove apenas aulas que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptLessonIds)) {
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delLessons->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptLessonIds), '?'));
                $delLessons = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_lessons WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delLessons->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptLessonIds));
            }

            // Remove apenas módulos que não fazem mais parte da estrutura
            if (empty($keptModuleIds)) {
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ?");
                $delModules->execute([$courseId]);
            } else {
                $placeholders = implode(',', array_fill(0, count($keptModuleIds), '?'));
                $delModules = $this->pdo->prepare("DELETE FROM academy_modules WHERE course_id = ? AND id NOT IN ({$placeholders})");
                $delModules->execute(array_merge([$courseId], $keptModuleIds));
            }

            $this->pdo->commit();
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if ($this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $migrationFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php';
        if (is_file($migrationFile)) {
            $migration = require $migrationFile;
            if (is_array($migration) && isset($migration['up']) && is_callable($migration['up'])) {
                ($migration['up'])($this->pdo);
            }
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    private function assertValidLessonEnums(string $sourceType, string $status): void
    {
        if (!in_array($sourceType, self::VALID_SOURCE_TYPES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Tipo de origem de aula inválido: {$sourceType}");
        }

        if (!in_array($status, self::VALID_STATUSES, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status de aula inválido: {$status}");
        }
    }

    private function sanitizeSlug(string $raw, int $fallbackPos = 1): string
    {
        $text = strtr($raw, self::$accentMap);
        if (function_exists('transliterator_transliterate')) {
            $trans = transliterator_transliterate('Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII; Lower()', $text);
            if ($trans !== false) {
                $text = $trans;
            }
        }

        $slug = strtolower(trim((string)preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/', '-', $text), '-'));
        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : ('aula-' . $fallbackPos);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, bool> $usedSlugs
     */
    private function deduplicateSlugInBatch(string $baseSlug, array $usedSlugs): string
    {
        $slug = $baseSlug;
        $counter = 1;
        while (isset($usedSlugs[$slug])) {
            $slug = "{$baseSlug}-{$counter}";
            $counter++;
        }
        return $slug;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoStudentAdminRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentAdminRepositoryInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência e consulta administrativa de alunos.
 * Resiliente a variações de schema da tabela users em produção (ex: ausência de username ou status).
 */
class PdoStudentAdminRepository implements StudentAdminRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $hasUsername = true;
    private bool $hasStatus = true;
    private bool $columnsChecked = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;
    }

    /**
     * Inspeciona as colunas da tabela users e executa auto-heal não-destrutivo se necessário.
     */
    private function ensureSchema(): void
    {
        if ($this->columnsChecked) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $colNames = [];
            $driver = '';
            try {
                $driver = (string)$this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
            } catch (Throwable) {
                $driver = 'mysql';
            }

            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("PRAGMA table_info(users)");
                if ($stmt) {
                    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'name'));
                }
            } else {
                $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users");
                if ($stmt) {
                    $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                    $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'Field'));
                }
            }

            $this->hasUsername = in_array('username', $colNames, true);
            $this->hasStatus = in_array('status', $colNames, true);

            // Auto-heal: tenta adicionar a coluna username se ausente
            if (!$this->hasUsername) {
                try {
                    $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN username VARCHAR(100) NULL");
                    $this->hasUsername = true;
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Se falhar (ex: sem privilégio DDL), mantém fallback para alias
                }
            }

            // Auto-heal: tenta adicionar a coluna status se ausente
            if (!$this->hasStatus) {
                try {
                    $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
                    $this->hasStatus = true;
                } catch (Throwable) {
                    // Mantém fallback para alias
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable) {
            // Em caso de falha de conexão ou tabela restrita, opera em modo seguro
            $this->hasUsername = false;
            $this->hasStatus = false;
        }

        $this->columnsChecked = true;
    }

    public function getPaginatedStudents(
        int $page = 1,
        int $perPage = 20,
        ?string $search = null,
        ?string $status = null
    ): array {
        $this->ensureSchema();

        $page = max(1, $page);
        $perPage = max(1, min(100, $perPage));
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;

        [$whereSql, $params] = $this->buildWhere($search, $status);

        $usernameField = $this->hasUsername ? "username" : "'' AS username";
        $statusField = $this->hasStatus ? "status" : "'active' AS status";

        $sql = "SELECT id, name, {$usernameField}, email, role, {$statusField}, created_at 
                FROM users 
                {$whereSql} 
                ORDER BY id DESC 
                LIMIT {$perPage} OFFSET {$offset}";

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    public function countStudents(?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): int
    {
        $this->ensureSchema();

        [$whereSql, $params] = $this->buildWhere($search, $status);

        $sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users {$whereSql}";
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($sql);
        $stmt->execute($params);

        return (int)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function updateStatus(int $studentId, string $status): void
    {
        $valid = ['active', 'suspended', 'banned'];
        if (!in_array($status, $valid, true)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Status inválido para aluno: {$status}");
        }

        $this->ensureSchema();
        if (!$this->hasStatus) {
            try {
                $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
                $this->hasStatus = true;
            } catch (Throwable) {
                return;
            }
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE users SET status = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$status, $studentId]);
    }

    public function updatePassword(int $studentId, string $passwordHash): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("UPDATE users SET password = ? WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$passwordHash, $studentId]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: string, 1: array<string, mixed>}
     */
    private function buildWhere(?string $search = null, ?string $status = null): array
    {
        $where = ["role IN ('user', 'student', 'subscriber')"];
        $params = [];

        if ($this->hasStatus && $status !== null && $status !== '' && $status !== 'all') {
            $where[] = "status = :status";
            $params[':status'] = $status;
        }

        if ($search !== null && trim($search) !== '') {
            if ($this->hasUsername) {
                $where[] = "(name LIKE :search OR email LIKE :search OR username LIKE :search)";
            } else {
                $where[] = "(name LIKE :search OR email LIKE :search)";
            }
            $params[':search'] = '%' . trim($search) . '%';
        }

        return ["WHERE " . implode(" AND ", $where), $params];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Repositories/PdoStudentProgressRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DatabaseConnectionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressRepositoryInterface;
use PDO;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Repositório PDO para persistência de progresso de aulas do aluno (ANSI SQL compatível com SQLite e MySQL).
 */
class PdoStudentProgressRepository implements StudentProgressRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tableEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(DatabaseConnectionInterface|PDO $connection, bool $autoEnsureSchema = true)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof DatabaseConnectionInterface
            ? $connection->getPdo()
            : $connection;

        if ($autoEnsureSchema) {
            $this->ensureTable();
        }
    }

    public function ensureTable(): void
    {
        if ($this->tableEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $sql = "
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lesson_progress (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                lesson_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                completed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ";

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        if ($driver === 'mysql') {
            $sql = "
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lesson_progress (
                    id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                    user_id INT NOT NULL,
                    course_id INT NOT NULL,
                    lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
                    completed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    UNIQUE KEY uq_user_lesson (user_id, lesson_id),
                    INDEX idx_user_course (user_id, course_id)
                ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            ";
        }

        try {
            $this->pdo->exec($sql);
            if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_progress_ul ON academy_lesson_progress(user_id, lesson_id)");
                $this->pdo->exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_academy_progress_uc ON academy_lesson_progress(user_id, course_id)");
            }
            $this->tableEnsured = true;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Silencia falha se já existir
        }
    }

    public function saveProgress(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        if ($this->hasCompleted($studentId, $lessonId)) {
            return true;
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            INSERT INTO academy_lesson_progress (user_id, course_id, lesson_id, completed_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId, $lessonId, date('Y-m-d H:i:s')]);
    }

    public function deleteProgress(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            DELETE FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND lesson_id = ?
        ");
        return $stmt->execute([$studentId, $lessonId]);
    }

    public function hasCompleted(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT id FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND lesson_id = ? 
            LIMIT 1
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $lessonId]);
        return (bool)$stmt->fetchColumn();
    }

    public function findCompletedLessonIds(int $studentId, int $courseId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTable();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("
            SELECT lesson_id FROM academy_lesson_progress 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND course_id = ? 
            ORDER BY lesson_id ASC
        ");
        $stmt->execute([$studentId, $courseId]);
        $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);

        $ids = [];
        if (is_array($rows)) {
            foreach ($rows as $val) {
                $ids[] = (int)$val;
            }
        }
        return $ids;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\ProductFulfillmentInterface;

/**
 * Responsável por atender e liberar a matrícula de cursos vendidos pelo Commerce (SRP / DIP).
 */
class AcademyCourseFulfillment implements ProductFulfillmentInterface
{
    private CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService;

    public function __construct(CourseEnrollmentInterface $enrollmentService)
    {
        $this->enrollmentService = $enrollmentService;
    }

    public function supports(string $itemType): bool
    {
        return in_array($itemType, ['course', 'academy_course', 'bundle'], true);
    }

    public function fulfill(int $userId, int $itemId, string $orderRef, array $metadata = []): bool
    {
        if ($userId <= 0 || $itemId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        $expiresAt = isset($metadata['expires_at']) && $metadata['expires_at'] instanceof \DateTimeImmutable
            ? $metadata['expires_at']
            : null;

        return $this->enrollmentService->enroll($userId, $itemId, $expiresAt, $orderRef);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PublicStorageInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

class CourseCatalogRenderer implements CourseCatalogRendererInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $repository;
    private ?PublicStorageInterface $storage;

    public function __construct(CourseRepositoryInterface $repository, ?PublicStorageInterface $storage = null)
    {
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->storage = $storage;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attrs Atributos do shortcode [hub_de_cursos limit="6" status="published"]
     */
    public function render(array $attrs = []): string
    {
        $limit = isset($attrs['limit']) ? (int)$attrs['limit'] : 12;
        if ($limit <= 0) {
            $limit = 12;
        }

        $status = $attrs['status'] ?? null;
        $filters = ['limit' => $limit];
        if (!empty($status) && in_array($status, ['published', 'soon', 'draft'], true)) {
            $filters['status'] = $status;
        }

        $courses = $this->repository->findPublished($filters);

        if (empty($courses)) {
            return "<div class='ds-academy-empty' style='text-align:center; padding:40px 20px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-radius:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.2); color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94);'>
                <p style='margin:0; font-size:1.05rem;'>Nenhum curso disponível no momento.</p>
            </div>";
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';

        $html = "<div class='academy-grid' style='display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; margin: 30px 0;'>";

        foreach ($courses as $course) {
            $title = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['title'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $desc = htmlspecialchars((string)($course['description'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            
            // Resolução agnóstica de Link (Evita 404 em subpastas e suporta checkouts externos)
            $rawLink = trim((string)($course['link'] ?? ''));
            if ($rawLink !== '') {
                if (str_starts_with($rawLink, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawLink, 'https://')) {
                    $finalLink = $rawLink;
                } else {
                    if ($baseUrl !== '' && !str_starts_with($rawLink, $baseUrl)) {
                        $finalLink = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawLink, '/');
                    } else {
                        $finalLink = '/' . ltrim($rawLink, '/');
                    }
                }
            } else {
                $finalLink = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . urlencode((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''));
            }
            $link = htmlspecialchars($finalLink, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');

            // Precificação e Parcelamento ("Quantas vezes")
            $price = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
            $isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? false : (isset($course['is_free']) ? (bool)$course['is_free'] : true);
            $maxInstallments = isset($course['max_installments']) && (int)$course['max_installments'] > 0
                ? (int)$course['max_installments']
                : 12;

            $pricingHtml = '';
            if ($isFree || $price <= 0.0) {
                $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                    <span style='background:rgba(40,167,69,0.15); color:#2ecc71; font-weight:700; font-size:0.82rem; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);'>GRATUITO</span>
                </div>";
                $btnText = "Acessar Conteúdo &rarr;";
                $btnBg = "var(--primary, #45f3ff)";
            } else {
                $formattedTotal = 'R$ ' . number_format($price, 2, ',', '.');
                if ($maxInstallments > 1) {
                    $installmentValue = $price / $maxInstallments;
                    $formattedInstallment = 'R$ ' . number_format($installmentValue, 2, ',', '.');
                    $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                        <div style='font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; color:#00d284;'>{$formattedTotal}</div>
                        <div style='font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); margin-top:2px;'>ou em até <strong style='color:#45f3ff;'>{$maxInstallments}x de {$formattedInstallment}</strong></div>
                    </div>";
                } else {
                    $pricingHtml = "<div class='course-pricing' style='margin-bottom:14px;'>
                        <div style='font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; color:#00d284;'>{$formattedTotal} à vista</div>
                    </div>";
                }
                $btnText = "Comprar";
                $btnBg = "linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370)";
            }

            if (!empty($course['thumbnail'])) {
                $rawThumb = (string)$course['thumbnail'];
                if ($this->storage !== null) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($this->storage->getPublicUrl($rawThumb), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } elseif (str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($rawThumb, 'data:')) {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($rawThumb, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                } else {
                    $thumbUrl = htmlspecialchars($baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawThumb, '/'), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                }
            } else {
                $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%231e2327"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 Academy</text></svg>';
            }

            $badge = '';
            if (($course['status'] ?? '') === 'soon') {
                $badge = "<span style='position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; background:#f0ad4e; color:#0b0c10; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); text-transform:uppercase;'>EM BREVE</span>";
            }

            $html .= "
            <div class=\"course-card glass-panel\" style=\"background:var(--bg-panel, #1d2327); border:1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.15); border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:relative; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;\">
                <div style=\"position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; background:#0b0c10; overflow:hidden;\">
                    <img src=\"{$thumbUrl}\" alt=\"{$title}\" style=\"width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;\" loading=\"lazy\">
                    {$badge}
                </div>
                <div style=\"padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex-grow:1;\">
                    <h3 style=\"margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--text-main, #ffffff); line-height:1.4;\">{$title}</h3>
                    <p style=\"margin:0 0 18px 0; color:var(--text-muted, #8c8f94); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.5; flex-grow:1;\">{$desc}</p>
                    {$pricingHtml}
                    <a href=\"{$link}\" style=\"display:inline-block; text-align:center; padding:10px 18px; border-radius:6px; background:{$btnBg}; color:#0b0c10; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; transition:opacity 0.2s;\" onmouseover=\"this.style.opacity='0.85'\" onmouseout=\"this.style.opacity='1'\">
                        {$btnText}
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>";
        }

        $html .= "</div>";

        $html .= "
        <style>
            .course-card:hover {
                transform: translateY(-4px);
                box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 12px rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2);
            }
        </style>";

        return $html;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseEnrollmentService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Negócio de Matrículas e Autorização de Acesso (SRP / DIP).
 */
class CourseEnrollmentService implements CourseEnrollmentInterface
{
    private CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo;
    private ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;

    public function __construct(
        CourseEnrollmentRepositoryInterface $enrollmentRepo,
        ?CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->enrollmentRepo = $enrollmentRepo;
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
    }

    public function hasActiveEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool
    {
        // 1. Validação estrita de entrada: IDs devem ser estritamente positivos
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        // 2. Se o curso existir e for explicitamente gratuito, libera para o aluno autenticado
        if ($this->courseRepo !== null) {
            $course = $this->courseRepo->findById($courseId);
            if ($course !== null) {
                $isFree = !empty($course['is_free']) || (isset($course['price']) && (float)$course['price'] <= 0.0);
                if ($isFree) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Verifica a existência de matrícula válida e ativa
        $enrollment = $this->enrollmentRepo->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
        if (!$enrollment) {
            return false;
        }

        if (($enrollment['status'] ?? '') !== 'active') {
            return false;
        }

        // 4. Verificação de expiração: falhar fechado em caso de data inválida/corrompida
        if (!empty($enrollment['expires_at'])) {
            try {
                $now = new DateTimeImmutable();
                $expiresAt = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('Y-m-d H:i:s', (string)$enrollment['expires_at']);
                if ($expiresAt === false) {
                    // Tenta parser genérico antes de invalidar
                    $expiresAt = new DateTimeImmutable((string)$enrollment['expires_at']);
                }

                if ($expiresAt <= $now) {
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                // Falha fechada: data malformada não concede acesso
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public function enroll(
        int $studentId,
        int $courseId,
        ?DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt = null,
        ?string $orderRef = null
    ): bool {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->saveEnrollment($studentId, $courseId, 'active', $expiresAt, $orderRef);
    }

    public function revoke(int $studentId, int $courseId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->updateStatus($studentId, $courseId, 'cancelled');
    }

    public function getActiveCourseIds(int $studentId): array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0) {
            return [];
        }

        $active = $this->enrollmentRepo->findActiveByStudent($studentId);
        $ids = [];
        foreach ($active as $en) {
            $cId = (int)($en['course_id'] ?? 0);
            if ($cId > 0 && !in_array($cId, $ids, true)) {
                $ids[] = $cId;
            }
        }
        return $ids;
    }

    public function getEnrollment(int $studentId, int $courseId): ?array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->enrollmentRepo->findByStudentAndCourse($studentId, $courseId);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/CourseNavigationService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;

class CourseNavigationService implements CourseNavigationInterface
{
    private CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo;
    private CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;
    private string $baseUrl;

    public function __construct(
        CourseRepositoryInterface $courseRepo,
        CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo,
        ?string $baseUrl = null
    ) {
        $this->courseRepo = $courseRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
        $this->baseUrl = $baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '');
    }

    private function getBaseUrl(): string
    {
        if ($this->baseUrl !== '') {
            return $this->baseUrl;
        }
        return defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
    }

    private function resolveCourse(string|int $courseIdentifier): ?array
    {
        if (is_numeric($courseIdentifier)) {
            return $this->courseRepo->findById((int)$courseIdentifier);
        }
        return $this->courseRepo->findBySlug((string)$courseIdentifier);
    }

    public function getCourseTree(string|int $courseIdentifier): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return [];
        }

        $courseId = (int)$course['id'];
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];

        $modules = $this->structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        // Agrupa apenas aulas publicadas por module_id
        $lessonsByModule = [];
        $standaloneLessons = [];

        foreach ($allLessons as $lesson) {
            if (($lesson['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $lessonSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
            $lesson['url'] = $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($lessonSlug);

            $modId = $lesson['module_id'] !== null ? (int)$lesson['module_id'] : null;
            if ($modId !== null && $modId > 0) {
                $lessonsByModule[$modId][] = $lesson;
            } else {
                $standaloneLessons[] = $lesson;
            }
        }

        $tree = [];

        foreach ($modules as $mod) {
            $mId = (int)$mod['id'];
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => $mId,
                'title'    => (string)$mod['title'],
                'position' => (int)$mod['position'],
                'lessons'  => $lessonsByModule[$mId] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        // Se houver aulas sem módulo cadastrado, agrupa num módulo geral
        if (!empty($standaloneLessons)) {
            $tree[] = [
                'id'       => 0,
                'title'    => 'Aulas Gerais',
                'position' => 999,
                'lessons'  => $standaloneLessons,
            ];
        }

        return $tree;
    }

    public function renderCourseNav(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug = '', array $options = []): string
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return '';
        }

        $tree = $this->getCourseTree($courseIdentifier);
        if (empty($tree)) {
            return '';
        }

        $courseTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$course['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $courseUrl = $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug);

        $html = '<nav class="course-nav ds-academy-nav" aria-label="Navegação do Curso ' . $courseTitle . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-header">';
        $html .= '<a href="' . $courseUrl . '" class="course-nav-home-link">🎓 ' . $courseTitle . '</a>';
        $html .= '</div>';

        $html .= '<div class="course-nav-body">';

        $globalLessonCounter = 1;

        foreach ($tree as $mod) {
            $modTitle = htmlspecialchars($mod['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $lessons = $mod['lessons'] ?? [];

            $html .= '<div class="course-nav-module">';
            $html .= '<h4 class="course-nav-module-title">' . $modTitle . '</h4>';
            $html .= '<ul class="course-nav-lessons">';

            foreach ($lessons as $lesson) {
                $lTitle = htmlspecialchars($lesson['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $lSlug = (string)$lesson['slug'];
                $lUrl = htmlspecialchars($lesson['url'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $isActive = ($lSlug === $currentLessonSlug);

                $activeClass = $isActive ? ' is-active current-lesson' : '';
                $ariaCurrent = $isActive ? ' aria-current="page"' : '';

                $html .= '<li class="course-nav-lesson-item' . $activeClass . '">';
                $html .= '<a href="' . $lUrl . '"' . $ariaCurrent . ' class="course-nav-lesson-link">';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-index">' . sprintf('%02d', $globalLessonCounter++) . '</span> ';
                $html .= '<span class="lesson-title">' . $lTitle . '</span>';
                $html .= '</a>';
                $html .= '</li>';
            }

            $html .= '</ul>';
            $html .= '</div>';
        }

        $html .= '</div>';
        $html .= '</nav>';

        return $html;
    }

    public function getAdjacentLessons(string|int $courseIdentifier, string $currentLessonSlug): array
    {
        $course = $this->resolveCourse($courseIdentifier);
        if (!$course) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $courseSlug = (string)$course['slug'];
        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons((int)$course['id']);

        if (empty($allLessons)) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        // Filtra apenas aulas publicadas e normaliza
        $flat = [];
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') !== 'published') {
                continue;
            }
            $slug = (string)$l['slug'];
            $flat[] = [
                'id'    => (int)$l['id'],
                'title' => (string)$l['title'],
                'slug'  => $slug,
                'url'   => $this->getBaseUrl() . '/cursos/' . urlencode($courseSlug) . '/' . urlencode($slug),
            ];
        }

        $currentIndex = -1;
        foreach ($flat as $index => $item) {
            if ($item['slug'] === $currentLessonSlug) {
                $currentIndex = $index;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($currentIndex === -1) {
            return ['prev' => null, 'next' => null];
        }

        $prev = ($currentIndex > 0) ? $flat[$currentIndex - 1] : null;
        $next = ($currentIndex < count($flat) - 1) ? $flat[$currentIndex + 1] : null;

        return ['prev' => $prev, 'next' => $next];
    }
}
