// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentProgressService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentProgressRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Serviço de Cálculo de Progresso de Cursos e Conclusão de Aulas (SRP / DIP).
 */
class StudentProgressService implements StudentProgressInterface
{
    private StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo;
    private ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo;

    public function __construct(
        StudentProgressRepositoryInterface $progressRepo,
        ?CourseStructureRepositoryInterface $structureRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->progressRepo = $progressRepo;
        $this->structureRepo = $structureRepo;
    }

    public function markLessonCompleted(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->saveProgress($studentId, $courseId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function markLessonIncomplete(int $studentId, int $courseId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->deleteProgress($studentId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function isLessonCompleted(int $studentId, int $lessonId): bool
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $lessonId <= 0) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->hasCompleted($studentId, $lessonId);
    }

    public function getCompletedLessonIds(int $studentId, int $courseId): array
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0) {
            return [];
        }

        return $this->progressRepo->findCompletedLessonIds($studentId, $courseId);
    }

    public function getCourseProgressPercentage(int $studentId, int $courseId): float
    {
        if ($studentId <= 0 || $courseId <= 0 || $this->structureRepo === null) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $allLessons = $this->structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);
        $publishedCount = 0;
        foreach ($allLessons as $l) {
            if (($l['status'] ?? 'published') === 'published') {
                $publishedCount++;
            }
        }

        if ($publishedCount === 0) {
            return 0.0;
        }

        $completedIds = $this->progressRepo->findCompletedLessonIds($studentId, $courseId);
        $completedCount = count($completedIds);

        $pct = ($completedCount / $publishedCount) * 100.0;
        return round(min(100.0, max(0.0, $pct)), 1);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/StudentViewRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\StudentViewRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderizador Oficial de Telas Públicas do Aluno.
 * Produz respostas HTTP independentes, isoladas de qualquer casca ou middleware administrativo.
 */
class StudentViewRenderer implements StudentViewRendererInterface
{
    private string $viewsPath;

    public function __construct(?string $viewsPath = null)
    {
        $this->viewsPath = $viewsPath ?? dirname(__DIR__) . '/views';
    }

    public function render(string $viewName, array $data = []): ResponseInterface
    {
        $viewFile = rtrim($this->viewsPath, '/\\') . '/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            return new Response("<h1>Página não encontrada</h1>", 404, [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
            ]);
        }

        ob_start();
        extract($data, EXTR_SKIP);
        include $viewFile;
        $content = (string)ob_get_clean();

        return new Response($content, 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
        ]);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemeLessonFileScaffolder.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\SlugHelper;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonBlockRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\LessonFileScaffolderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Fábrica Automática de Pastas (Módulos) e Arquivos PHP Pré-Configurados de Aulas.
 *
 * Cria fisicamente diretórios e arquivos `.php` dentro de `pages/` do tema ativo,
 * pré-configurados com CSS e JS padrão para resoluções Desktop, Mobile e Tablet,
 * prontos para edição via Blocos.
 *
 * Exemplo:
 *   Título: "Estrutura de Dados"
 *   Arquivo gerado: `estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   Slug relativo: `pages/estrutura-de-dados.php`
 *   URL pública: `http://localhost/domain-system/cursos/estrutura-de-dados`
 */
class ThemeLessonFileScaffolder implements LessonFileScaffolderInterface
{
    private ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer;
    private ?string $overridePagesRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemePageResolverInterface $themeResolver = null,
        ?LessonBlockRendererInterface $blockRenderer = null,
        ?string $overridePagesRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new ThemePageResolver();
        $this->blockRenderer = $blockRenderer ?? new LessonBlockRenderer();
        $this->overridePagesRoot = $overridePagesRoot;
    }

    public function slugify(string $title): string
    {
        return SlugHelper::slugify($title, 'aula-sem-titulo');
    }

    public function createFolder(string $folderTitle): array
    {
        $trimmed = trim($folderTitle);
        if ($trimmed === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O nome da pasta ou módulo não pode estar vazio.");
        }

        // Suporta subpastas seguras ex: "tutoriais/python" ou título simples "Estrutura de Dados"
        $parts = array_filter(explode('/', str_replace('\\', '/', $trimmed)), fn($p) => trim($p) !== '' && $p !== '.' && $p !== '..');
        $slugParts = array_map(fn($p) => $this->slugify($p), $parts);
        if (empty($slugParts)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Nome de pasta inválido.");
        }

        $folderSlug = implode('/', $slugParts);
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $targetDir = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $folderSlug);

        if (!is_dir($targetDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetDir)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar a pasta física em: pages/{$folderSlug}");
            }
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realTargetDir = realpath($targetDir);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realTargetDir === false || !str_starts_with($realTargetDir, $realPagesRoot)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Violação de segurança ao validar diretório da pasta criada.");
        }

        return [
            'slug'          => $folderSlug,
            'relative_path' => 'pages/' . $folderSlug,
            'full_path'     => $realTargetDir,
        ];
    }

    public function fabricateLessonFile(
        string $title,
        ?string $folder = null,
        ?string $blocksJson = null,
        string $mobileProfile = 'drawer'
    ): array {
        $trimmedTitle = trim($title);
        if ($trimmedTitle === '') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("O título da aula/página é obrigatório para fabricar o arquivo PHP.");
        }

        $slug = $this->slugify($trimmedTitle);
        $fileName = $slug . '.php';
        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();

        $cleanFolder = '';
        if ($folder !== null && trim($folder) !== '') {
            $normalizedFolder = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $folder), '/');
            if (str_starts_with($normalizedFolder, 'pages/')) {
                $normalizedFolder = substr($normalizedFolder, 6);
            }
            if ($normalizedFolder !== '') {
                $folderInfo = $this->createFolder($normalizedFolder);
                $cleanFolder = $folderInfo['slug'];
            }
        }

        $relativePath = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? 'pages/' . $cleanFolder . '/' . $fileName
            : 'pages/' . $fileName;

        $targetDir = $cleanFolder !== ''
            ? $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanFolder)
            : $pagesRoot;

        $fullPath = $targetDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $fileName;

        $phpTemplate = $this->buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
            $trimmedTitle,
            $slug,
            $relativePath,
            $blocksJson,
            $mobileProfile
        );

        if (@file_put_contents($fullPath, $phpTemplate, LOCK_EX) === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao gravar o arquivo pré-configurado em: {$relativePath}");
        }

        $realPagesRoot = realpath($pagesRoot);
        $realFile = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($realPagesRoot === false || $realFile === false || !str_starts_with($realFile, $realPagesRoot)) {
            @unlink($fullPath);
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Caminho de arquivo fora do diretório permitido.");
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $publicUrl = $baseUrl . '/cursos/' . $slug;

        return [
            'title'         => $trimmedTitle,
            'slug'          => $slug,
            'file_name'     => $fileName,
            'relative_path' => $relativePath,
            'full_path'     => $realFile,
            'public_url'    => $publicUrl,
        ];
    }

    private function resolvePagesDirectory(): string
    {
        if ($this->overridePagesRoot !== null && $this->overridePagesRoot !== '') {
            if (!is_dir($this->overridePagesRoot)) {
                @mkdir($this->overridePagesRoot, 0755, true);
            }
            return rtrim($this->overridePagesRoot, '/\\');
        }

        $themePath = $this->themeResolver->resolveActiveThemePath();
        $pagesDir = rtrim($themePath, '/\\') . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'pages';
        if (!is_dir($pagesDir)) {
            @mkdir($pagesDir, 0755, true);
        }
        return $pagesDir;
    }

    private function buildPreconfiguredPhpTemplate(
        string $title,
        string $slug,
        string $relativePath,
        ?string $blocksJson,
        string $mobileProfile
    ): string {
        $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars($title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        $safeProfile = in_array($mobileProfile, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true) ? $mobileProfile : 'drawer';

        if ($blocksJson === null || trim($blocksJson) === '') {
            $defaultBlocks = [
                'time' => time(),
                'blocks' => [
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_head_1',
                        'type' => 'header',
                        'data' => ['level' => 2, 'text' => $title],
                    ],
                    [
                        'id'   => 'b_par_1',
                        'type' => 'paragraph',
                        'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo inicial da aula <strong>' . $safeTitle . '</strong>. Edite este arquivo pelo <code>Editor em Blocos</code> do painel Academy para atualizar automaticamente Desktop e Mobile.'],
                    ],
                ],
            ];
            $blocksJson = (string)json_encode($defaultBlocks, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
        }

        $renderedBlocksHtml = $this->blockRenderer->render($blocksJson);
        $encodedJsonComment = base64_encode($blocksJson);

        return <<<PHP
<?php
/**
 * ============================================================================
 * ARQUIVO GERADO PELA FÁBRICA DE AULAS DO ACADEMY (Domain-System v2.4)
 * ============================================================================
 * Título: {$safeTitle}
 * Slug: {$slug}
 * Caminho: {$relativePath}
 * Perfil Mobile: {$safeProfile}
 * DS_BLOCKS_B64: {$encodedJsonComment}
 * ============================================================================
 */
?>
<article class="ds-fabricated-lesson" data-lesson-slug="{$slug}" data-mobile-profile="{$safeProfile}">
    <style>
        /* CSS Padrão Pré-Configurado: Resoluções Desktop, Tablet e Mobile */
        .ds-fabricated-lesson {
            color: var(--text-main, #e2e8f0);
            line-height: 1.75;
            font-size: 1.04rem;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson .ds-lesson-blocks {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson pre {
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: auto;
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .ds-fabricated-lesson img,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson iframe,
        .ds-fabricated-lesson video {
            max-width: 100%;
        }

        /* Responsividade Tablet (<= 1024px) */
        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
        }

        /* Responsividade Mobile (<= 768px) */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .ds-fabricated-lesson {
                font-size: 0.96rem;
                line-height: 1.65;
            }
            .ds-fabricated-lesson[data-mobile-profile="cinema"] .ds-block-video {
                position: sticky;
                top: 8px;
                z-index: 30;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
            }
        }
    </style>

    <div class="ds-fabricated-lesson-body">
        {$renderedBlocksHtml}
    </div>

    <script>
        /* JS Padrão Pré-Configurado (Desktop & Mobile) */
        (function() {
            const article = document.querySelector('.ds-fabricated-lesson[data-lesson-slug="{$slug}"]');
            if (!article) return;
            article.querySelectorAll('pre code').forEach(function(codeBlock) {
                codeBlock.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            });
        })();
    </script>
</article>
PHP;
    }

    public function extractBlocksFromFile(string $relativePath): ?string
    {
        $cleanRel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($cleanRel, 'pages/')) {
            $cleanRel = substr($cleanRel, 6);
        }

        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $fullPath = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRel);
        if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $content = (string)@file_get_contents($fullPath);
        if (preg_match('/DS_BLOCKS_B64:\s*([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)/', $content, $matches)) {
            $decoded = base64_decode($matches[1], true);
            return $decoded !== false ? $decoded : null;
        }

        return null;
    }

    public function inspectLessonFile(string $relativePath): array
    {
        $cleanRel = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $relativePath), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($cleanRel, 'pages/')) {
            $cleanRel = substr($cleanRel, 6);
        }

        $pagesRoot = $this->resolvePagesDirectory();
        $fullPath = $pagesRoot . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . str_replace('/', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, $cleanRel);

        $fileName = basename($cleanRel);
        $fallbackTitle = ucwords(str_replace(['-', '_'], ' ', preg_replace('/\.(php|html)$/i', '', $fileName)));

        if (!is_file($fullPath)) {
            return [
                'title'          => $fallbackTitle,
                'slug'           => $this->slugify($fallbackTitle),
                'mobile_profile' => 'drawer',
                'has_blocks'     => false,
                'blocks_json'    => null,
            ];
        }

        // Lê até 8KB iniciais para extração rápida de cabeçalho e <h1>
        $handle = @fopen($fullPath, 'r');
        $content = $handle ? (string)@fread($handle, 8192) : (string)@file_get_contents($fullPath);
        if ($handle) {
            @fclose($handle);
        }

        $title = null;
        // 1. Tenta extrair do cabeçalho docblock: * Título: ... ou * Title: ...
        if (preg_match('/(?:\*|\/\/)\s*(?:T[íi]tulo|Title)\s*:\s*([^\r\n*]+)/iu', $content, $m)) {
            $candidate = trim($m[1]);
            if ($candidate !== '') {
                $title = $candidate;
            }
        }

        // 2. Se não encontrou, tenta extrair da primeira tag <h1>...</h1>
        if ($title === null && preg_match('/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/is', $content, $m)) {
            $candidate = trim(strip_tags($m[1]));
            if ($candidate !== '') {
                $title = $candidate;
            }
        }

        if ($title === null || $title === '') {
            $title = $fallbackTitle;
        }

        // 3. Perfil Mobile
        $mobileProfile = 'drawer';
        if (preg_match('/(?:\*|\/\/)\s*(?:Perfil\s*Mobile|Mobile\s*Profile)\s*:\s*([a-z_]+)/iu', $content, $m)) {
            $p = strtolower(trim($m[1]));
            if (in_array($p, ['drawer', 'bottom_bar', 'cinema'], true)) {
                $mobileProfile = $p;
            }
        }

        // 4. Blocos em Base64
        $blocksJson = null;
        $hasBlocks = false;
        if (preg_match('/DS_BLOCKS_B64:\s*([A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+)/', $content, $m)) {
            $decoded = base64_decode($m[1], true);
            if ($decoded !== false && trim($decoded) !== '') {
                $blocksJson = $decoded;
                $hasBlocks = true;
            }
        }

        return [
            'title'          => $title,
            'slug'           => $this->slugify($title),
            'mobile_profile' => $mobileProfile,
            'has_blocks'     => $hasBlocks,
            'blocks_json'    => $blocksJson,
        ];
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/Services/ThemePageResolver.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SiteStateInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemePathResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\ThemePageResolverInterface;
use FilesystemIterator;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

class ThemePageResolver implements ThemePageResolverInterface
{
    private ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ?ThemePathResolverInterface $themeResolver;
    private ?SiteStateInterface $siteState;
    private string $baseRoot;

    public function __construct(
        ?ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager = null,
        ?ThemePathResolverInterface $themeResolver = null,
        ?SiteStateInterface $siteState = null,
        ?string $baseRoot = null
    ) {
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->baseRoot = $baseRoot ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4));
        $this->themeResolver = $themeResolver ?? new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->baseRoot . '/themes',
            $this->baseRoot . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes',
        ]);
        $this->siteState = $siteState ?? new EnvSiteState();
    }

    public function resolveActiveThemePath(): string
    {
        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $activePath = $this->themeManager->getActiveThemePath();
            if (!empty($activePath) && is_dir($activePath)) {
                return $activePath;
            }
        }

        $activeTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';
        if ($activeTheme !== '' && $this->themeResolver !== null && $this->themeResolver->themeExists($activeTheme)) {
            return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme);
        }

        $candidates = ['default'];
        if ($this->themeResolver !== null) {
            foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
                if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($candidate)) {
                    return $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($candidate);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->themeResolver !== null
            ? $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($activeTheme)
            : $this->baseRoot . '/themes/default';
    }

    public function resolvePublicThemePages(): array
    {
        $pages = [];

        if ($this->themeManager !== null) {
            $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages();
        }

        if (empty($pages)) {
            $activePublicTheme = $this->siteState !== null ? $this->siteState->getActiveTheme() : '';

            if ($this->themeManager !== null && $activePublicTheme !== '') {
                $pages = $this->themeManager->getAvailablePages($activePublicTheme);
            }

            if (empty($pages) && $this->themeResolver !== null) {
                $candidateThemes = array_unique(array_filter([$activePublicTheme, 'default']));
                foreach ($candidateThemes as $themeName) {
                    if ($this->themeResolver->themeExists($themeName)) {
                        $pagesDir = $this->themeResolver->resolveThemePath($themeName) . '/pages';
                        if (is_dir($pagesDir)) {
                            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($pagesDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
                            );
                            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                                if ($file->isFile() && in_array(strtolower($file->getExtension()), ['php', 'html'], true)) {
                                    $rel = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($pagesDir) + 1));
                                    $pages[] = 'pages/' . ltrim($rel, '/');
                                }
                            }
                            if (!empty($pages)) {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $pages = array_values(array_unique($pages));
        natsort($pages);
        return array_values($pages);
    }

    /**
     * Alias retrocompatível para resolvePublicThemePages().
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function getAvailablePages(): array
    {
        return $this->resolvePublicThemePages();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_courses (
                id {$autoInc},
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                thumbnail VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                description TEXT NULL,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                link VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
                is_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                max_installments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12,
                external_platform VARCHAR(50) NULL,
                external_product_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
                external_checkout_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_courses");
    },
];


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoInc = $driver === 'sqlite' ? 'INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT' : 'INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY';

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_modules (
                id {$autoInc},
                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $db->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS academy_lessons (
                id {$autoInc},
                course_id INT NOT NULL,
                module_id INT NULL,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                source_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'theme_file',
                source VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                content TEXT NULL,
                mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer',
                position INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                UNIQUE(course_id, slug)
            )
        ");

        // Garante colunas mobile_profile e folder_slug via SQL ANSI padrão (independente de ERRMODE ou driver)
        $hasMobileCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtMob = @$db->query("SELECT mobile_profile FROM academy_lessons LIMIT 1");
            $hasMobileCol = ($stmtMob !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasMobileCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasMobileCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_lessons ADD COLUMN mobile_profile VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'drawer'");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }

        $hasFolderCol = false;
        try {
            $stmtFold = @$db->query("SELECT folder_slug FROM academy_modules LIMIT 1");
            $hasFolderCol = ($stmtFold !== false);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $hasFolderCol = false;
        }
        if (!$hasFolderCol) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE academy_modules ADD COLUMN folder_slug VARCHAR(255) NULL");
            } catch (\Throwable $inner) {
                // Coluna já existe ou não aplicável
            }
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_lessons");
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS academy_modules");
    },
];

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_11_08_000003_add_student_columns_to_users.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

return [
    'up' => function (\PDO $db) {
        $driver = $db->getAttribute(\PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);

        $colNames = [];
        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            $stmt = $db->query("PRAGMA table_info(users)");
            if ($stmt) {
                $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'name'));
            }
        } else {
            $stmt = $db->query("SHOW COLUMNS FROM users");
            if ($stmt) {
                $rows = $stmt->fetchAll(\PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
                $colNames = array_map('strtolower', array_column($rows, 'Field'));
            }
        }

        if (!in_array('username', $colNames, true)) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN username VARCHAR(100) NULL");
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }

        if (!in_array('status', $colNames, true)) {
            try {
                $db->exec("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active'");
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }
    },
    'down' => function (\PDO $db) {
        // Regra de integridade aditiva: colunas de dados não são dropadas em rollback
    },
];

            <script>
                function toggleCoursePricingMode(val) {
                    const isFree = (val === '1' || val === 1);
                    const priceBox = document.getElementById('box_edit_course_price');
                    const instBox = document.getElementById('box_edit_course_installments');
                    const freeNotice = document.getElementById('box_free_notice');
                    const payWrapper = document.getElementById('box_payment_options_wrapper');
                    const priceInput = document.getElementById('edit_course_price');

                    if (isFree) {
                        if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'none';
                        if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'none';
                        if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'block';
                        if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                        if (priceInput) priceInput.value = '0.00';
                    } else {
                        if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'block';
                        if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'block';
                        if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'none';
                        if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'block';
                        if (priceInput && (parseFloat(priceInput.value) <= 0 || priceInput.value === '')) {
                            priceInput.value = '10.00';
                        }
                    }
                }

                function toggleExternalPlatformFields(val) {
                    const isExternal = ['hotmart', 'eduzz', 'monetizze', 'clickbank'].includes(val);
                    const isPp = (val === 'paypal');
                    const isStripe = (val === 'stripe');

                    const idBox = document.getElementById('box_external_product_id');
                    const urlBox = document.getElementById('box_external_checkout_url');
                    const tipBox = document.getElementById('box_native_gateway_tip');
                    const ppBox = document.getElementById('box_paypal_settings');
                    const stripeBox = document.getElementById('box_stripe_settings');

                    if (idBox) idBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (urlBox) urlBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (ppBox) ppBox.style.display = isPp ? 'block' : 'none';
                    if (stripeBox) stripeBox.style.display = isStripe ? 'block' : 'none';

                    if (tipBox) {
                        tipBox.style.display = isExternal ? 'none' : 'block';
                        if (val === 'stripe') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Stripe Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará via Cartão de Crédito Global / Apple Pay diretamente pelo Stripe Checkout. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else if (val === 'paypal') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>PayPal Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Saldo PayPal ou Cartão Internacional via API oficial v2 do PayPal. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else if (val === 'mercadopago') {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Mercado Pago Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Pix Instantâneo (QR Code na tela), Cartão até 12x ou Boleto via Mercado Pago Oficial. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        } else {
                            tipBox.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Checkout Multigateway:</strong> O aluno terá na tela de compra as opções ativas: Pix Instantâneo, Mercado Pago, Stripe e PayPal. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                        }
                    }
                }
            </script>
        </div>

        var foldersMap = {};
        availablePages.forEach(function(pagePath) {
            var lastSlash = pagePath.lastIndexOf('/');
            var dir = lastSlash > 0 ? pagePath.substring(0, lastSlash) : 'pages';
            if (!foldersMap[dir]) {
                foldersMap[dir] = [];
            }
            foldersMap[dir].push(pagePath);
        });

        function slugifyText(raw) {
            var map = {'á':'a','à':'a','ã':'a','â':'a','ä':'a','é':'e','è':'e','ê':'e','ë':'e','í':'i','ì':'i','î':'i','ï':'i','ó':'o','ò':'o','õ':'o','ô':'o','ö':'o','ú':'u','ù':'u','û':'u','ü':'u','ç':'c','ñ':'n'};
            var str = String(raw || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[áàãâäéèêëíìîïóòõôöúùûüçñ]/g, function(c) { return map[c] || c; });
            return str.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'aula';
        }

                document.getElementById('new_folder_slug_preview').textContent = prefix + s;
            }
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'flex';
        };
        window.closeCreateFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalCreateFolder').style.display = 'none';

            var prefix = courseSlug ? ('pages/' + courseSlug + '/') : 'pages/';
            document.getElementById('new_folder_slug_preview').textContent = prefix + (s || 'modulo-01');
        };

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return String(str).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
        }

        function formatFilenameToTitle(filePath) {
            var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
            var match = fileName.match(/^(\d+)[-_]+(.*)$/);
            if (match) {
                var num = match[1];
                var rest = match[2].replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
                return num + ' - ' + rest;
            }
            return fileName.replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function(l) { return l.toUpperCase(); });
        }

        function formatFilenameToSlug(filePath) {
            var fileName = filePath.split('/').pop().replace(/\.(php|html)$/i, '');
            return fileName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
        }

        window.openImportFolderModal = function(modIdx) {
            document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value = modIdx;
            var select = document.getElementById('import_folder_select');
            select.innerHTML = '';

            var courseSlug = '<?= htmlspecialchars((string)($course['slug'] ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>';
            var defaultCourseFolder = 'pages/' + courseSlug;

            var folderKeys = Object.keys(foldersMap);
            var courseFolders = [];
            var otherFolders = [];
            var hasRootPages = false;

            folderKeys.forEach(function(folder) {
                if (folder === 'pages') {
                    hasRootPages = true;
                } else if (folder === defaultCourseFolder || folder.indexOf(defaultCourseFolder + '/') === 0) {
                    courseFolders.push(folder);
                } else {
                    otherFolders.push(folder);
                }
            });

            var hasAny = (courseFolders.length > 0 || otherFolders.length > 0 || hasRootPages);
            if (!hasAny) {
                select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Nenhuma pasta de aulas encontrada em pages/</option>';
                document.getElementById('import_folder_preview').innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo .php encontrado na pasta pages/ do tema.';
            } else {
                var firstSelectable = null;

                // 1. Grupo prioritário: Workspace do Curso
                if (courseFolders.length > 0) {
                    var grpCourse = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpCourse.label = '🎯 Workspace deste Curso (' + defaultCourseFolder + '/)';
                    courseFolders.forEach(function(folder) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = folder;
                        opt.textContent = folder + '/ (' + foldersMap[folder].length + ' aulas)';
                        grpCourse.appendChild(opt);
                        if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = folder;
                    });
                    select.appendChild(grpCourse);
                }

                // 2. Grupo: Outras Pastas de Módulos/Cursos
                if (otherFolders.length > 0) {
                    var grpOther = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpOther.label = '📁 Outras Pastas de Aulas no Tema';
                    otherFolders.forEach(function(folder) {
                        var opt = document.createElement('option');
                        opt.value = folder;
                        opt.textContent = folder + '/ (' + foldersMap[folder].length + ' arquivos)';
                        grpOther.appendChild(opt);
                        if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = folder;
                    });
                    select.appendChild(grpOther);
                }

                // 3. Grupo: Raiz pages/ (Arquivos Globais)
                if (hasRootPages && foldersMap['pages'] && foldersMap['pages'].length > 0) {
                    var grpRoot = document.createElement('optgroup');
                    grpRoot.label = '⚠️ Raiz pages/ (Páginas Globais do Tema - Não Recomendado)';
                    var optRoot = document.createElement('option');
                    optRoot.value = 'pages';
                    optRoot.textContent = 'pages/ (' + foldersMap['pages'].length + ' páginas do site)';
                    grpRoot.appendChild(optRoot);
                    select.appendChild(grpRoot);
                    if (!firstSelectable) firstSelectable = 'pages';
                }

                if (firstSelectable) {
                    select.value = firstSelectable;
                }
                updateImportFolderPreview();
            }

            select.onchange = updateImportFolderPreview;
            document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'flex';
        };

        function updateImportFolderPreview() {
            var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
            var preview = document.getElementById('import_folder_preview');
            var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];
            if (files.length === 0) {
                preview.innerHTML = 'Nenhum arquivo nesta pasta.';
                return;
            }

            var html = '';
            if (folder === 'pages') {
                html += '<div style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.3); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fca5a5; font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.4;">' +
                        '⚠️ <strong>Atenção:</strong> Estes arquivos estão soltos na raiz de <code>pages/</code> e incluem páginas do site (ex: index, contato). Recomenda-se criar e importar a partir da pasta dedicada do curso: <code>pages/<?= htmlspecialchars((string)($course['slug'] ?? '')) ?>/</code>.' +
                        '</div>';
            }

            html += files.map(function(f) {
                var meta = availablePagesMeta[f] || {};
                var title = meta.title || formatFilenameToTitle(f);
                var badge = meta.has_blocks 
                    ? '<span style="font-size:10px; background:rgba(69,243,255,0.15); color:#45f3ff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600;">⚡ Blocos</span>' 
                    : '<span style="font-size:10px; background:rgba(168,85,247,0.15); color:#a855f7; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600;">🐘 PHP Puro</span>';
                return '<div style="padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">' +
                       '<span>📄 ' + escapeHtml(f) + ' &rarr; <strong style="color:#45f3ff;">' + escapeHtml(title) + '</strong></span>' +
                       badge +
                       '</div>';
            }).join('');

            preview.innerHTML = html;
        }

        window.closeImportFolderModal = function() {
            document.getElementById('modalImportFolder').style.display = 'none';
        };

        window.confirmImportFolder = function() {
            var modIdx = parseInt(document.getElementById('import_target_mod_idx').value, 10);
            var folder = document.getElementById('import_folder_select').value;
            var files = foldersMap[folder] || [];

            if (!structure[modIdx] || files.length === 0) {
                closeImportFolderModal();
                return;
            }

            if (!Array.isArray(structure[modIdx].lessons)) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons = [];
            }

            var existingSources = {};
            structure[modIdx].lessons.forEach(function(l) {
                if (l.source) existingSources[l.source] = true;
            });

            files.forEach(function(filePath) {
                if (!existingSources[filePath]) {
                    var meta = availablePagesMeta[filePath] || {};
                    var lessonTitle = meta.title || formatFilenameToTitle(filePath);
                    var lessonSlug = meta.slug || formatFilenameToSlug(filePath);
                    var mobileProfile = meta.mobile_profile || 'drawer';
                    var content = meta.blocks_json || '';

                    structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                        title: lessonTitle,
                        slug: lessonSlug,
                        source_type: 'theme_file',
                        source: filePath,
                        content: content,
                        mobile_profile: mobileProfile,
                        status: 'published'
                    });
                }
            });

            closeImportFolderModal();
            renderModules();
        };

        window.addModule = function() {
            structure.push({
                title: 'Novo Módulo',
                folder_slug: '',
                position: structure.length + 1,
                lessons: []
            });
            renderModules();
        };

        window.removeModule = function(modIdx) {
            if (confirm('Deseja excluir este módulo e todas as suas aulas?')) {
                structure.splice(modIdx, 1);
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateModTitle = function(modIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].title = val;
            }
        };

        window.updateModFolderSlug = function(modIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].folder_slug = val ? slugifyText(val) : '';
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.addLesson = function(modIdx) {
            if (structure[modIdx]) {
                var lesCount = (structure[modIdx].lessons || []).length + 1;
                structure[modIdx].lessons.push({
                    title: 'Aula ' + lesCount,
                    slug: 'aula-' + lesCount,
                    source_type: 'content',
                    source: '',
                    content: '',
                    mobile_profile: 'drawer',
                    status: 'published'
                });
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.removeLesson = function(modIdx, lesIdx) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons.splice(lesIdx, 1);
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonTitleAndAutoSlug = function(modIdx, lesIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                var les = structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx];
                les.title = val;
                var newSlug = slugifyText(val);
                if (!les.slug || /^aula-\d+$/.test(les.slug)) {
                    les.slug = newSlug;
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonField = function(modIdx, lesIdx, field, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx][field] = val;
                if (field === 'source' && val !== '') {
                    structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = 'theme_file';
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.updateLessonSourceType = function(modIdx, lesIdx, val) {
            if (structure[modIdx] && structure[modIdx].lessons && structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx]) {
                structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source_type = val;
                if (val === 'content') {
                    structure[modIdx].lessons[lesIdx].source = '';
                }
                renderModules();
            }
        };

        window.prepareStructureJson = function() {
            document.getElementById('structure_json_input').value = JSON.stringify(structure);
            return true;
        };

        renderModules();
    })();
    </script>
<?php endif; ?>

                <script>
                    function toggleNewCoursePricingMode(val) {
                        const isFree = (val === '1' || val === 1);
                        const priceBox = document.getElementById('new_box_price');
                        const instBox = document.getElementById('new_box_installments');
                        const freeNotice = document.getElementById('new_box_free_notice');
                        const payWrapper = document.getElementById('new_box_payment_options_wrapper');
                        const priceInput = document.getElementById('new_course_price');

                        if (isFree) {
                            if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'none';
                            if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'none';
                            if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'block';
                            if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'none';
                            if (priceInput) priceInput.value = '0.00';
                        } else {
                            if (priceBox) priceBox.style.display = 'block';
                            if (instBox) instBox.style.display = 'block';
                            if (freeNotice) freeNotice.style.display = 'none';
                            if (payWrapper) payWrapper.style.display = 'block';
                            if (priceInput && (parseFloat(priceInput.value) <= 0 || priceInput.value === '')) {
                                priceInput.value = '10.00';
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    function toggleNewCoursePlatform(val) {
                        const isExt = ['hotmart', 'eduzz', 'monetizze', 'clickbank'].includes(val);
                        const isPp = (val === 'paypal');
                        const isStripe = (val === 'stripe');

                        const idB = document.getElementById('new_box_external_product_id');
                        const urlB = document.getElementById('new_box_external_checkout_url');
                        const tipB = document.getElementById('new_box_native_tip');
                        const ppBox = document.getElementById('new_box_paypal_settings');
                        const stripeBox = document.getElementById('new_box_stripe_settings');

                        if (idB) idB.style.display = isExt ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (urlB) urlB.style.display = isExt ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (ppBox) ppBox.style.display = isPp ? 'block' : 'none';
                        if (stripeBox) stripeBox.style.display = isStripe ? 'block' : 'none';

                        if (tipB) {
                            tipB.style.display = isExt ? 'none' : 'block';
                            if (val === 'stripe') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Stripe Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará via Cartão de Crédito Global / Apple Pay diretamente pelo Stripe Checkout. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else if (val === 'paypal') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>PayPal Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Saldo PayPal ou Cartão Internacional via API oficial v2 do PayPal. Configure suas chaves acima ou em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else if (val === 'mercadopago') {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Mercado Pago Selecionado:</strong> O aluno pagará com Pix Instantâneo (QR Code na tela), Cartão até 12x ou Boleto via Mercado Pago Oficial. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            } else {
                                tipB.innerHTML = '💡 <strong>Checkout Multigateway:</strong> O aluno terá na tela de compra as opções ativas: Pix Instantâneo, Mercado Pago, Stripe e PayPal. Credenciais em <a href="<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/commerce/settings" target="_blank" style="color:#00d284; font-weight:700; text-decoration:underline;">Commerce &rarr; Configurações</a>.';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                </script>

                    document.getElementById('course_new_thumbnail')?.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
                        const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
                        const previewBox = document.getElementById('course_new_thumb_preview');
                        const previewImg = document.getElementById('course_new_thumb_preview_img');
                        if (file && previewBox && previewImg) {
                            const reader = new FileReader();
                            reader.onload = function(ev) {
                                previewImg.src = ev.target.result;
                                previewBox.style.display = 'flex';
                            };
                            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                        }
                    });
                </script>
