            btnMobile.style.color = '#8c8f94';
            if (profileSelect) profileSelect.style.display = 'none';
            if (dimBadge) dimBadge.style.display = 'none';

            stage.style.maxWidth = '100%';
            stage.style.margin = '0';
            stage.style.background = 'transparent';
            stage.style.border = 'none';
            stage.style.borderRadius = '0';
            stage.style.boxShadow = 'none';

            viewport.style.padding = '8px 4px';
            viewport.style.minHeight = 'auto';
            if (statusbar) statusbar.style.display = 'none';
            if (siteHeader) siteHeader.style.display = 'none';
            if (drawerBar) drawerBar.style.display = 'none';
            if (footerZone) footerZone.style.display = 'none';
            if (homebar) homebar.style.display = 'none';
            if (lessonTitle) lessonTitle.style.fontSize = '1.85rem';
        }

        refreshLivePreview();
    };

    window.setMobileProfile = function(profileKey) {
        if (MOBILE_PROFILES[profileKey]) {
            currentMobileProfile = profileKey;
            setPreviewDevice('mobile');
        }
    };

    window.setEditorViewMode = function(mode) {
        currentViewMode = mode;
        var grid = document.getElementById('editor_workspace_grid');
        var colEdit = document.getElementById('editor_blocks_column');
        var colPrev = document.getElementById('editor_preview_column');
        var btnEdit = document.getElementById('btn_mode_edit');
        var btnSplit = document.getElementById('btn_mode_split');
        var btnPrev = document.getElementById('btn_mode_preview');

        [btnEdit, btnSplit, btnPrev].forEach(function(b) {
            if (b) {
                b.style.background = 'transparent';
                b.style.color = '#8c8f94';
            }
        });

        if (mode === 'edit') {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
            colEdit.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.display = 'none';
            btnEdit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnEdit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        } else if (mode === 'preview') {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr';
            colEdit.style.display = 'none';
            colPrev.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'none';
            btnPrev.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnPrev.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        } else {
            grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = '1fr 1fr';
            colEdit.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.display = 'block';
            colPrev.style.maxHeight = 'calc(100vh - 115px)';
            btnSplit.style.background = 'rgba(69,243,255,0.15)';
            btnSplit.style.color = '#45f3ff';
        }
        refreshLivePreview();
    };

    function resolveVideoEmbedHtml(rawUrl) {
        rawUrl = String(rawUrl || '').trim();
        if (!rawUrl) return '';

        var ytMatch = rawUrl.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
        if (ytMatch && ytMatch[1]) {
            var ytUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + ytMatch[1] + '?rel=0';
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + ytUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
        }

        var vimeoMatch = rawUrl.match(/vimeo\.com\/(?:video\/)?(\d+)/);
        if (vimeoMatch && vimeoMatch[1]) {
            var vmUrl = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' + vimeoMatch[1];
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);"><iframe src="' + vmUrl + '" style="position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; border:0;" allowfullscreen loading="lazy"></iframe></div>';
        }

        if (/\.(mp4|webm|ogg)(\?.*)?$/i.test(rawUrl)) {
            return '<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#000;"><video controls style="width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain;"><source src="' + escapeHtml(rawUrl) + '"></video></div>';
        }

        return '';
    }

    window.refreshLivePreview = function() {
        var titleInput = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input');
        var previewTitle = document.getElementById('live_preview_lesson_title');
        if (titleInput && previewTitle) {
            previewTitle.textContent = titleInput.value || 'Aula sem título';
        }

        var previewBody = document.getElementById('live_preview_body');
        if (!previewBody) return;

        if (!blocks || blocks.length === 0) {
            previewBody.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#64748b; text-align:center; padding:30px 0;">Adicione blocos à esquerda para visualizar a aula aqui em tempo real.</p>';
            return;
        }

        var isMobile = (currentDevice === 'mobile');
        var mProfile = MOBILE_PROFILES[currentMobileProfile] || MOBILE_PROFILES.standard;
        var bodyFontSize = isMobile ? mProfile.fontSize : '1.03rem';
        var hSizes = isMobile ? mProfile.hSizes : {1: '2rem', 2: '1.6rem', 3: '1.3rem', 4: '1.1rem'};

        var htmlParts = [];
        blocks.forEach(function(b) {
            var d = b.data || {};
            switch(b.type) {
                case 'header':
                    var lvl = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, parseInt(d.level || 2)));
                    htmlParts.push('<h' + lvl + ' style="color:#fff; font-size:' + (hSizes[lvl] || '1.4rem') + '; font-weight:800; margin:1.4rem 0 0.7rem 0; line-height:1.3;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '') + '</h' + lvl + '>');
                    break;

                case 'paragraph':
                    var pText = escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
                    htmlParts.push('<p style="margin:0 0 1.1rem 0; line-height:1.75; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + '; word-break:break-word;">' + pText + '</p>');
                    break;

                case 'video':
                    var vUrl = d.url || d.source || '';
                    var vCap = d.caption || '';
                    var embed = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(vUrl);
                    if (embed) {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.3rem 0;">' + embed + (vCap ? '<div style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94; text-align:center;">' + escapeHtml(vCap) + '</div>' : '') + '</div>');
                    } else if (vUrl) {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.1rem 0; padding:12px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.3); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; word-break:break-all;">🔗 Vídeo: ' + escapeHtml(vUrl) + '</div>');
                    }
                    break;

                case 'code':
                    var lang = (d.language || 'code').toUpperCase();
                    var codePad = isMobile ? '12px' : '16px';
                    var codeFont = isMobile ? '0.8rem' : '0.9rem';
                    htmlParts.push(
                        '<div style="margin:1.3rem 0; border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; background:#0d1117; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2);">' +
                            '<div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding:6px 12px; font-size:0.72rem; font-family:monospace; color:#45f3ff; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">' + escapeHtml(lang) + '</div>' +
                            '<pre style="margin:0; padding:' + codePad + '; overflow-x:auto; font-family:Consolas,Monaco,monospace; font-size:' + codeFont + '; line-height:1.55; color:#e6edf3;"><code>' + escapeHtml(d.code || '') + '</code></pre>' +
                        '</div>'
                    );
                    break;

                case 'callout':
                    var ctype = d.type || 'info';
                    var styles = {
                        info: { border: '#45f3ff', bg: 'rgba(69,243,255,0.07)', icon: '💡' },
                        success: { border: '#00d284', bg: 'rgba(0,210,132,0.08)', icon: '✅' },
                        warning: { border: '#f5a623', bg: 'rgba(245,166,35,0.08)', icon: '⚠️' },
                        danger: { border: '#e06c75', bg: 'rgba(224,108,117,0.08)', icon: '🛑' }
                    };
                    var st = styles[ctype] || styles.info;
                    var calloutPad = isMobile ? '12px 14px' : '16px 20px';
                    htmlParts.push(
                        '<div style="margin:1.2rem 0; padding:' + calloutPad + '; border-left:4px solid ' + st.border + '; background:' + st.bg + '; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' +
                            '<span style="font-size:1.1rem;">' + st.icon + '</span>' +
                            '<div style="color:#fff; line-height:1.6; flex:1; word-break:break-word;">' + escapeHtml(d.text || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</div>' +
                        '</div>'
                    );
                    break;

                case 'list':
                    var items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
                    var tag = (d.style === 'ordered') ? 'ol' : 'ul';
                    var lis = items.map(function(it) {
                        var txt = typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.content || '');
                        return '<li style="margin-bottom:6px;">' + escapeHtml(txt) + '</li>';
                    }).join('');
                    htmlParts.push('<' + tag + ' style="margin:0 0 1.2rem 1.25rem; color:#c5c6c7; line-height:1.7; font-size:' + bodyFontSize + ';">' + lis + '</' + tag + '>');
                    break;

                case 'image':
                    var iUrl = d.url || (d.file ? d.file.url : '') || '';
                    var iCap = d.caption || '';
                    if (iUrl) {
                        htmlParts.push(
                            '<figure style="margin:1.4rem 0; text-align:center;">' +
                                '<img src="' + escapeHtml(iUrl) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '" style="max-width:100%; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">' +
                                (iCap ? '<figcaption style="margin-top:6px; font-size:0.8rem; color:#8c8f94;">' + escapeHtml(iCap) + '</figcaption>' : '') +
                            '</figure>'
                        );
                    }
                    break;

                case 'pdf':
                case 'pdf_viewer':
                    var pdfUrl = String(d.url || d.source || '').trim();
                    var pdfTitle = d.title || 'Documento PDF da Aula';
                    var pdfCap = d.caption || '';
                    var pdfMode = d.mode || 'pdfjs_canvas';
                    var startPg = Math.max(1, parseInt(d.start_page || 1, 10));
                    var endPg = Math.max(0, parseInt(d.end_page || 0, 10));
                    var pdfHeight = isMobile ? '360px' : (d.height || '520px');
                    var allowDl = (d.allow_download === undefined || d.allow_download === true || d.allow_download === 1 || d.allow_download === '1');
                    var rangeText = endPg > 0 ? ('Págs. ' + startPg + '–' + endPg) : ('Pág. inicial ' + startPg);
                    var modeLabel = pdfMode === 'card_modal' ? 'Cartão Expansível' : (pdfMode === 'native_embed' ? 'Iframe Nativo' : 'PDF.js Lazy Canvas');

                    if (pdfUrl) {
                        if (pdfUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('<iframe') !== -1) {
                            var srcM = pdfUrl.match(/\bsrc=["']([^"']+)["']/i);
                            if (srcM && srcM[1]) {
                                pdfUrl = srcM[1].replace(/&amp;/g, '&');
                            }
                        }
                        var previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                        var gdMatch = pdfUrl.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i) || pdfUrl.match(/drive\.google\.com\/(?:open|uc)\?(?:[^#]*&)?id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
                        var odMatch = pdfUrl.match(/onedrive\.live\.com\/(?:view\.aspx|redir)\?(.+)$/i);
                        if (gdMatch && gdMatch[1]) {
                            previewFrameUrl = 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + gdMatch[1] + '/preview';
                        } else if (/onedrive\.live\.com\/embed/i.test(pdfUrl) || /1drv\.ms\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                        } else if (odMatch && odMatch[1]) {
                            previewFrameUrl = 'https://onedrive.live.com/embed?' + odMatch[1];
                        } else if (/\.sharepoint\.com\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl;
                            if (previewFrameUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('action=embedview') === -1 && previewFrameUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf('/embed') === -1) {
                                previewFrameUrl += (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'action=embedview';
                            }
                        } else if (/dropbox\.com\//i.test(pdfUrl)) {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl.replace(/([?&])dl=0\b/i, '$1raw=1');
                            if (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('raw=1') === -1) {
                                previewFrameUrl += (previewFrameUrl.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?') + 'raw=1';
                            }
                        } else {
                            previewFrameUrl = pdfUrl + (pdfUrl.indexOf('#') !== -1 ? '&' : '#') + 'page=' + startPg + '&zoom=page-width' + (!allowDl ? '&toolbar=0&navpanes=0' : '');
                        }
                        htmlParts.push(
                            '<figure style="margin:1.4rem 0; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; background:#0b0e14; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.28); box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);">' +
                                '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px; background:#141920; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:0;">' +
                                        '<span>📄</span>' +
                                        '<strong style="color:#fff; font-size:0.86rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;">' + escapeHtml(pdfTitle) + '</strong>' +
                                        '<span style="background:rgba(69,243,255,0.14); color:#45f3ff; border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.3); padding:1px 7px; border-radius:10px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700;">' + escapeHtml(rangeText) + '</span>' +
                                    '</div>' +
                                    '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:10px; color:#94a3b8;">' +
                                        '<span style="padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">' + escapeHtml(modeLabel) + '</span>' +
                                        (allowDl ? '<a href="' + escapeHtml(pdfUrl) + '" target="_blank" style="color:#45f3ff; text-decoration:none; font-weight:700;">⬇ Abrir/Baixar</a>' : '<span style="color:#f5a623;">🔒 Download Bloqueado</span>') +
                                    '</div>' +
                                '</div>' +
                                (pdfMode === 'card_modal'
                                    ? '<div style="padding:22px; text-align:center; background:#12161f; color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">🗂️ Modo Cartão Compacto: o aluno verá o botão <strong>"📖 Abrir Leitor Online"</strong> para expandir o PDF sob demanda.</div>'
                                    : '<div style="width:100%; height:' + escapeHtml(pdfHeight) + '; background:#161922;"><iframe src="' + escapeHtml(previewFrameUrl) + '" style="width:100%; height:100%; border:0; display:block;" loading="lazy"></iframe></div>'
                                ) +
                                (pdfCap ? '<figcaption style="padding:8px 12px; font-size:0.78rem; color:#8c8f94; text-align:center; background:#0b0e14;">' + escapeHtml(pdfCap) + '</figcaption>' : '') +
                            '</figure>'
                        );
                    } else {
                        htmlParts.push('<div style="margin:1.2rem 0; padding:16px; border:1px dashed rgba(69,243,255,0.35); border-radius:8px; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; text-align:center;">📄 Informe a URL (Nuvem / CDN / Google Drive) ou envie um arquivo PDF local para pré-visualizar o leitor aqui.</div>');
                    }
                    break;

                case 'delimiter':
                    htmlParts.push('<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.2); margin:1.6rem 0;">');
                    break;
            }
        });

        previewBody.innerHTML = htmlParts.join('');
    };

    function renderCanvas() {
        var container = document.getElementById('blocks_canvas');
        container.innerHTML = '';

        if (blocks.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:30px; text-align:center; color:#8c8f94; border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:6px;">Nenhum bloco ainda. Clique nos botões abaixo para começar a estruturar sua aula.</div>';
            refreshLivePreview();
            return;
        }

        blocks.forEach(function(b, idx) {
            var card = document.createElement('div');
            card.className = 'ds-block-card';

            var header = document.createElement('div');
            header.style.cssText = 'display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-bottom:8px;';
            
            var badgeTitle = getBlockBadge(b.type);
            header.innerHTML = `
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                    <span style="font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-blue, #45f3ff); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px;">` + badgeTitle + `</span>
                    <span style="font-size:11px; color:#64748b;">#` + (idx + 1) + `</span>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;">
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, -1)" title="Mover para Cima">▲</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="moveBlock(` + idx + `, 1)" title="Mover para Baixo">▼</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="duplicateBlock(` + idx + `)" title="Duplicar">📋</button>
                    <button type="button" class="ds-block-ctrl-btn" onclick="removeBlock(` + idx + `)" style="color:#e06c75;" title="Excluir Bloco">✕</button>
                </div>
            `;
            card.appendChild(header);

            var body = document.createElement('div');
            body.innerHTML = renderBlockInputs(b, idx);
            card.appendChild(body);

            container.appendChild(card);
        });

        refreshLivePreview();
    }

    function getBlockBadge(type) {
        switch(type) {
            case 'header': return '📌 Título';
            case 'paragraph': return '📝 Parágrafo';
            case 'video': return '🎬 Vídeo Embed (16:9)';
            case 'code': return '💻 Bloco de Código';
            case 'callout': return '💡 Dica / Alerta';
            case 'list': return '📋 Lista';
            case 'image': return '🖼️ Imagem';
            case 'pdf':
            case 'pdf_viewer': return '📄 Leitor de PDF (Nuvem / Local)';
            case 'delimiter': return '➖ Divisor';
            default: return 'Bloco';
        }
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

    function notifyEditor(message, type) {
        type = type || 'info';
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
            window.OS.notify(message, type);
            return;
        }
        var container = document.getElementById('ds-editor-toast-fallback');
        if (!container) {
            container = document.createElement('div');
            container.id = 'ds-editor-toast-fallback';
            container.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:20px; right:20px; z-index:99999; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;';
            document.body.appendChild(container);
        }
        var color = type === 'success' ? '#10b981' : (type === 'error' ? '#ef4444' : (type === 'warning' ? '#f59e0b' : '#3b82f6'));
        var icon = type === 'success' ? '✅' : (type === 'error' ? '🚨' : (type === 'warning' ? '⚠️' : 'ℹ️'));
        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.style.cssText = 'background:#0f172a; color:#f8fafc; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); font-weight:600; font-size:13.5px; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; border:1px solid #334155; border-left:5px solid ' + color + '; max-width:430px; line-height:1.45;';
        toast.innerHTML = '<span>' + icon + '</span><span style="flex:1;">' + escapeHtml(message) + '</span>';
        container.appendChild(toast);
        setTimeout(function() { if (toast.parentElement) toast.remove(); }, type === 'error' ? 10000 : 4500);
    }

    function parseJsonResponse(res) {
        return res.text().then(function(rawText) {
            var trimmed = String(rawText || '').trim();
            if (!trimmed) {
                return { success: false, message: 'Resposta vazia do servidor (HTTP ' + res.status + ').' };
            }
            try {
                return JSON.parse(trimmed);
            } catch (e) {
                if (/POST Content-Length of (\d+) bytes exceeds the limit of (\d+) bytes/i.test(trimmed)) {
                    var m = trimmed.match(/POST Content-Length of (\d+) bytes exceeds the limit of (\d+) bytes/i);
                    var sentMb = (parseInt(m[1], 10) / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                    var limitMb = (parseInt(m[2], 10) / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                    return {
                        success: false,
                        message: 'O arquivo enviado (' + sentMb + ' MB) excede o limite do servidor PHP (' + limitMb + ' MB). Use um PDF menor ou hospede na nuvem.'
                    };
                }
                var jsonStart = trimmed.indexOf('{');
                var jsonEnd = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
                if (jsonStart !== -1 && jsonEnd > jsonStart) {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(trimmed.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd + 1));
                    } catch (innerErr) {}
                }
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'O servidor retornou uma resposta inesperada (HTTP ' + res.status + ').'
                };
            }
        });
    }

    function renderBlockInputs(b, idx) {
        var d = b.data || {};

        switch(b.type) {
            case 'header':
                var lvl = d.level || 2;
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;">
                        <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'level', parseInt(this.value))" style="width:110px; padding:8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff;">
                            <option value="1" ` + (lvl === 1 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H1 Principal</option>
                            <option value="2" ` + (lvl === 2 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H2 Seção</option>
                            <option value="3" ` + (lvl === 3 ? 'selected' : '') + `>H3 Subseção</option>
                        </select>
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(d.text) + `" placeholder="Digite o cabeçalho..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="flex:1; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:15px; font-weight:600;">
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'paragraph':
                return `
                    <textarea rows="4" placeholder="Escreva o texto da aula... Suporta formatações como <strong>, <em>, <code> e links." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:14px; line-height:1.6; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(d.text) + `</textarea>
                `;

            case 'video':
                var url = d.url || d.source || '';
                var cap = d.caption || '';
                var inlineEmbed = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(url);
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(url) + `" placeholder="URL do Vídeo (YouTube: https://youtube.com/watch?v=... ou Vimeo / MP4)" oninput="updateVideoBlockUrl(` + idx + `, this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; box-sizing:border-box;">
                        <div id="inline_video_preview_` + idx + `">` + inlineEmbed + `</div>
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(cap) + `" placeholder="Legenda do vídeo (opcional)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'caption', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'code':
                var lang = d.language || 'php';
                var code = d.code || '';
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Linguagem:</span>
                            <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'language', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; font-size:12px;">
                                <option value="php" ` + (lang === 'php' ? 'selected' : '') + `>PHP</option>
                                <option value="python" ` + (lang === 'python' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Python</option>
                                <option value="javascript" ` + (lang === 'javascript' ? 'selected' : '') + `>JavaScript</option>
                                <option value="sql" ` + (lang === 'sql' ? 'selected' : '') + `>SQL</option>
                                <option value="html" ` + (lang === 'html' ? 'selected' : '') + `>HTML</option>
                                <option value="css" ` + (lang === 'css' ? 'selected' : '') + `>CSS</option>
                                <option value="json" ` + (lang === 'json' ? 'selected' : '') + `>JSON</option>
                                <option value="bash" ` + (lang === 'bash' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Bash / Shell</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <textarea rows="6" placeholder="// Cole seu código aqui..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'code', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#08090b; color:#58a6ff; font-family:Consolas, Monaco, monospace; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(code) + `</textarea>
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'callout':
                var ctype = d.type || 'info';
                var ctext = d.text || '';
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Tipo de Aviso:</span>
                            <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'type', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px;">
                                <option value="info" ` + (ctype === 'info' ? 'selected' : '') + `>💡 Dica / Informação (Azul)</option>
                                <option value="success" ` + (ctype === 'success' ? 'selected' : '') + `>✅ Boas Práticas (Verde)</option>
                                <option value="warning" ` + (ctype === 'warning' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚠️ Atenção / Cuidado (Laranja)</option>
                                <option value="danger" ` + (ctype === 'danger' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🛑 Erro Comum (Vermelho)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <textarea rows="3" placeholder="Mensagem do aviso didático..." oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'text', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:13px; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(ctext) + `</textarea>
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'list':
                var itemsArr = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];
                var itemsStr = itemsArr.map(function(it) {
                    return typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.content || '');
                }).join("\n");
                var style = d.style || 'unordered';
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
                            <span style="font-size:12px; color:#8c8f94;">Estilo:</span>
                            <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'style', this.value)" style="padding:6px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px;">
                                <option value="unordered" ` + (style === 'unordered' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Marcadores (Bulleted)</option>
                                <option value="ordered" ` + (style === 'ordered' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Numerada (1, 2, 3...)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <textarea rows="4" placeholder="Um item por linha..." oninput="updateListItems(` + idx + `, this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#c5c6c7; font-size:13px; resize:vertical; box-sizing:border-box;">` + escapeHtml(itemsStr) + `</textarea>
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'image':
                var imgUrl = d.url || (d.file ? d.file.url : '') || '';
                var imgCap = d.caption || '';
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(imgUrl) + `" placeholder="URL da imagem (ex: https://... ou /caminho/imagem.png)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'url', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; box-sizing:border-box;">
                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(imgCap) + `" placeholder="Legenda da imagem (opcional)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'caption', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'pdf':
            case 'pdf_viewer':
                var pdfUrlVal = d.url || d.source || '';
                var pdfTitleVal = d.title || '';
                var pdfCapVal = d.caption || '';
                var pdfModeVal = d.mode || 'pdfjs_canvas';
                var startPgVal = d.start_page || 1;
                var endPgVal = d.end_page || 0;
                var pdfHeightVal = d.height || '620px';
                var allowDlVal = (d.allow_download === undefined || d.allow_download === true || d.allow_download === 1 || d.allow_download === '1');
                return `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
                        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                            <input type="text" id="pdf_url_input_` + idx + `" value="` + escapeHtml(pdfUrlVal) + `" placeholder="URL do PDF (Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox ou /uploads/academy/pdfs/...)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'url', this.value)" style="flex:1; min-width:220px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-family:monospace; font-size:12.5px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            <label style="display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(69,243,255,0.12); border:1px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.4); color:#45f3ff; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;" title="Enviar arquivo PDF para a pasta local (Hostinger / Servidor)">
                                <span id="pdf_upload_label_` + idx + `">📤 Enviar PDF Local</span>
                                <input type="file" accept="application/pdf,.pdf" onchange="uploadLessonPdfFile(` + idx + `, this)" style="display:none;">
                            </label>
                        </div>

                        <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:10px;">
                            <div>
                                <label style="display:block; font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; margin-bottom:4px;">Título do Documento / Figura:</label>
                                <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(pdfTitleVal) + `" placeholder="Ex: Apostila Cap. 3 — Gráficos e Tabelas" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'title', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12.5px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label style="display:block; font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; margin-bottom:4px;">Modo do Leitor Online:</label>
                                <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'mode', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#45f3ff; font-size:12px;">
                                    <option value="pdfjs_canvas" ` + (pdfModeVal === 'pdfjs_canvas' ? 'selected' : '') + `>⚡ Por Página Sob Demanda (PDF.js Lazy Canvas — Leve)</option>
                                    <option value="native_embed" ` + (pdfModeVal === 'native_embed' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🖥️ Leitor Incorporado / Iframe (Nativo / Google Drive)</option>
                                    <option value="card_modal" ` + (pdfModeVal === 'card_modal' ? 'selected' : '') + `>🗂️ Cartão Compacto (Expande ao Clicar)</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr)); gap:10px; align-items:end; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.22); padding:10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">
                            <div>
                                <label style="display:block; font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; margin-bottom:4px;" title="Página em que o leitor deve abrir (útil para ir direto a um gráfico ou figura)">Página Inicial:</label>
                                <input type="number" min="1" value="` + parseInt(startPgVal, 10) + `" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'start_page', Math.max(1, parseInt(this.value || '1', 10)))" style="width:100%; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label style="display:block; font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; margin-bottom:4px;" title="0 = liberar até o final; ou informe a página limite para recortar apenas um trecho">Página Final (0 = Todas):</label>
                                <input type="number" min="0" value="` + parseInt(endPgVal, 10) + `" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'end_page', Math.max(0, parseInt(this.value || '0', 10)))" style="width:100%; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <label style="display:block; font-size:11px; color:#8c8f94; margin-bottom:4px;">Altura do Leitor:</label>
                                <select onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'height', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#fff; font-size:12px;">
                                    <option value="420px" ` + (pdfHeightVal === '420px' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Compacta (420px)</option>
                                    <option value="540px" ` + (pdfHeightVal === '540px' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Média (540px)</option>
                                    <option value="620px" ` + (pdfHeightVal === '620px' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Padrão (620px)</option>
                                    <option value="780px" ` + (pdfHeightVal === '780px' ? 'selected' : '') + `>Ampla (780px)</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            <label style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:12px; color:#cbd5e1; cursor:pointer; padding-bottom:6px;">
                                <input type="checkbox" ` + (allowDlVal ? 'checked' : '') + ` onchange="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'allow_download', this.checked)" style="accent-color:#45f3ff;">
                                <span>Permitir Download</span>
                            </label>
                        </div>

                        <input type="text" value="` + escapeHtml(pdfCapVal) + `" placeholder="Legenda ou nota explicativa abaixo do PDF (opcional)" oninput="updateBlockData(` + idx + `, 'caption', this.value)" style="width:100%; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #3a444a; background:#0b0c10; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px; box-sizing:border-box;">
                    </div>
                `;

            case 'delimiter':
                return `
                    <div style="padding:10px 0; text-align:center; color:#8c8f94; font-size:12px;">
                        &mdash;&mdash;&mdash; Linha Divisória de Seção &mdash;&mdash;&mdash;
                    </div>
                `;
        }
        return '';
    }

    window.addBlock = function(type) {
        var newBlock = {
            id: 'b_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
            type: type,
            data: {}
        };

        switch(type) {
            case 'header': newBlock.data = { level: 2, text: '' }; break;
            case 'paragraph': newBlock.data = { text: '' }; break;
            case 'video': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
            case 'code': newBlock.data = { language: 'php', code: '' }; break;
            case 'callout': newBlock.data = { type: 'info', text: '' }; break;
            case 'list': newBlock.data = { style: 'unordered', items: [] }; break;
            case 'image': newBlock.data = { url: '', caption: '' }; break;
            case 'pdf': newBlock.data = { url: '', title: 'Material Complementar (PDF)', mode: 'pdfjs_canvas', start_page: 1, end_page: 0, height: '620px', allow_download: true, caption: '' }; break;
            case 'delimiter': newBlock.data = {}; break;
        }

        blocks.push(newBlock);
        renderCanvas();
    };

    window.removeBlock = function(idx) {
        if (confirm('Deseja excluir este bloco?')) {
            blocks.splice(idx, 1);
            renderCanvas();
        }
    };

    window.moveBlock = function(idx, dir) {
        var target = idx + dir;
        if (target >= 0 && target < blocks.length) {
            var item = blocks.splice(idx, 1)[0];
            blocks.splice(target, 0, item);
            renderCanvas();
        }
    };

    window.duplicateBlock = function(idx) {
        var item = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(blocks[idx]));
        item.id = 'b_' + Date.now();
        blocks.splice(idx + 1, 0, item);
        renderCanvas();
    };

    window.updateBlockData = function(idx, key, val) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
            blocks[idx].data[key] = val;
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.updateVideoBlockUrl = function(idx, val) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
            blocks[idx].data.url = val;
            var inlineBox = document.getElementById('inline_video_preview_' + idx);
            if (inlineBox) {
                inlineBox.innerHTML = resolveVideoEmbedHtml(val);
            }
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.updateListItems = function(idx, text) {
        if (blocks[idx]) {
            var lines = text.split("\n").map(function(s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(function(s) { return s.length > 0; });
            blocks[idx].data.items = lines;
            refreshLivePreview();
        }
    };

    window.uploadLessonPdfFile = function(idx, fileInput) {
        if (!fileInput || !fileInput.files || !fileInput.files[0]) return;
        var file = fileInput.files[0];

        var maxBytes = 128 * 1024 * 1024;
        if (file.size > maxBytes) {
            var fileMb = (file.size / 1048576).toFixed(1);
            notifyEditor('O arquivo PDF (' + fileMb + ' MB) excede o limite máximo de 128 MB para upload local. Para arquivos maiores, utilize uma URL na nuvem.', 'warning');
            fileInput.value = '';
            return;
        }

        var labelSpan = document.getElementById('pdf_upload_label_' + idx);
        var originalText = labelSpan ? labelSpan.textContent : '📤 Enviar PDF Local';
        if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = '⏳ Enviando...';

        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('csrf_token', csrfToken);
        formData.append('pdf', file);

        fetch(baseUrl + '/admin/academy/lessons/' + lessonId + '/upload-pdf', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken,
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            },
            body: formData
        })
        .then(parseJsonResponse)
        .then(function(data) {
            if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = originalText;
            fileInput.value = '';
            if (data && data.success && data.url) {
                if (blocks[idx]) {
                    if (!blocks[idx].data) blocks[idx].data = {};
                    blocks[idx].data.url = data.url;
                    if (!blocks[idx].data.title || blocks[idx].data.title === 'Material Complementar (PDF)') {
                        blocks[idx].data.title = file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, '');
                    }
                    renderCanvas();
                }
                notifyEditor(data.message || 'Arquivo PDF enviado com sucesso!', 'success');
            } else {
                notifyEditor((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Erro ao enviar o arquivo PDF.', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            if (labelSpan) labelSpan.textContent = originalText;
            fileInput.value = '';
            notifyEditor('Falha na comunicação durante o envio do PDF: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), 'error');
        });
    };

    window.saveLessonBlocks = function() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_save_lesson');
        var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_save_text');
        var indicator = document.getElementById('save_indicator');
        var title = document.getElementById('lesson_title_input').value;
        var status = document.getElementById('lesson_status_select').value;
        var mobileProfileEl = document.getElementById('lesson_mobile_layout_profile');
        var mobileProfile = mobileProfileEl ? mobileProfileEl.value : 'drawer';
        var fabEl = document.getElementById('fabricate_php_checkbox');
        var fabricatePhp = fabEl ? fabEl.checked : false;

        btn.disabled = true;
        btnText.textContent = 'Salvando...';

        var payload = {
            csrf_token: csrfToken,
            title: title,
            status: status,
            mobile_profile: mobileProfile,
            fabricate_php: fabricatePhp,
            blocks: blocks
        };

        fetch(baseUrl + '/admin/academy/lessons/' + lessonId + '/update-content', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken,
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        })
        .then(parseJsonResponse)
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
            if (data && data.success) {
                indicator.style.display = 'inline';
                setTimeout(function() { indicator.style.display = 'none'; }, 4000);
                notifyEditor(data.message || 'Aula salva com sucesso!', 'success');
            } else {
                notifyEditor((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Erro ao salvar aula.', 'error');
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btnText.textContent = 'Salvar Aula';
            notifyEditor('Erro na comunicação com o servidor: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), 'error');
        });
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 's') {
            e.preventDefault();
            saveLessonBlocks();
        }
    });

    renderCanvas();
})();
</script>

<script>
function openEnrollModal(studentId, studentName) {
    document.getElementById('modalEnrollStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('formEnroll').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/enroll';
    document.getElementById('modalEnroll').style.display = 'flex';
}

function openStatusModal(studentId, studentName, currentStatus) {
    document.getElementById('modalStatusStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('modalStatusSelect').value = currentStatus;
    document.getElementById('formStatus').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/status';
    document.getElementById('modalStatus').style.display = 'flex';
}

function openPasswordModal(studentId, studentName) {
    document.getElementById('modalPasswordStudentName').textContent = studentName;
    document.getElementById('inputNewPassword').value = '';
    document.getElementById('formPassword').action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/academy/students/' + studentId + '/reset-password';
    document.getElementById('modalPassword').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeModal(modalId) {
    const el = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
}

// Fechar ao clicar fora
window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    ['modalEnroll', 'modalStatus', 'modalPassword'].forEach(id => {
        const modal = document.getElementById(id);
        if (modal && e.target === modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
});
</script>

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * View Pública: Apresentação e Índice do Curso
 *
 * @var array $course
 * @var string $title
 * @var string $desc
 * @var string $ctaButton
 * @var string $navHtml
 * @var string $baseUrl
 */

$price = (float)($course['price'] ?? 0.0);
$isFree = ($price > 0.0) ? false : (isset($course['is_free']) ? (bool)$course['is_free'] : true);
$maxInstallments = isset($course['max_installments']) && (int)$course['max_installments'] > 0
    ? (int)$course['max_installments']
    : 12;

$thumb = (string)($course['thumbnail'] ?? $course['image'] ?? '');
if (!empty($thumb)) {
    if (str_starts_with($thumb, 'http://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'https://') || str_starts_with($thumb, 'data:')) {
        $thumbUrl = $thumb;
    } else {
        $thumbUrl = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($thumb, '/');
    }
} else {
    $thumbUrl = 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="360" viewBox="0 0 640 360"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="%23141a23"/><text x="50%" y="50%" fill="%2345f3ff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">🎓 ' . rawurlencode((string)$title) . '</text></svg>';
}
?>

    <div class='container' style='max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto;'>
        <!-- Card Hero de Apresentação com Capa e Detalhes da Compra -->

            <div class='ds-course-hero-grid' style='display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 0.95fr; gap: 36px; align-items: center;'>
                <!-- Coluna de Apresentação e Ação -->
                <div>
                    <div style='display: inline-block; background: rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.1); color: var(--primary, #45f3ff); padding: 0.35rem 1rem; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); margin-bottom: 14px;'>
                        Curso Academy
                    </div>

                    <h1 style='color: #fff; font-size: 2.3rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 14px;'><?= $title ?></h1>
                    <p style='color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 24px;'><?= $desc ?></p>
                    
                    <div style='margin-top: 10px;'>
                        <?= $ctaButton ?>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Coluna do Card Visual com Capa e Precificação -->
                <div style='background: #090d14; border: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.25); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);'>
                    <div style='position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #000; overflow: hidden;'>
                        <img src='<?= htmlspecialchars($thumbUrl, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>' alt='<?= htmlspecialchars((string)$title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') ?>' style='width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;'>
                    </div>
                    <div style='padding: 22px;'>
                        <?php if ($isFree && $price <= 0.0): ?>
                            <div style='display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;'>
                                <span style='background: rgba(40,167,69,0.15); color: #2ecc71; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);'>
                                    ACESSO GRATUITO

                        <?php else: ?>
                            <div style='margin-bottom: 14px;'>
                                <div style='font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #00d284;'>
                                    R$ <?= number_format($price, 2, ',', '.') ?>
                                </div>
                                <?php if ($maxInstallments > 1): ?>
                                    <?php $instVal = $price / $maxInstallments; ?>
                                    <div style='font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8); margin-top: 2px;'>
                                        em até <strong style='color: #45f3ff;'><?= $maxInstallments ?>x de R$ <?= number_format($instVal, 2, ',', '.') ?></strong>
                                    </div>
                                <?php endif; ?>
                            </div>
                            <div style='border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding-top: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted, #94a3b8);'>
                                <div>⚡ Liberação imediata via Pix ou Cartão</div>

    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:16px;">

        </h3>
        <button type="button" onclick="window.toggleStudentNotes(false)" style="background:none; border:none; color:#94a3b8; font-size:1.3rem; cursor:pointer;" aria-label="Fechar">✕</button>
    </div>
    <p style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:0.82rem; margin:0 0 14px 0; line-height:1.5;">
        Suas anotações são pessoais, salvas automaticamente em seu armazenamento isolado e privado.
    </p>
    <textarea id="ds-student-notes-textarea" placeholder="Digite aqui suas observações, dúvidas e códigos desta aula..." style="flex:1; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; background:#121824; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius:8px; padding:14px; color:#fff; font-size:0.9rem; font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; resize:none; line-height:1.6;"></textarea>
    <div style="margin-top:14px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
        <span id="ds-notes-status" style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#64748b;">Pronto</span>
        <button type="button" id="ds-btn-save-notes" onclick="window.saveStudentNotes()" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, #00d284, #00b370); color:#000; border:none; padding:10px 20px; border-radius:6px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.88rem; cursor:pointer;">
            💾 Salvar Anotação
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    var dsLessonId = <?= (int)($lessonId ?? 0) ?>;
    var dsCsrfToken = <?= json_encode((string)($csrfToken ?? '')) ?>;
    var dsBaseUrl = <?= json_encode((defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '')) ?>;
    var dsNotesLoaded = false;

    window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer = function(open) {
        var sidebar = document.getElementById('ds-academy-sidebar');
        var backdrop = document.getElementById('ds-academy-drawer-backdrop');
        if (!sidebar || !backdrop) return;
        if (open) {
            sidebar.classList.add('is-open');
            backdrop.classList.add('is-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        } else {
            sidebar.classList.remove('is-open');
            backdrop.classList.remove('is-open');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
    };

    window.toggleStudentNotes = function(open) {
        var drawer = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-drawer');
        var backdrop = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-backdrop');
        if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;
        if (open) {
            drawer.style.display = 'flex';
            backdrop.style.display = 'block';
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            if (!dsNotesLoaded && dsLessonId > 0) {
                document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Carregando anotações...';
                fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/notes', {
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
                })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function(data) {
                    if (data && data.success) {
                        document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-textarea').value = data.content || '';
                        document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Anotações carregadas.';
                        dsNotesLoaded = true;
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() {
                    document.getElementById('ds-notes-status').textContent = 'Nova anotação.';
                });
            }
        } else {
            drawer.style.display = 'none';
            backdrop.style.display = 'none';
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }
    };

    window.saveStudentNotes = function() {
        if (dsLessonId <= 0) return;
        var btn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-save-notes');
        var status = document.getElementById('ds-notes-status');
        var content = document.getElementById('ds-student-notes-textarea').value;

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'Salvando...';
        status.textContent = 'Salvando no seu workspace privado...';

        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('content', content);
        fd.append('csrf_token', dsCsrfToken);

        fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/notes', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': dsCsrfToken },
            body: fd
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar Anotação';
            if (data && data.success) {
                status.textContent = '✓ Anotação salva com sucesso!';
                setTimeout(function() { status.textContent = 'Pronto'; }, 3000);
            } else {
                status.textContent = 'Erro ao salvar anotação.';
            }
        })
        .catch(function() {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar Anotação';
            status.textContent = 'Erro de conexão.';
        });
    };

    window.toggleLessonComplete = function() {
        if (dsLessonId <= 0) return;
        var btn = document.getElementById('ds-btn-toggle-complete');
        var icon = document.getElementById('ds-complete-icon');
        var text = document.getElementById('ds-complete-text');

        btn.style.opacity = '0.6';

        var fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('csrf_token', dsCsrfToken);

        fetch(dsBaseUrl + '/aluno/aulas/' + dsLessonId + '/toggle-complete', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': dsCsrfToken },
            body: fd
        })
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.style.opacity = '1';
            if (data && data.success) {
                if (data.completed) {
                    btn.classList.add('is-completed');
                    icon.textContent = '✓';
                    text.textContent = 'Aula Concluída';
                } else {
                    btn.classList.remove('is-completed');
                    icon.textContent = '○';
                    text.textContent = 'Marcar como Concluída';
                }
            }
        })
        .catch(function() {
            btn.style.opacity = '1';
        });
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            window.toggleAcademyMobileDrawer(false);
            window.toggleStudentNotes(false);
        }
    });
</script>

        function togglePassVisibility(inputId, btn) {

            if (!input) return;

        // Sugestão automática de username a partir do Nome Completo
        const nameInput = document.getElementById('student-name');
        const usernameInput = document.getElementById('student-username');
        let usernameManuallyEdited = false;

        if (usernameInput) {
            usernameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                usernameManuallyEdited = this.value.trim().length > 0;
            });
        }

        if (nameInput && usernameInput) {
            nameInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                if (!usernameManuallyEdited) {
                    const clean = this.value
                        .normalize('NFD')
                        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
                    usernameInput.value = clean;
                }
            });
        }

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Controllers/TrackerController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;

class TrackerController
{
    private \PDO $db;

    public function __construct(\DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection $connection)
    {
        $this->db = $connection->getPdo();
    }

    public function track(Request $request)
    {
        // Pega corpo JSON
        $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
        
        $type = $input['type'] ?? 'unknown';
        $source = $input['source'] ?? 'unknown';
        
        // Hash de sessão simples (IP + UserAgent) para filtrar views únicos
        $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
        $ua = $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? '';
        $hash = hash('sha256', $ip . $ua . date('Y-m-d')); // Único por dia
        
        try {
            
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO analytics_events (event_type, event_source, session_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?)");
            $stmt->execute([$type, $source, $hash]);
            
            return Response::json(['status' => 'ok']);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return Response::json(['error' => $e->getMessage()], 500);
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.dashboard.widgets');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
        $os->listenHook('seo.after_render');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // 1. Injeta o tracker no final do HTML
        $runtime->onHook('seo.after_render', function(string &$html) {
            $trackerScript = "
            <script>
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
                // Registrar visualização de página
                fetch('" . BASE_URL . "/api/analytics/track', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'pageview', source: window.location.pathname })
                });

                // Registrar cliques em botões trackeados
                document.querySelectorAll('[data-track]').forEach(function(btn) {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                        let sourceName = this.getAttribute('data-track');
                        fetch('" . BASE_URL . "/api/analytics/track', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({ type: 'click', source: sourceName })
                        });
                    });
                });
            });
            </script>";
            
            // Injeta antes de fechar o body
            $html = str_replace('</body>', $trackerScript . "\n</body>", $html);
        });

        // 2. Registrar rota da API
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/api/analytics/track', [\DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Controllers\TrackerController::class, 'track']);
        });

        // 3. Adicionar Widgets no Dashboard
        try {
            
            $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
            $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', function($registry) use ($db) {
                $registry->registerProvider(new \DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Widgets\AnalyticsWidgetProvider($db));
            });
        } catch (\Exception $e) {}
    }

    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        try {
            $schema = $runtime->getLink('core.db.schema');
            $schema->create('analytics_events', function ($table) {
                $table->id();
                $table->string('event_type', 50); // pageview, click
                $table->string('event_source', 100); // url or button name
                $table->string('session_hash', 64); // to count unique visitors
                $table->datetime('created_at')->default('CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');
            });
        } catch (\Exception $e) {}
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/analytics/Widgets/AnalyticsWidgetProvider.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\analytics\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DashboardWidgetProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;

class AnalyticsWidgetProvider implements DashboardWidgetProviderInterface
{
    private \PDO $db;

    public function __construct(\PDO $db)
    {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function getProviderName(): string
    {
        return "RachidD Analytics (Monitor)";
    }

    public function getAvailableWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            'anl_pageviews_month' => [
                'title' => 'Visitas no Mês',
                'description' => 'Acessos únicos e totais no mês atual.'
            ],
            'anl_clicks_month' => [
                'title' => 'Cliques de Conversão',
                'description' => 'Acessos a botões de venda e WhatsApp.'
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function renderWidget(string $widgetId): string
    {
        try {
            $startOfMonth = date('Y-m-01 00:00:00');
            $endOfMonth = date('Y-m-t 23:59:59');

            if ($widgetId === 'anl_pageviews_month') {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(DISTINCT session_hash) as unique_visits FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ?");
                $stmt->execute([$startOfMonth, $endOfMonth]);
                $row = $stmt->fetch();
                $total = $row['total'] ?? 0;
                $unique = $row['unique_visits'] ?? 0;

                return "
                <div style='text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 100%;'>
                    <h1 style='font-size: 46px; margin: 0; color: var(--accent-blue);'>{$total}</h1>
                    <p style='color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 5px;'>Visualizações Totais</p>
                    
                    <div style='margin-top: 15px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;'>
                        <span style='font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-green);'>{$unique}</span>
                        <span style='font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);'> Visitantes Únicos</span>
                    </div>
                </div>";
            }

            if ($widgetId === 'anl_clicks_month') {
                $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT event_source, COUNT(*) as cliq FROM analytics_events WHERE event_type = 'click' AND created_at BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY event_source ORDER BY cliq DESC LIMIT 5");
                $stmt->execute([$startOfMonth, $endOfMonth]);
                $clicks = $stmt->fetchAll();

                $html = "<ul style='list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;'>";
                
                if (empty($clicks)) {
                    $html .= "<li style='color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 20px;'>Nenhum clique registrado ainda.</li>";
                } else {
                    foreach ($clicks as $c) {
                        $source = htmlspecialchars($c['event_source']);
                        $qtd = $c['cliq'];
                        
                        $iconColor = 'var(--text-muted)';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'amazon')) $iconColor = '#FF9900';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'hotmart')) $iconColor = '#F04E23';
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($source), 'whatsapp')) $iconColor = '#25D366';

                        $html .= "
                        <li style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding-bottom: 8px;'>
                            <span style='display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px;'>
                                <span style='display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: {$iconColor};'></span>
                                {$source}
                            </span>
                            <span style='font-weight: bold; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 11px;'>{$qtd}</span>
                        </li>";
                    }
                }
                $html .= "</ul>";
                return $html;
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return "<div>Erro no DB: " . $e->getMessage() . "</div>";
        }
        return "";
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/clock_widget/ClockWidgetProvider.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\clock_widget;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\DashboardWidgetProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager;

class ClockWidgetProvider implements DashboardWidgetProviderInterface
{
    private IdentityManager $identity;

    public function __construct(IdentityManager $identity)
    {
        $this->identity = $identity;
    }

    public function getProviderName(): string
    {
        return 'App Relógio Mundial';
    }

    public function getAvailableWidgets(): array
    {
        return [
            'world_clock' => [
                'title' => 'Relógio Mundial Seguro',
                'description' => 'Exibe o horário mundial protegido por ACL'
            ]
        ];
    }

    public function renderWidget(string $widgetId): string
    {
        if ($widgetId !== 'world_clock') {
            return '';
        }

        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0;
        
        if ($this->identity->userCan($userId, 'clock.view')) {
            $html = '<div id="clock-widget-container" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); color: #10b981; padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-family: monospace; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">';
            
            // Combobox (Select) for Timezones
            $html .= '<div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">';
            $html .= '<select id="clock-timezone-select" style="background: #0f172a; color: #10b981; border: 1px solid #334155; padding: 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; outline: none; cursor: pointer;">';
            $html .= '<option value="system">Relógio Local (Sistema)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="America/Sao_Paulo">Brasil (Brasília)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="America/New_York">EUA (Nova Iorque)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="Europe/London">Reino Unido (Londres)</option>';
            $html .= '<option value="Asia/Tokyo">Japão (Tóquio)</option>';
            $html .= '</select>';
            $html .= '</div>';

            $html .= '<div style="font-size: 28px;">';
            $html .= '<i class="far fa-clock" style="color: #4ade80; margin-right: 10px;"></i>';
            $html .= '<span id="live-clock-text">--:--:--</span>';
            $html .= '</div>';
            
            $html .= '<div style="font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 10px;">Protegido por ACL (clock.view)</div>';
            $html .= '</div>';
            
            // The magic to make it ALIVE (Client-side JS)
            $html .= '<script>
                (function() {
                    let el = document.getElementById("live-clock-text");
                    let select = document.getElementById("clock-timezone-select");
                    if(el && select) {
                        setInterval(() => {
                            let now = new Date();
                            let tz = select.value;
                            
                            let options = { hour12: false };
                            if (tz !== "system") {
                                options.timeZone = tz;
                            }
                            
                            try {
                                el.innerHTML = now.toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR", options);
                            } catch (e) {
                                el.innerHTML = "Erro de Fuso";
                            }
                        }, 1000);
                    }
                })();
            </script>';
            
            return $html;
        }

        $html = '<div style="background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; padding: 15px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #f87171;">';
        $html .= '<i class="fas fa-lock"></i> Você não tem o Privilégio (Capability) <strong>clock.view</strong> para ver as horas.';
        $html .= '</div>';
        return $html;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/clock_widget/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\clock_widget;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    // Fase de Negociação
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        // O Plugin pede permissão para injetar Widgets no Dashboard Admin usando o evento correto
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
        
        // Exige o IdentityManager para testar se o usuário tem a permissão
        $os->requireLink('core.identity');
    }

    // Fase de Execução
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $identity = $runtime->getLink('core.identity');
        $provider = new ClockWidgetProvider($identity);

        $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', function($registry) use ($provider) {
            $registry->registerProvider($provider);
        });
    }

    // Ocorre APENAS quando o SysAdmin clica em "Ativar/Instalar"
    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // Aqui o Plugin injeta silenciosamente as Capabilities no SO!
        $runtime->registerCapability('clock.view', 'App Relógio Mundial');
        $runtime->registerCapability('clock.configure', 'App Relógio Mundial');
    }
}
