<script>
(function() {
    var activeOrderId = null;

    function notify(msg, type) {
        if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
            window.OS.notify(msg, type);
        } else if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && typeof window.DS.ui.toast === 'function') {
            window.DS.ui.toast(msg, type);
        } else {
            console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
        }
    }

    window.dsConfirmApproval = function(orderId, orderRef) {
        activeOrderId = orderId;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        var refElem = document.getElementById('dsModalOrderRef');
        if (refElem) refElem.textContent = 'Pedido: ' + orderRef;
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
    };

    window.dsCloseApprovalModal = function() {
        activeOrderId = null;
        var modal = document.getElementById('dsApprovalModal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    };

    var confirmBtn = document.getElementById('dsModalConfirmBtn');
    if (confirmBtn) {
        confirmBtn.onclick = function() {
            if (!activeOrderId) return;
            var orderId = activeOrderId;
            confirmBtn.disabled = true;
            confirmBtn.textContent = 'Aprovando...';

            var formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('status', 'paid');
            formData.append('csrf_token', <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>);

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/orders/' + orderId + '/status', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?> },
                body: formData
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();

                if (data && data.success) {
                    notify('Pedido #' + orderId + ' aprovado e matrícula liberada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 1000);
                } else {
                    notify('Erro: ' + (data && data.message ? data.message : 'Falha ao atualizar pedido.'), 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                confirmBtn.disabled = false;
                confirmBtn.textContent = 'Confirmar e Liberar';
                window.dsCloseApprovalModal();
                notify('Erro de conexão ao aprovar pedido.', 'error');
            });
        };
    }

    // Renderização dos Gráficos com Chart.js
    var timelineData = <?= json_encode($salesTimeline, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;
    var breakdownData = <?= json_encode($paymentBreakdown, JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_AMP) ?>;

    function initCharts() {
        if (typeof Chart === 'undefined') return;

        // 1. Gráfico de Linha (Faturamento)
        var salesCtx = document.getElementById('dsSalesChart');
        if (salesCtx && timelineData && timelineData.labels) {
            var ctx = salesCtx.getContext('2d');
            var gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 200);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.28)');
            gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.01)');

            new Chart(salesCtx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: timelineData.labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Faturamento (R$)',
                        data: timelineData.totals,
                        borderColor: '#00d284',
                        backgroundColor: gradient,
                        borderWidth: 2.5,
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.35,
                        pointBackgroundColor: '#00d284',
                        pointBorderColor: '#0f141c',
                        pointBorderWidth: 2,
                        pointRadius: timelineData.labels.length > 20 ? 2 : 4,
                        pointHoverRadius: 6,
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            bodyColor: '#00d284',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.3)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: { color: '#64748b', font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' } }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)', borderColor: 'transparent' },
                            ticks: {
                                color: '#64748b',
                                font: { size: 11, family: 'system-ui' },
                                callback: function(value) {
                                    return 'R$ ' + value.toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // 2. Gráfico Donut (Mix de Pagamentos)
        var mixCtx = document.getElementById('dsPaymentMixChart');
        if (mixCtx && breakdownData && Object.keys(breakdownData).length > 0) {
            var mixLabels = [];
            var mixTotals = [];
            var mixColors = [];

            for (var key in breakdownData) {
                if (breakdownData.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    mixLabels.push(breakdownData[key].label);
                    mixTotals.push(breakdownData[key].total);
                    mixColors.push(breakdownData[key].color);
                }
            }

            new Chart(mixCtx, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: mixLabels,
                    datasets: [{
                        data: mixTotals,
                        backgroundColor: mixColors,
                        borderWidth: 2,
                        borderColor: '#0f141c',
                        hoverOffset: 4
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '72%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            backgroundColor: '#0f172a',
                            titleColor: '#f8fafc',
                            borderColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            padding: 10,
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function(context) {
                                    var val = Number(context.raw || 0);
                                    return ' ' + context.label + ': R$ ' + val.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') {
        initCharts();
    } else {
        var chartScript = document.createElement('script');
        chartScript.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js';
        chartScript.async = true;
        chartScript.onload = initCharts;
        document.head.appendChild(chartScript);
    }
})();
</script>

        function notify(msg, type) {
            if (window.OS && typeof window.OS.notify === 'function') {
                window.OS.notify(msg, type);
            } else if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && typeof window.DS.ui.toast === 'function') {
                window.DS.ui.toast(msg, type);
            } else {
                console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
            }
        }

        function testMercadoPagoCredentials() {
            var tokenInput = document.getElementById('mp_access_token_input');
            var pubkeyInput = document.getElementById('mp_public_key_input');
            var tokenBox = document.getElementById('mp_token_status_box');
            var pubkeyBox = document.getElementById('mp_pubkey_status_box');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_mp');
            var spinner = document.getElementById('mp_test_spinner');

            var accessToken = tokenInput ? tokenInput.value.trim() : '';
            var publicKey = pubkeyInput ? pubkeyInput.value.trim() : '';

            if (!accessToken && !publicKey) {
                notify('Preencha ao menos o Access Token ou a Public Key para realizar o teste de validação.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            spinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
            tokenBox.style.display = 'none';
            pubkeyBox.style.display = 'none';

            var payload = {
                csrf_token: <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>,
                access_token: accessToken,
                public_key: publicKey
            };

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/test-mercadopago', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                spinner.style.display = 'none';

                if (!data || !data.success) {
                    var errorMsg = (data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao executar teste';
                    notify(errorMsg, 'error');
                    return;
                }

                notify('Teste de conexão com a API do Mercado Pago concluído!', 'success');

                // Renderiza Status do Access Token (Verde ou Vermelho)
                if (data.access_token) {
                    tokenBox.style.display = 'block';
                    if (data.access_token.ok) {
                        tokenBox.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        tokenBox.style.color = '#00d284';
                        tokenBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        tokenBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🟢</span><strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.access_token.message;
                    } else {
                        tokenBox.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        tokenBox.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        tokenBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        tokenBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🔴</span><strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.access_token.message;
                    }
                }

                // Renderiza Status da Public Key (Verde ou Vermelho)
                if (data.public_key) {
                    pubkeyBox.style.display = 'block';
                    if (data.public_key.ok) {
                        pubkeyBox.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        pubkeyBox.style.color = '#00d284';
                        pubkeyBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        pubkeyBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🟢</span><strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.public_key.message;
                    } else {
                        pubkeyBox.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        pubkeyBox.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        pubkeyBox.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        pubkeyBox.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size: 1.1rem; margin-right: 6px;">🔴</span><strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.public_key.message;
                    }
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                spinner.style.display = 'none';
                notify('Erro de conexão ao testar credenciais: ' + err, 'error');
            });
        }

        function testPayPalCredentials() {
            var clientId = (document.getElementById('pp_client_id_input') || {}).value || '';
            var clientSecret = (document.getElementById('pp_client_secret_input') || {}).value || '';
            var box = document.getElementById('pp_status_box');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_paypal');

            if (!clientId.trim() || !clientSecret.trim()) {
                notify('Informe o Client ID e Client Secret do PayPal para testar.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = '⏳ Testando...';
            box.style.display = 'none';

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/test-paypal', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    csrf_token: <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>,
                    client_id: clientId.trim(),
                    client_secret: clientSecret.trim()
                })
            })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Credenciais do PayPal';
                box.style.display = 'block';
                if (data && data.success && data.result) {
                    if (data.result.ok) {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#00d284';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🟢 <strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify('Conexão com PayPal validada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    } else {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🔴 <strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify(data.result.message, 'error');
                    }
                } else {
                    notify((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha no teste PayPal.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Credenciais do PayPal';
                notify('Erro de conexão ao testar PayPal: ' + err, 'error');
            });
        }

        function testStripeCredentials() {
            var secretKey = (document.getElementById('stripe_secret_key_input') || {}).value || '';
            var box = document.getElementById('stripe_status_box');
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_test_stripe');

            if (!secretKey.trim()) {
                notify('Informe a Secret Key do Stripe para testar.', 'error');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = '⏳ Testando...';
            box.style.display = 'none';

            fetch(<?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?> + '/admin/commerce/test-stripe', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    csrf_token: <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>,
                    secret_key: secretKey.trim()
                })
            })
            .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Chave Secreta do Stripe';
                box.style.display = 'block';
                if (data && data.success && data.result) {
                    if (data.result.ok) {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#00d284';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🟢 <strong>OK:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify('Conexão com Stripe validada com sucesso!', 'success');
                    } else {
                        box.style.background = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)';
                        box.style.color = '#ef4444';
                        box.style.border = '1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35)';
                        box.innerHTML = '🔴 <strong>Erro:</strong> ' + data.result.message;
                        notify(data.result.message, 'error');
                    }
                } else {
                    notify((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha no teste Stripe.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '⚡ Testar Chave Secreta do Stripe';
                notify('Erro de conexão ao testar Stripe: ' + err, 'error');
            });
        }

'display:none;' : '' ?>">
                        <label for="payer_cpf" style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 6px;">

                        <input type="text" id="payer_cpf" name="payer_cpf" value="<?= $userCpf ?>" placeholder="000.000.000-00" maxlength="14" style="width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; background: #06090e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 6px; color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; font-family: monospace; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s;" oninput="formatCpfInput(this)">
                        <span style="display: block; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 6px;">

                        📋 Copiar Código Pix

    <!-- Sistema Oficial de Notificações Toast -->
    <script src="<?= $baseUrl ?>/assets/js/core/toast.js"></script>

    <script>
        var baseUrl = <?= json_encode($baseUrl) ?>;
        var csrfToken = <?= json_encode($csrfToken) ?>;
        var courseId = <?= (int)$courseId ?>;
        var selectedMethod = 'pix';

        function showNotify(msg, type) {
            type = type || 'info';
            if (window.DS && window.DS.ui && window.DS.ui.toast) {
                if (type === 'error') DS.ui.toast.error(msg);
                else if (type === 'success') DS.ui.toast.success(msg);
                else if (type === 'warning') DS.ui.toast.warning(msg);
                else DS.ui.toast.info(msg);
            } else {
                console.log('[' + type + '] ' + msg);
            }
        }

        function formatCpfInput(el) {
            var v = el.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 11);
            if (v.length > 9) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,2})/, '$1.$2.$3-$4');
            } else if (v.length > 6) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2.$3');
            } else if (v.length > 3) {
                el.value = v.replace(/(\d{3})(\d{1,3})/, '$1.$2');
            } else {
                el.value = v;
            }
        }

        var selectedMethod = 'pix';
        var selectedGateway = 'mercadopago';

        function selectPaymentMethod(m, g) {
            selectedMethod = m;
            selectedGateway = g || (m === 'stripe' ? 'stripe' : (m === 'paypal' ? 'paypal' : 'mercadopago'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.ds-method-option').forEach(function(el) {
                el.classList.remove('active');
            });
            var rad = document.querySelector('input[value="' + m + '"]');
            if (rad) {
                rad.checked = true;
                rad.closest('.ds-method-option').classList.add('active');
            }

            var cpfGroup = document.getElementById('cpf_field_group');
            var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment_text');
            if (m === 'pix') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'block';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '⚡ Gerar QR Code Pix (R$ <?= $formattedTotal ?>)';
            } else if (m === 'checkout_pro') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '💳 Pagar com Mercado Pago (R$ <?= $formattedTotal ?>)';
            } else if (m === 'stripe') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '🌐 Pagar com Cartão / Stripe (R$ <?= $formattedTotal ?>)';
            } else if (m === 'paypal') {
                if (cpfGroup) cpfGroup.style.display = 'none';
                if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '🅿️ Pagar com PayPal (R$ <?= $formattedTotal ?>)';
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            var cpfEl = document.getElementById('payer_cpf');
            if (cpfEl && cpfEl.value) {
                formatCpfInput(cpfEl);
            }
            <?php if ($hasPayPal && ($coursePlatform === 'paypal' || (!$hasMercadoPago && !$hasStripe))): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('paypal', 'paypal');
            <?php elseif ($hasStripe && ($coursePlatform === 'stripe' || (!$hasMercadoPago && !$hasPayPal))): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('stripe', 'stripe');
            <?php elseif ($hasMercadoPago): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('pix', 'mercadopago');
            <?php elseif ($hasPayPal): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('paypal', 'paypal');
            <?php elseif ($hasStripe): ?>
            selectPaymentMethod('stripe', 'stripe');
            <?php endif; ?>
        });

        var pixPollInterval = null;

        function startPixPolling(orderRef) {
            if (pixPollInterval) clearInterval(pixPollInterval);
            pixPollInterval = setInterval(function() {
                if (!orderRef) return;
                fetch(baseUrl + '/checkout/status/' + encodeURIComponent(orderRef), {
                    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
                })
                .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
                .then(function(res) {
                    if (res && res.paid) {
                        clearInterval(pixPollInterval);
                        var hint = document.getElementById('pix_status_hint');
                        if (hint) {
                            hint.innerHTML = '✅ Pagamento confirmado pelo banco! Liberando seu curso...';
                            hint.style.color = '#00d284';
                        }
                        showNotify('🎉 Pagamento Pix confirmado com sucesso! Redirecionando para suas aulas...', 'success');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = res.redirect_url || (baseUrl + '/aluno/painel');
                        }, 1200);
                    }
                })
                .catch(function() {});
            }, 3500);
        }

        function handlePaymentSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment');
            var btnText = document.getElementById('btn_submit_payment_text');
            var cpfInput = document.getElementById('payer_cpf');
            var rawCpf = cpfInput ? cpfInput.value.replace(/\D/g, '') : '';

            if (selectedMethod === 'pix' && rawCpf.length !== 11) {
                showNotify('Por favor, informe seu CPF com 11 dígitos para emissão do Pix.', 'warning');
                if (cpfInput) {
                    cpfInput.focus();
                    cpfInput.style.borderColor = '#45f3ff';
                }
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            if (btnText) btnText.textContent = '⏳ Processando Pagamento...';

            showNotify('Conectando ao gateway de pagamento seguro...', 'info');

            var gateway = selectedGateway;

            var payload = {
                csrf_token: csrfToken,
                course_id: courseId,
                gateway: gateway,
                payment_method: selectedMethod,
                payer_cpf: rawCpf
            };

            fetch(baseUrl + '/checkout/process', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) {
                return res.text().then(function(text) {
                    try {
                        return JSON.parse(text);
                    } catch (parseErr) {
                        console.error('Resposta não-JSON recebida:', text);
                        throw new Error('Resposta inválida do servidor: ' + text.substring(0, 100));
                    }
                });
            })
            .then(function(data) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                selectPaymentMethod(selectedMethod);

                if (data && data.success) {
                    if (data.status === 'approved') {
                        showNotify(data.message || 'Pagamento aprovado com sucesso! Redirecionando...', 'success');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = data.redirect_url || (baseUrl + '/aluno/painel');
                        }, 1200);
                    } else if (data.payment_method === 'pix' && data.pix_copia_e_cola) {
                        showNotify('Chave Pix gerada! Escaneie o QR Code ou copie o código abaixo.', 'success');
                        var box = document.getElementById('pix_result_box');
                        box.style.display = 'block';
                        document.getElementById('pix_copia_cola_text').value = data.pix_copia_e_cola;
                        
                        var qrImgUrl = data.pix_qr_code || ('https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=220x220&margin=8&data=' + encodeURIComponent(data.pix_copia_e_cola));
                        document.getElementById('pix_qr_image_wrap').innerHTML = '<img src="' + qrImgUrl + '" alt="QR Code Pix" style="max-width:210px; border-radius:10px; border:2px solid rgba(69,243,255,0.4); padding:8px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); display:inline-block;">';
                        
                        box.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                        if (data.order_ref) {
                            startPixPolling(data.order_ref);
                        }
                    } else if (data.redirect_url) {
                        var targetName = (data.payment_method === 'paypal') ? 'PayPal' : ((data.payment_method === 'stripe') ? 'Stripe' : 'Mercado Pago');
                        showNotify(data.message || ('Redirecionando para o ambiente seguro do ' + targetName + '...'), 'info');
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
                        }, 900);
                    } else if (data.boleto_url) {
                        showNotify('Boleto bancário gerado com sucesso!', 'success');
                        window.open(data.boleto_url, '_blank');
                    } else {
                        showNotify(data.message || 'Solicitação processada.', 'info');
                    }
                } else {
                    showNotify((data && data.message) ? data.message : 'Falha ao processar pagamento.', 'error');
                }
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                selectPaymentMethod(selectedMethod);
                showNotify('Erro de conexão ao processar pagamento: ' + err.message, 'error');
            });
        }

        function copyPixCode() {
            var txt = document.getElementById('pix_copia_cola_text');
            txt.select();
            txt.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt.value).then(function() {
                    showNotify('Código Pix copiado para a área de transferência!', 'success');
                });
            } else {
                document.execCommand('copy');
                showNotify('Código Pix copiado com sucesso!', 'success');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de serialização segura de DTOs de widgets em HTML sanitizado (SOLID - DIP / ISP).
 */
interface DtoRendererInterface
{
    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $dto
     */
    public function render(array $dto): string;

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $tree
     */
    public function renderTree(array $tree): string;
}

/**

     */
    public function toDto(array $attributes, array $children = []): array;

    public function render(array $attributes, string $content = ''): string;

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Controllers/BuilderAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\PageContentRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\AssetBundle;
use Throwable;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * CONTROLLER: BuilderAdminController (Editor Visual Full Site Editing)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsável por renderizar a interface do editor visual e expor a API
 * de schema dos widgets (controles de propriedade) para o JavaScript.
 *
 * Desacoplado via PageContentRepositoryInterface (SOLID - DIP / ISP).
 */
class BuilderAdminController
{
    private ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private WidgetManagerInterface $widgetManager;
    private ?PageContentRepositoryInterface $pageRepo;

    public function __construct(
        ThemeManagerInterface $theme,
        WidgetManagerInterface $widgetManager,
        ?PageContentRepositoryInterface $pageRepo = null
    ) {
        $this->theme         = $theme;
        $this->widgetManager = $widgetManager;
        $this->pageRepo      = $pageRepo;
    }

    /**
     * Renderiza a view do editor visual (Full Site Editing) com isolamento estrito de escopo.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): ViewResponse
    {
        $pageId = $request->input('page_id');
        $pageContent = '';

        if ($pageId && $this->pageRepo !== null) {
            $page = $this->pageRepo->findById((int)$pageId);
            if (is_array($page) && !empty($page['content'])) {
                $pageContent = (string)$page['content'];
            }
        }

        $builderData = [
            'page_id' => $pageId,
            'content' => $pageContent,
        ];

        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/builder_editor.php';
        $isolatedInclude = static function (string $__file, array $__ctx): string {
            ob_start();
            try {
                extract($__ctx, EXTR_SKIP);
                include $__file;
                return (string)ob_get_clean();
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
                    ob_end_clean();
                }
                throw $e;
            }
        };

        return new ViewResponse($isolatedInclude($viewFile, $builderData), false);
    }

    /** Entrega o bundle JS (todos os módulos do manifesto, na ordem). */
    public function script(): Response
    {
        return $this->asset('js', 'application/javascript; charset=utf-8');
    }

    /** Entrega o bundle CSS. */
    public function style(): Response
    {
        return $this->asset('css', 'text/css; charset=utf-8');
    }

    private function asset(string $type, string $contentType): Response
    {
        $bundle = new AssetBundle(dirname(__DIR__) . '/assets');
        $content = $bundle->build($type);

        if ($content === null) {
            return new Response('Not found', 404, ['Content-Type' => 'text/plain']);
        }

        return new Response($content, 200, [
            'Content-Type'  => $contentType,
            'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * API JSON: Retorna o schema de controles de todos os widgets registrados.
     * Consumido pelo JavaScript do editor para montar o painel de propriedades.
     */
    public function getSchema(): Response
    {
        $schema = [];
        foreach ($this->widgetManager->getWidgets() as $tag => $widget) {
            $schema[$tag] = [
                'name'     => $widget->getName(),
                'controls' => $widget->getControls(),
            ];
        }

        return new Response(
            json_encode($schema, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT),
            200,
            ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']
        );
    }

    public function save(Request $request): Response
    {
        $pageId = $request->input('page_id');
        $content = $request->input('content');

        if (!$pageId || empty($content)) {
            return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Missing page_id or content']), 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        if ($this->pageRepo === null) {
            return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => 'Page repository unavailable']), 503, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        try {
            $this->pageRepo->update((int)$pageId, ['content' => $content]);
            return new Response(json_encode(['success' => true]), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Core/AbstractWidget.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\DtoRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetInterface;

abstract class AbstractWidget implements WidgetInterface
{
    protected ?DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer;

    public function __construct(?DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->dtoRenderer = $dtoRenderer;
    }

    public function setDtoRenderer(DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer): void
    {
        $this->dtoRenderer = $dtoRenderer;
    }
    /**
     * Constrói o mapa estruturado de estilos CSS a partir das propriedades do widget.
     */
    protected function buildStyles(array $props): array
    {
        $unit = fn($val) => (is_numeric($val) ? $val . 'px' : $val);
        $styles = [];

        $map = [
            'position' => 'position', 'left' => 'left', 'top' => 'top',
            'width' => 'width', 'height' => 'height', 'minHeight' => 'min-height',
            'flex' => 'flex', 'margin' => 'margin', 'padding' => 'padding',
            'display' => 'display', 'flexDirection' => 'flex-direction',
            'justifyContent' => 'justify-content', 'alignItems' => 'align-items',
            'gap' => 'gap', 'order' => 'order', 'backgroundColor' => 'background-color',
            'border' => 'border', 'borderRadius' => 'border-radius',
            'boxShadow' => 'box-shadow', 'opacity' => 'opacity',
            'zIndex' => 'z-index', 'overflow' => 'overflow', 'color' => 'color',
        ];

        foreach ($map as $key => $cssProperty) {
            if (isset($props[$key]) && $props[$key] !== '' && $props[$key] !== null) {
                $styles[$cssProperty] = in_array($key, ['width', 'height', 'minHeight', 'left', 'top', 'borderRadius'], true)
                    ? $unit($props[$key])
                    : $props[$key];
            }
        }

        if (($props['hidden'] ?? false) === true || ($props['hidden'] ?? '') === 'true') {
            $styles['display'] = 'none';
        }

        return $styles;
    }

    /**
     * Construtor padrão de DTO. Os widgets filhos especializam tag/styles/content.
     */
    public function toDto(array $attributes, array $children = []): array
    {
        $classes = ['flex-widget', 'widget-node'];
        if (!empty($attributes['layout'])) {
            $classes[] = 'layout-' . $attributes['layout'];
        }
        if (!empty($attributes['class_css'])) {
            $classes[] = $attributes['class_css'];
        }

        return [
            'type' => 'div',
            'tag' => 'div',
            'attrs' => [
                'id' => !empty($attributes['id']) ? $attributes['id'] : null,
                'class' => array_values(array_filter($classes)),
            ],
            'styles' => $this->buildStyles($attributes),
            'content' => (string)($attributes['content'] ?? ''),
            'children' => $children,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Renderização de compatibilidade (ex: Shortcodes diretos) delegando ao DtoRendererInterface.
     */
    public function render(array $attributes, string $content = ''): string
    {
        $dto = $this->toDto($attributes, []);
        if ($content !== '' && empty($dto['content'])) {
            $dto['content'] = $content;
        }
        $renderer = $this->dtoRenderer ?? new DtoRenderer();
        return $renderer->render($dto);
    }

    // Helpers legados mantidos como protected para retrocompatibilidade
    protected function extractCommonAttributes(array $attributes): string
    {
        $html = '';
        if (!empty($attributes['id'])) {
            $html .= ' id="' . htmlspecialchars((string)$attributes['id']) . '"';
        }

        $classes = ['widget-node'];
        if (!empty($attributes['layout'])) {
            $classes[] = 'layout-' . $attributes['layout'];
        }
        if (!empty($attributes['class_css'])) {
            $classes[] = $attributes['class_css'];
        }
        $html .= ' class="' . htmlspecialchars(implode(' ', $classes)) . '"';

        $styles = $this->generateBaseStyles($attributes);
        if (!empty($styles)) {
            $html .= ' style="' . htmlspecialchars($styles) . '"';
        }

        return $html;
    }

    protected function generateBaseStyles(array $props): string
    {
        $styles = $this->buildStyles($props);
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($styles as $prop => $val) {
            $parts[] = "{$prop}: {$val};";
        }
        return implode(' ', $parts);
    }

    protected function extractCommonStyles(array $attributes): string
    {
        $styles = '';
        if (!empty($attributes['margin'])) {
            $styles .= 'margin:' . $attributes['margin'] . ';';
        }
        if (!empty($attributes['padding'])) {
            $styles .= 'padding:' . $attributes['padding'] . ';';
        }
        return $styles;
    }

    public function getControls(): array
    {
        return [
            'layout' => [
                'title' => 'Layout e Espaçamento',
                'controls' => [
                    'width' => [
                        'type' => 'dimension',
                        'label' => 'Largura',
                        'units' => ['px', '%', 'vw', 'auto'],
                        'css_property' => 'width'
                    ],
                    'margin' => [
                        'type' => 'spacing',
                        'label' => 'Margem',
                        'css_property' => 'margin'
                    ],
                    'padding' => [
                        'type' => 'spacing',
                        'label' => 'Preenchimento',
                        'css_property' => 'padding'
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ];
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Core/AssetBundle.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core;

use RuntimeException;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * AssetBundle — empacota os módulos front-end do Builder Flex
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 *
 * Responsabilidade ÚNICA: ler o manifesto (assets/manifest.php) e concatenar,
 * na ordem declarada, os arquivos JS ou CSS de cada módulo com cache por hash.
 */
final class AssetBundle
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $memoryCache = [];

    public function __construct(private string $assetsDir)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param string $type 'js' ou 'css'
     * @return string|null Conteúdo concatenado, ou null se o tipo não existir no manifesto.
     */
    public function build(string $type): ?string
    {
        $manifestFile = $this->assetsDir . '/manifest.php';
        if (!is_file($manifestFile)) {
            return null;
        }

        $manifest = require $manifestFile;

        if (!isset($manifest[$type]) || !is_array($manifest[$type])) {
            return null;
        }

        $mtimes = [];
        $filesToRead = [];
        foreach ($manifest[$type] as $relativePath) {
            $file = $this->assetsDir . '/' . $type . '/' . $relativePath;
            if (!is_file($file)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Módulo do Builder não encontrado: {$type}/{$relativePath}");
            }
            $mtimes[] = $relativePath . ':' . (string)@filemtime($file);
            $filesToRead[$relativePath] = $file;
        }

        $cacheKey = $type . '_' . md5(implode('|', $mtimes));
        if (isset($this->memoryCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return $this->memoryCache[$cacheKey];
        }

        $output = '';
        foreach ($filesToRead as $relativePath => $file) {
            $output .= "/* ── {$relativePath} ── */\n" . file_get_contents($file) . "\n\n";
        }

        $this->memoryCache[$cacheKey] = $output;

        return $output;
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Core/DtoRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\SafeHtmlSanitizer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\DtoRendererInterface;

/**
 * Renderer central: transforma um DTO de widget em HTML.
 * Único ponto no BuilderFlex responsável por serializar DTOs em HTML com sanitização contra XSS/CSS injection.
 */
class DtoRenderer implements DtoRendererInterface
{
    private HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer;
    private ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        ?HtmlSanitizerInterface $htmlSanitizer = null,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->htmlSanitizer = $htmlSanitizer ?? new SafeHtmlSanitizer();
        $this->styleRenderer = $styleRenderer ?? new ElementStyleRenderer();
    }

    public function render(array $dto): string
    {
        if (empty($dto)) {
            return '';
        }

        $tag = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', (string)($dto['tag'] ?? 'div')) ?: 'div';
        $attrs = $this->renderAttrs($dto['attrs'] ?? []);
        $styles = $this->renderStyles($dto['styles'] ?? []);
        $rawContent = (string)($dto['content'] ?? '');
        $content = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeInlineHtml($rawContent);

        $childrenHtml = '';
        foreach ($dto['children'] ?? [] as $child) {
            if (is_array($child)) {
                $childrenHtml .= $this->render($child);
            }
        }

        $styleAttr = $styles !== '' ? ' style="' . htmlspecialchars($styles, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '"' : '';
        if (in_array(strtolower($tag), ['img', 'hr', 'br', 'input'], true)) {
            return "<{$tag}{$attrs}{$styleAttr} />";
        }

        return "<{$tag}{$attrs}{$styleAttr}>{$content}{$childrenHtml}</{$tag}>";
    }

    private function renderAttrs(array $attrs): string
    {
        $out = '';
        foreach ($attrs as $key => $val) {
            if ($val === null || $val === '') {
                continue;
            }
            if (is_array($val)) {
                $val = implode(' ', array_filter($val, fn($v) => $v !== null && $v !== ''));
            }
            if ($val === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $safeKey = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_:-]/', '', (string)$key);
            if ($safeKey === '' || str_starts_with(strtolower($safeKey), 'on')) {
                continue;
            }
            $strVal = (string)$val;
            if (in_array(strtolower($safeKey), ['href', 'src'], true)) {
                $strVal = $this->htmlSanitizer->sanitizeUrl($strVal, '#');
            }
            $out .= ' ' . $safeKey . '="' . htmlspecialchars($strVal, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . '"';
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private function renderStyles(array $styles): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($styles as $prop => $val) {
            if ($val === null || $val === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $safeProp = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', (string)$prop);
            $safeVal = $this->styleRenderer->sanitizeCssValue((string)$val);
            if ($safeProp === '' || $safeVal === '') {
                continue;
            }
            $parts[] = "{$safeProp}: {$safeVal}";
        }
        return implode('; ', $parts);
    }

    public function renderTree(array $tree): string
    {
        return implode('', array_map(fn($node) => is_array($node) ? $this->render($node) : '', $tree));
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Core/JsonRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageTreeRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\DtoRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetManagerInterface;

class JsonRenderer implements PageTreeRendererInterface
{
    private WidgetManagerInterface $widgetManager;
    private DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer;

    public function __construct(WidgetManagerInterface $widgetManager, ?DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->widgetManager = $widgetManager;
        $this->dtoRenderer = $dtoRenderer ?? new DtoRenderer();
    }

    public function renderTree(array $tree): string
    {
        $dtos = array_values(array_filter(array_map(fn($node) => is_array($node) ? $this->buildDto($node) : [], $tree)));
        return $this->dtoRenderer->renderTree($dtos);
    }

    public function buildDto(array $node): array
    {
        if (empty($node['type']) || empty($node['id'])) {
            return [];
        }

        $widget = $this->widgetManager->getWidget($node['type']);
        if (!$widget) {
            return [
                'type' => 'div',
                'tag' => 'div',
                'content' => '<!-- Widget não encontrado: ' . htmlspecialchars((string)$node['type'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') . ' -->',
                'attrs' => [],
                'styles' => [],
                'children' => [],
            ];
        }

        $props = $node['props'] ?? [];
        if (empty($props['class_css'])) {
            $props['class_css'] = 'bw-' . $node['id'];
        }

        $children = [];
        foreach ($node['children'] ?? [] as $child) {
            if (is_array($child)) {
                $childDto = $this->buildDto($child);
                if (!empty($childDto)) {
                    $children[] = $childDto;
                }
            }
        }

        return $widget->toDto($props, $children);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Core/WidgetManager.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ShortcodeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\DtoRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetManagerInterface;

class WidgetManager implements WidgetManagerInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, WidgetInterface> */
    protected array $widgets = [];

    /** @var array<string, WidgetInterface> Índice O(1) por nome curto e nome da classe */
    protected array $shortNameIndex = [];

    private ?DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer;

    public function __construct(?DtoRendererInterface $dtoRenderer = null)
    {
        $this->dtoRenderer = $dtoRenderer;
    }

    public function registerWidget(WidgetInterface $widget): void
    {
        if ($this->dtoRenderer !== null && $widget instanceof AbstractWidget) {
            $widget->setDtoRenderer($this->dtoRenderer);
        }

        $tag = $widget->getShortcodeTag();
        $this->widgets[$tag] = $widget;

        $classParts = explode('\\', get_class($widget));
        $className = (string)end($classParts);
        $this->shortNameIndex[$className] = $widget;

        if (str_ends_with($className, 'Widget')) {
            $shortName = substr($className, 0, -6);
            if ($shortName !== '') {
                $this->shortNameIndex[$shortName] = $widget;
            }
        }
    }

    public function getWidgets(): array
    {
        return $this->widgets;
    }

    public function getWidget(string $name): ?WidgetInterface
    {
        // Busca O(1) direta pela tag do shortcode (ex: flex_container)
        if (isset($this->widgets[$name])) {
            return $this->widgets[$name];
        }

        // Busca O(1) pelo índice de nomes curtos / classes (ex: Container ou ContainerWidget)
        if (isset($this->shortNameIndex[$name])) {
            return $this->shortNameIndex[$name];
        }

        return null;
    }

    // Acopla todos os widgets registrados dinamicamente ao motor de Shortcodes do Kernel
    public function bootShortcodes(ShortcodeManagerInterface $shortcodeManager): void
    {
        foreach ($this->widgets as $tag => $widget) {
            $shortcodeManager->add($tag, function (array $attrs, ?string $content = '') use ($widget) {
                return $widget->render($attrs, (string)$content);
            });
        }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\AbstractWidget;

class LogoWidget extends AbstractWidget
{
    public function getName(): string { return 'Logo do Site'; }
    public function getShortcodeTag(): string { return 'flex_logo'; }

    public function toDto(array $attributes, array $children = []): array
    {
        $dto = parent::toDto($attributes, $children);
        $logoUrl = $attributes['src'] ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL . '/assets/img/logo-default.png' : '/logo.png');
        $width = $attributes['width'] ?? '150px';

        $dto['tag'] = 'a';
        $dto['type'] = 'a';
        $dto['attrs']['href'] = defined('BASE_URL') && BASE_URL !== '' ? BASE_URL : '/';
        $dto['children'] = [
            [
                'type' => 'img',
                'tag' => 'img',
                'attrs' => [
                    'src' => $logoUrl,
                    'alt' => 'Logo',
                ],
                'styles' => [
                    'max-width' => is_numeric($width) ? $width . 'px' : $width,
                    'height' => 'auto',
                ],
                'content' => '',
                'children' => [],
            ],
        ];
        return $dto;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\AbstractWidget;

class TextWidget extends AbstractWidget
{
    public function getName(): string { return 'Texto'; }
    public function getShortcodeTag(): string { return 'flex_text'; }

    public function toDto(array $attributes, array $children = []): array
    {
        $dto = parent::toDto($attributes, $children);
        $dto['tag'] = $attributes['tag'] ?? 'p';
        $dto['type'] = $dto['tag'];
        $dto['content'] = (string)($attributes['content'] ?? ($attributes['text'] ?? ''));
        return $dto;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/Widgets/UserAuthWidget.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Widgets;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\AbstractWidget;

/**
 * Widget de Autenticação / Login & Cadastro para o Flex Builder.
 */
class UserAuthWidget extends AbstractWidget
{
    public function getName(): string
    {
        return 'Login & Cadastro (Aluno)';
    }

    public function getShortcodeTag(): string
    {
        return 'flex_user_auth';
    }

    public function getControls(): array
    {
        return [
            'login_text'    => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto Login', 'default' => 'Entrar'],
            'login_url'     => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link Login', 'default' => '/aluno/login'],
            'register_text' => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Texto Cadastro', 'default' => 'Cadastrar'],
            'register_url'  => ['type' => 'text', 'label' => 'Link Cadastro', 'default' => '/aluno/cadastro'],
            'align'         => ['type' => 'select', 'label' => 'Alinhamento', 'options' => ['left', 'center', 'right'], 'default' => 'right'],
        ];
    }

    public function toDto(array $attributes, array $children = []): array
    {
        $dto = parent::toDto($attributes, $children);

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') : '';
        $resolveUrl = function(string $raw, string $default) use ($baseUrl): string {
            $raw = trim($raw);
            if ($raw === '') {
                $raw = $default;
            }
            if (str_starts_with($raw, 'http://') || str_starts_with($raw, 'https://') || str_starts_with($raw, '//') || str_starts_with($raw, '#')) {
                return $raw;
            }
            if ($baseUrl !== '' && str_starts_with($raw, $baseUrl . '/')) {
                return $raw;
            }
            return ($baseUrl !== '' ? $baseUrl : '') . '/' . ltrim($raw, '/');
        };

        $loginText = (string)($attributes['login_text'] ?? 'Entrar');
        $loginUrl = $resolveUrl((string)($attributes['login_url'] ?? ''), '/aluno/login');
        $registerText = (string)($attributes['register_text'] ?? 'Cadastrar');
        $registerUrl = $resolveUrl((string)($attributes['register_url'] ?? ''), '/aluno/cadastro');
        $dashboardText = (string)($attributes['dashboard_text'] ?? 'Área do Aluno');
        $dashboardUrl = $resolveUrl((string)($attributes['dashboard_url'] ?? ''), '/aluno/painel');
        $logoutText = (string)($attributes['logout_text'] ?? 'Sair');
        $logoutUrl = $resolveUrl((string)($attributes['logout_url'] ?? ''), '/aluno/logout');

        // Verifica se há aluno logado via sessão isolada da academia
        $isLoggedIn = !empty($_SESSION['academy_student_id']);
        $studentName = (string)($_SESSION['academy_student_name'] ?? 'Aluno');

        if ($isLoggedIn) {
            $dto['tag'] = 'div';
            $dto['type'] = 'div';
            $dto['styles']['display'] = 'inline-flex';
            $dto['styles']['align-items'] = 'center';
            $dto['styles']['gap'] = '10px';
            $dto['children'] = [
                [
                    'type'     => 'a',
                    'tag'      => 'a',
                    'attrs'    => ['href' => $dashboardUrl],
                    'styles'   => [
                        'display'         => 'inline-flex',
                        'align-items'     => 'center',
                        'gap'             => '6px',
                        'padding'         => '8px 14px',
                        'border-radius'   => '6px',
                        'background'      => 'rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.12)',
                        'border'          => '1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.35)',
                        'color'           => '#45f3ff',
                        'font-weight'     => '700',
                        'font-size'       => '13px',
                        'text-decoration' => 'none',
                    ],
                    'content'  => '🎓 ' . htmlspecialchars($dashboardText),
                    'children' => [],
                ],
                [
                    'type'     => 'a',
                    'tag'      => 'a',
                    'attrs'    => ['href' => $logoutUrl],
                    'styles'   => [
                        'display'         => 'inline-flex',
                        'align-items'     => 'center',
                        'padding'         => '8px 12px',
                        'border-radius'   => '6px',
                        'background'      => 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                        'border'          => '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                        'color'           => '#cbd5e1',
                        'font-weight'     => '600',
                        'font-size'       => '13px',
                        'text-decoration' => 'none',
                    ],
                    'content'  => htmlspecialchars($logoutText),
                    'children' => [],
                ],
            ];
            return $dto;
        }

        $dto['tag'] = 'div';
        $dto['type'] = 'div';
        $dto['styles']['display'] = 'inline-flex';
        $dto['styles']['align-items'] = 'center';
        $dto['styles']['gap'] = '10px';
        $dto['children'] = [
            [
                'type'     => 'a',
                'tag'      => 'a',
                'attrs'    => ['href' => $loginUrl],
                'styles'   => [
                    'display'         => 'inline-flex',
                    'align-items'     => 'center',
                    'gap'             => '6px',
                    'padding'         => '8px 14px',
                    'border-radius'   => '6px',
                    'background'      => 'transparent',
                    'border'          => '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
                    'color'           => '#ffffff',
                    'font-weight'     => '600',
                    'font-size'       => '13px',
                    'text-decoration' => 'none',
                ],
                'content'  => '🔑 ' . htmlspecialchars($loginText),
                'children' => [],
            ],
            [
                'type'     => 'a',
                'tag'      => 'a',
                'attrs'    => ['href' => $registerUrl],
                'styles'   => [
                    'display'         => 'inline-flex',
                    'align-items'     => 'center',
                    'gap'             => '6px',
                    'padding'         => '8px 16px',
                    'border-radius'   => '6px',
                    'background'      => '#00d284',
                    'border'          => '1px solid #00d284',
                    'color'           => '#0b0c10',
                    'font-weight'     => '700',
                    'font-size'       => '13px',
                    'text-decoration' => 'none',
                    'box-shadow'      => '0 2px 10px rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.25)',
                ],
                'content'  => '✨ ' . htmlspecialchars($registerText),
                'children' => [],
            ],
        ];

        return $dto;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/assets/js/core/BreakpointManager.js
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * BreakpointManager — Fonte única de verdade sobre qual breakpoint está
 * sendo editado no momento. Centraliza a lógica para evitar que ela fique
 * espalhada entre Editor, CanvasRenderer e InspectorPanel (SRP).
 */
BuilderFlex.BreakpointManager = class BreakpointManager {
    constructor(bus) {
        this.bus = bus;
        this.current = 'base';
        this.widths = { base: '100%', tablet: '768px', mobile: '375px' };
    }

    set(breakpoint) {
        if (!['base', 'tablet', 'mobile'].includes(breakpoint)) {
            console.warn(`Breakpoint inválido: ${breakpoint}`);
            return;
        }
        if (this.current === breakpoint) return;
        this.current = breakpoint;
        this.bus.emit('breakpoint:changed', breakpoint);
    }

    get() { return this.current; }

    getWidth() { return this.widths[this.current]; }

    isMobile() { return this.current === 'mobile'; }
    isTablet() { return this.current === 'tablet'; }
    isDesktop() { return this.current === 'base'; }
};


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/assets/js/core/Editor.js
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * Editor - raiz de composição (Composition Root) do BuilderFlex.
 */
BuilderFlex.Editor = class Editor {
    constructor(dom) {
        this.dom = dom;
        this.bus = new BuilderFlex.EventBus();
        this.state = new BuilderFlex.EditorState();
        this.breakpoints = new BuilderFlex.BreakpointManager(this.bus);

        this.canvas = new BuilderFlex.CanvasRenderer(dom.canvasRoot, this.state, this.breakpoints);
        this.palette = new BuilderFlex.PalettePanel(dom.paletteList);
        this.inspector = new BuilderFlex.InspectorPanel(dom.inspectorBody, this.state, this.breakpoints);
        this.drag = new BuilderFlex.DragController(this.state, this.bus, dom.dragOverlay);
        this.resize = new BuilderFlex.ResizeController(this.state, this.bus, dom.dragOverlay);
        this.exportModal = new BuilderFlex.ExportModal(dom.exportModal, dom.exportOutput);
        this.contextMenu = new BuilderFlex.ContextMenu(dom.contextMenu, this.bus, this.state);
        this.paragraphEditor = new BuilderFlex.ParagraphEditor(this.bus, this.state, dom.canvasRoot);
        
        // Novo Layer Navigator
        this.layers = new BuilderFlex.LayerNavigator(dom.layerList, this.state, this.bus);
        
    }

    start() {
        window.BuilderFlex._editingMode = true;
        this.subscribe();
        this.palette.render();
        this.canvas.render();
        this.inspector.render(null);
        this.bindDom();
    }

    subscribe() {
        this.bus
            .on('tree:changed', () => {
                this.canvas.render();
                this.layers.render();
            })
            .on('selection:changed', () => {
                this.inspector.render(this.state.activeNode);
                this.canvas.highlight();
                this.layers.highlight();
            })
            .on('node:moved', node => {
                this.canvas.moveElement(node);
                this.inspector.syncField('left', node.props.left);
                this.inspector.syncField('top', node.props.top);
            })
            .on('breakpoint:changed', () => {
                this.canvas.render();
                this.inspector.render(this.state.activeNode);
            });
    }

    findParent(tree, childId) {
        for (const node of tree) {
            if (node.children && node.children.some(c => c.id === childId)) return node;
            const found = this.findParent(node.children || [], childId);
            if (found) return found;
        }
        return null;
    }

    addWidget(type) {
        const widget = BuilderFlex.WidgetRegistry.createInstance(type);
        this.state.tree.push(widget);
        this.state.activeNode = widget;
        this.bus.emit('tree:changed');
        this.bus.emit('selection:changed');
        return widget;
    }

    select(node) {
        this.state.activeNode = node;
        this.bus.emit('selection:changed');
    }

    deleteActive() {
        const node = this.state.activeNode;
        if (!node) return;
        BuilderFlex.NodeTree.remove(this.state.tree, node.id);
        this.state.activeNode = null;
        this.bus.emit('tree:changed');
        this.bus.emit('selection:changed');
    }

    updateProp(rawKey, rawValue) {
        const node = this.state.activeNode;
        if (!node) return;

        const bp = this.breakpoints.get();
        let value = rawValue;

        if (rawKey.startsWith('attrs.')) {
            const attrKey = rawKey.split('.')[1];
            node.props.attrs = node.props.attrs || {};
            node.props.attrs[attrKey] = value;
            this.bus.emit('tree:changed');
            return;
        }

        if (typeof node.props[rawKey] === 'number') {
            value = parseFloat(rawValue);
            if (Number.isNaN(value)) value = 0;
        }

        if (rawKey === 'columnsDesktop' || rawKey === 'columnsTablet' || rawKey === 'columnsMobile') {
            node.setColumns(parseInt(value), bp);
        } else {
            node.setProp(rawKey, value, bp);
        }

        this.bus.emit('tree:changed');
    }

    clear() {
        if (!confirm('Tem certeza? Todo o form será apagado.')) return;
        this.state.tree = [];
        this.state.activeNode = null;
        this.bus.emit('tree:changed');
        this.bus.emit('selection:changed');
    }

    exportJson() {
        this.exportModal.open(BuilderFlex.JsonExporter.serialize(this.state.tree));
    }

    bindDom() {
        const { canvasRoot, paletteList, layerList, inspectorBody, dragOverlay } = this.dom;

        // Abas da Paleta
        const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.palette-tabs .btn-tab');
        tabs.forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
                tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                ev.target.classList.add('active');

                const targetId = ev.target.dataset.target;
                if (paletteList) paletteList.hidden = (targetId !== 'palette-list');
                if (layerList) layerList.hidden = (targetId !== 'layer-list');
            });
        });

        paletteList.addEventListener('mousedown', ev => {
            const item = ev.target.closest('[data-palette-type]');
            if (!item) return;
            ev.preventDefault();
            this.drag.begin(this.addWidget(item.dataset.paletteType), ev);
        });

        canvasRoot.addEventListener('mousedown', ev => {
            if (ev.button === 2) return;

            const resizeHandle = ev.target.closest('.resize-handle');
            if (resizeHandle && this.state.activeNode) {
                ev.preventDefault();
                ev.stopPropagation();
                this.resize.begin(this.state.activeNode, resizeHandle.dataset.dir, ev);
                return;
            }
            
            const el = ev.target.closest('.widget-node');
            if (!el) {
                // Clicou fora (no fundo vazio do stage) -> Limpa a seleção
                this.state.activeNode = null;
                this.bus.emit('selection:changed');
                return;
            }
            
            const node = BuilderFlex.NodeTree.find(this.state.tree, el.dataset.nodeId);
            if (!node) return;
            
            this.select(node);

            // Se for editável, NÃO inicia o arraste e não previne default (para o cursor focar)
            if (ev.target.closest('.paragraph-content') || ev.target.closest('.paragraph-toolbar')) {
                return; 
            }

            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            this.drag.begin(node, ev);
        });

        canvasRoot.addEventListener('contextmenu', ev => {
            const el = ev.target.closest('.widget-node');
            if (!el) return;
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            const node = BuilderFlex.NodeTree.find(this.state.tree, el.dataset.nodeId);
            if (!node) return;
            this.select(node);
            this.contextMenu.open(ev, node);
        });

        dragOverlay.addEventListener('mousemove', ev => {
            this.drag.move(ev);
            this.resize.move(ev);
        });
        dragOverlay.addEventListener('mouseup', ev => {
            this.drag.end(ev);
            this.resize.end(ev);
        });

        inspectorBody.addEventListener('input', ev => {
            // Se for o color picker mudando
            if (ev.target.matches('.prop-color-picker')) {
                const key = ev.target.dataset.sync;
                const textInput = inspectorBody.querySelector(`[data-prop="${key}"]`);
                if (textInput) {
                    textInput.value = ev.target.value;
                    this.updateProp(key, ev.target.value);
                }
                return;
            }

            // Se for o campo de texto normal (ou select, ou checkbox)
            const key = ev.target.dataset.prop;
            if (key) {
                const value = ev.target.type === 'checkbox' ? ev.target.checked : ev.target.value;
                this.updateProp(key, value);
                
                // Two-way binding visual pro color picker
                if (ev.target.matches('.prop-input')) {
                    const colorPicker = ev.target.parentElement.querySelector('.prop-color-picker');
                    if (colorPicker && ev.target.value.startsWith('#') && ev.target.value.length === 7) {
                        colorPicker.value = ev.target.value;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-inspector');
        if (toggleBtn) {
            toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const panel = document.getElementById('builder-inspector');
                panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            });
        }

        const togglePaletteBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-palette');
        if (togglePaletteBtn) {
            togglePaletteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const panel = document.getElementById('builder-palette');
                panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            });
        }

        const actions = {
            'delete-node':   () => this.deleteActive(),
            'clear-canvas':  () => this.clear(),
            'export-json':   () => this.exportJson(),
            'close-export':  () => this.exportModal.close(),
            'view-desktop':  () => { this.breakpoints.set('base'); this.canvas.setViewMode('desktop'); },
            'view-mobile':   () => { this.breakpoints.set('mobile'); this.canvas.setViewMode('mobile'); },
            'switch-breakpoint': (trigger) => {
                const bp = trigger.dataset.breakpoint;
                if (bp) {
                    this.breakpoints.set(bp);
                    this.canvas.setViewMode(bp === 'base' ? 'desktop' : bp);
                }
            }
        };

        document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
            const trigger = ev.target.closest('[data-action]');
            const action = trigger && actions[trigger.dataset.action];
            if (action) action(trigger);
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', ev => {
            if (ev.key !== 'Delete' && ev.key !== 'Backspace') return;
            if (['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(document.activeElement.tagName)) return;
            this.deleteActive();
        });
    }
};


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/assets/js/core/EventBus.js
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * EventBus — Observer mínimo.
 * Desacopla os módulos: quem muda o estado apenas emite um evento,
 * quem precisa reagir (canvas, inspetor...) assina. Ninguém conhece ninguém.
 *
 * Eventos usados:
 *  - tree:changed       a árvore de componentes mudou (re-renderizar o canvas)
 *  - selection:changed  outro componente foi selecionado
 *  - node:moved         um componente foi arrastado (payload: node)
 */
BuilderFlex.EventBus = class EventBus {
    constructor() {
        this.handlers = {};
    }

    on(eventName, handler) {
        (this.handlers[eventName] = this.handlers[eventName] || []).push(handler);
        return this;
    }

    emit(eventName, payload) {
        (this.handlers[eventName] || []).forEach(handler => handler(payload));
    }
};


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/BuilderFlex/assets/js/core/IViewportResolver.js
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/**
 * IViewportResolver - Contrato de visualização
 * Uma só fonte de verdade para como os nós resolvem suas propriedades baseadas em breakpoint.
 */
BuilderFlex.IViewportResolver = class IViewportResolver {
    static getBreakpoints() {
        return [
            { id: 'base', name: 'Desktop', maxWidth: null, canvasWidth: '100%' },
            { id: 'tablet', name: 'Tablet', maxWidth: 1024, canvasWidth: '768px' },
            { id: 'mobile', name: 'Mobile', maxWidth: 767, canvasWidth: '375px' }
        ];
    }

    static getResponsiveProps() {
        return [
            'width', 'height', 'minHeight', 'padding', 'margin', 
            'gap', 'fontSize', 'textAlign', 'display', 'layout', 
            'hidden', 'order'
        ];
    }

    static resolve(node, breakpoint) {
        const result = { props: {}, layout: 'absolute', hidden: false, order: 0 };
        const bps = this.getBreakpoints();
        
        // Cascata: base -> tablet -> mobile
        const chain = ['base'];
        if (breakpoint === 'tablet') chain.push('tablet');
        if (breakpoint === 'mobile') chain.push('tablet', 'mobile');

        for (const prop of this.getResponsiveProps()) {
            let val = undefined;
            for (const bp of chain) {
                const nodeVal = node.getRawProp(prop, bp);
                if (nodeVal !== undefined && nodeVal !== null && nodeVal !== '') {
                    val = nodeVal;
                }
            }
            result.props[prop] = val;
        }

        result.layout = result.props.layout || 'absolute';
        result.hidden = result.props.hidden === true || result.props.hidden === 'true';
        result.order = parseInt(result.props.order) || 0;

        return result;
    }
};
