<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ShortcodeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\TranslatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\DesignTokensInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\MediaUploadServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartManagementServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Controller Administrativo do Flex Builder (Motor em Blocos & Design Tokens).
 *
 * Responsável apenas pela coordenação HTTP, delegando descoberta de temas,
 * persistência/atribuição e compilação de preview para serviços injetados via contratos (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 */
class ThemePartsAdminController
{
    private ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo;
    private ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc;
    private DesignTokensInterface $tokens;
    private BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry;
    private LayoutGridInterface $layoutGrid;
    private ThemePartRendererInterface $renderer;
    private ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ShortcodeManagerInterface $shortcodeManager;
    private ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider;
    private ?SessionManagerInterface $session;
    private string $basePath;
    private ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery;
    private MediaUploadServiceInterface $mediaUpload;
    private ?TranslatorInterface $translator;
    private ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer;
    private ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface $previewService;
    private ThemePartManagementServiceInterface $managementService;
    private PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver;

    public function __construct(
        ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo,
        ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc,
        DesignTokensInterface $tokens,
        BlockRegistryInterface $blockRegistry,
        LayoutGridInterface $layoutGrid,
        ThemePartRendererInterface $renderer,
        ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager,
        ShortcodeManagerInterface $shortcodeManager,
        ?MenuProviderInterface $menuProvider,
        ?SessionManagerInterface $session,
        string $basePath,
        ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery,
        MediaUploadServiceInterface $mediaUpload,
        ?TranslatorInterface $translator,
        ?ElementStyleRendererInterface $styleRenderer,
        ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface $previewService,
        ThemePartManagementServiceInterface $managementService,
        PublicUrlResolverInterface $urlResolver
    ) {
        $this->partRepo          = $partRepo;
        $this->partAssoc         = $partAssoc;
        $this->tokens            = $tokens;
        $this->blockRegistry     = $blockRegistry;
        $this->layoutGrid        = $layoutGrid;
        $this->renderer          = $renderer;
        $this->themeManager      = $themeManager;
        $this->shortcodeManager  = $shortcodeManager;
        $this->menuProvider      = $menuProvider;
        $this->session           = $session;
        $this->basePath          = $basePath;
        $this->themeDiscovery    = $themeDiscovery;
        $this->mediaUpload       = $mediaUpload;
        $this->translator        = $translator;
        $this->styleRenderer     = $styleRenderer;
        $this->previewService    = $previewService;
        $this->managementService = $managementService;
        $this->urlResolver       = $urlResolver;
    }

    /**
     * Lista todas as partes (Headers, Footers, Seções) e a matriz de associação de temas.
     */
    public function index(Request $request): ViewResponse
    {
        $allParts = $this->partRepo->all();

        $headers = [];
        $footers = [];
        $sections = [];

        foreach ($allParts as $part) {
            match ($part->getType()) {
                ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER  => $headers[] = $part,
                ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER  => $footers[] = $part,
                ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION => $sections[] = $part,
                default => null,
            };
        }

        $themes = $this->getAvailableThemes();
        $activeTheme = $this->getActiveThemeFolder();
        $allAssignments = $this->partAssoc->getAllAssignments();
        $assignments = $allAssignments['themes'] ?? $allAssignments;
        $globalHeader = $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        $globalFooter = $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER);

        return $this->renderView('admin/parts_list', [
            'headers'        => $headers,
            'footers'        => $footers,
            'sections'       => $sections,
            'themes'         => $themes,
            'activeTheme'    => $activeTheme,
            'assignments'    => $assignments,
            'allAssignments' => $allAssignments,
            'globalHeader'   => $globalHeader,
            'globalFooter'   => $globalFooter,
            'templates'      => $this->getThemeTemplates($activeTheme),
            'baseUrl'        => $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl(),
            'session'        => $this->session,
            'csrfToken'      => $this->getCsrfToken(),
        ], true);
    }

    /**
     * Inicia a criação de uma nova parte (Header, Footer ou Seção).
     */
    public function create(Request $request): ViewResponse
    {
        $type = (string)$request->input('type', ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        $newPart = $this->managementService->createDefaultPart($type);

        return $this->renderEditorView($newPart, true);
    }

    /**
     * Abre o construtor visual para editar uma parte existente.
     */
    public function edit(Request $request): ViewResponse|Response
    {
        $id = (string)$request->input('id', '');
        if ($id === '') {
            return Response::redirect($this->urlResolver->resolve('/admin/builder'));
        }

        $part = $this->partRepo->findById($id);
        if ($part === null) {
            if ($this->session) {
                $this->session->setFlash('error', 'Parte visual não encontrada.');
            }
            return Response::redirect($this->urlResolver->resolve('/admin/builder'));
        }

        return $this->renderEditorView($part, false);
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX / POST: Salva ou atualiza uma ThemePart.
     */
    public function savePart(Request $request): Response
    {
        try {
            $input = $this->extractInput($request);
            $part = $this->managementService->saveFromPayload($input);

            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => true,
                'id'      => $part->getId(),
                'title'   => $part->getTitle(),
                'message' => 'Parte "' . $part->getTitle() . '" salva com sucesso no Flex Builder!',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Erro de validação: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 422, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Erro ao salvar parte: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if (!class_exists(\PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase::class, false)) {
                error_log('[FlexBuilder][savePart] ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Erro interno ao processar o salvamento da parte visual.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 500, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX / POST: Exclui uma parte pelo ID.
     */
    public function deletePart(Request $request): Response
    {
        $input = $this->extractInput($request);
        $id = trim((string)($input['id'] ?? ''));

        if ($id === '') {
            return new Response(json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID inválido.'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        $deleted = $this->managementService->deletePart($id);

        if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => $deleted,
                'message' => $deleted ? 'Parte excluída com sucesso.' : 'Falha ao excluir parte.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        if ($this->session) {
            $this->session->setFlash($deleted ? 'success' : 'error', $deleted ? 'Parte excluída com sucesso.' : 'Falha ao excluir parte.');
        }

        return Response::redirect($this->urlResolver->resolve('/admin/builder'));
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX / POST: Define atribuição de uma parte a um tema, padrão global ou template.
     */
    public function assign(Request $request): Response
    {
        $input = $this->extractInput($request);
        $assigned = $this->managementService->assignFromPayload($input);

        if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => $assigned,
                'message' => $assigned ? 'Atribuição atualizada com sucesso!' : 'Falha ao atualizar atribuição.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), $assigned ? 200 : 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        if ($this->session) {
            $this->session->setFlash($assigned ? 'success' : 'error', $assigned ? 'Atribuição atualizada com sucesso!' : 'Falha ao atualizar atribuição.');
        }

        return Response::redirect($this->urlResolver->resolve('/admin/builder'));
    }

    /**
     * Interface de Edição de Design Tokens (Paleta de Cores e Tipografia).
     */
    public function tokens(Request $request): ViewResponse
    {
        return $this->renderView('admin/tokens_editor', [
            'palette'    => $this->tokens->getColorPalette(),
            'typography' => $this->tokens->getTypography(),
            'cssVars'    => $this->tokens->generateCssVariables(),
            'baseUrl'    => $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl(),
            'session'    => $this->session,
            'csrfToken'  => $this->getCsrfToken(),
        ], true);
    }

    /**
     * Salva as alterações nos Design Tokens globais.
     */
    public function saveTokens(Request $request): Response
    {
        $input = $this->extractInput($request);

        $colors = (array)($input['palette'] ?? ($input['colors'] ?? []));
        $typography = (array)($input['typography'] ?? []);

        $success = $this->tokens->updateTokens([
            'palette'    => $colors,
            'typography' => $typography,
        ]);

        if ($this->isAjax($request)) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => $success,
                'message' => $success ? 'Design Tokens atualizados com sucesso!' : 'Erro ao atualizar tokens.',
                'css'     => $this->tokens->generateCssVariables(),
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        if ($this->session) {
            $this->session->setFlash($success ? 'success' : 'error', $success ? 'Design Tokens atualizados com sucesso!' : 'Erro ao atualizar tokens.');
        }

        return Response::redirect($this->urlResolver->resolve('/admin/builder/tokens'));
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX: Renderiza pré-visualização ao vivo da parte visual via ThemePartPreviewService.
     */
    public function preview(Request $request): Response
    {
        try {
            $input = $this->extractInput($request);
            $html = $this->previewService->renderPreview($input);

            return new Response($html, 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8']);
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return new Response(
                '<div style="padding:20px; color:#f87171; background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border-radius:6px;">Dados de pré-visualização inválidos.</div>',
                422,
                ['Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8']
            );
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            if (!class_exists(\PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase::class, false)) {
                error_log('[FlexBuilder][preview] ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
            return new Response(
                '<div style="padding:20px; color:#f87171; background:rgba(239,68,68,0.1); border-radius:6px;">Não foi possível gerar a pré-visualização.</div>',
                500,
                ['Content-Type' => 'text/html; charset=utf-8']
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX: Upload seguro de imagens para logos e blocos de imagem.
     */
    public function uploadImage(Request $request): Response
    {
        $file = $request->file('image') ?? ($request->file('file') ?? null);
        if (!$file) {
            return new Response(json_encode([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Nenhum arquivo enviado ou erro no upload.',
            ], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 400, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
        }

        $result = $this->mediaUpload->upload($file);
        $status = $result['success'] ? 200 : 400;

        return new Response(json_encode($result, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), $status, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
    }

    /**
     * API AJAX: Schema completo dos blocos, presets, shortcodes do sistema e menus.
     */
    public function schema(Request $request): Response
    {
        $partType = (string)($request->input('part_type') ?? '');
        $blocks = $partType !== '' ? $this->blockRegistry->allForPartType($partType) : $this->blockRegistry->all();

        $blocksData = [];
        foreach ($blocks as $block) {
            $blocksData[$block->getType()] = [
                'type'               => $block->getType(),
                'name'               => $block->getName(),
                'icon'               => $block->getIcon(),
                'category'           => $block->getCategory(),
                'schema'             => $block->getSchema(),
                'allowed_part_types' => $block->getAllowedPartTypes(),
            ];
        }

        $shortcodes = [];
        foreach ($this->shortcodeManager->getRegisteredShortcodes() as $tag => $info) {
            $shortcodes[] = [
                'tag'         => '[' . $tag . ']',
                'description' => $info['description'] ?? '',
                'category'    => $info['category'] ?? 'Geral',
            ];
        }

        $menus = [];
        if ($this->menuProvider !== null && method_exists($this->menuProvider, 'getMenus')) {
            $menus = $this->menuProvider->getMenus();
        }

        return new Response(json_encode([
            'blocks'        => $blocksData,
            'presets'       => $this->layoutGrid->getPresets(),
            'shortcodes'    => $shortcodes,
            'menus'         => $menus,
            'toggle_styles' => [
                MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC => 'Clássico ☰ (3 Barras)',
                MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL    => 'Pílula MENU ☰ (Texto + Ícone)',
                MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL => 'Minimalista ✕ (2 Barras Modernas)',
                MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_DOTS    => 'Pontos ⋮ (3 Pontinhos Verticais)',
            ],
            'tokens'        => [
                'palette'    => $this->tokens->getColorPalette(),
                'typography' => $this->tokens->getTypography(),
            ],
            'locale'        => $this->translator !== null ? $this->translator->getLocale() : 'pt_BR',
            'i18n'          => $this->translator !== null ? $this->translator->getCatalog() : [],
        ], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE), 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
    }

    /**
     * Helper para carregar a tela do Studio do Construtor Visual.
     */
    private function renderEditorView(ThemePartInterface $part, bool $isNew): ViewResponse
    {
        $presets = $this->layoutGrid->getPresets();
        $blocks = $this->blockRegistry->all();
        $shortcodes = $this->shortcodeManager->getRegisteredShortcodes();
        $menus = ($this->menuProvider && method_exists($this->menuProvider, 'getMenus')) ? $this->menuProvider->getMenus() : [];
        $tokens = [
            'palette'    => $this->tokens->getColorPalette(),
            'typography' => $this->tokens->getTypography(),
        ];
        $themes = $this->getAvailableThemes();
        $activeTheme = $this->getActiveThemeFolder();

        return $this->renderView('admin/builder_editor', [
            'part'             => $part,
            'isNew'            => $isNew,
            'presets'          => $presets,
            'blocks'           => $blocks,
            'shortcodes'       => $shortcodes,
            'menus'            => $menus,
            'tokens'           => $tokens,
            'themes'           => $themes,
            'activeTheme'      => $activeTheme,
            'templates'        => $this->getThemeTemplates($activeTheme),
            'assignedTemplate' => ($part->getType() === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION) ? $this->getAssignedTemplateForSection($activeTheme, $part->getId()) : '',
            'baseUrl'          => $this->urlResolver->getBaseUrl(),
            'session'          => $this->session,
            'csrfToken'        => $this->getCsrfToken(),
            'locale'           => $this->translator !== null ? $this->translator->getLocale() : 'pt_BR',
            'i18n'             => $this->translator !== null ? $this->translator->getCatalog() : [],
        ], false);
    }

    private function getCsrfToken(): string
    {
        return $this->session !== null ? $this->session->getCsrfToken() : '';
    }

    private function renderView(string $viewName, array $data = [], bool $wrapLayout = true): ViewResponse
    {
        $viewFile = dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . ltrim($viewName, '/\\') . '.php';
        if (!is_file($viewFile)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("View não encontrada: {$viewFile}");
        }

        $isolatedInclude = static function (string $__file, array $__ctx): string {
            ob_start();
            try {
                extract($__ctx, EXTR_SKIP);
                include $__file;
                return (string)ob_get_clean();
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
                    ob_end_clean();
                }
                throw $e;
            }
        };

        $html = $isolatedInclude($viewFile, $data);

        return new ViewResponse($html, $wrapLayout);
    }

    /**
     * Extrai dados enviados via objeto Request (JSON ou form POST) sem depender de leitura direta de php://input quando Request já foi populado.
     */
    private function extractInput(Request $request): array
    {
        if (method_exists($request, 'json')) {
            $jsonBody = $request->json();
            if (!empty($jsonBody)) {
                return $jsonBody;
            }
        }

        $all = $request->all();
        if (!empty($all)) {
            return $all;
        }

        $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
        if (!empty($raw)) {
            $json = json_decode($raw, true);
            if (is_array($json)) {
                return $json;
            }
        }

        return [];
    }

    private function isAjax(Request $request): bool
    {
        $accept = (string)($request->server['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '');
        $xrw = (string)($request->server['HTTP_X_REQUESTED_WITH'] ?? '');
        $ct = (string)($request->server['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '');

        return str_contains($accept, 'application/json')
            || strtolower($xrw) === 'xmlhttprequest'
            || str_contains($ct, 'application/json');
    }

    /**
     * Descobre os temas instalados no sistema via ThemeDiscoveryService.
     * @return array<int, array<string, string>>
     */
    public function getAvailableThemes(): array
    {
        return $this->themeDiscovery->getAvailableThemes();
    }

    public function getActiveThemeFolder(): string
    {
        return $this->themeDiscovery->getActiveThemeFolder();
    }

    public function getAssignedTemplateForSection(string $themeFolder, string $sectionId): string
    {
        return $this->partAssoc->getAssignedTemplateForSection($themeFolder, $sectionId) ?? '';
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getThemeTemplates(string $themeFolder): array
    {
        return $this->themeDiscovery->getThemeTemplates($themeFolder);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemeController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemePartsAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\BuilderFlexBootstrapper;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

/**
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PLUGIN: FlexTheme (O Hub Visual do Domain System OS)
 * ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 */
class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    //  FASE 1: NEGOCIAÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->requireLink('core.theme_parts');
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    //  FASE 2: EXECUÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        //  MOTOR DE TEMAS (Renderização Frontend)
        // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            // Rotas de renderização do tema
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/', [ThemeController::class, 'renderHome']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/docs/{*slug}', [ThemeController::class, 'renderDoc']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/docs', function() {
                $base = defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
                return Response::redirect("$base/docs/index");
            });

            // Rotas do Novo Flex Builder (Motor Visual em Blocos FSE & Contratos SOLID)
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'index'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder/create', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'create'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder/edit', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'edit'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/save-part', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'savePart'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/delete-part', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'deletePart'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/assign', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'assign'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder/tokens', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'tokens'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/tokens/save', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'saveTokens'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/preview', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'preview'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/upload-image', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'uploadImage'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder/schema', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'schema'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);

            // Aliases de compatibilidade e navegação
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/builder/save', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'savePart'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/builder/api/schema', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'schema'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/themes/parts', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'index'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/themes/tokens', [ThemePartsAdminController::class, 'tokens'], 'flextheme', ['admin']);
        });

        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $sm) use ($runtime) {
            $sm->add('base_url', function() {
                return defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
            }, 'Retorna a URL base do site (ex: /domain-system/public)');

            $sm->add('theme_header', function($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    $renderer = $runtime->getLink('core.theme_parts');
                    $theme = $attrs['theme'] ?? 'default';
                    return $renderer->renderHeader($theme);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    return '';
                }
            }, 'Renderiza o Header ativo do Flex Builder (suporta atributo theme)');

            $sm->add('theme_footer', function($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                try {
                    $renderer = $runtime->getLink('core.theme_parts');
                    $theme = $attrs['theme'] ?? 'default';
                    return $renderer->renderFooter($theme);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    return '';
                }
            }, 'Renderiza o Rodapé ativo do Flex Builder (suporta atributo theme)');

            $sm->add('section', function($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                $id = $attrs['id'] ?? '';
                if ($id !== '') {
                    try {
                        $renderer = $runtime->getLink('core.theme_parts');
                        return $renderer->renderSection($id);
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                        return '';
                    }
                }
                return '';
            }, 'Renderiza uma Seção específica do Flex Builder pelo ID: [section id="..."]');

            $sm->add('theme_part', function($attrs = []) use ($runtime) {
                $id = $attrs['id'] ?? '';
                if ($id !== '') {
                    try {
                        $renderer = $runtime->getLink('core.theme_parts');
                        return $renderer->renderSection($id);
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                        return '';
                    }
                }
                return '';
            }, 'Renderiza uma parte específica (Header, Footer ou Seção) pelo ID: [theme_part id="..."]');
        });

        // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        //  BUILDER FLEX (Subplugin — Bootstrapper Dedicado SRP)
        // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        (new BuilderFlexBootstrapper())->boot($runtime);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageTreeRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ShortcodeManagerInterface;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\BlockRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\DesignTokensInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ElementStyleRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\HtmlSanitizerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayoutGridInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\PublicUrlResolverInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartCompilerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartValidatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Validation\ThemePartValidator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\DtoRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Contracts\WidgetManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\ContainerWidget;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\DtoRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Core\JsonRenderer;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Widgets\TextWidget;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\BuilderFlex\Widgets\UserAuthWidget;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\MediaUploadServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartManagementServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemeController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Controllers\ThemePartsAdminController;

/**
 * Bootstrapper dedicado do subsistema Builder Flex (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 *
 * Isola o registro de singletons, provedores, widgets e menus administrativos
 * do arquivo principal Plugin.php.
 */
class BuilderFlexBootstrapper
{
    public function boot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $basePath = defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4);

        // 1. Serviços de infraestrutura e aplicação do FlexTheme / Flex Builder
        $runtime->singleton(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class, fn() => new ThemeDiscoveryService($basePath));
        $runtime->singleton(MediaUploadServiceInterface::class, fn() => new MediaUploadService($basePath));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePathResolverInterface::class, fn() => new SafeThemeResolver([
            $basePath . '/themes',
            dirname(__DIR__) . '/themes',
        ]));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartCompilerInterface::class, fn($c) => $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class));

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartValidatorInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartValidator(
                $c->make(BlockRegistryInterface::class),
                $c->make(LayoutGridInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartPreviewService(
                $c->make(ThemePartCompilerInterface::class)
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new ThemePartManagementService(
                $c->make(ThemePartRepositoryInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartAssociationInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartValidatorInterface::class)
            );
        });
        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartManagementService::class, fn($c) => $c->make(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class));

        // 2. Motor de Widgets do BuilderFlex (Subplugin)
        $runtime->singleton(DtoRendererInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new DtoRenderer(
                $c->has(HtmlSanitizerInterface::class) ? $c->make(HtmlSanitizerInterface::class) : null,
                $c->has(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) ? $c->make(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) : null
            );
        });
        $runtime->singleton(DtoRenderer::class, fn($c) => $c->make(DtoRendererInterface::class));

        $runtime->singleton(WidgetManagerInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return new WidgetManager($c->make(DtoRendererInterface::class));
        });

        $runtime->singleton(JsonRenderer::class, function ($c) {
            return new JsonRenderer(
                $c->make(WidgetManagerInterface::class),
                $c->make(DtoRendererInterface::class)
            );
        });
        $runtime->singleton(PageTreeRendererInterface::class, function ($c) {
            return $c->make(JsonRenderer::class);
        });

        // 3. Controllers do FlexTheme / Flex Builder com todas as dependências injetadas via Container
        $runtime->singleton(ThemeController::class, function ($c) use ($basePath) {
            $siteState = $c->has(SiteStateInterface::class) ? $c->make(SiteStateInterface::class) : new EnvSiteState();
            $partRenderer = $c->has(ThemePartRendererInterface::class) ? $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class) : null;
            $shortcodes = $c->has(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                ? $c->make(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                : ($c->has(ShortcodeManager::class) ? $c->make(ShortcodeManager::class) : null);
            $urlResolver = $c->has(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class) ? $c->make(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class) : new BaseUrlResolver();
            $themeResolver = $c->make(ThemePathResolverInterface::class);

            return new ThemeController(
                $siteState,
                $partRenderer,
                $shortcodes,
                $urlResolver,
                $themeResolver,
                $basePath
            );
        });

        $runtime->singleton(ThemePartsAdminController::class, function ($c) use ($basePath) {
            $shortcodes = $c->has(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                ? $c->make(ShortcodeManagerInterface::class)
                : $c->make(ShortcodeManager::class);
            $urlResolver = $c->has(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class)
                ? $c->make(PublicUrlResolverInterface::class)
                : new BaseUrlResolver();

            return new ThemePartsAdminController(
                $c->make(ThemePartRepositoryInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartAssociationInterface::class),
                $c->make(DesignTokensInterface::class),
                $c->make(BlockRegistryInterface::class),
                $c->make(LayoutGridInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartRendererInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemeManagerInterface::class),
                $shortcodes,
                $c->has(MenuProviderInterface::class) ? $c->make(MenuProviderInterface::class) : null,
                $c->has(SessionManagerInterface::class) ? $c->make(SessionManagerInterface::class) : null,
                $basePath,
                $c->make(ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(MediaUploadServiceInterface::class),
                $c->has(TranslatorInterface::class) ? $c->make(TranslatorInterface::class) : null,
                $c->has(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) ? $c->make(ElementStyleRendererInterface::class) : null,
                $c->make(ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface::class),
                $c->make(ThemePartManagementServiceInterface::class),
                $urlResolver
            );
        });

        // 4. Registra os widgets nativos
        /** @var WidgetManagerInterface $manager */
        $manager = $runtime->make(WidgetManagerInterface::class);
        $manager->registerWidget(new ContainerWidget());
        $manager->registerWidget(new TextWidget());
        $manager->registerWidget(new LogoWidget());
        $manager->registerWidget(new UserAuthWidget());

        // 5. Integra com o motor de Shortcodes
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function (ShortcodeManager $sm) use ($manager) {
            $manager->bootShortcodes($sm);
        });

        // 6. Adiciona o submenu do Flex Builder e Design Tokens dentro do menu "Temas"
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function ($menus, $role) {
            if (in_array($role, ['admin', 'manager'])) {
                $inserted = false;

                foreach ($menus as &$menu) {
                    if (isset($menu['title']) && $menu['title'] === 'Temas') {
                        if (!isset($menu['submenu'])) {
                            $menu['submenu'] = [];
                        }
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Flex Builder',
                            'url'   => '/admin/builder',
                        ];
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Design Tokens',
                            'url'   => '/admin/builder/tokens',
                        ];
                        $inserted = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!$inserted) {
                    $menus[] = [
                        'title' => 'Flex Builder',
                        'url'   => '/admin/builder',
                        'icon'  => '🏗️'
                    ];
                    $menus[] = [
                        'title' => 'Design Tokens',
                        'url'   => '/admin/builder/tokens',
                        'icon'  => '🎨'
                    ];
                }
            }
            return $menus;
        });
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/Services/MediaUploadService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\MediaUploadServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço responsável pelo upload seguro de imagens para o Flex Builder.
 *
 * Aplica validação de tamanho máximo, whitelist estrita de extensões e tipos MIME,
 * sanitização de nomes com entropia criptográfica e isolamento no sistema de arquivos.
 */
class MediaUploadService implements MediaUploadServiceInterface
{
    public const DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE = 52428800; // 50MB em bytes

    public const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [
        'png',
        'jpg',
        'jpeg',
        'webp',
        'svg',
        'gif',
        'mp4',
        'webm',
        'ogg',
        'mov',
    ];

    public const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = [
        'image/png',
        'image/jpeg',
        'image/webp',
        'image/svg+xml',
        'image/gif',
        'video/mp4',
        'video/webm',
        'video/ogg',
        'video/quicktime',
    ];

    private string $uploadDir;
    private string $baseUrl;
    private int $maxBytes;

    public function __construct(
        ?string $basePath = null,
        ?string $baseUrl = null,
        int $maxBytes = self::DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE
    ) {
        $root = rtrim($basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4)), '/\\');
        $this->uploadDir = $root . '/public/uploads/builder';
        $this->baseUrl   = rtrim($baseUrl ?? (defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : ''), '/\\');
        $this->maxBytes  = $maxBytes;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $file
     * @return array{success: bool, url?: string, filename?: string, message: string}
     */
    public function upload(array $file): array
    {
        $error = $file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE;
        if ($error !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK || empty($file['tmp_name'])) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Nenhum arquivo enviado ou erro durante o envio.',
            ];
        }

        $tmpName = (string)$file['tmp_name'];
        if (!file_exists($tmpName) || !is_readable($tmpName)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Arquivo temporário indisponível ou ilegível.',
            ];
        }

        $size = (int)($file['size'] ?? filesize($tmpName));
        if ($size <= 0 || $size > $this->maxBytes) {
            $maxMb = round($this->maxBytes / (1024 * 1024), 1);
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "O arquivo excede o limite máximo permitido de {$maxMb}MB.",
            ];
        }

        $origName = (string)($file['name'] ?? 'upload');
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($origName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));

        if (!in_array($ext, self::ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS, true)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Extensão não permitida. Envie PNG, SVG, JPG, WEBP, GIF ou vídeos MP4, WEBM, OGG, MOV.',
            ];
        }

        // Validação estrita por detecção de MIME real via finfo
        if (function_exists('finfo_open')) {
            $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
            if ($finfo !== false) {
                $mime = finfo_file($finfo, $tmpName);
                finfo_close($finfo);

                if (is_string($mime) && !in_array($mime, self::ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES, true)) {
                    // Tolerância específica para arquivos SVG puros que podem ser reportados como text/plain ou text/xml
                    if ($ext === 'svg' && (str_contains($mime, 'xml') || str_contains($mime, 'text'))) {
                        // Válido
                    } else {
                        return [
                            'success' => false,
                            'message' => "Tipo de arquivo inválido ($mime).",
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (!is_dir($this->uploadDir)) {
            @mkdir($this->uploadDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $safeName = 'media_' . time() . '_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(8)) . '.' . $ext;
        $destPath = $this->uploadDir . '/' . $safeName;

        // Sanitização estrita de arquivos SVG contra Stored XSS (<script>, <foreignObject>, on* handlers, javascript:)
        if ($ext === 'svg') {
            $rawSvg = @file_get_contents($tmpName);
            if ($rawSvg === false || stripos($rawSvg, '<svg') === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Arquivo SVG inválido ou malformado.',
                ];
            }

            $sanitizedSvg = $this->sanitizeSvgContent($rawSvg);
            if (stripos($sanitizedSvg, '<svg') === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Arquivo SVG bloqueado por conter conteúdo inseguro.',
                ];
            }

            if (@file_put_contents($destPath, $sanitizedSvg, LOCK_EX) === false) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Falha ao salvar o arquivo SVG sanitizado no diretório de destino.',
                ];
            }
        } else {
            // Suporte tanto a uploads normais via HTTP (is_uploaded_file / move_uploaded_file)
            // quanto testes unitários (copy)
            $moved = false;
            if (is_uploaded_file($tmpName)) {
                $moved = @move_uploaded_file($tmpName, $destPath);
            }
            if (!$moved) {
                $moved = @copy($tmpName, $destPath);
            }

            if (!$moved) {
                return [
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Falha ao salvar o arquivo no diretório de destino.',
                ];
            }
        }

        $publicUrl = $this->baseUrl . '/uploads/builder/' . $safeName;

        return [
            'success'  => true,
            'url'      => $publicUrl,
            'filename' => $safeName,
            'message'  => 'Imagem enviada com sucesso!',
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Valida a árvore XML do SVG via DOMDocument e remove quaisquer elementos ou atributos fora da whitelist segura.
     */
    public function sanitizeSvgContent(string $svg): string
    {
        if (trim($svg) === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Bloqueia declarações DOCTYPE / ENTITY (prevenção contra XXE / Billion Laughs)
        if (preg_match('/<!(?:DOCTYPE|ENTITY)\b/i', $svg)) {
            return '';
        }

        // 1. Pré-limpeza de blocos perigosos antes do parser XML
        $clean = preg_replace('#<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script>#is', '', $svg) ?? $svg;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<script\b[^>]*/?>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<foreignObject\b[^>]*>.*?</foreignObject>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;
        $clean = preg_replace('#<foreignObject\b[^>]*/?>#is', '', $clean) ?? $clean;

        if (!class_exists(\DOMDocument::class)) {
            return '';
        }

        $dom = new \DOMDocument();
        $prevUseErrors = libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $loaded = $dom->loadXML($clean, LIBXML_NONET | LIBXML_NOERROR | LIBXML_NOWARNING);
        libxml_clear_errors();
        libxml_use_internal_errors($prevUseErrors);

        if (!$loaded || $dom->documentElement === null || strtolower($dom->documentElement->localName ?? $dom->documentElement->nodeName) !== 'svg') {
            return '';
        }

        $allowedTags = [
            'svg', 'g', 'a', 'image', 'path', 'rect', 'circle', 'ellipse', 'line', 'polyline', 'polygon',
            'text', 'tspan', 'defs', 'lineargradient', 'radialgradient', 'stop', 'clippath',
            'mask', 'pattern', 'symbol', 'use', 'title', 'desc', 'metadata', 'style',
            'filter', 'fegaussianblur', 'feoffset', 'feblend', 'fecolormatrix', 'femerge', 'femergenode', 'fedropshadow',
        ];

        $this->sanitizeDomElement($dom->documentElement, $allowedTags);

        $serialized = $dom->saveXML($dom->documentElement);
        return is_string($serialized) ? $serialized : '';
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $allowedTags
     */
    private function sanitizeDomElement(\DOMElement $element, array $allowedTags): void
    {
        // Sanitiza atributos do elemento atual
        if ($element->hasAttributes()) {
            $attrsToRemove = [];
            foreach ($element->attributes as $attr) {
                if (!$attr instanceof \DOMAttr) {
                    continue;
                }
                $attrName = strtolower($attr->nodeName);
                $localName = strtolower($attr->localName ?? $attrName);
                $val = html_entity_decode($attr->nodeValue ?? '', ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
                $normVal = strtolower(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x20\s]+/', '', $val) ?? '');

                if (str_starts_with($attrName, 'on') || str_starts_with($localName, 'on')) {
                    $attrsToRemove[] = $attr->nodeName;
                    continue;
                }

                if ($localName === 'href' || $attrName === 'href' || $attrName === 'xlink:href') {
                    if (
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'javascript:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'vbscript:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, 'data:') ||
                        str_starts_with($normVal, '//') ||
                        (preg_match('/^([a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*):/i', $normVal, $m) && !in_array(strtolower($m[1]), ['http', 'https'], true))
                    ) {
                        $attr->nodeValue = '#';
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if ($localName === 'style') {
                    if (
                        str_contains($normVal, 'expression(') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'javascript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'vbscript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, '@import') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'url(javascript:') ||
                        str_contains($normVal, 'url(data:')
                    ) {
                        $attrsToRemove[] = $attr->nodeName;
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach ($attrsToRemove as $attrName) {
                $element->removeAttribute($attrName);
            }
        }

        if (strtolower($element->localName ?? $element->nodeName) === 'style') {
            $css = html_entity_decode($element->textContent ?? '', ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
            $normCss = strtolower(preg_replace('/[\x00-\x20\s]+/', '', $css) ?? '');
            if (
                str_contains($normCss, 'expression(') ||
                str_contains($normCss, 'javascript:') ||
                str_contains($normCss, 'vbscript:') ||
                str_contains($normCss, '@import')
            ) {
                $element->nodeValue = '';
            }
        }

        // Percorre filhos (copia para array estático antes de remover nós)
        $children = [];
        foreach ($element->childNodes as $child) {
            $children[] = $child;
        }

        foreach ($children as $child) {
            if ($child instanceof \DOMElement) {
                $tagName = strtolower($child->localName ?? $child->nodeName);
                if (!in_array($tagName, $allowedTags, true)) {
                    $element->removeChild($child);
                    continue;
                }
                $this->sanitizeDomElement($child, $allowedTags);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/Services/ThemeDiscoveryService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço responsável pela descoberta de temas disponíveis, resolução do tema ativo e listagem de templates.
 *
 * Desacopla a exploração de diretórios do sistema de arquivos e arquivos de configuração
 * dos controladores HTTP (respeito estrito ao SRP - Single Responsibility Principle).
 */
class ThemeDiscoveryService implements ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface
{
    private string $basePath;

    public function __construct(?string $basePath = null)
    {
        $this->basePath = rtrim($basePath ?? (defined('DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT') ? DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT : dirname(__DIR__, 4)), '/\\');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array<string, string>>
     */
    public function getAvailableThemes(): array
    {
        $themes = [];
        $seen = [];

        // 1. Diretório raiz /themes
        $themesDir = $this->basePath . '/themes';
        if (is_dir($themesDir)) {
            foreach (glob($themesDir . '/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [] as $dir) {
                $folder = basename($dir);
                if (in_array($folder, ['admin', 'manager'], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $seen[$folder] = true;
                $themeJson = $dir . '/theme.json';
                $json = file_exists($themeJson) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents($themeJson), true) : [];
                $themes[] = [
                    'folder' => $folder,
                    'name'   => is_array($json) && isset($json['name']) && is_string($json['name']) ? $json['name'] : ucfirst($folder),
                ];
            }
        }

        // 2. Bundled themes dentro de plugins
        $pluginsDir = $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins';
        if (is_dir($pluginsDir)) {
            foreach (glob($pluginsDir . '/*/themes/*', GLOB_ONLYDIR) ?: [] as $dir) {
                $folder = basename($dir);
                if (isset($seen[$folder])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $seen[$folder] = true;
                $themeJson = $dir . '/theme.json';
                $json = file_exists($themeJson) ? json_decode((string)file_get_contents($themeJson), true) : [];
                $themes[] = [
                    'folder' => $folder,
                    'name'   => is_array($json) && isset($json['name']) && is_string($json['name']) ? $json['name'] : ucfirst($folder),
                ];
            }
        }

        return $themes;
    }

    public function getActiveThemeFolder(): string
    {
        $activeFile = $this->basePath . '/config/active_theme.json';
        if (file_exists($activeFile)) {
            $data = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($activeFile), true);
            $theme = $data['active_theme'] ?? ($data['active'] ?? null);
            if (is_string($theme) && trim($theme) !== '') {
                return basename(trim($theme));
            }
        }

        return 'default';
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function getThemeTemplates(string $themeFolder): array
    {
        $possibleDirs = [
            $this->basePath . '/themes/' . $themeFolder . '/templates',
            $this->basePath . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/' . $themeFolder . '/templates',
        ];

        $templates = [];
        foreach ($possibleDirs as $dir) {
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                foreach (glob($dir . '/*.php') ?: [] as $file) {
                    $base = basename($file, '.php');
                    $templates[$base] = $base . '.php';
                }
            }
        }

        if (empty($templates)) {
            $templates = [
                'home'        => 'home.php (Página Inicial)',
                'sobre'       => 'sobre.php (Página Sobre)',
                'blog'        => 'blog.php (Blog / Artigos)',
                'privacidade' => 'privacidade.php',
                'termos'      => 'termos.php',
            ];
        }

        return $templates;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/Services/ThemePartManagementService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartAssociationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartValidatorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartManagementServiceInterface;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Serviço de aplicação responsável pela criação, validação estrutural, persistência verificada
 * e atribuição consistente (com compensação em caso de falha) de partes visuais de tema (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 */
class ThemePartManagementService implements ThemePartManagementServiceInterface
{
    private ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo;
    private ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc;
    private ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery;
    private ThemePartValidatorInterface $validator;

    public function __construct(
        ThemePartRepositoryInterface $partRepo,
        ThemePartAssociationInterface $partAssoc,
        ThemeDiscoveryServiceInterface $themeDiscovery,
        ThemePartValidatorInterface $validator
    ) {
        $this->partRepo = $partRepo;
        $this->partAssoc = $partAssoc;
        $this->themeDiscovery = $themeDiscovery;
        $this->validator = $validator;
    }

    /**
     * Constrói uma nova ThemePart com o preset e blocos iniciais recomendados para o tipo.
     */
    public function createDefaultPart(string $requestedType): ThemePartInterface
    {
        $type = in_array($requestedType, [
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER,
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
        ], true) ? $requestedType : ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER;

        $defaultPreset = match ($type) {
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER  => '3_cols_header',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER  => '4_cols_footer',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION => '1_col',
            default => '1_col',
        };

        $defaultSettings = [
            'is_full_width' => false,
            'max_width'     => '1280px',
            'gap'           => '24px',
            'padding'       => '20px 24px',
            'align_items'   => 'center',
            'background'    => '',
        ];

        $initialColumns = match ($defaultPreset) {
            '3_cols_header' => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'Domain<span style="color:var(--color-primary);">System</span>', 'height' => '32px']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'nav_menu', 'data' => ['align' => 'center']]],
                2 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Acessar', 'url' => '/login', 'variant' => 'primary', 'align' => 'right']]],
            ],
            '4_cols_footer' => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem', 'height' => '28px']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Ecossistema modular de alto desempenho.', 'font_size' => '0.85rem']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Navegação', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => '<a href="/" style="color:inherit;">Início</a><br><a href="/cursos" style="color:inherit;">Cursos</a>', 'font_size' => '0.85rem']]],
                2 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Comunidade', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'social_icons', 'data' => []]],
                3 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Legal', 'level' => 'h4', 'font_size' => '1rem']], ['type' => 'copyright', 'data' => ['site_name' => 'Domain-System']]],
            ],
            default => [
                0 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Título da Seção', 'level' => 'h2']], ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Insira seu texto e blocos aqui.']]],
            ]
        };

        return new ThemePart(
            uniqid('part_', true),
            $type,
            'Novo ' . ucfirst($type),
            $defaultPreset,
            $defaultSettings,
            $initialColumns,
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC,
            false
        );
    }

    /**
     * Valida estruturalmente o documento, salva a ThemePart e aplica atribuições verificadas
     * com compensação automática caso uma atribuição posterior falhe.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $input
     */
    public function saveFromPayload(array $input): ThemePartInterface
    {
        // 1. Validação estrutural completa antes de qualquer efeito colateral
        $this->validator->validate($input);

        $id = trim((string)($input['id'] ?? ''));
        if ($id === '') {
            $id = uniqid('part_', true);
        }

        $type = (string)($input['type'] ?? ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER);
        $title = trim((string)($input['title'] ?? 'Sem Título'));
        $preset = (string)($input['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
        $settings = (array)($input['container_settings'] ?? []);
        unset($settings['hide_desktop'], $settings['hide_laptop'], $settings['hide_tablet'], $settings['hide_mobile']);
        $columnsData = (array)($input['columns_data'] ?? []);
        $mobileToggleStyle = (string)($input['mobile_toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $mobileToggleAlign = (string)($input['mobile_toggle_align'] ?? 'right');
        $isDefault = !empty($input['is_default']);
        $sections = (array)($input['sections'] ?? []);

        foreach ($sections as &$sec) {
            if (is_array($sec)) {
                if (isset($sec['container_settings']) && is_array($sec['container_settings'])) {
                    unset(
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_desktop'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_laptop'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_tablet'],
                        $sec['container_settings']['hide_mobile']
                    );
                }
                if (isset($sec['settings']) && is_array($sec['settings'])) {
                    unset(
                        $sec['settings']['hide_desktop'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_laptop'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_tablet'],
                        $sec['settings']['hide_mobile']
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        unset($sec);

        // Captura snapshot anterior da parte e associações para compensação caso uma associação falhe após o save
        $previousPart = $this->partRepo->findById($id);
        $previousGlobalDefault = $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault($type);
        $assignedTheme = !empty($input['assigned_theme']) ? (string)$input['assigned_theme'] : '';
        $previousThemeAssignedId = $assignedTheme !== '' ? $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId($assignedTheme, $type) : null;
        $targetTheme = $assignedTheme !== ''
            ? $assignedTheme
            : $this->themeDiscovery->getActiveThemeFolder();
        $previousSectionTemplate = ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template']))
            ? $this->partAssoc->getAssignedTemplateForSection($targetTheme, $id)
            : null;

        $part = new ThemePart(
            $id,
            $type,
            $title !== '' ? $title : 'Sem Título',
            $preset,
            $settings,
            $columnsData,
            $mobileToggleStyle,
            $isDefault,
            isset($input['created_at']) ? (int)$input['created_at'] : ($previousPart?->getCreatedAt()),
            time(),
            $sections,
            $mobileToggleAlign
        );

        $saved = $this->partRepo->save($part);
        if (!$saved) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao gravar os dados da parte visual no armazenamento.');
        }

        try {
            if ($isDefault) {
                if (!$this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($type, $id)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao definir a parte visual como padrão global.');
                }
            }

            if ($assignedTheme !== '') {
                if (!$this->partAssoc->assignPart($assignedTheme, $type, $id)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao associar a parte visual ao tema '{$assignedTheme}'.");
                }
            }

            if ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template'])) {
                $templateChoice = trim((string)$input['assigned_template']);
                $effectiveTemplate = ($templateChoice !== '' && $templateChoice !== 'none') ? $templateChoice : null;
                if (!$this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($targetTheme, $id, $effectiveTemplate)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("Falha ao associar a seção ao template '{$templateChoice}'.");
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            // Compensação: restaura integralmente o estado anterior da parte e de todas as associações
            if ($isDefault) {
                $this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($type, $previousGlobalDefault);
            }
            if ($assignedTheme !== '') {
                $this->partAssoc->assignPart($assignedTheme, $type, $previousThemeAssignedId);
            }
            if ($type === ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION && isset($input['assigned_template'])) {
                $this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($targetTheme, $id, $previousSectionTemplate);
            }
            if ($previousPart !== null) {
                $this->partRepo->save($previousPart);
            } else {
                $this->partRepo->delete($id);
            }

            if ($e instanceof RuntimeException) {
                throw $e;
            }
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao atualizar as associações da parte visual: ' . $e->getMessage(), 0, $e);
        }

        return $part;
    }

    /**
     * Processa uma solicitação de atribuição (tema <-> parte, global ou seção <-> template).
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $input
     */
    public function assignFromPayload(array $input): bool
    {
        $themeFolder = trim((string)($input['theme_folder'] ?? ''));
        $partType    = trim((string)($input['part_type'] ?? ''));
        $partId      = trim((string)($input['part_id'] ?? ''));
        $sectionId   = trim((string)($input['section_id'] ?? $partId));
        $isGlobal    = !empty($input['is_global']);

        if ($partType === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $resolvedPartId = ($partId !== '' && $partId !== 'none' && $partId !== 'fallback') ? $partId : null;

        if (str_starts_with($partType, 'template:')) {
            $slug = substr($partType, strlen('template:'));
            $targetSectionId = $resolvedPartId ?? $sectionId;
            if ($targetSectionId === '' || $targetSectionId === 'none' || $themeFolder === '') {
                return false;
            }
            $effectiveSlug = ($partType !== 'template:none' && $resolvedPartId !== null) ? $slug : null;
            return $this->partAssoc->assignTemplateToSection($themeFolder, $targetSectionId, $effectiveSlug);
        }

        if ($isGlobal) {
            return $this->partAssoc->setGlobalDefault($partType, $resolvedPartId);
        }

        if ($themeFolder === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->partAssoc->assignPart($themeFolder, $partType, $resolvedPartId);
    }

    /**
     * Exclui uma parte visual e limpa quaisquer referências órfãs nas associações de temas/templates/globais.
     */
    public function deletePart(string $id): bool
    {
        $cleanId = trim($id);
        if ($cleanId === '') {
            return false;
        }

        $deleted = $this->partRepo->delete($cleanId);
        if ($deleted) {
            $cleaned = $this->partAssoc->removePartReferences($cleanId);
            if (!$cleaned) {
                error_log("[ThemePartManagementService] Aviso: referências de '{$cleanId}' podem não ter sido limpas integralmente.");
            }
        }

        return $deleted;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/flextheme/Services/ThemePartPreviewService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartCompilerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Contracts\ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface;

/**
 * Serviço dedicado à pré-visualização ao vivo (Preview) no Studio do Flex Builder (SOLID - SRP / DIP).
 *
 * Delega integralmente a compilação da parte visual ao motor oficial (ThemePartCompilerInterface),
 * garantindo caminho único de compilação entre o Preview do Studio e a publicação no Frontend,
 * sem qualquer instanciação direta de classes concretas de infraestrutura.
 */
class ThemePartPreviewService implements ThemePartPreviewServiceInterface
{
    private ThemePartCompilerInterface $compiler;

    public function __construct(ThemePartCompilerInterface $compiler)
    {
        $this->compiler = $compiler;
    }

    public function renderPreview(array $payload): string
    {
        $rawType = (string)($payload['type'] ?? ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION);
        $validTypes = [ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION];
        $partType = in_array($rawType, $validTypes, true) ? $rawType : ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION;

        $enforceTypeFilter = isset($payload['type']) && in_array($rawType, $validTypes, true);

        $preset = (string)($payload['layout_preset'] ?? '1_col');
        $settings = (array)($payload['container_settings'] ?? []);
        $columnsData = (array)($payload['columns_data'] ?? []);
        $mobileToggleStyle = (string)($payload['mobile_toggle_style'] ?? MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_CLASSIC);
        $mobileToggleAlign = (string)($payload['mobile_toggle_align'] ?? 'right');
        $sections = (array)($payload['sections'] ?? []);

        $ephemeralPart = new ThemePart(
            'preview_part',
            $partType,
            (string)($payload['title'] ?? 'Preview'),
            $preset,
            $settings,
            $columnsData,
            $mobileToggleStyle,
            false,
            null,
            null,
            $sections,
            $mobileToggleAlign
        );

        return $this->compiler->compilePart(
            $ephemeralPart,
            [
                'preview'            => true,
                '_enforce_part_type' => $enforceTypeFilter,
            ],
            true,
            false
        );
    }
}

                    </li>

                        <strong>Passo 2 — Criar um Header Pro com 3 Colunas:</strong><br>
                        Clique em <code>+ Criar Nova Parte &gt; Novo Header</code>. Selecione o preset <code>3 Colunas Header Pro (25% / 50% / 25%)</code>. Adicione <strong>Logotipo</strong> na Coluna 1, <strong>Menu de Navegação</strong> na Coluna 2 e <strong>Botão CTA</strong> na Coluna 3.
                    </li>
                    <li>
                        <strong>Passo 3 — Configurar o Toggle Mobile (Exclusivo de Headers):</strong><br>
                        Na aba lateral <code>CONFIG</code> do Header, escolha o estilo do botão hamburguer (<code>classic ☰</code>, <code>pill MENU ☰</code>, <code>minimal ✕</code> ou <code>dots ⋮</code>) e seu alinhamento (<code>Esquerda</code>, <code>Centro</code> ou <code>Direita</code>).
                    </li>
                    <li>
                        <strong>Passo 4 — Testar Ocultação por Elemento nas 4 Resoluções:</strong><br>
                        Clique sobre o bloco <strong>Logotipo</strong> no palco ou na árvore de camadas, abra a seção <strong>Visibilidade Responsiva (Ocultar Elemento)</strong> no Inspetor e marque <em>Ocultar no Tablet (768px)</em>. Clique no botão <code>📱 768px</code> no topo do Studio e veja apenas o Logotipo desaparecer enquanto o Menu e o Botão CTA reajustam suas larguras automaticamente!
                    </li>
                    <li>
                        <strong>Passo 5 — Criar e Vincular uma Seção Central a um Template:</strong><br>
                        Crie uma <code>Nova Seção</code>, adicione o bloco <strong>Grade de Cards / Posts</strong> (exclusivo para seções de conteúdo) e, na aba <code>CONFIG</code>, vincule diretamente ao template <code>home.php</code> (ou incorpore em qualquer página usando o shortcode <code>[section id="ID_DA_PARTE"]</code>).
                    </li>
                    <li>
                        <strong>Passo 6 — Personalizar os Design Tokens Globais:</strong><br>
                        Acesse <code><?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/tokens</code> para editar a paleta de cores e tipografia global injetada automaticamente em todas as partes visuais.
                    </li>
                </ol>
            </div>

            <!-- SEÇÃO 3: CATÁLOGO DOS 14 BLOCOS SEMÂNTICOS -->

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const privacyNotice = document.getElementById('privacyNotice');
    if (!privacyNotice) return;

    const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('acceptPrivacy');
    const rejectBtn = document.getElementById('rejectPrivacy');

    function hideNotice() {
        privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
        setTimeout(() => { privacyNotice.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
    }

    if (acceptBtn) {
        acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            localStorage.setItem('ds_privacy_accepted', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    if (rejectBtn) {
        rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            sessionStorage.setItem('ds_privacy_rejected', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    const privacyAccepted = localStorage.getItem('ds_privacy_accepted');
    const privacyRejected = sessionStorage.getItem('ds_privacy_rejected');
    
    if (privacyAccepted !== 'true' && privacyRejected !== 'true') {
        setTimeout(() => {
            privacyNotice.style.display = 'block';
            // Force reflow
            void privacyNotice.offsetWidth;
            privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }, 1000);
    }
});
</script>

                │ ↓ │
                │ 4. AUDITORIA SEMÂNTICA (O código faz sentido?) │

                │ │

            <ul class="layer-list" style="margin-bottom: 30px;">
                <li data-i18n="li2_1"><strong class="highlight">Valida o que a IA produziu</strong> (sem viés)</li>

                <li data-i18n="li2_3"><strong class="highlight">Registra evolução</strong> (auditoria histórica)</li>
                <li data-i18n="li2_4"><strong class="highlight">Bloqueia padrões ruins</strong> (regras configuráveis)
                </li>
            </ul>

            <h3 data-i18n="h3_1">As 5 Camadas de Auditoria</h3>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_1">Camada 1: Auditoria Sintática (Automática)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c1_1">Plugin.php compila</li>
                <li data-i18n="c1_2">Sem erros de sintaxe</li>
                <li data-i18n="c1_3">Sem código morto e variáveis não usadas</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_2" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 2: Auditoria de Contratos (Automática)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c2_1">Todos os Links exigidos existem</li>
                <li data-i18n="c2_2">Todos os Hooks escutados existem</li>
                <li data-i18n="c2_3">Todas as Interfaces estão implementadas corretamente</li>
                <li data-i18n="c2_4">Nenhum Link é consumido sem declaração prévia</li>
                <li data-i18n="c2_5">Nenhuma Contribution invade área de outro plugin</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_3" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 3: Auditoria Semântica (IA Leve)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c3_1">Analisa intenção vs. implementação.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c3_2">Valida se os Hooks e Links escolhidos fazem sentido para o objetivo de negócio.
                </li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_4" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 4: Auditoria SOLID (Estática + Regras)</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c4_1">SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c4_2">Valida tamanho de classes, interfaces infladas e acoplamento.</li>
            </ul>

            <h4 data-i18n="h4_5" style="margin-top: 20px;">Camada 5: Auditoria de Segurança e LGPD</h4>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li data-i18n="c5_1">Bloqueia funções perigosas (<code>eval</code>, <code>shell_exec</code>).</li>
                <li data-i18n="c5_2">Previne SSRF, SQL Injection, XSS.</li>
                <li data-i18n="c5_3">Valida exposição de PII (Personally Identifiable Information).</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
            <h2 data-i18n="h2_3">Como Isso Se Encaixa com a DSL</h2>
            <p data-i18n="p3_1">A auditoria funciona perfeitamente <strong class="highlight">porque o Domain-System
                    possui uma DSL</strong>. Sem DSL, a auditoria precisa entender código livre (impossível com 100% de
                precisão). Com DSL, a auditoria sabe exatamente o que esperar de cada plugin (Análise Contratual).</p>

            <p><strong class="highlight text-blue" data-i18n="p3_example">Exemplo de Validação Contratual:</strong></p>
            <ul class="layer-list">
                <li><strong data-i18n="ex_1">Declarado:</strong>
                    <code>getSubscribedHooks() => ['appointment.canceled']</code></li>
                <li><strong data-i18n="ex_2">Implementado:</strong>
                    <code>public function onAppointmentCanceled($appointment)</code></li>
                <li data-i18n="ex_3">A auditoria verifica a correspondência e o respeito à assinatura do contrato.</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

                │ HookRegistry │ │ Contratos │ │ Contratos │
                │ HubManager │ │ Manifestos │ │ Semântica │
                │ CircuitBreaker │ │ Validação │ │ SOLID │
                │ │ │ │ │ Segurança │

                └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘</div>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });

            document.getElementById('diagram1').textContent = lang === 'en' ? diag1_en : diag1_pt;
            document.getElementById('diagram2').textContent = lang === 'en' ? diag2_en : diag2_pt;

            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
        }

        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>
