    <header>
        <h1>Engine Architecture</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>How does the Kernel work?</h2>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> is initialized via <code>bootstrap.php</code>. At this moment, the <strong>Dependency Injection Container</strong> is assembled. The Container is the brain that manages the creation of all important classes, ensuring no one creates objects the wrong way with "new" scattered throughout the code.</p>

        <h2>Core Components</h2>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>SessionManager:</strong> The single authority over user memory storage (prevents loose superglobals like $_SESSION across the code).</li>
            <li><strong>Router (Gatekeeper):</strong> Maps URLs to Controllers and acts as a Bouncer (ACL), validating roles even before instantiating controllers.</li>
            <li><strong>EventDispatcher (Triggers):</strong> Manages Actions (Hooks) and Filters. If a plugin wants to change the menu, it "listens" to the <code>admin.menu</code> event.</li>
            <li><strong>PluginManager:</strong> Reads the <code>src/Plugins/</code> folder, validates <code>plugin.json</code>, and calls the <code>register()</code> method of each active plugin.</li>
            <li><strong>ThemeManager:</strong> Manages the Front-end. Intercepts requests that are not from the API or Dashboard, and delivers visuals using Server-Side Rendering (SSR).</li>
        </ul>

        <h2>Request Flow (Life-cycle)</h2>
        <pre>
1. User accesses the browser.
2. public/index.php receives the request.
3. bootstrap.php loads the Container and Services (Database, EventDispatcher, SessionManager).
4. PluginManager activates the Plugins (each plugin injects its Routes and Repositories).
5. Router evaluates the URL and checks Access Rules (ACL).
6. Specific Controller is instantiated via Dependency Injection.
7. The Controller accesses the Repository Layer (Repository Pattern) which handles the DB via PDO.
8. A purely HTTP Response is returned to the user.</pre>

    </div>

        <h1>⚡ Resiliência e Circuit Breaker</h1>
        <p>Como o Domain-System se protege sozinho de plugins fatais e erros críticos.</p>
    </header>
    <div class="content">
        <h2>O Problema Clássico (Tela Branca da Morte)</h2>
        <p>Nos sistemas monolíticos ou baseados em plugins tradicionais (como o WordPress antigo), um simples erro de digitação de um desenvolvedor — como esquecer um ponto-e-vírgula em um plugin recém-instalado — pode causar a famosa "Tela Branca da Morte". O PHP interrompe abruptamente toda a execução, e o site inteiro fica inacessível para todos (inclusive para os administradores).</p>
        <h2>A Solução: Circuit Breaker (Disjuntor)</h2>
        <p>O <strong>Domain-System</strong> foi desenhado com um conceito avançado de arquitetura focado na alta resiliência: o <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/https://martinfowler.com/bliki/CircuitBreaker" target="_blank">Circuit Breaker</a> (Disjuntor).</p>
        <p>Funciona de maneira muito semelhante a um disjuntor de energia em uma casa. Quando ocorre uma "sobrecarga" (um erro fatal) em um dos cômodos (plugins), o disjuntor "desarma" apenas aquela linha, protegendo o núcleo geral de queimar.</p>
        <h3>Como Funciona nos Bastidores</h3>
        <ol>
            <li><strong>Interceptação Global (ErrorHandler):</strong> Uma camada de defesa, conectada diretamente ao <code>register_shutdown_function</code> do PHP, vigia todos os eventos fatais em nível de hardware e compilação (Erros de Sintaxe, Parse Errors, etc).</li>
            <li><strong>Rastreamento Isolado:</strong> Quando uma exceção fatal explode, o Vigia captura o <em>Stack Trace</em> para descobrir a origem exata do erro.</li>
            <li><strong>Desarme Automático:</strong> Se o sistema identifica que a falha veio de um arquivo pertencente à pasta de um Plugin específico, ele intercepta o arquivo <code>config/plugins.json</code> e <strong>desconecta / desativa o plugin em milissegundos</strong>.</li>
            <li><strong>Proteção do Painel:</strong> O sistema limpa os buffers pela metade e renderiza uma tela limpa de "Sobrecarga de Núcleo" <strong>apenas para o autor da requisição afetada</strong>. Na mesma tela, exibe um botão para Recarregar o Sistema Seguro.</li>
            <li><strong>Log e Alerta Visuais:</strong> O sistema adiciona um registro da queda ao arquivo temporário de <code>disarmed.json</code>. Assim que o administrador acessa a tela nativa de Plugins (via <em>SystemAdmin</em>), ele vê um alerta brilhante apontando o plugin desarmado, com o atalho para a tela de relatórios detalhados (<em>SystemMonitor</em>).</li>
        </ol>
    </div>

        <h1>⚡ Resilience & Circuit Breaker</h1>
        <p>How Domain-System protects itself from fatal plugins and critical errors.</p>
    </header>
    <div class="content">
        <h2>The Classic Problem (White Screen of Death)</h2>
        <p>In traditional monolithic or plugin-based systems (like legacy WordPress), a simple typo by a developer — such as forgetting a semicolon in a newly installed plugin — can cause the infamous "White Screen of Death". PHP abruptly halts all execution, and the entire site becomes inaccessible for everyone (including administrators).</p>
        <h2>The Solution: Circuit Breaker</h2>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> was designed with an advanced architectural concept focused on high resilience: the <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/https://martinfowler.com/bliki/CircuitBreaker" target="_blank">Circuit Breaker</a>.</p>
        <p>It works very similarly to an electrical circuit breaker in a house. When an "overload" (a fatal error) occurs in one of the rooms (plugins), the breaker "trips" only that line, protecting the overall core from burning out.</p>
        <h3>How It Works Under the Hood</h3>
        <ol>
            <li><strong>Global Interception (ErrorHandler):</strong> A defense layer, directly hooked into PHP's <code>register_shutdown_function</code>, watches all fatal events at the hardware and compilation level (Syntax Errors, Parse Errors, etc).</li>
            <li><strong>Isolated Tracking:</strong> When a fatal exception blows up, the Watchman captures the <em>Stack Trace</em> to discover the exact origin of the error.</li>
            <li><strong>Automatic Disarming:</strong> If the system identifies that the failure came from a file belonging to a specific Plugin's folder, it intercepts the <code>config/plugins.json</code> file and <strong>disconnects / disables the plugin in milliseconds</strong>.</li>
            <li><strong>Panel Protection:</strong> The system clears half-rendered buffers and displays a clean "Core Overload" screen <strong>only for the author of the affected request</strong>. On the same screen, it displays a button to Reload the Safe System.</li>
            <li><strong>Log and Visual Alerts:</strong> The system adds a record of the crash to the temporary <code>disarmed.json</code> file. As soon as the administrator accesses the native Plugins screen (via <em>SystemAdmin</em>), they see a bright alert highlighting the disarmed plugin, with a shortcut to the detailed reports screen (<em>SystemMonitor</em>).</li>
        </ol>
    </div>

    <header>
        <h1>Contratos e Interfaces</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>A Importância das Interfaces (SOLID)</h2>
        <p>No Domain-System, aplicamos estritamente a "Letra I" do SOLID (Interface Segregation Principle). Classes não dependem umas das outras, elas dependem de <strong>Contratos (Interfaces)</strong>.</p>
        <p>Se o sistema espera que você extraia arquivos ZIP, ele não depende da biblioteca nativa do ZIP, ele pede um <code>ExtractorInterface</code>. Isso significa que amanhã você pode trocar o método de extração sem quebrar o sistema inteiro.</p>

        <h2>PluginInterface</h2>
        <p>Todo plugin DEVE assinar este contrato indiretamente (ao estender a classe abstrata <code>AbstractPlugin</code>). Ele dita as regras do ciclo de vida:</p>
        <pre><code>interface PluginInterface
{
    public function register(): void;
    public function boot(): void;
    public function activate(): void;
    public function deactivate(): void;
    public function uninstall(): void;
}</code></pre>

        <h3>Explicação dos Métodos:</h3>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>register():</strong> O lugar certo para registrar Rotas, Listeners de Eventos, e Menus no painel. Executado a cada requisição.</li>
            <li><strong>boot():</strong> Executado após todos os plugins terminarem de se registrar.</li>
            <li><strong>activate():</strong> Rodado <strong>apenas uma vez</strong> quando você liga o Plugin no Painel (Ideal para Migrations e criação de tabelas).</li>
            <li><strong>deactivate() / uninstall():</strong> Usados para limpar os rastros que o plugin deixou quando for desativado ou deletado.</li>
        </ul>

    </div>

    <header>
        <h1>Contracts and Interfaces</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>The Importance of Interfaces (SOLID)</h2>
        <p>In the Domain-System, we strictly apply the "Letter I" of SOLID (Interface Segregation Principle). Classes don't depend on each other, they depend on <strong>Contracts (Interfaces)</strong>.</p>
        <p>If the system expects you to extract ZIP files, it doesn't depend on the native ZIP library, it asks for an <code>ExtractorInterface</code>. This means tomorrow you can change the extraction method without breaking the entire system.</p>

        <h2>PluginInterface</h2>
        <p>Every plugin MUST sign this contract indirectly (by extending the abstract class <code>AbstractPlugin</code>). It dictates the lifecycle rules:</p>
        <pre><code>interface PluginInterface
{
    public function register(): void;
    public function boot(): void;
    public function activate(): void;
    public function deactivate(): void;
    public function uninstall(): void;
}</code></pre>

        <h3>Explanation of Methods:</h3>
        <ul>
            <li><strong>register():</strong> The right place to register Routes, Event Listeners, and Dashboard Menus. Executed on every request.</li>
            <li><strong>boot():</strong> Executed after all plugins finish registering.</li>
            <li><strong>activate():</strong> Run <strong>only once</strong> when you turn on the Plugin in the Dashboard (Ideal for Migrations and table creation).</li>
            <li><strong>deactivate() / uninstall():</strong> Used to clean up the traces the plugin left when deactivated or deleted.</li>
        </ul>

    </div>

    <header>
        <div class="lang-switch">
            <button onclick="setLanguage('en')" id="btn-en" class="active">English</button>
            <button onclick="setLanguage('pt')" id="btn-pt">Português</button>
        </div>
        <h1 data-i18n="title">O Fluxo de Vida do Plugin</h1>
        <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 1.1rem;" data-i18n="subtitle">Entendendo a abstração do Kernel através da analogia da Imigração.</p>
    </header>

    <div class="container">
        <p class="intro" data-i18n="intro">
            Como o Domain-System OS impede que um plugin quebre o sistema inteiro? Ele não executa códigos cegamente. O Kernel segue um rigoroso <strong>processo de alfândega em 3 etapas</strong>. Clique nas etapas abaixo para entender a mágica.
        </p>

        <div class="timeline">
            
            <!-- STEP 1 -->
            <div class="timeline-step active" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step1_title"><span>🛂</span> 1. O Passaporte (JSON)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step1_subtitle">A verificação de identidade antes do código.</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step1_desc">A primeira coisa que o Kernel faz é ler o arquivo <code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">plugin.json</code>. Nenhuma linha de código PHP foi executada ainda. O Kernel apenas olha o documento e avalia: <em>"Quem é você? Qual sua versão? Você precisa de outro plugin para funcionar?"</em>. Se algo estiver corrompido, ele barra a entrada aqui, evitando a famosa "Tela Branca da Morte".</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre>{
    <span class="s">"name"</span>: <span class="s">"test_os"</span>,
    <span class="s">"version"</span>: <span class="s">"1.0.0"</span>,
    <span class="s">"description"</span>: <span class="s">"Plugin de Teste para o novo Sistema Operacional Web"</span>,
    <span class="s">"core"</span>: <span class="v">false</span>,
    <span class="s">"dependencies"</span>: []
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 2 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step2_title"><span>🤝</span> 2. A Entrevista (Negociação)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step2_subtitle">O Método osRegister()</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step2_desc">Se o passaporte estiver válido e ativado, o Kernel carrega o seu arquivo PHP. Mas ele não deixa você trabalhar ainda! Ele chama você para uma sala de entrevista (<code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">osRegister</code>). O Kernel pergunta: <em>"O que você vai precisar usar aqui dentro?"</em>. Você responde anotando na prancheta do conector.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// Anotando na prancheta o que eu preciso</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>);
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 3 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step3_title"><span>🛠️</span> 3. O Crachá (Execução)</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step3_subtitle">O Método osBoot() e a Injeção de Dependências</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step3_desc">Com a entrevista aprovada, o Kernel finalmente te entrega o crachá de acesso (<code style="color:var(--accent-purple)">OsRuntime</code>). Ele diz: <em>"Pode começar a trabalhar! Aqui estão as ferramentas que você pediu."</em>. Através do Runtime, o SO injeta as dependências diretamente na sua mão. Se você tentar pegar algo que não pediu no Passo 2, o crachá é bloqueado imediatamente.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// O SO te entrega a sessão pronta e segura</span>
    <span class="v">$session</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// O SO deixa você desenhar no menu administrativo</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>, [
        <span class="s">'title'</span> => <span class="s">'Minha Clínica'</span>
    ]);
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- STEP 4 -->
            <div class="timeline-step" onclick="activateStep(this)">
                <div class="timeline-content">
                    <h2 data-i18n="step4_title"><span>🧩</span> 4. O Código Completo</h2>
                    <h3 data-i18n="step4_subtitle">Juntando todas as peças</h3>
                    <p data-i18n="step4_desc">Veja como fica o arquivo final da sua Extensão, com os "uses" (namespaces) obrigatórios e o método legado exigido pela arquitetura de transição.</p>
                    <div class="code-block">
<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\test_os;

    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {

    }

    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="c">/** @var SessionManager $session */</span>
        <span class="v">$session</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.session'</span>);

        <span class="f">error_log</span>(<span class="s">"🚀 BINGO! O Plugin TestOS foi aprovado!"</span>);
        
        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
            <span class="s">'type'</span> => <span class="s">'success'</span>,
            <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'O novo Sistema Operacional Web está operante!'</span>
        ]);
    }
}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
        }

        function activateStep(element) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.timeline-step').forEach(step => {
                step.classList.remove('active');
            });
            element.classList.add('active');
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');

    <header>
        <h1>Visão, Propósito e Público-Alvo</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>Por que criar este projeto?</h2>
        <p>A web atual sofre com dois extremos: de um lado, sistemas monolíticos pesados e lentos (como versões legadas e infladas de CMS tradicionais) repletos de "gambiarras"; do outro lado, frameworks modernos e complexos que exigem uma curva de aprendizado altíssima e dependências infinitas via Composer.</p>
        <p>O <strong>Domain-System</strong> nasceu da necessidade de encontrar o <em>meio-termo perfeito</em>: um sistema <strong>simples em sua essência</strong> (PHP puro), mas <strong>extremamente robusto em sua arquitetura</strong> (100% focado nos princípios SOLID e Padrões de Projeto).</p>

        <h2>Qual é o propósito?</h2>
        <p>Criar um <strong>Kernel (Núcleo)</strong> ultraleve, seguro e agnóstico, cujo único trabalho seja <em>orquestrar</em> aplicativos menores (Plugins) e Exibições (Temas). O núcleo não sabe o que é um "Paciente" ou um "Agendamento". Ele apenas fornece Ferramentas (Injeção de Dependência, Roteador, Banco de Dados Seguro) para que os Plugins façam o trabalho duro.</p>
        <p>Dessa forma, criamos um <strong>SaaS White-label (Software as a Service)</strong> escalável. Se amanhã quisermos criar um sistema para Advogados em vez de Clínicas, o núcleo continua o mesmo, bastando apenas conectar novos Plugins.</p>

        <h2>Para quem é este projeto?</h2>
        <p>Para clínicas médicas, consultórios e desenvolvedores corporativos que precisam de um ecossistema <strong>flexível, rápido e próprio</strong>, sem pagar licenças milionárias ou ficar refém do código espaguete de terceiros. A estrutura é feita para desenvolvedores sérios que apreciam Clean Architecture e TDD (Test-Driven Development).</p>

        <h2>Como poderá ser estendido?</h2>
        <p>A escalabilidade é infinita. Graças à arquitetura <em>Event-Driven</em> (Orientada a Eventos), desenvolvedores futuros podem injetar comportamentos (via Filtros e Ações) sem nunca tocar no código original (Open/Closed Principle).</p>
        <p>Você pode adicionar um Plugin de Gateway de Pagamento, um Plugin de WhatsApp Inteligente (Z-API), ou conectar o frontend via APIs REST, tudo isso respeitando o fluxo natural de rotas do sistema.</p>
    </div>

    <header>
        <h1>Vision, Purpose and Target Audience</h1>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
        <h2>Why create this project?</h2>
        <p>The current web suffers from two extremes: on one side, heavy and slow monolithic systems (like legacy and bloated versions of traditional CMS) full of workarounds; on the other side, modern and complex frameworks that require a very high learning curve and infinite dependencies via Composer.</p>
        <p>The <strong>Domain-System</strong> was born from the need to find the <em>perfect middle ground</em>: a system <strong>simple in its essence</strong> (pure PHP), but <strong>extremely robust in its architecture</strong> (100% focused on SOLID principles and Design Patterns).</p>

        <h2>What is the purpose?</h2>
        <p>Create an ultralight, secure and agnostic <strong>Kernel</strong>, whose sole job is to <em>orchestrate</em> smaller applications (Plugins) and Views (Themes). The core doesn't know what a "Patient" or an "Appointment" is. It just provides Tools (Dependency Injection, Router, Secure Database) for the Plugins to do the hard work.</p>
        <p>This way, we created a scalable <strong>White-label SaaS (Software as a Service)</strong>. If tomorrow we want to create a system for Lawyers instead of Clinics, the core remains the same, just requiring new Plugins to be connected.</p>

        <h2>Who is this project for?</h2>
        <p>For medical clinics, offices, and enterprise developers who need a <strong>flexible, fast and proprietary</strong> ecosystem, without paying expensive licenses or being held hostage by third-party spaghetti code. The structure is made for serious developers who appreciate Clean Architecture and TDD (Test-Driven Development).</p>

        <h2>How can it be extended?</h2>
        <p>Scalability is infinite. Thanks to the <em>Event-Driven</em> architecture, future developers can inject behaviors (via Filters and Actions) without ever touching the original code (Open/Closed Principle).</p>
        <p>You can add a Payment Gateway Plugin, a Smart WhatsApp Plugin (Z-API), or connect the frontend via REST APIs, all respecting the system's natural routing flow.</p>
    </div>

    <h1>Instalação e Primeiros Passos</h1>
    <p>Como baixar, configurar e testar o Domain-System OS localmente ou em produção.</p>
</header>

<div class="content">
    <h2>1. O Repositório Oficial no GitHub</h2>
    <p>O <strong>Domain-System OS</strong> é um projeto open-source. Você pode encontrar o código-fonte, reportar problemas e contribuir no nosso repositório oficial:</p>
    <p style="text-align: center; margin: 20px 0;">
        <a href="https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system" target="_blank" style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: bold;">🔗 github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system</a>
    </p>

    <h2 style="margin-top: 30px;">2. Como Baixar (Download)</h2>
    <p>Você tem duas opções principais para obter o código do sistema:</p>
    
    <h3>Opção A: Via Git (Recomendado para Devs)</h3>
    <p>Abra o seu terminal e clone o repositório diretamente. Isso facilitará a atualização posterior.</p>
    <pre><code>git clone https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system.git</code></pre>
    
    <h3>Opção B: Download do ZIP</h3>
    <p>Acesse o repositório acima, clique no botão verde <strong>"Code"</strong> e selecione <strong>"Download ZIP"</strong>. Após o download, descompacte o arquivo na pasta desejada.</p>

    <h2 style="margin-top: 30px;">3. Testando Localmente (XAMPP / Laragon)</h2>
    <p>Para testar o sistema na sua própria máquina, recomendamos o uso de pacotes locais como o <strong>XAMPP</strong> (Windows/Mac/Linux) ou <strong>Laragon</strong> (Windows).</p>
    <ul style="line-height: 1.8; margin-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
        <li><strong>Passo 1:</strong> Mova a pasta extraída (ou clonada) para dentro da sua pasta pública local (ex: <code>C:\xampp\htdocs\domain-system</code>).</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 2:</strong> Certifique-se de ter o <strong>PHP 8.3 ou superior</strong> ativo no seu servidor.</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 3:</strong> Inicie o serviço do Apache pelo painel de controle do XAMPP/Laragon.</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 4:</strong> Abra o navegador e acesse <code>http://localhost/domain-system/public/</code>. Você deverá ver a tela inicial do FlexTheme funcionando instantaneamente!</li>
    </ul>

    <div style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); border-left: 4px solid #10b981; padding: 15px; margin: 20px 0; border-radius: 4px;">
        <strong style="color: #10b981;">Dica de Ouro:</strong> O sistema possui um roteador próprio avançado que redireciona as requisições limpas através do arquivo <code>public/index.php</code> e do arquivo <code>.htaccess</code>.
    </div>

    <h2 style="margin-top: 30px;">4. Hospedando em Produção (Ex: Hostinger)</h2>
    <p>A Hostinger (e outros servidores de hospedagem modernos) possui suporte nativo ao nosso sistema. Siga os passos para publicar seu projeto online:</p>
    <ul style="line-height: 1.8; margin-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
        <li><strong>Passo 1:</strong> Acesse o Painel de Controle da hospedagem (hPanel).</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 2:</strong> Vá em "Configurações do PHP" e certifique-se de selecionar a versão <strong>PHP 8.3+</strong> (O suporte de migração para 8.4 já está previsto na arquitetura).</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 3:</strong> Use o Gerenciador de Arquivos ou FTP para fazer o upload dos arquivos para o servidor.</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 4:</strong> <strong>Diretório Público:</strong> O diretório <code>public/</code> deve atuar como a sua raiz pública (equivalente ao <code>public_html</code>). O restante do sistema (pastas vitais como <code>src/</code>, <code>logs/</code> e o arquivo <code>.env</code>) deve ficar fora de alcance e invisível aos visitantes por segurança!</li>
        <li><strong>Passo 5:</strong> <strong>Banco de Dados (Importante!):</strong> Antes de acessar o seu site pela primeira vez, vá na seção "Bancos de Dados MySQL" da Hostinger e crie um novo banco. <strong>Anote o Nome do Banco de Dados, Usuário e a Senha!</strong> Sem esses três dados em mãos, o Wizard Automático de Instalação do Domain-System não conseguirá conectar e criar as tabelas.</li>
    </ul>
    
    <p>A equipe da Hostinger validou e aceitou a hospedagem do código-fonte PHP modular, validando os padrões de segurança nativos e a adoção futura de middlewares de Cache Headers, descartando a necessidade de plugins pesados de WordPress como o LiteSpeed Cache.</p>

    <div style="margin-top: 40px; text-align: center;">
        <a href="<?= defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '' ?>/docs/tutorial-dev" style="display: inline-block; padding: 12px 25px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); border: 1px solid #3b82f6; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; color: #60a5fa; text-decoration: none; transition: 0.3s;">
            Próximo Passo: Criando o seu Primeiro Plugin →
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

        <div id="tab1" class="tab-content active">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab1_h2">How to Use Priorities</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p1">In the new OS 2.0 contract, when calling <code class="highlight">$runtime->onHook()</code>, you can pass a third parameter indicating the priority.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p2">If no priority is passed, the OS defaults to <code>0</code>. Negative priorities run earlier, positive priorities run later. The higher the number, the later it runs.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// Default execution (priority 0)</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$menu</span>) { ... });

    <span class="c">// High Priority - Runs LATER (e.g., Priority 999)</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'router.before_dispatch'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$uri</span>) { ... }, <span class="n">999</span>);

    <span class="c">// Low Priority - Runs EARLIER (e.g., Priority -10)</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'router.before_dispatch'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$uri</span>) { ... }, <span class="n">-10</span>);
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="tab2" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab2_h2">The "Emergency Hatch" Pattern (Firewall)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p1">Look at how the <strong>SystemAdmin</strong> plugin acts as the ultimate security net of the Kernel. It listens to the <code>router.before_dispatch</code> event with priority <code>999</code>.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p2">Why? Because the Auth Plugin might handle authentication at priority 0. If Auth crashes, gets disabled, or fails, the SystemAdmin will trigger its Emergency Hatch and block unauthenticated users from accessing the <code>/admin</code> panel, forwarding them to the emergency login.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="c">// The Emergency Hatch (Safety Net)</span>
<span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'router.before_dispatch'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$uri</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$sessionManager</span>) {
    <span class="k">if</span> (<span class="f">str_starts_with</span>(<span class="v">$uri</span>, <span class="s">'/admin'</span>) && !<span class="f">str_starts_with</span>(<span class="v">$uri</span>, <span class="s">'/admin/emergency'</span>)) {
        
        <span class="c">// If no session exists at this exact moment (even after other plugins tried)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> (!<span class="v">$sessionManager</span>-><span class="f">has</span>(<span class="s">'user_id'</span>)) {
            <span class="f">header</span>(<span class="s">"Location: "</span> . BASE_URL . <span class="s">"/admin/emergency"</span>);
            <span class="k">exit</span>; <span class="c">// Terminates the OS securely</span>
        }
    }
}, <span class="n">999</span>); <span class="c">// Guaranteed to be the last one checking!</span></pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div id="tab3" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab3_h2">Execution Flow Security</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab3_p1">The priority mechanism in the <code>OsRuntime</code> prevents "race conditions" where two plugins compete for the same action. It acts as an orchestrator.</p>
            
            <ul>
                <li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong style="color:var(--accent-red)">Phase 1 (Priority < 0):</strong> Preparation plugins, logging setups, modifying request data.</li>
                <li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong style="color:var(--accent-blue)">Phase 2 (Priority 0):</strong> Standard logic execution. Almost 90% of your Hooks will sit here.</li>
                <li style="margin-bottom: 10px;"><strong style="color:var(--accent-purple)">Phase 3 (Priority > 0):</strong> Firewalls, overrides, emergency hatch exits.</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

    </div>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            // Update buttons
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
            
            // Update copy buttons text
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.innerText = lang === 'en' ? 'Copy' : 'Copiar';
            });
        }

        function openTab(tabId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function copyCode(btn) {
            const code = btn.nextElementSibling.innerText;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                const originalText = btn.innerText;
                const isEnglish = document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.contains('active');
                btn.innerText = isEnglish ? 'Copied!' : 'Copiado!';
                btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.color = '';
                    btn.style.borderColor = '';
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>

        <!-- TAB 1 -->
        <div id="tab1" class="tab-content active">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab1_h2">What is a Plugin Hub?</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p1">Suppose you want to distribute a "Clinic Management Package". It has a module for Patients, another for Doctors, and another for Finance. Creating one gigantic, monolithic plugin is terrible for code maintenance.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p2">Instead, OS 2.0 allows you to create a <strong>Hub (Package)</strong>. The Hub is a parent plugin that physically contains multiple completely independent child plugins.</p>
            <h3 data-i18n="tab1_h3">Why is this amazing?</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p3">The developer of the child plugin doesn't need to know they are inside a package. They just sign the <code>OsExtensionInterface</code> contract as usual, and the OS 2.0 recursively discovers them, booting each one individually!</p>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 2 -->
        <div id="tab2" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab2_h2">Configuring the Parent Plugin (Hub)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p1">To transform a standard plugin into a Package Hub, you just need to declare the <code>getSubPluginsPath()</code> method. This tells the OS 2.0 <i>Plugin Discoverer</i> where to look for child modules.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\clinic_pack;

<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;

<span class="k">class</span> <span class="f">Plugin</span> <span class="k">extends</span> AbstractPlugin <span class="k">implements</span> OsExtensionInterface
{
    <span class="c">// The magical method that enables the HUB feature!</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">getSubPluginsPath</span>(): <span class="k">string</span>
    {
        <span class="c">// Inform the OS where your children are located</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> __DIR__ . <span class="s">'/bundled_plugins'</span>;
    }

    <span class="c">// Standard OS 2.0 Contract (The Hub itself can also have logic)</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span> {
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'admin.menu'</span>);
    }
    
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span> {
        <span class="c">// Hub logic...</span>
    }
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 3 -->
        <div id="tab3" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab3_h2">Developing the Child Plugin</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab3_p1">This is the best part: the child plugin code is <strong>exactly identical</strong> to a standalone root plugin. You don't need to import the parent or talk to the Hub. The child talks directly to the OS 2.0 Kernel.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">namespace</span> DomainSystem\Plugins\patients;

<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
<span class="k">use</span> DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;

<span class="k">class</span> <span class="f">Plugin</span> <span class="k">extends</span> AbstractPlugin <span class="k">implements</span> OsExtensionInterface
{
    <span class="c">// I am a child, but I can demand my own database link!</span>
    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
        <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'router.register'</span>);
    }

    <span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
    {
        <span class="c">// My routes are registered globally, independently of the Hub!</span>
        <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'router.register'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$router</span>) {
            <span class="v">$router</span>-><span class="f">addRoute</span>(<span class="s">'GET'</span>, <span class="s">'/patients'</span>, [Controller::class, <span class="s">'index'</span>]);
        });
    }
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

            <p data-i18n="tab4_p1">Notice how the parent has a <code>plugin.json</code> and each child also has its own <code>plugin.json</code>. Each folder acts as an isolated micro-service within the system.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">

<pre>src/Plugins/
 └── clinic_pack/                   (The Hub)
      ├── Plugin.php                (Returns getSubPluginsPath)
      ├── plugin.json               (Hub Manifest)
      │
      └── bundled_plugins/          (The Hub's internal ecosystem)
           ├── patients/            (Child 1)
           │    ├── Plugin.php      (Normal OsExtensionInterface)
           │    └── plugin.json     (Manifest for versioning)
           │
           ├── finance/             (Child 2)
           │    ├── Plugin.php      (Normal OsExtensionInterface)
           │    └── plugin.json     (Manifest for versioning)
           │
           └── appointments/        (Child 3)</pre>

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            // Update buttons
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
            
            // Update copy buttons text
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.innerText = lang === 'en' ? 'Copy' : 'Copiar';
            });
        }

        function openTab(tabId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function copyCode(btn) {
            const code = btn.nextElementSibling.innerText;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                const originalText = btn.innerText;
                const isEnglish = document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.contains('active');
                btn.innerText = isEnglish ? 'Copied!' : 'Copiado!';
                btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.color = '';
                    btn.style.borderColor = '';
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>

                <p style="color: #fca5a5; margin: 0;" data-i18n="alert_desc">To build for Domain-System OS, <strong>you must understand Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts</strong>. The system does not use loose global functions. Everything is based on Interfaces, Contracts, Classes, and Encapsulation.</p>
            </div>

        <div class="tabs">
            <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="openTab('tab1')" data-i18n="tab1_btn">1. The Contract</button>

            <button class="tab-btn" onclick="openTab('tab3')" data-i18n="tab3_btn">3. Execution (osBoot)</button>
            <button class="tab-btn" onclick="openTab('tab4')" data-i18n="tab4_btn">4. Full Example</button>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 1 -->
        <div id="tab1" class="tab-content active">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab1_h2">The End of Global Mess</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p1">If you come from WordPress, you are used to creating a <code class="highlight">functions.php</code> and using global functions. In Domain-System OS, this is strictly prohibited.</p>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p2">Every Extension (Plugin or Theme) is a Class that must sign a contract called <code class="highlight">OsExtensionInterface</code>. This contract divides your plugin's lifecycle into two isolated security phases.</p>
            
            <h3 data-i18n="tab1_h3">Dependency Injection (The Waiter)</h3>
            <p data-i18n="tab1_p3">Here, you don't hunt for system resources by instantiating random variables globally. The system works on a "Waiter" model: you sit down, ask for what you want (Phase 1), and the Operating System <strong class="highlight">injects</strong> the ready tool right into your hands (Phase 2).</p>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 2 -->
        <div id="tab2" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab2_h2">Phase 1: Negotiation (osRegister)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab2_p1">Before running any business logic, you use the <code class="highlight">OsConnector</code> object to notify the Operating System what you will need to use. If you do not request permission here, you will be blocked in Phase 2.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osRegister</span>(OsConnector <span class="v">$os</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. LINKS (Tools/Services)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requireLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. SLOTS (Visual injection)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">requestSlot</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>);

    <span class="c">// 3. HOOKS (Events/Triggers)</span>
    <span class="v">$os</span>-><span class="f">listenHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>);
}</pre>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- TAB 3 -->
        <div id="tab3" class="tab-content">
            <h2 data-i18n="tab3_h2">Phase 2: Execution (osBoot)</h2>
            <p data-i18n="tab3_p1">After approving your contract, the OS hands you the <code class="highlight">OsRuntime</code>. This is where you actually work, receiving the requested resources strictly via Dependency Injection.</p>
            
            <div class="code-block">
                <button class="copy-btn" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
<pre><span class="k">public function</span> <span class="f">osBoot</span>(OsRuntime <span class="v">$runtime</span>): <span class="k">void</span>
{
    <span class="c">// 1. GETTING TOOLS</span>
    <span class="v">$db</span> = <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">getLink</span>(<span class="s">'core.db'</span>);
    
    <span class="c">// 2. INJECTING VISUALS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">contributeTo</span>(<span class="s">'admin.dashboard.alerts'</span>, [
        <span class="s">'message'</span> => <span class="s">'Plugin successfully booted!'</span>
    ]);

    <span class="c">// 3. LISTENING TO EVENTS</span>
    <span class="v">$runtime</span>-><span class="f">onHook</span>(<span class="s">'patient.created'</span>, <span class="k">function</span>(<span class="v">$patientId</span>) <span class="k">use</span> (<span class="v">$db</span>) {
        <span class="c">// Safe to execute logic here!</span>
    });
}</pre>

        });
    }

        function setLanguage(lang) {
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => {
                const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
                if (translations[lang][key]) {
                    el.innerHTML = translations[lang][key];
                }
            });
            
            // Update buttons
            document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'en');
            document.getElementById('btn-pt').classList.toggle('active', lang === 'pt');
            
            // Update copy buttons text
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.innerText = lang === 'en' ? 'Copy' : 'Copiar';
            });
        }

        function openTab(tabId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            event.target.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function copyCode(btn) {
            const code = btn.nextElementSibling.innerText;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                const originalText = btn.innerText;
                const isEnglish = document.getElementById('btn-en').classList.contains('active');
                btn.innerText = isEnglish ? 'Copied!' : 'Copiado!';
                btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                btn.style.borderColor = '#10b981';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = originalText;
                    btn.style.color = '';
                    btn.style.borderColor = '';
                }, 2000);
            });
        }
        
        // Initialize Default English
        setLanguage('en');
    </script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const privacyNotice = document.getElementById('privacyNotice');
    if (!privacyNotice) return;

    const acceptBtn = document.getElementById('acceptPrivacy');
    const rejectBtn = document.getElementById('rejectPrivacy');

    function hideNotice() {
        privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)';
        setTimeout(() => { privacyNotice.style.display = 'none'; }, 500);
    }

    if (acceptBtn) {
        acceptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            localStorage.setItem('rachidd_privacy_accepted', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    if (rejectBtn) {
        rejectBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            sessionStorage.setItem('rachidd_privacy_rejected', 'true');
            hideNotice();
        });
    }

    const privacyAccepted = localStorage.getItem('rachidd_privacy_accepted');
    const privacyRejected = sessionStorage.getItem('rachidd_privacy_rejected');
    
    if (privacyAccepted !== 'true' && privacyRejected !== 'true') {
        setTimeout(() => {
            privacyNotice.style.display = 'block';
            // Force reflow
            void privacyNotice.offsetWidth;
            privacyNotice.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        }, 1000);
    }
});
</script>

    function getSelectedBlock() {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return null;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return null;
        return sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx] || null;
    }

    function getResponsivePropKey(key, dev) {
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        return (dev === 'desktop') ? key : (key + '_' + dev);
    }

    function getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key, dev) {
        if (!block || !block.data) return '';
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        var d = block.data;
        if (dev === 'mobile') {
            if (d[key + '_mobile'] !== undefined && d[key + '_mobile'] !== '') return d[key + '_mobile'];
            if (d[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && d[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return d[key + '_tablet'];
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        if (dev === 'tablet') {
            if (d[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && d[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return d[key + '_tablet'];
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        if (dev === 'laptop') {
            if (d[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && d[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return d[key + '_laptop'];
            return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
        }
        return d[key] !== undefined ? d[key] : '';
    }

    function isPropOverriddenInDevice(block, key, dev) {
        if (!block || !block.data) return false;
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        if (dev === 'desktop') return (block.data[key] !== undefined && block.data[key] !== '');
        return (block.data[key + '_' + dev] !== undefined && block.data[key + '_' + dev] !== '');
    }

    function updateBlockPropResponsive(key, val) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (!block.data) block.data = {};

        var targetKey = getResponsivePropKey(key, currentDeviceKey);
        if (val === '' || val === null || val === undefined) {
            if (currentDeviceKey !== 'desktop') {
                delete block.data[targetKey];
            } else {
                block.data[key] = '';
            }
        } else {
            block.data[targetKey] = val;
        }

        renderCanvas();
    }

    function renderResponsiveControlHeader(label, baseKey, block) {
        var dev = currentDeviceKey;
        var isOverridden = isPropOverriddenInDevice(block, baseKey, dev);
        var devIcon = dev === 'mobile' ? '📱 Mobile' : (dev === 'tablet' ? '📱 Tablet' : (dev === 'laptop' ? '💻 Laptop' : '💻 Desktop'));
        var badgeColor = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') ? '#10b981' : 'var(--primary)';
        var badgeBg = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)' : 'rgba(56,189,248,0.1)';
        var badgeText = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') ? (devIcon + ' (Custom)') : devIcon;
        var clearBtn = (isOverridden && dev !== 'desktop') 
            ? '<button type="button" onclick="updateBlockPropResponsive(\'' + baseKey + '\', \'\'); renderInspector(); renderCanvas();" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#ef4444; font-size:10px; cursor:pointer; padding:0 2px;" title="Redefinir para herdar da resolução superior">✕ Limpar</button>'
            : '';

        return '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label" style="margin-bottom:0;">' + label + '</label>' +
               '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">' +
               '<span style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:' + badgeColor + '; background:' + badgeBg + '; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px;" title="Editando na resolução: ' + dev + '">' + badgeText + '</span>' +
               clearBtn +
               '</div>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function getSecResponsiveValue(sec, key, dev) {
        if (!sec || !sec.container_settings) return '';
        dev = dev || currentDeviceKey;
        var s = sec.container_settings;
        if (dev === 'mobile') {
            if (s[key + '_mobile'] !== undefined && s[key + '_mobile'] !== '') return s[key + '_mobile'];
            if (s[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && s[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return s[key + '_tablet'];
            if (s[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && s[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return s[key + '_laptop'];
            return s[key] !== undefined ? s[key] : '';
        }
        if (dev === 'tablet') {
            if (s[key + '_tablet'] !== undefined && s[key + '_tablet'] !== '') return s[key + '_tablet'];
            if (s[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && s[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return s[key + '_laptop'];
            return s[key] !== undefined ? s[key] : '';

        if (dev === 'laptop') {
            if (s[key + '_laptop'] !== undefined && s[key + '_laptop'] !== '') return s[key + '_laptop'];
            return s[key] !== undefined ? s[key] : '';
        }
        return s[key] !== undefined ? s[key] : '';
    }

    function updateActiveSecSettingResponsive(key, val) {
        var sec = getSelectedSection();
        if (!sec) return;
        if (!sec.container_settings) sec.container_settings = {};

            } else {
                sec.container_settings[key] = '';
            }

    function getMaxSectionsForType(type) {
        if (type === 'header') return 3; // Topbar, Principal, Sub-header
        if (type === 'footer') return 3; // Newsletter, Principal, Copyright
        return 6; // Seções centrais livres
    }

    var selectionType = 'none'; // 'none' | 'section' | 'block' | 'column'
    var selectedSecIdx = 0;

    function initStudio() {
        initDraggableNavigator();
        initSidebarResizer();
        if (state.container_settings) {
            delete state.container_settings.hide_desktop;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_laptop;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_tablet;
            delete state.container_settings.hide_mobile;
        }
        if (Array.isArray(state.sections)) {
            state.sections.forEach(function(sec) {
                if (sec && sec.container_settings) {
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_desktop;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_laptop;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_tablet;
                    delete sec.container_settings.hide_mobile;
                }
            });
        }
        state.mobile_toggle_style = state.mobile_toggle_style || '<?= $part->getMobileToggleStyle() ?>';
        state.mobile_toggle_align = state.mobile_toggle_align || '<?= $part->getMobileToggleAlign() ?>';
        var alignSel = document.getElementById('setting_mobile_toggle_align');
        if (alignSel && state.mobile_toggle_align) {
            alignSel.value = state.mobile_toggle_align;
        }
        renderSidebarLayoutTab();
        renderBlocksCatalog();
        renderLayersTree();
        renderCanvas();
    }

    function switchSidebarTab(tab) {
        currentSidebarTab = tab;
        ['layout', 'layers', 'blocks', 'inspector', 'settings'].forEach(function(t) {
            var el = document.getElementById('sidebar_tab_' + t);
            if (el) el.style.display = (t === tab) ? 'block' : 'none';
            var btn = document.getElementById('tab_btn_' + t);
            if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
        });
        if (tab === 'layers') {
            renderLayersTree();
        }
    }

    // NAVEGADOR FLUTUANTE DE CAMADAS (ELEMENTOR-STYLE FLOATING POPUP)
    function toggleFloatingLayers(forceState) {
        var panel = document.getElementById('floating_layers_panel');
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_toggle_floating_layers');
        if (!panel) return;
        var willOpen = (typeof forceState === 'boolean') ? forceState : (panel.style.display === 'none');
        panel.style.display = willOpen ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (btn) {
            btn.classList.toggle('active', willOpen);
            btn.style.borderColor = willOpen ? 'var(--primary)' : 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)';
        }
        if (willOpen) {
            renderLayersTree();
        }
    }

    function toggleFloatingLayersMinimize() {
        var content = document.getElementById('floating_layers_content');
        if (!content) return;
        content.style.display = (content.style.display === 'none') ? 'block' : 'none';
    }

    function initDraggableNavigator() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('floating_layers_panel');
        var handle = document.getElementById('floating_layers_drag_handle');
        if (!panel || !handle) return;

        var isDragging = false;
        var startX, startY, initialLeft, initialTop;

        handle.onmousedown = function(e) {
            if (e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') return;
            isDragging = true;
            startX = e.clientX;
            startY = e.clientY;
            
            var rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
            initialLeft = rect.left;
            initialTop = rect.top;

            // Transfere o posicionamento de bottom/right para top/left para arraste suave
            panel.style.bottom = 'auto';
            panel.style.right = 'auto';
            panel.style.left = initialLeft + 'px';
            panel.style.top = initialTop + 'px';
            
            document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        };

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            var dx = e.clientX - startX;
            var dy = e.clientY - startY;

            var newLeft = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - panel.offsetWidth - 10, initialLeft + dx));
            var newTop = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - panel.offsetHeight - 10, initialTop + dy));

            panel.style.left = newLeft + 'px';
            panel.style.top = newTop + 'px';
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
            if (isDragging) {
                isDragging = false;
                document.body.style.userSelect = '';
            }
        });
    }

    function initSidebarResizer() {
        var sidebar = document.getElementById('studio-sidebar');
        var resizer = document.getElementById('studio-sidebar-resizer');
        if (!sidebar || !resizer) return;

        // Restaura largura salva no localStorage (entre 260px e 750px)
        var savedWidth = localStorage.getItem('studio_sidebar_width');
        if (savedWidth) {
            var parsed = parseInt(savedWidth, 10);
            if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 260 && parsed <= 750) {
                sidebar.style.width = parsed + 'px';
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', parsed + 'px');
            }
        }

        var isDragging = false;
        var startX = 0;
        var startWidth = 0;

        resizer.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            isDragging = true;
            startX = e.clientX;
            startWidth = sidebar.getBoundingClientRect().width;

            resizer.classList.add('is-dragging');
            document.body.classList.add('is-resizing-sidebar');
        });

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            var delta = e.clientX - startX;
            var newWidth = Math.max(260, Math.min(startWidth + delta, 750));
            sidebar.style.width = newWidth + 'px';
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', newWidth + 'px');
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
            if (!isDragging) return;
            isDragging = false;
            resizer.classList.remove('is-dragging');
            document.body.classList.remove('is-resizing-sidebar');
            var curWidth = parseInt(sidebar.style.width, 10);
            if (!isNaN(curWidth)) {
                localStorage.setItem('studio_sidebar_width', curWidth + 'px');
            }
        });

        // Duplo-clique restaura a largura padrão de 360px
        resizer.addEventListener('dblclick', function() {
            sidebar.style.width = '360px';
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--studio-sidebar-width', '360px');
            localStorage.removeItem('studio_sidebar_width');
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                showToast('Largura do menu redefinida para o padrão (360px)');
            }
        });
    }

    var currentLiveHeightPreset = 'auto';

    function setLiveViewportHeight(h) {
        currentLiveHeightPreset = h;
        ['850', '1200', 'full', 'auto'].forEach(function(k) {
            var btn = document.getElementById('btn_vh_' + k);
            if (btn) btn.classList.remove('active');
        });

        var activeKey = (h === '850px') ? '850' : ((h === '1200px') ? '1200' : ((h === 'auto') ? 'auto' : 'full'));
        var activeBtn = document.getElementById('btn_vh_' + activeKey);
        if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

        adjustLiveStageIframeHeight();
    }

    function adjustLiveStageIframeHeight() {
        var iframe = document.getElementById('live_stage_iframe');
        var container = document.getElementById('live-stage-container');
        var viewport = document.getElementById('device-viewport');
        var canvas = document.getElementById('canvas-content');
        if (!viewport) return;

        var isSection = (state.type === 'section');
        var minBase = isSection ? 850 : 480;

        if (currentLiveHeightPreset === 'auto') {
            viewport.style.minHeight = minBase + 'px';
            viewport.style.height = 'auto';
            if (canvas) {
                canvas.style.minHeight = 'auto';
                canvas.style.height = 'auto';
                canvas.style.overflowY = 'visible';
            }
            if (iframe) {
                try {
                    var doc = iframe.contentDocument || (iframe.contentWindow && iframe.contentWindow.document);
                    if (doc && doc.body) {
                        var scrollH = Math.max(doc.body.scrollHeight, doc.documentElement.scrollHeight);
                        var finalH = Math.max(minBase, scrollH + 40);
                        iframe.style.height = finalH + 'px';
                        if (container) {
                            container.style.height = finalH + 'px';
                            container.style.minHeight = finalH + 'px';
                        }
                        viewport.style.minHeight = finalH + 'px';
                        return;
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
                iframe.style.height = minBase + 'px';
            }
            if (container) {
                container.style.height = minBase + 'px';
                container.style.minHeight = minBase + 'px';
            }
        } else {
            var targetH = currentLiveHeightPreset;
            viewport.style.minHeight = targetH;
            viewport.style.height = targetH;
            if (canvas) {
                var offset = (targetH === 'calc(100vh - 160px)') ? 'calc(100vh - 210px)' : (parseInt(targetH) - 50) + 'px';
                canvas.style.minHeight = offset;
                canvas.style.height = offset;
                canvas.style.overflowY = 'auto';
            }
            if (iframe) {
                iframe.style.height = targetH;
            }
            if (container) {
                container.style.height = targetH;
                container.style.minHeight = targetH;
            }
        }
    }

    function setStudioMode(mode) {
        studioMode = mode;
        document.getElementById('btn_mode_structure').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'structure');
        document.getElementById('btn_mode_live').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'live');

        var canvasContent = document.getElementById('canvas-content');
        var liveStage = document.getElementById('live-stage-container');

        if (mode === 'live') {
            canvasContent.style.display = 'none';
            liveStage.style.display = 'flex';
            loadLiveStageContent();
            setTimeout(adjustLiveStageIframeHeight, 150);
        } else {
            canvasContent.style.display = 'block';
            liveStage.style.display = 'none';
            renderCanvas();
        }
    }

    function getPreviewGuardScript() {
        return '<script>' +
            'document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {' +
                'var link = e.target.closest("a, area");' +
                'if (link) {' +
                    'e.preventDefault();' +
                    'e.stopPropagation();' +
                    'var href = link.getAttribute("href") || "#";' +
                    'try {' +
                        'if (window.parent && typeof window.parent.showToast === "function") {' +
                            'var msg = (window.parent.__ ? window.parent.__("link_disabled_live", "Links estão desativados no modo Ao Vivo para não sair da edição.") : "Links estão desativados no modo Ao Vivo para não sair da edição.");' +
                            'window.parent.showToast("🔗 " + msg + " (" + href + ")");' +
                        '}' +
                    '} catch(err) {}' +
                    'return false;' +
                '}' +
            '}, true);' +
            'document.addEventListener("submit", function(e) {' +
                'e.preventDefault();' +
                'e.stopPropagation();' +
                'try {' +
                    'if (window.parent && typeof window.parent.showToast === "function") {' +
                        'window.parent.showToast("⚠️ Formulários desativados no modo Ao Vivo.");' +
                    '}' +
                '} catch(err) {}' +
                'return false;' +
            '}, true);' +
        '</' + 'script>';
    }

    var liveStageDebounceTimer = null;
    function loadLiveStageContent() {
        if (liveStageDebounceTimer) {
            clearTimeout(liveStageDebounceTimer);
        }
        liveStageDebounceTimer = setTimeout(function() {
            var iframe = document.getElementById('live_stage_iframe');
            if (!iframe) return;
            var payload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
            payload.csrf_token = csrfToken;

            if (!payload.mobile_toggle_style && state.mobile_toggle_style) {
                payload.mobile_toggle_style = state.mobile_toggle_style;
            }
            if (!payload.mobile_toggle_align && state.mobile_toggle_align) {
                payload.mobile_toggle_align = state.mobile_toggle_align;
            }

            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/preview', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.text(); })
            .then(function(html) {
                var bodyClass = 'ds-live-preview';
                if (currentDevice === '375px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-mobile-mode ds-device-375';
                } else if (currentDevice === '768px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-tablet-mode ds-device-768';
                } else if (currentDevice === '1024px') {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-laptop-mode ds-device-1024';
                } else {
                    bodyClass += ' ds-desktop-mode ds-device-desktop ds-device-1440';
                }

                iframe.onload = function() {
                    adjustLiveStageIframeHeight();
                };

                var liveStyles = '<style>' +
                    'body { margin:0; padding:0; background:#06090e; color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-primary, sans-serif); min-height:100vh; box-sizing:border-box; }' +
                    'a { cursor:pointer !important; }' +
                    (state.type === 'section' ? '.ds-part-wrapper, .ds-theme-section { min-height: 80vh; }' : '') +
                    '</style>';

                iframe.srcdoc = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">' + liveStyles + '</head><body class="' + bodyClass + '">' + html + getPreviewGuardScript() + '</body></html>';

                setTimeout(adjustLiveStageIframeHeight, 150);
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.error('[LiveStage] Erro ao renderizar preview ao vivo:', err);
            });
        }, 50);
    }

    function setDevice(width) {
        currentDevice = width;
        var viewport = document.getElementById('device-viewport');
        viewport.style.maxWidth = width;
        var pxEl = document.getElementById('cur_device_px');
        if (pxEl) pxEl.textContent = width;
        
        ['desktop', 'laptop', 'tablet', 'mobile'].forEach(function(d) {
            var b1 = document.getElementById('btn_dev_' + d);
            if (b1) b1.classList.remove('active');
            var b2 = document.getElementById('bar_dev_' + d);
            if (b2) b2.classList.remove('active');
        });

        viewport.classList.remove('ds-desktop-mode', 'ds-laptop-mode', 'ds-mobile-mode', 'ds-tablet-mode', 'ds-device-desktop', 'ds-device-1024', 'ds-device-375', 'ds-device-768');

        var activeKey = 'desktop';
        var devName = 'Desktop (100%)';
        if (width === '100%') {
            activeKey = 'desktop';
            devName = 'Desktop (100%)';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-desktop-mode', 'ds-device-desktop');
        } else if (width === '1024px') {
            activeKey = 'laptop';
            devName = 'Laptop (1024px)';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-laptop-mode', 'ds-device-1024');
        } else if (width === '768px') {
            activeKey = 'tablet';
            devName = 'Tablet (768px) - 📱 Hamburguer Ativo';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-tablet-mode', 'ds-device-768');
        } else if (width === '375px') {
            activeKey = 'mobile';
            devName = 'Mobile (375px) - 📱 Hamburguer Ativo';
            viewport.classList.add('ds-mobile-mode', 'ds-device-375');
        }

        currentDeviceKey = activeKey;

        var b1 = document.getElementById('btn_dev_' + activeKey);
        if (b1) b1.classList.add('active');
        var b2 = document.getElementById('bar_dev_' + activeKey);
        if (b2) b2.classList.add('active');

        var nameEl = document.getElementById('cur_device_name');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = devName;

        var curSec = getSelectedSection();
        if (curSec) {
            renderSectionStyleControls(curSec);
        }
        if (selectedBlockCoord) {
            renderInspector();
        }

        if (studioMode === 'live') {
            loadLiveStageContent();
        } else {
            renderCanvas();
        }
    }

    function setPreviewModalDevice(w) {
        var iframe = document.getElementById('preview_iframe');
        iframe.style.maxWidth = w;
        var badge = document.getElementById('preview_device_badge');
