    function inspectorTextInput(label, key, val, isResponsive) {
        var headerHtml = '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>';
        var oninputAttr = 'updateBlockProp(\'' + key + '\', this.value)';
        var inputVal = val;

        if (isResponsive) {
            var block = getSelectedBlock();
            headerHtml = renderResponsiveControlHeader(label, key, block);
            oninputAttr = 'updateBlockPropResponsive(\'' + key + '\', this.value); renderCanvas();';
            inputVal = getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key);
            if (inputVal === '' && key === 'text' && block && block.data) {
                inputVal = block.data.brand_text || block.data.text || '';
            }
        }

        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               headerHtml +
               '<input type="text" class="inspector-input" value="' + escapeAttr(inputVal) + '" oninput="' + oninputAttr + '">' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function inspectorInput(label, key, val, type) {
        var inputType = type || 'text';
        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>' +
               '<input type="' + escapeAttr(inputType) + '" class="inspector-input" value="' + escapeAttr(val) + '" oninput="updateBlockProp(\'' + key + '\', this.value)">' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function updateMobileBehavior(val) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var block = getSelectedBlock();
        if (!block) return;
        if (!block.data) block.data = {};
        if (val === 'absorb') {
            block.data.absorb_in_mobile = true;
            block.data.hide_mobile = false;
            block.data.hide_375 = false;
        } else if (val === 'keep') {
            block.data.absorb_in_mobile = false;
            block.data.hide_mobile = false;
            block.data.hide_375 = false;
        } else if (val === 'hide') {
            block.data.absorb_in_mobile = false;
            block.data.hide_mobile = true;
            block.data.hide_375 = true;
        }
        renderCanvas();
        renderInspector();
    }

    function inspectorMobileDrawerControl(block) {
        if (!block || (block.type !== 'user_auth' && block.type !== 'button' && block.type !== 'cta_button')) {
            return '';
        }
        var curBehavior = 'absorb';
        if (block.data.hide_mobile || block.data.hide_375) {
            curBehavior = 'hide';
        } else if (block.data.absorb_in_mobile === false) {
            curBehavior = 'keep';
        }

        return '<div class="inspector-field" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56,189,248,0.08), rgba(2,132,199,0.04)); border:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.3); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; margin:14px 0;">' +
               '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label" style="color:var(--primary); font-weight:700; margin:0; font-size:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">📱 Encaixe no Menu Mobile (Hambúrguer)</label>' +
               '<span style="font-size:9.5px; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color:#38bdf8; font-weight:700;">Pronto</span>' +
               '</div>' +
               '<div style="font-size:11px; color:#cbd5e1; margin-bottom:8px; line-height:1.4;">Ao abrir o menu hambúrguer ☰ em celulares e tablets, este bloco pode se encaixar automaticamente no popup da gaveta:</div>' +
               '<select class="inspector-select" onchange="updateMobileBehavior(this.value)" style="margin-bottom:8px; font-weight:600;">' +
               '<option value="absorb"' + (curBehavior === 'absorb' ? ' selected' : '') + '>📱 Encaixar dentro da Gaveta Mobile (Padrão Recomendado)</option>' +
               '<option value="keep"' + (curBehavior === 'keep' ? ' selected' : '') + '>👁️ Manter Fixo na Barra Superior (Cabeçalho)</option>' +
               '<option value="hide"' + (curBehavior === 'hide' ? ' selected' : '') + '>🚫 Ocultar Totalmente no Celular</option>' +
               '</select>' +
               '<div style="font-size:10.5px; color:var(--text-muted); line-height:1.4; padding:6px 8px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.25); border-radius:6px; border-left:3px solid var(--primary); margin-bottom:10px;">' +
               (curBehavior === 'absorb'
                   ? '⚡ <strong>Encaixado na Gaveta:</strong> O botão sai do topo e aparece com largura total dentro do popup ao tocar no hambúrguer ☰.'
                   : (curBehavior === 'keep'
                       ? '👁️ <strong>Fixo no Topo:</strong> Permanece visível na barra de topo ao lado do logotipo e do botão hambúrguer.'
                       : '🚫 <strong>Oculto:</strong> O botão não será renderizado em telas de celular ou tablet.')) +
               '</div>' +
               '<button type="button" class="header-btn" onclick="testMobileDrawer()" style="width:100%; justify-content:center; padding:7px 12px; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.18); border:1px solid var(--primary); color:#fff; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer;">👁️ Visualizar / Testar no Menu Hambúrguer</button>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function inspectorCheckbox(label, key, isChecked) {

    function inspectorTextarea(label, key, val) {
        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>' +

    function inspectorSelect(label, key, options, curVal, isResponsive) {
        var opts = options.map(function(o) {
            var val = (typeof o === 'object') ? o.value : o;
            var text = (typeof o === 'object') ? o.label : o;
            return '<option value="' + escapeAttr(val) + '"' + (String(val) === String(curVal) ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + escapeHtml(text) + '</option>';
        }).join('');
        
        var headerHtml = '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>';
        var onchangeAttr = 'updateBlockProp(\'' + key + '\', this.value); renderCanvas(); renderInspector();';

        if (isResponsive) {
            var block = getSelectedBlock();
            headerHtml = renderResponsiveControlHeader(label, key, block);
            onchangeAttr = 'updateBlockPropResponsive(\'' + key + '\', this.value); renderCanvas(); renderInspector();';
        }

        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               headerHtml +
               '<select class="inspector-select" onchange="' + onchangeAttr + '">' + opts + '</select>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function updateBlockDimensionValue(key, numStr, unitStr, isResp) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var block = getSelectedBlock();
        if (!block) return;
        var cleanNum = String(numStr !== undefined && numStr !== null ? numStr : '').trim().replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '');
        var fullVal = '';
        if (cleanNum !== '') {
            var unit = unitStr || 'px';
            fullVal = cleanNum + unit;
        }

        if (isResp && currentDeviceKey !== 'desktop') {
            updateBlockPropResponsive(key, fullVal);
        } else {
            updateBlockProp(key, fullVal);
        }
        renderCanvas();
    }

    function inspectorDimension(label, key, val, isResponsive) {
        var rawVal = String(val || '').trim();
        var num = rawVal.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '');
        var unit = rawVal.replace(/[0-9.-]/g, '').trim() || 'px';
        if (['px', '%', 'rem', 'em', 'vw', 'vh'].indexOf(unit) === -1) {
            unit = 'px';
        }

        var headerHtml = '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>';
        var respParam = isResponsive ? 'true' : 'false';

        if (isResponsive) {
            var block = getSelectedBlock();
            headerHtml = renderResponsiveControlHeader(label, key, block);
            var respVal = getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key);
            if (respVal !== undefined && respVal !== '') {
                rawVal = String(respVal).trim();
                num = rawVal.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, '');
                unit = rawVal.replace(/[0-9.-]/g, '').trim() || 'px';
                if (['px', '%', 'rem', 'em', 'vw', 'vh'].indexOf(unit) === -1) {
                    unit = 'px';
                }
            }
        }

        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               headerHtml +
               '<div class="dimension-row">' +
               '<input type="number" step="any" class="inspector-input" value="' + escapeAttr(num) + '" placeholder="0" ' +
               'oninput="updateBlockDimensionValue(\'' + key + '\', this.value, this.nextElementSibling.value, ' + respParam + ')">' +
               '<select class="inspector-select" ' +
               'onchange="updateBlockDimensionValue(\'' + key + '\', this.previousElementSibling.value, this.value, ' + respParam + ')">' +
               '<option value="px"' + (unit === 'px' ? ' selected' : '') + '>px</option>' +
               '<option value="%"' + (unit === '%' ? ' selected' : '') + '>%</option>' +
               '<option value="rem"' + (unit === 'rem' ? ' selected' : '') + '>rem</option>' +
               '<option value="em"' + (unit === 'em' ? ' selected' : '') + '>em</option>' +
               '<option value="vw"' + (unit === 'vw' ? ' selected' : '') + '>vw</option>' +
               '<option value="vh"' + (unit === 'vh' ? ' selected' : '') + '>vh</option>' +
               '</select>' +
               '</div>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function applyUnitToBlockPropResponsive(key, newUnit) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        var curVal = getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key) || '16';
        var num = String(curVal).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') || '16';
        updateBlockPropResponsive(key, num + newUnit);
        renderInspector();
    }

    function inspectorShortcodeSelector(label, key, curVal) {
        var opts = '<option value="">-- Escolha um Shortcode --</option>';
        shortcodesList.forEach(function(sc) {
            var tag = '[' + sc + ']';
            opts += '<option value="' + tag + '"' + (tag === curVal ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + tag + '</option>';
        });
        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>' +
               '<select class="inspector-select" onchange="updateBlockProp(\'' + key + '\', this.value)">' + opts + '</select>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function inspectorMenuSelector(label, key, curVal) {
        var headerMenu = menusList.find(function(m) { return m.location === 'header'; }) || menusList[0] || null;
        var effectiveVal = curVal ? String(curVal) : (headerMenu ? String(headerMenu.id) : '');
        var opts = '<option value=""' + (!effectiveVal ? ' selected' : '') + '>-- Padrão: Menu Principal (Header) --</option>';
        menusList.forEach(function(m) {
            var locLabel = m.location ? ' (' + m.location + ')' : '';
            opts += '<option value="' + m.id + '"' + (String(m.id) === effectiveVal ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + escapeHtml(m.name + locLabel) + '</option>';
        });
        return '<div class="inspector-field">' +
               '<label class="inspector-label">' + label + '</label>' +
               '<select class="inspector-select" onchange="updateBlockProp(\'' + key + '\', this.value); renderCanvas(); renderInspector();">' + opts + '</select>' +
               '</div>';
    }

    function inspectorSocialIconsRepeater(block) {
        var rawNetworks = block.data.networks || [
            { network: 'instagram', url: 'https://instagram.com' },
            { network: 'whatsapp', url: 'https://wa.me/5511999999999' },
            { network: 'youtube', url: 'https://youtube.com' }
        ];

        var list = [];
        if (Array.isArray(rawNetworks)) {
            list = rawNetworks;
        } else if (typeof rawNetworks === 'object' && rawNetworks !== null) {
            for (var k in rawNetworks) {
                list.push({ network: k, url: rawNetworks[k] });
            }
        }
        block.data.networks = list;

        var availableNetworks = [
            { id: 'whatsapp', label: '💬 WhatsApp' },
            { id: 'instagram', label: '📸 Instagram' },
            { id: 'youtube', label: '🎥 YouTube' },
            { id: 'linkedin', label: '💼 LinkedIn' },
            { id: 'facebook', label: '👥 Facebook' },
            { id: 'x', label: '✖️ X (Twitter)' },
            { id: 'tiktok', label: '🎵 TikTok' },
            { id: 'github', label: '🐙 GitHub' },
            { id: 'telegram', label: '✈️ Telegram' },
            { id: 'email', label: '✉️ Email' },
            { id: 'phone', label: '📞 Telefone' },
            { id: 'website', label: '🌐 Website Geral' }
        ];

        var out = '<div class="inspector-field" style="margin-top:16px;">' +
                  '<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px;">' +
                  '<label class="inspector-label" style="margin-bottom:0; font-weight:700; color:var(--primary);">🔗 Redes Sociais Conectadas</label>' +
                  '<button type="button" class="header-btn" onclick="addSocialIconItem()" style="font-size:10px; padding:2px 8px; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); border-color:var(--primary); color:var(--primary);">➕ Adicionar</button>' +
                  '</div>';

        if (list.length === 0) {
            out += '<div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted); text-align:center; padding:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border-radius:6px;">Nenhuma rede adicionada. Clique em Adicionar acima.</div>';
        } else {
            out += '<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;">';
            list.forEach(function(item, idx) {
                var netSelect = '<select class="inspector-select" style="width:130px; font-size:11px; padding:4px 6px;" onchange="updateSocialIconItem(' + idx + ', \'network\', this.value)">';
                availableNetworks.forEach(function(an) {
                    netSelect += '<option value="' + an.id + '"' + (item.network === an.id ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + an.label + '</option>';
                });
                netSelect += '</select>';

                out += '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius:6px; padding:6px 8px;">' +
                       netSelect +
                       '<input type="text" class="inspector-input" style="flex:1; font-size:11px; padding:4px 8px;" value="' + escapeAttr(item.url || '') + '" placeholder="https://..." oninput="updateSocialIconItem(' + idx + ', \'url\', this.value)">' +
                       '<button type="button" class="block-act-btn del" onclick="removeSocialIconItem(' + idx + ')" title="Remover rede" style="width:24px; height:24px; line-height:22px; font-size:11px;">✕</button>' +
                       '</div>';
            });
            out += '</div>';
        }

        out += '</div>';
        return out;
    }

    function addSocialIconItem() {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (!block.data) block.data = {};
        if (!Array.isArray(block.data.networks)) block.data.networks = [];
        block.data.networks.push({ network: 'instagram', url: 'https://instagram.com' });
        renderCanvas();
        renderInspector();
    }

    function removeSocialIconItem(idx) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (block.data && Array.isArray(block.data.networks)) {
            block.data.networks.splice(idx, 1);
            renderCanvas();
            renderInspector();
        }
    }

    function updateSocialIconItem(idx, key, val) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (block.data && Array.isArray(block.data.networks) && block.data.networks[idx]) {
            block.data.networks[idx][key] = val;
            renderCanvas();
        }
    }

    function updateBlockProp(key, val) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        if (!block.data) block.data = {};

        var nonResponsiveKeys = ['_id', 'type', 'menu_id', 'code', 'tag', 'action_type', 'toggle_style', 'toggle_align', 'absorb_in_mobile', 'url', 'image_url'];
        var isResp = (currentDeviceKey !== 'desktop') && (nonResponsiveKeys.indexOf(key) === -1);

        if (isResp) {
            var targetKey = getResponsivePropKey(key, currentDeviceKey);
            if (val === '' || val === null || val === undefined) {
                delete block.data[targetKey];
            } else {
                block.data[targetKey] = val;
            }
        } else {
            block.data[key] = val;
        }

        if ((key === 'url' || key === 'image_url') && val) {
            block.data[key] = val;
        }

        if (key === 'border_color') {
            compileElemBorder(block);
        }
        if (key === 'toggle_style') {
            state.mobile_toggle_style = val;
            var partSetting = document.getElementById('setting_mobile_toggle');
            if (partSetting) partSetting.value = val;
        }
        if (key === 'toggle_align') {
            state.mobile_toggle_align = val;
            var alignSetting = document.getElementById('setting_mobile_toggle_align');
            if (alignSetting) alignSetting.value = val;
        }
        renderCanvas();
        if (isEditorMobileDrawerOpen) {
            renderEditorMobileDrawerOverlay(true);
        }
    }

    function applyUnitToBlockProp(key, newUnit) {
        if (!selectedBlockCoord) return;
        var sec = state.sections[selectedBlockCoord.sec];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col]) return;
        var block = sec.columns_data[selectedBlockCoord.col][selectedBlockCoord.blockIdx];
        var curVal = getBlockResponsiveValue(block, key) || (block.data && block.data[key]) || '16';
        var num = String(curVal).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') || '16';
        updateBlockProp(key, num + newUnit);
        renderInspector();
    }

    function getDefaultBlockData(type) {
        var defaultData = {};
        if (type === 'heading') defaultData = { text: 'Novo Título', level: 'h2', font: 'secondary' };
        if (type === 'paragraph') defaultData = { text: 'Insira seu texto explicativo aqui.', font_size: '1rem' };
        if (type === 'cta_button') defaultData = { label: 'Saiba Mais', url: '#', variant: 'primary', absorb_in_mobile: true };
        if (type === 'user_auth') defaultData = { login_text: 'Entrar', login_url: '/aluno/login', register_text: 'Cadastrar', register_url: '/aluno/cadastro', dashboard_text: '🎓 Área do Aluno', dashboard_url: '/aluno/painel', logout_text: 'Sair', logout_url: '/aluno/logout', align: 'right', absorb_in_mobile: true };
        if (type === 'logo') defaultData = { text: 'DomainSystem', height: '36px', flex_direction: 'row', flex_direction_mobile: 'row' };
        if (type === 'divider') defaultData = { style: 'solid', height: '24px' };
        if (type === 'copyright') defaultData = { site_name: 'Domain-System' };
        if (type === 'button') defaultData = { label: 'Clique Aqui', action_type: 'link', url: '#', bg_color: 'var(--color-primary)', text_color: '#0f172a', hover_animation: 'lift', border_radius: '8px', align: 'left', absorb_in_mobile: true };
        if (type === 'social_icons') defaultData = {
            networks: [
                { network: 'instagram', url: 'https://instagram.com' },
                { network: 'whatsapp', url: 'https://wa.me/5511999999999' },
                { network: 'youtube', url: 'https://youtube.com' }
            ],
            shape: 'circle',
            color_mode: 'official',
            hover_animation: 'lift',
            align: 'center',
            gap: '12px',
            icon_size: '20px',
            button_size: '40px'
        };
        if (type === 'nav_menu') defaultData = { toggle_style: state.mobile_toggle_style || 'classic', toggle_align: state.mobile_toggle_align || 'right', align: 'center' };
        return defaultData;
    }

    function checkBlockAllowedInPart(type) {
        var curPartType = '<?= $part->getType() ?>';
        var bMeta = blocksCatalog.find(function(x) { return x.type === type; });
        if (!bMeta) return true;
        if (bMeta.allowed_types && bMeta.allowed_types.length > 0) {
            if (bMeta.allowed_types.indexOf(curPartType) === -1) {
                var blockName = bMeta.name || type;
                var partLabel = (curPartType === 'header') ? 'Header (Cabeçalho)' : ((curPartType === 'footer') ? 'Footer (Rodapé)' : 'esta área');
                showToast('🔒 O bloco "' + blockName + '" não é permitido no ' + partLabel + '. Use seções de página/Hero para vídeos.', 'error');
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    function addBlockToCell(secIdx, colIdx, type) {
        if (!checkBlockAllowedInPart(type)) return;
        var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
        if (!sec) return;
        if (!sec.columns_data[colIdx]) sec.columns_data[colIdx] = [];
        var defaultData = getDefaultBlockData(type);
        sec.columns_data[colIdx].push({ type: type, data: defaultData });
        activeSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeColIdx = colIdx;
        selectBlock(secIdx, colIdx, sec.columns_data[colIdx].length - 1);
        renderCanvas();
        renderLayersTree();
        showToast('Bloco adicionado à Célula ' + (colIdx + 1));
    }

    function insertBlockAtCell(secIdx, colIdx, blockIdx, type) {
        if (!checkBlockAllowedInPart(type)) return;
        var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
        if (!sec) return;
        if (!sec.columns_data[colIdx]) sec.columns_data[colIdx] = [];
        var defaultData = getDefaultBlockData(type);
        sec.columns_data[colIdx].splice(blockIdx, 0, { type: type, data: defaultData });
        activeSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeColIdx = colIdx;
        selectBlock(secIdx, colIdx, blockIdx);
        renderCanvas();
        renderLayersTree();
        showToast('Bloco inserido na Célula ' + (colIdx + 1));
    }

    function moveBlockInCell(secIdx, colIdx, blockIdx, dir, e) {
        if (e && typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
        var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[colIdx]) return;
        var list = sec.columns_data[colIdx];
        var targetIdx = blockIdx + dir;
        if (targetIdx >= 0 && targetIdx < list.length) {
            var item = list.splice(blockIdx, 1)[0];
            list.splice(targetIdx, 0, item);
            selectBlock(secIdx, colIdx, targetIdx);
            renderLayersTree();
        }
    }

    function duplicateBlockInCell(secIdx, colIdx, blockIdx, e) {
        if (e && typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
        var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
        if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[colIdx]) return;
        var item = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sec.columns_data[colIdx][blockIdx]));
        sec.columns_data[colIdx].splice(blockIdx + 1, 0, item);
        renderCanvas();
        renderLayersTree();
        renderSectionStyleControls(sec);
        showToast('Bloco duplicado!');
    }

    function deleteBlockInCell(secIdx, colIdx, blockIdx, e) {
        if (e && typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
        if (confirm('Deseja excluir este bloco?')) {
            var sec = state.sections[secIdx];
            if (!sec || !sec.columns_data[colIdx]) return;
            sec.columns_data[colIdx].splice(blockIdx, 1);
            selectedBlockCoord = null;
            renderCanvas();
            renderInspector();
            renderLayersTree();
            renderSectionStyleControls(sec);
            showToast('Bloco removido.');
        }
    }

    function moveBlockAcrossSecs(fromSec, fromCol, fromIdx, toSec, toCol, toIdx) {
        var sFrom = state.sections[fromSec];
        var sTo = state.sections[toSec];
        if (!sFrom || !sFrom.columns_data[fromCol] || !sFrom.columns_data[fromCol][fromIdx]) return;
        if (!sTo) return;
        if (!sTo.columns_data[toCol]) sTo.columns_data[toCol] = [];

        var item = sFrom.columns_data[fromCol].splice(fromIdx, 1)[0];
        if (toIdx === null || toIdx === undefined || toIdx >= sTo.columns_data[toCol].length) {
            sTo.columns_data[toCol].push(item);
            selectBlock(toSec, toCol, sTo.columns_data[toCol].length - 1);
        } else {
            sTo.columns_data[toCol].splice(toIdx, 0, item);
            selectBlock(toSec, toCol, toIdx);
        }
        activeSecIdx = toSec;
        activeColIdx = toCol;
        renderCanvas();
        renderLayersTree();
        showToast('Bloco reposicionado!');
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       MODAL DE SELEÇÃO RÁPIDA DE BLOCOS (QUICK ADD BLOCK)
       ========================================================================== */
    var currentQuickCategory = 'all';

    function openAddBlockForCell(secIdx, colIdx) {
        activeSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeColIdx = colIdx;
        selectionType = 'column';
        renderCanvas();
        renderBlocksCatalog();
        openQuickBlockModal(secIdx, colIdx);
    }

    function openQuickBlockModal(secIdx, colIdx) {
        activeSecIdx = secIdx;
        activeColIdx = colIdx;

        var sec = state.sections[secIdx] || {};
        var presetInfo = presets[sec.layout_preset] || presets['1_col'];
        var colTitle = getColumnTitle(sec.layout_preset, colIdx, presetInfo.columns, sec);
        var secTitle = sec.title || ('Seção ' + (secIdx + 1));

        var titleEl = document.getElementById('quick_add_block_title');
        if (titleEl) {
            titleEl.innerHTML = 'Adicionar Bloco na <strong style="color:var(--primary);">' + escapeHtml(colTitle) + '</strong> (' + escapeHtml(secTitle) + ')';
        }

        currentQuickCategory = 'all';
        var searchInput = document.getElementById('quick_block_search_input');
        if (searchInput) {
            searchInput.value = '';
        }

        var pills = document.querySelectorAll('#quick_block_category_pills .quick-cat-btn');
        pills.forEach(function(p, i) { p.classList.toggle('active', i === 0); });

        renderQuickBlocksGrid('');

        var modal = document.getElementById('modalQuickAddBlock');
        if (modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (searchInput) searchInput.focus();
            }, 80);
        }
    }

    function closeQuickBlockModal() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('modalQuickAddBlock');
        if (modal) {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function setQuickBlockCategory(cat, btn) {
        currentQuickCategory = cat;
        var pills = document.querySelectorAll('#quick_block_category_pills .quick-cat-btn');
        pills.forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
        if (btn) btn.classList.add('active');

        var searchInput = document.getElementById('quick_block_search_input');
        renderQuickBlocksGrid(searchInput ? searchInput.value : '');
    }

    function filterQuickBlocks(query) {
        renderQuickBlocksGrid(query);
    }

    function categorizeBlockType(type) {
        if (type === 'heading' || type === 'text' || type === 'paragraph' || type === 'callout') return 'text';
        if (type === 'image' || type === 'video' || type === 'logo' || type === 'pdf') return 'media';
        if (type === 'button' || type === 'cta_button' || type === 'cta' || type === 'user_auth' || type === 'auth') return 'action';
        if (type === 'card' || type === 'accordion' || type === 'social' || type === 'social_icons' || type === 'shortcode' || type === 'nav_menu' || type === 'menu' || type === 'blog_posts') return 'interactive';
        return 'other';
    }

    function renderQuickBlocksGrid(query) {
        var grid = document.getElementById('quick_blocks_grid');
        if (!grid) return;
        grid.innerHTML = '';

        var q = (query || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        var curPartType = '<?= $part->getType() ?>';

        var filtered = blocksCatalog.filter(function(b) {
            if (currentQuickCategory !== 'all') {
                var blockCat = categorizeBlockType(b.type);
                if (blockCat !== currentQuickCategory) return false;
            }

            if (q !== '') {
                var nameMatch = (b.name || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
                var descMatch = (b.desc || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
                var typeMatch = (b.type || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
                if (!nameMatch && !descMatch && !typeMatch) return false;
            }

            return true;
        });

        if (filtered.length === 0) {
            grid.innerHTML = '<div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 30px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px;">' +
                             'Nenhum bloco encontrado para os filtros selecionados.' +
                             '</div>';
            return;
        }

        filtered.forEach(function(b) {
            var isDisallowed = (b.allowed_types && b.allowed_types.indexOf(curPartType) === -1);
            var item = document.createElement('div');
            item.className = 'quick-block-card' + (isDisallowed ? ' disallowed-in-part' : '');
            if (isDisallowed) {
                item.style.opacity = '0.5';
                item.style.border = '1px dashed rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4)';
            }
            item.onclick = function() {
                if (isDisallowed) {
                    checkBlockAllowedInPart(b.type);
                    return;
                }
                addBlockToCell(activeSecIdx, activeColIdx, b.type);
                closeQuickBlockModal();
            };
            var badgeLock = isDisallowed ? ' <span style="font-size:10px; color:#ef4444; font-weight:700;">🔒 Restrito</span>' : '';
            item.innerHTML = '<div class="quick-block-icon">' + b.icon + '</div>' +
                             '<div class="quick-block-name">' + escapeHtml(b.name) + badgeLock + '</div>' +
                             '<div class="quick-block-desc">' + escapeHtml(b.desc) + '</div>';
            grid.appendChild(item);
        });
    }

    function savePart() {
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_save');
        btn.textContent = 'Salvando...';
        btn.disabled = true;

        if (!state.sections || state.sections.length === 0) {
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar';
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert('Adicione ao menos uma seção com divisórias antes de salvar.');
            return;
        }

        state.title = document.getElementById('part_title_input').value || state.title;
        var assignedTheme = document.getElementById('setting_assigned_theme').value;

        // Mantém sincronizada a raiz da parte com a primeira seção para retrocompatibilidade
        var firstSec = state.sections[0] || {};
        state.layout_preset = firstSec.layout_preset || '3_cols_header';
        state.container_settings = firstSec.container_settings || {};
        state.columns_data = firstSec.columns_data || {};

        var payload = {
            csrf_token: csrfToken,
            id: state.id,
            type: state.type,
            title: state.title,
            layout_preset: state.layout_preset,
            container_settings: state.container_settings,
            columns_data: state.columns_data,
            sections: state.sections,
            mobile_toggle_style: state.mobile_toggle_style || 'classic',
            mobile_toggle_align: state.mobile_toggle_align || 'right',
            is_default: !!state.is_default,
            assigned_theme: assignedTheme,
            assigned_template: document.getElementById('setting_assigned_template') ? document.getElementById('setting_assigned_template').value : ''
        };

        fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/save-part', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 
                'Content-Type': 'application/json', 
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        })
        .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
        .then(function(data) {
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar';
            btn.disabled = false;
            if (data.success) {
                var templateChoice = document.getElementById('setting_assigned_template') ? document.getElementById('setting_assigned_template').value : '';
                showToast('✓ ' + data.message);
                if (state.type === 'section') {
                    showSaveSuccessModal(state.title, '[section id="' + state.id + '"]', templateChoice);
                }
            } else {
                alert('Erro ao salvar: ' + (data.message || 'Erro desconhecido'));
            }
        })
        .catch(function(err) {
            btn.textContent = '💾 Salvar';
            btn.disabled = false;
            alert('Falha na requisição: ' + err);
        });
    }

    function toggleLivePreviewModal() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('previewModal');
        if (modal.style.display === 'none') {
            modal.style.display = 'block';
            var previewPayload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
            previewPayload.csrf_token = csrfToken;
            previewPayload.sections = state.sections;

            fetch('<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/preview', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(previewPayload)
            })
            .then(function(res) { return res.text(); })
            .then(function(html) {
                var iframe = document.getElementById('preview_iframe');
                iframe.srcdoc = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"><style>body{margin:0;padding:20px;background:#06090e;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;} a{cursor:pointer !important;}</style></head><body>' + html + getPreviewGuardScript() + '</body></html>';
            });
        } else {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    var _dsToastTimer = null;
    function showToast(msg, type) {
        var toast = document.getElementById('toast');
        if (!toast) return;
        toast.textContent = msg;
        if (type === 'error' || type === 'warning') {
            toast.style.background = '#dc2626';
            toast.style.color = '#ffffff';
            toast.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
        } else {
            toast.style.background = '#10b981';
            toast.style.color = '#000000';
            toast.style.border = 'none';
        }
        toast.style.display = 'block';
        if (_dsToastTimer) clearTimeout(_dsToastTimer);
        _dsToastTimer = setTimeout(function() { toast.style.display = 'none'; }, 3800);
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
        return String(str || '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }
    function escapeAttr(str) {
        return String(str || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
    }

        function copyStudioShortcode(btn) {
        var sc = (state.type === 'section') ? '[section id="' + state.id + '"]' : ('[theme_part id="' + state.id + '"]');
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(sc).then(function() {
                showToast('✓ Shortcode ' + sc + ' copiado! Cole na página que preferir (menu Páginas).');
                if (btn) {
                    var orig = btn.innerHTML;
                    btn.innerHTML = '✓ Copiado!';
                    btn.style.color = '#10b981';
                    setTimeout(function() { btn.innerHTML = orig; btn.style.color = '#38bdf8'; }, 2000);
                }
            });
        } else {
            prompt('Copie o shortcode da seção:', sc);
        }
    }

    function showSaveSuccessModal(title, shortcode, assignedTemplate) {
        var modal = document.getElementById('saveSuccessModal');
        if (!modal) return;

        document.getElementById('save_success_title').textContent = title || 'Seção';
        document.getElementById('save_success_sc_code').textContent = shortcode;
        
        var tNotice = document.getElementById('save_success_template_notice');
        if (assignedTemplate && assignedTemplate !== 'none') {
            tNotice.style.display = 'block';
            tNotice.innerHTML = '🎯 <strong>Atribuição Direta:</strong> Esta seção está vinculada ao template <code>' + escapeHtml(assignedTemplate) + '.php</code> e substituirá o conteúdo da página automaticamente!';
        } else {
            tNotice.style.display = 'none';
        }

        modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function copyModalShortcode() {
        var sc = document.getElementById('save_success_sc_code').textContent;
        var btn = document.getElementById('btn_modal_copy_sc');
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(sc).then(function() {
                var orig = btn.innerHTML;
                btn.innerHTML = '✓ Copiado!';
                btn.style.background = '#10b981';
                btn.style.color = '#000';
                setTimeout(function() { btn.innerHTML = orig; btn.style.background = ''; btn.style.color = ''; }, 2000);
            });
        } else {
            prompt('Copie o shortcode abaixo:', sc);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initStudio);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeQuickBlockModal();
        }
    });
    </script>

<script>
function copyShortcode(text, btn) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {
            showCopyFeedback(btn);
        }).catch(function() {
            fallbackCopy(text, btn);
        });
    } else {
        fallbackCopy(text, btn);
    }
}

function fallbackCopy(text, btn) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try {
        document.execCommand('copy');
        showCopyFeedback(btn);
    } catch(e) {
        prompt('Copie o shortcode abaixo:', text);
    }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
}

function showCopyFeedback(btn) {
    if (!btn) return;
    var origText = btn.innerHTML;
    btn.innerHTML = '✓ Copiado!';
    btn.style.setProperty('background', '#065f46', 'important');
    btn.style.setProperty('border-color', '#10b981', 'important');
    btn.style.setProperty('color', '#ecfdf5', 'important');
    setTimeout(function() {
        btn.innerHTML = origText;
        btn.style.setProperty('background', '#238636', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('border-color', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)', 'important');
        btn.style.setProperty('color', '#fff', 'important');
    }, 2000);
}

function assignTemplateSection(sectionId, templateSlug) {
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/assign';

    var csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= htmlspecialchars($csrfToken ?? "") ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);

    var themeInput = document.createElement('input');
    themeInput.type = 'hidden';
    themeInput.name = 'theme_folder';
    themeInput.value = '<?= htmlspecialchars($activeTheme ?? "default") ?>';
    form.appendChild(themeInput);

    var typeInput = document.createElement('input');
    typeInput.type = 'hidden';
    typeInput.name = 'part_type';
    typeInput.value = (templateSlug === 'none' || !templateSlug) ? 'template:none' : ('template:' + templateSlug);
    form.appendChild(typeInput);

    var idInput = document.createElement('input');
    idInput.type = 'hidden';
    idInput.name = 'part_id';
    idInput.value = (templateSlug === 'none' || !templateSlug) ? 'none' : sectionId;
    form.appendChild(idInput);

    var secInput = document.createElement('input');
    secInput.type = 'hidden';
    secInput.name = 'section_id';
    secInput.value = sectionId;
    form.appendChild(secInput);

    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}

function deletePart(id) {
    if (!confirm('Deseja realmente excluir esta parte de tema?')) return;
    
    var form = document.createElement('form');
    form.method = 'POST';
    form.action = '<?= $baseUrl ?>/admin/builder/delete-part';

    var csrfInput = document.createElement('input');
    csrfInput.type = 'hidden';
    csrfInput.name = 'csrf_token';
    csrfInput.value = '<?= htmlspecialchars($csrfToken ?? '') ?>';
    form.appendChild(csrfInput);
    
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'hidden';
    input.name = 'id';
    input.value = id;
    
    form.appendChild(input);
    document.body.appendChild(form);
    form.submit();
}

window.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var dropdown = document.getElementById('dropdownCreate');
    if (dropdown && !e.target.closest('.button-primary')) {
        dropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }
});
</script>

function updateColorPicker(key, val) {
    if (/^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$/.test(val)) {
        document.getElementById('color_picker_' + key).value = val;
    }
    applyPreviewTokens();
}

    applyPreviewTokens();

function applyPreviewTokens() {
    var primary    = document.getElementById('color_text_primary').value;
    var secondary  = document.getElementById('color_text_secondary').value;
    var tertiary   = document.getElementById('color_text_tertiary').value;
    var background = document.getElementById('color_text_background').value;
    var surface    = document.getElementById('color_text_surface').value;
    var textMain   = document.getElementById('color_text_text_main').value;
    var textMuted  = document.getElementById('color_text_text_muted').value;

    var fontPrimary   = document.getElementById('input_font_primary').value || 'sans-serif';
    var fontSecondary = document.getElementById('input_font_secondary').value || 'sans-serif';

    var card = document.getElementById('tokens_preview_card');
    card.style.setProperty('background-color', surface, 'important');
    card.style.setProperty('font-family', fontPrimary + ', sans-serif', 'important');

    var previewHeading = document.getElementById('preview_heading');
    previewHeading.style.setProperty('color', textMain, 'important');
    previewHeading.style.setProperty('font-family', fontSecondary + ', sans-serif', 'important');

    document.getElementById('preview_text_main').style.setProperty('color', textMain, 'important');
    document.getElementById('preview_text_muted').style.setProperty('color', textMuted, 'important');

    document.getElementById('preview_logo').style.setProperty('color', textMain, 'important');
    document.getElementById('preview_logo_primary').style.setProperty('color', primary, 'important');

    var badge = document.getElementById('preview_badge');
    badge.style.setProperty('background-color', tertiary, 'important');
    badge.style.setProperty('color', '#0f172a', 'important');

    var btnPri = document.getElementById('preview_btn_primary');
    btnPri.style.setProperty('background-color', primary, 'important');
    btnPri.style.setProperty('color', '#0f172a', 'important');

    var btnSec = document.getElementById('preview_btn_secondary');
    btnSec.style.setProperty('background-color', 'transparent', 'important');
    btnSec.style.setProperty('color', primary, 'important');
    btnSec.style.setProperty('border', '1px solid ' + primary, 'important');
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/pages/Controllers/PageAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Contracts\PageRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\JsonResponse;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\RedirectResponse;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Services\PageSlugHelper;

class PageAdminController
{
    private ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private PageRepositoryInterface $pageRepo;
    private SessionManagerInterface $session;

    public function __construct(ThemeManagerInterface $theme, PageRepositoryInterface $pageRepo, SessionManagerInterface $session)
    {
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->pageRepo = $pageRepo;
        $this->session = $session;
    }

    public function index()
    {
        $pages = $this->pageRepo->getAll();
        return $this->theme->render('admin_pages', ['pages' => $pages], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');
    }

    public function create()
    {
        $themes = $this->theme->getAvailableThemes();
        return $this->theme->render('admin_page_form', ['page' => null, 'available_themes' => $themes], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');
    }

    public function edit(string $id)
    {
        $page = $this->pageRepo->findById((int)$id);
        if (!$page) {
            return Response::redirect(\BASE_URL . '/admin/pages');
        }
        $themes = $this->theme->getAvailableThemes();
        return $this->theme->render('admin_page_form', ['page' => $page, 'available_themes' => $themes], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $id = $request->input('id');
        $title = $request->input('title');
        $content = $request->input('content', '');
        $theme = $request->input('theme');
        $template_file = $request->input('template_file');
        
                $manualSlug = $request->input('slug');

        if (empty($title)) {
            $this->session->setFlash('error', 'O Título é obrigatório.');
            return Response::redirect(\BASE_URL . '/admin/pages');
        }

        $rawSlug = !empty($manualSlug) ? (string)$manualSlug : (string)$title;
        $slug = PageSlugHelper::slugify($rawSlug);

        if (!empty($template_file) && empty($theme)) {
            $theme = 'default';
        }

        if ($id) {
            // Verificar colisão de slug na edição
            $exists = $this->pageRepo->findBySlug($slug);
            if ($exists && $exists['id'] != $id) {
                $slug = $slug . '-' . time();
            }

            $this->pageRepo->update((int)$id, [
                'title' => $title,
                'slug' => $slug,
                'content' => $content,
                'theme' => $theme,
                'template_file' => $template_file
            ]);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Página atualizada!');
        } else {
            $exists = $this->pageRepo->findBySlug($slug);
            if ($exists) {
                $slug = $slug . '-' . time();
            }

            $this->pageRepo->create([
                'title' => $title,
                'slug' => $slug,
                'content' => $content,
                'theme' => $theme,
                'template_file' => $template_file
            ]);
            $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Página criada!');
        }

        return Response::redirect(\BASE_URL . '/admin/pages');
    }

    public function getThemeFiles(Request $request)
    {
        $themeName = $request->input('theme');
        if (!$themeName) {
            return new JsonResponse([]);
        }
        
        $templates = $this->theme->getAvailableTemplates($themeName);
        $pages = $this->theme->getAvailablePages($themeName);
        
        $data = [
            'templates' => $templates,
            'pages' => $pages
        ];
        return new JsonResponse($data);
    }

    public function delete(string $id)
    {
        $this->pageRepo->delete((int)$id);
        $this->session->setFlash('success', 'Página excluída com sucesso!');
        return Response::redirect(\BASE_URL . '/admin/pages');
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/pages/Controllers/PageFrontController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageTreeRendererInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Contracts\PageRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\seo\Contracts\SeoManagerInterface;

class PageFrontController
{
    private PageRepositoryInterface $pageRepo;
    private ShortcodeManager $shortcodes;
    private SeoManagerInterface $seo;
    private ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager;
    private ?PageTreeRendererInterface $treeRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        PageRepositoryInterface $pageRepo,
        ShortcodeManager $shortcodes,
        SeoManagerInterface $seo,
        ThemeManagerInterface $themeManager,
        ?PageTreeRendererInterface $treeRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->pageRepo = $pageRepo;
        $this->shortcodes = $shortcodes;
        $this->seo = $seo;
        $this->themeManager = $themeManager;
        $this->treeRenderer = $treeRenderer;
    }

    public function show(string $slug)
    {
        $page = $this->pageRepo->findBySlug($slug);

        if (!$page) {
            return new Response("<h1>404 - Página não encontrada</h1><p>Buscando pelo slug: [" . htmlspecialchars($slug) . "]</p>", 404);
        }

        $this->seo->setTitle($page['title'] . ' | Rachid');
        $this->seo->setDescription(mb_substr(strip_tags($page['content'] ?? ''), 0, 150) . '...');

        $html = null;

        // Se a página tem um template PHP ou página estática linkada
        if (!empty($page['theme']) && !empty($page['template_file'])) {
            $themesBaseDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes';
            $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver($themesBaseDir);
            $themeRoot = $resolver->resolveThemePath((string)$page['theme']);
            $templateFile = $page['template_file'];

            // Backward compatibility: se não tiver prefixo, assume templates/
            if (!str_starts_with($templateFile, 'templates/') && !str_starts_with($templateFile, 'pages/')) {
                $templateFile = 'templates/' . $templateFile;
            }

            if (str_starts_with($templateFile, 'pages/')) {
                // MODO PÁGINA ESTÁTICA (Bypassa o renderizador de templates)
                $filePath = $themeRoot . '/' . $templateFile;
                if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
                    return new Response("<h1>404 - Arquivo estático não encontrado no tema</h1>", 404);
                }

                $realPath = realpath($filePath);
                $realThemeRoot = realpath($themeRoot);

                if (
                    $realPath === false
                    || $realThemeRoot === false
                    || !str_starts_with($realPath, rtrim($realThemeRoot, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)
                ) {
                    return new Response("<h1>403 - Tentativa de acesso inválido</h1>", 403);
                }

                ob_start();
                extract(['page' => $page], EXTR_SKIP);
                include $realPath;
                $html = ob_get_clean();
            } else {
                // MODO TEMPLATE (Usa o ThemeManager)
                $templateName = str_replace('templates/', '', preg_replace('/\.php$/', '', $templateFile));
                $templatesDir = $themeRoot . '/templates';
                $candidateFile = $templatesDir . '/' . basename($templateName) . '.php';

                if (file_exists($candidateFile)) {
                    try {
                        $html = $this->themeManager->render($templateName, ['page' => $page], $templatesDir);
                    } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                        $html = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if ($html === null) {
            // Renderiza o fallback de conteúdo de banco de dados
            if (!empty($page['content']) && str_starts_with(trim($page['content']), '[')) {
                $tree = json_decode($page['content'], true);
                if (is_array($tree)) {
                    if ($this->treeRenderer !== null) {
                        $html = $this->treeRenderer->renderTree($tree);
                    } else {
                        $html = $page['content'];
                    }
                } else {
                    $html = $page['content'];
                }
            } else {
                $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars($page['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
                $html = "<div class='container' style='padding: 60px 20px; min-height: 70vh;'>
                            <article class='glass-panel' style='padding: 40px; margin-top: 20px;'>
                                <h1 class='text-primary' style='font-size: 2.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(69, 243, 255, 0.2); padding-bottom: 20px; margin-bottom: 30px;'>{$safeTitle}</h1>
                                <div class='page-content' style='font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-main);'>
                                    {$page['content']}
                                </div>
                            </article>
                         </div>";
            }
        }

        // Processa os shortcodes no HTML final!
        $html = $this->shortcodes->parse($html);

        return new Response($html);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/pages/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\pages;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Controllers\PageAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Controllers\PageFrontController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    // ==========================================
    // 1. FASE DE NEGOCIAÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 2. FASE DE EXECUÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->bind(
            \DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Contracts\PageRepositoryInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Repositories\PageRepository::class
        );
        $runtime->bind(
            \DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Repositories\PageRepository::class
        );

        // Adiciona ao Menu do Painel
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function($menus, $role = 'admin') {
            if (in_array($role, ['admin', 'manager'])) {
                $menus[] = [
                    'title' => 'Páginas',
                    'url' => '/admin/pages',
                    'icon' => '📄'
                ];
            }
            return $menus;
        });

        // Rotas
        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            // Rotas do Painel
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/pages', [PageAdminController::class, 'index'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/pages/create', [PageAdminController::class, 'create'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/pages/edit/{id}', [PageAdminController::class, 'edit'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/pages/store', [PageAdminController::class, 'store'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/pages/delete/{id}', [PageAdminController::class, 'delete'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            
            // A rota de API para carregar os templates do tema dinamicamente!
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/pages/api/theme-files', [PageAdminController::class, 'getThemeFiles'], 'pages', ['admin', 'manager']);
            
            // Rota Pública (O site)
            // Alterado de /p/{slug} para /{slug} para URLs limpas (estilo WordPress)
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/{slug}', [PageFrontController::class, 'show']);
        });

        // ==================================================
        // 🛡️ SHORTCODE DE LINK BLINDADO
        // Ex: [url to="privacidade"] ou [url to="docs/index"]
        // ==================================================
        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function($manager) {
            $manager->add('url', function($attrs) {
                $to = $attrs['to'] ?? '';
                if (empty($to)) return '#';
                
                $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
                return $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($to, '/');
                
            }, 'Gera um link seguro para uma rota. Exemplo: href="[url to=\'sobre\']"', ['to' => 'Slug da página (ex: tutoriais)'], 'Páginas');
        });
    }

    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        try {
            $schema = $runtime->getLink('core.db.schema');
            $schema->create('pages', function ($table) {
                $table->id();
                $table->string('slug')->unique();
                $table->string('title');
                $table->text('content')->nullable();
                $table->string('theme')->nullable();
                $table->string('template_file')->nullable();
                $table->datetime('created_at')->nullable()->default('CURRENT_TIMESTAMP');
            });
            
            // Seed default pages
            $db = $runtime->getLink('core.db')->getPdo();
            \DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Services\DefaultPagesSeeder::seed($db);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {}
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/Plugins/pages/Repositories/PageRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Contracts\PageRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PDOException;
use PDO;

class PageRepository implements PageRepositoryInterface, PageLookupInterface
{
    private const ALLOWED_COLUMNS = [
        'id',
        'slug',
        'title',
        'content',
        'theme',
        'template_file',
        'created_at',
    ];

    private PDO $db;

    public function __construct(Connection|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->db = $connection instanceof Connection ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
    }

    private function validateColumns(array $data): void
    {
        if (empty($data)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Nenhum dado fornecido para persistência em pages.');
        }

        foreach (array_keys($data) as $col) {
            if (!in_array((string)$col, self::ALLOWED_COLUMNS, true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException("Coluna inválida não permitida em pages: {$col}");
            }
        }
    }

    public function getSelectablePages(): array
    {
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->query("SELECT id, title, slug FROM pages ORDER BY title ASC");
            return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function getAll(): array
    {
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->query("SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY created_at DESC");
            return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?array
    {
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->execute([":id" => $id]);
            $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            return $result ?: null;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function findBySlug(string $slug): ?array
    {
        try {
            $stmt = $this->db->prepare("SELECT * FROM pages WHERE slug = :slug LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->execute([":slug" => $slug]);
            $result = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
            return $result ?: null;
        } catch (PDOException $e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public function create(array $data): void
    {
        $this->validateColumns($data);
        $fields = implode(", ", array_keys($data));
        $placeholders = ":" . implode(", :", array_keys($data));
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("INSERT INTO pages ($fields) VALUES ($placeholders)");
        $params = [];
        foreach ($data as $k => $v) {
            $params[":$k"] = $v;
        }
        $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function update(int $id, array $data): void
    {
        $this->validateColumns($data);
        $sets = [];
        $params = [":id" => $id];
        foreach ($data as $k => $v) {
            $sets[] = "$k = :$k";
            $params[":$k"] = $v;
        }
        $setString = implode(", ", $sets);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("UPDATE pages SET $setString WHERE id = :id");
        $stmt->execute($params);
    }

    public function delete(int $id): void
    {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare("DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = :id");
        $stmt->execute([":id" => $id]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\pages\Services;

use PDO;

class DefaultPagesSeeder
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array{slug: string, title: string, content: string, theme: string, template_file: string}>
     */
    public static function getDefaultPages(): array
    {
        return [
            [
                'slug' => 'inicio',
                'title' => 'Início',
                'content' => '<h1>Bem-vindo ao Domain-System</h1><p>Página inicial do site oficial.</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/home.php',
            ],
            [
                'slug' => 'blog',
                'title' => 'Blog',
                'content' => '<h1>Blog & Artigos</h1><p>Últimas novidades, arquitetura de software e tecnologia.</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/blog.php',
            ],
            [
                'slug' => 'sobre',
                'title' => 'Sobre',
                'content' => '<h1>Sobre Mim</h1><p>Sou o criador do Domain-System OS, uma infraestrutura web modular pronta para o futuro.</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/sobre.php',
            ],
            [
                'slug' => 'privacidade',
                'title' => 'Privacidade',
                'content' => '<h1>Política de Privacidade</h1><p>Respeitamos sua privacidade e a segurança de seus dados pessoais.</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/privacidade.php',
            ],
            [
                'slug' => 'termos',
                'title' => 'Termos e Usos',
                'content' => '<h1>Termos e Condições de Uso</h1><p>Ao navegar em nosso ecossistema você concorda com nossos termos de uso.</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/termos.php',
            ],
            [
                'slug' => 'tutoriais',
                'title' => 'Tutoriais',
                'content' => '<h1>Central de Conhecimento e Cursos</h1><p>[hub_de_cursos]</p>',
                'theme' => 'default',
                'template_file' => 'templates/academy.php',
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Semeia as páginas padrão garantindo idempotência e compatibilidade cruzada (SQLite / MySQL).
     */
    public static function seed(PDO $pdo): int
    {
        $pages = self::getDefaultPages();
        $insertedCount = 0;

        $checkStmt = $pdo->prepare("SELECT id FROM pages WHERE slug = ?");
        $insertStmt = $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO pages (slug, title, content, theme, template_file) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");

        foreach ($pages as $p) {
            $checkStmt->execute([$p['slug']]);
            $existing = $checkStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

            if (!$existing) {
                $insertStmt->execute([
                    $p['slug'],
                    $p['title'],
                    $p['content'],
                    $p['theme'],
                    $p['template_file']
                ]);
                $insertedCount++;
            }
        }

        return $insertedCount;
    }
}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const themeSelect = document.getElementById('theme_select');
    const templateSelect = document.getElementById('template_select');
    const contentContainer = document.getElementById('content_container');
    const templateInfo = document.getElementById('template_info');
    const contentInfo = document.getElementById('content_info');
    const titleInput = document.getElementById('title_input');
    const slugInput = document.getElementById('slug_input');
    const slugSidebar = document.getElementById('slug_sidebar');
    const publishBtn = document.getElementById('publish_btn');
    const savedTemplate = '<?= $page["template_file"] ?? "" ?>';
    const isEditing = <?= $page ? 'true' : 'false' ?>;

    // Gera slug a partir do título (apenas para páginas novas)
    function generateSlug(text) {
        return text.toLowerCase()
            .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
            .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
            .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
    }

    titleInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        if (!isEditing) {
            const slug = generateSlug(this.value) || '...';
            if (slugInput) slugInput.value = slug;
            slugSidebar.textContent = slug;
        }
    });

    // Confirmação de publicação
    document.getElementById('page_form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
        const title = titleInput.value.trim();
        if (!title) {
            e.preventDefault();
            OS.notify('O título é obrigatório.', 'error');
            return;
        }
        
        const action = isEditing ? 'atualizar' : 'publicar';
        const usingTemplate = themeSelect.value && templateSelect.value;
        
        let msg = `Deseja ${action} a página "${title}"?\n\n`;
        msg += usingTemplate 
            ? `📄 Modo: Template PHP\n📁 Arquivo: ${templateSelect.value}` 
            : `✏️ Modo: Conteúdo do Editor`;
        msg += `\n🔗 Slug: /${slugPreview.textContent}`;
        
        if (!confirm(msg)) {
            e.preventDefault();
        }
    });

    // Carrega templates via AJAX
    function loadTemplates() {
        const theme = themeSelect.value;
        templateSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">Carregando...</option>';
        
        if (!theme) {
            templateSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Selecione um Tema Primeiro --</option>';
            updateMode();
            return;
        }

        fetch('<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/pages/api/theme-files?theme=' + encodeURIComponent(theme), {
                credentials: 'same-origin'
            })
            .then(res => {
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
                return res.json();
            })
            .then(files => {
                if (files.templates.length === 0 && files.pages.length === 0) {
                    templateSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">Nenhum template ou página encontrado</option>';
                } else {
                    templateSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Escolha um arquivo --</option>';
                    
                    if (files.templates.length > 0) {
                        const optgroupTpl = document.createElement('optgroup');
                        optgroupTpl.label = 'Templates Dinâmicos (templates/)';
                        files.templates.forEach(file => {
                            const opt = document.createElement('option');
                            opt.value = 'templates/' + file; // add prefix back for logic
                            opt.textContent = '📄 ' + file;
                            if (('templates/' + file) === savedTemplate || file === savedTemplate) opt.selected = true;
                            optgroupTpl.appendChild(opt);
                        });
                        templateSelect.appendChild(optgroupTpl);
                    }

                    if (files.pages.length > 0) {
                        const optgroupPg = document.createElement('optgroup');
                        optgroupPg.label = 'Páginas Estáticas (pages/)';
                        files.pages.forEach(file => {
                            const opt = document.createElement('option');
                            opt.value = file; // already has pages/ prefix
                            opt.textContent = '🔗 ' + file.replace('pages/', '');
                            if (file === savedTemplate) opt.selected = true;
                            optgroupPg.appendChild(opt);
                        });
                        templateSelect.appendChild(optgroupPg);
                    }
                }
                updateMode();
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error('Erro ao carregar arquivos do tema:', err);
                templateSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">❌ Erro ao carregar</option>';
            });
    }

    // Alterna visual entre Modo Template/Página e Modo Editor
    function updateMode() {
        const selectedValue = templateSelect.value;
        const usingTemplate = themeSelect.value && selectedValue !== '';
        
        if (usingTemplate) {
            contentContainer.style.opacity = '0.4';
            contentContainer.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            contentInfo.style.display = 'none';
            templateInfo.style.display = 'block';
            
            if (selectedValue.startsWith('pages/')) {
                templateInfo.innerHTML = '✅ <strong>Modo Arquivo Raw:</strong> Esta rota apontará diretamente para o arquivo estático selecionado. O banco de dados não injetará conteúdo.';
                templateInfo.style.background = 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.08)'; // orange theme
                templateInfo.style.borderColor = 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.2)';
            } else {
                templateInfo.innerHTML = '✅ <strong>Modo Template:</strong> Esta página injetará o conteúdo do banco de dados dentro do template PHP selecionado.';
                templateInfo.style.background = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.08)'; // green theme
                templateInfo.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0, 210, 132, 0.2)';
            }
        } else {
            contentContainer.style.opacity = '1';
            contentContainer.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            templateInfo.style.display = 'none';
            contentInfo.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }

    themeSelect.addEventListener('change', loadTemplates);
    templateSelect.addEventListener('change', updateMode);

    // Carrega templates se já existir um tema salvo
    if (themeSelect.value) {
        loadTemplates();
    }
});
</script>

                <th style="padding: 12px; text-align: left;">URL (Slug)</th>
                <th style="padding: 12px; text-align: center;">Ações</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            <?php if(empty($pages)): ?>
                <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:center; padding: 30px;">Nenhuma página criada ainda.</td></tr>
            <?php else: foreach($pages as $p): ?>
                <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                    <td style="padding: 12px; font-weight: bold;"><?= htmlspecialchars($p['title']) ?></td>
                    <td style="padding: 12px; color: #64748b;">/<?= htmlspecialchars($p['slug']) ?></td>
                    <td style="padding: 12px; text-align: center;">
                        <a href="<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/pages/edit/<?= $p['id'] ?>" style="color: #2563eb; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 15px;">Editar</a>
                        <a href="<?= BASE_URL ?>/<?= $p['slug'] ?>" target="_blank" style="color: #10b981; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 15px;">Ver Página ↗</a>
                        <form action="<?= BASE_URL ?>/admin/pages/delete/<?= $p['id'] ?>" method="POST" style="display:inline;" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); const f = this; OS.confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir esta página permanentemente?', () => f.submit());">
    <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="<?= $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '' ?>">
                            <button type="submit" style="background: none; border: none; color: #ef4444; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;">Excluir</button>
                        </form>
                    </td>
                </tr>
            <?php endforeach; endif; ?>
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\radio_online;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.identity');
        $os->listenHook('dashboard.register_widgets');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $identity = $runtime->getLink('core.identity');
        
        $runtime->onHook('dashboard.register_widgets', function($registry) use ($identity) {
            $registry->registerProvider(new RadioWidgetProvider($identity));
        });
    }

    public function activate(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        // Cria a permissão no Banco de Dados para ouvir rádio
        $runtime->registerCapability('radio.listen', 'Ouvir Rádio Online');
    }
}
