                    Página <strong style="color:#fff;"><?= (int)$page ?></strong> de <strong style="color:#fff;"><?= (int)$totalPages ?></strong>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px;">
                    <?php if ($page > 1): ?>
                        <a href="<?= $buildPageUrl($page - 1) ?>" class="btn" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; text-decoration: none;">&larr; Anterior</a>
                    <?php endif; ?>

                    <?php for ($p = 1; $p <= $totalPages; $p++): ?>
                        <?php if ($p == $page): ?>
                            <span style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; background: #38bdf8; color: #000; border-radius: 4px;"><?= $p ?></span>
                        <?php elseif ($p == 1 || $p == $totalPages || abs($p - $page) <= 2): ?>
                            <a href="<?= $buildPageUrl($p) ?>" class="btn" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #fff; text-decoration: none;"><?= $p ?></a>
                        <?php elseif (abs($p - $page) == 3): ?>
                            <span style="padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b;">...</span>
                        <?php endif; ?>
                    <?php endfor; ?>

                    <?php if ($page < $totalPages): ?>
                        <a href="<?= $buildPageUrl($page + 1) ?>" class="btn" style="padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; text-decoration: none;">Próxima &rarr;</a>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                </div>
            </div>
        <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
</div>


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/installer/Contracts/InstallerServiceInterface.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Contracts;

/**
 * Contrato de serviço para o instalador do sistema (SOLID - DIP / N-3).
 */
interface InstallerServiceInterface
{
    public function getOrCreateSetupToken(): string;

    public function regenerateSetupToken(): string;

    public function validateSetupToken(string $inputToken): bool;

    public function checkRequirements(): array;

    public function testConnection(string $driver, string $host, string $port, string $dbname, string $user, string $pass): array;

    public function writeEnvFile(string $dsn, string $user, string $pass): void;
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/installer/Controllers/SetupController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ContainerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PasswordPolicyInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\LinkRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsConnector;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\OsRuntime;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\PluginManager;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;

/**
 * Wizard de instalação.
 *
 * Cada etapa é ISOLADA: qualquer falha vira uma mensagem na própria tela do
 * wizard (e uma linha em temp/install.log) em vez de explodir como
 * "Falha de Núcleo Interceptada".
 */
class SetupController
{
    private PluginManager $manager;
    private ContainerInterface $container;
    private \DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Contracts\InstallerServiceInterface $service;

    /** Tabelas sem as quais o sistema não sobe (criadas por SystemApps\auth). */
    private const ESSENTIAL_TABLES = ['users', 'roles', 'user_roles', 'capabilities'];

    public function __construct(
        PluginManager $manager,
        ContainerInterface $container,
        \DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Contracts\InstallerServiceInterface $service
    ) {
        $this->manager = $manager;
        $this->container = $container;
        $this->service = $service;
    }

    public function step1(Request $request): Response
    {
        \DomainSystem\Core\Bootstrap\RuntimeDirectories::ensure(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT);
        $infoMessage = null;

        if ($request->input('action') === 'regenerate_token') {
            try {
                $this->service->regenerateSetupToken();
                $infoMessage = 'Token gerado/atualizado com sucesso no servidor! Lembre-se: no Gerenciador de Arquivos da Hostinger/cPanel, recarregue a lista (ícone 🔄 ou F5) para a pasta "token" aparecer.';
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', $e->getMessage());
            }
        } else {
            try {
                $this->service->getOrCreateSetupToken();
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', $e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        $tokenExists = file_exists(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/token/setup.token');

        return $this->renderStep('step1', null, [
            'tokenExists' => $tokenExists,
            'infoMessage' => $infoMessage,
        ]);
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // PASSO 1 → 2: valida o servidor, testa a conexão e grava o .env
    // =====================================================================
    public function step2_database(Request $request): Response
    {
        $token = $request->input('setup_token', '');
        
        if (!$this->service->validateSetupToken($token)) {
            return $this->renderStep('step1', 'O Setup Token inserido é inválido. Verifique o arquivo token/setup.token.');
        }

        if ($this->preflight()) {
            return $this->renderStep('step1', 'O servidor não atende aos requisitos listados acima. Corrija e tente novamente.');
        }

        $driver = $request->input('db_driver') === 'sqlite' ? 'sqlite' : 'mysql';
        $host   = trim((string) $request->input('db_host', 'localhost'));
        $port   = trim((string) $request->input('db_port', '3306'));
        $name   = trim((string) $request->input('db_name', ''));
        $user   = trim((string) $request->input('db_user', ''));
        $pass   = (string) $request->input('db_pass', '');

        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            if (!extension_loaded('pdo_sqlite')) {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', 'A extensão PHP pdo_sqlite não está habilitada neste servidor.');
            }
        } else {
            if (!extension_loaded('pdo_mysql')) {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', 'A extensão PHP pdo_mysql não está habilitada.');
            }
            if ($name === '' || $user === '') {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', 'Informe o nome do banco e o usuário do banco.');
            }
        }

        try {
            // Delega a montagem e teste da conexão
            $result = $this->service->testConnection($driver, $host, $port, $name, $user, $pass);
            $dsn = $result['dsn'];
        } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            return $this->renderStep('step1', $e->getMessage());
        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            $this->log('step2-conexao', $e);
            return $this->renderStep('step1', 'Falha na conexão: ' . $this->explainPdoError($e));
        }

        // 2) Grava o .env de forma segura
        try {
            $this->service->writeEnvFile($dsn, $user, $pass);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            return $this->renderStep('step1', $e->getMessage());
        }

        // 3) O que o bootstrap vai LER é igual ao que a pessoa digitou?
        //    Se não for, o sistema cairia silenciosamente no SQLite no próximo request.
        foreach (['DB_DSN' => $dsn, 'DB_USER' => $user, 'DB_PASS' => $pass] as $key => $expected) {
            if ($this->readEnvValue($key) !== $expected) {
                return $this->renderStep('step1', "O arquivo .env não conseguiu preservar o valor de {$key} (a senha contém caracteres que o .env não suporta?). Tente outra senha de banco.");
            }
        }

        // 4) Banco novo => o log de migrações do banco anterior não vale mais.
        //    (Antes isso era feito no passo 3, tarde demais: o boot daquele request já tinha pulado as migrações.)
        $migrations = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/migrations.json';
        if (file_exists($migrations)) {
            @unlink($migrations);
        }

        return $this->renderStep('step2');
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // PASSO 2 → fim: cria schema, administrador e trava o instalador
    // =====================================================================
    public function step3_install(Request $request): Response
    {
        $lockFile = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config/installed.lock';
        if (file_exists($lockFile)) {
            return Response::redirect(BASE_URL . '/admin');
        }

        $adminName  = trim((string) $request->input('admin_name', ''));
        $adminEmail = trim((string) $request->input('admin_email', ''));
        $adminPass  = (string) $request->input('admin_pass', '');

        // --- Etapa A: entrada do usuário -----------------------------------
        if ($adminName === '' || $adminEmail === '' || $adminPass === '') {
            return $this->renderStep('step2', 'Preencha todos os campos do administrador.');
        }
        if (!filter_var($adminEmail, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            return $this->renderStep('step2', 'E-mail inválido.');
        }
        $policy = $this->container->make(PasswordPolicyInterface::class);
        if (!$policy->isAcceptable($adminPass)) {
            return $this->renderStep('step2', 'Senha fraca. Faltando: ' . implode(', ', $policy->getMissingRequirements($adminPass)));
        }

        // --- Etapa B: o passo 1 foi realmente concluído? --------------------
        if (!file_exists(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/.env') || !getenv('DB_DSN')) {
            return $this->renderStep('step1', 'Configuração do banco não encontrada. Refaça o passo 1.');
        }
        try {
            $db = $this->container->make(Connection::class)->getPdo();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->log('step3-conexao', $e);
            return $this->renderStep('step1', 'Não foi possível conectar ao banco configurado: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }

        // --- Etapa C: schema (activate() de cada plugin) --------------------
        $failures = $this->activatePlugins();

        $missing = $this->missingTables($db, self::ESSENTIAL_TABLES);
        if ($missing) {
            $detail = $failures ? ' Detalhes: ' . implode(' | ', $failures) : ' Veja temp/install.log.';
            return $this->renderStep('step2', 'As tabelas essenciais não foram criadas (' . implode(', ', $missing) . ').' . $detail);
        }
        foreach ($failures as $plugin => $message) {
            // Plugins opcionais não impedem a instalação, mas ficam registrados.
            $this->log("activate:{$plugin}", new \RuntimeException($message));
        }

        // --- Etapa D: conta do administrador (transação) --------------------
        $skipLogin = false;
        try {
            $userId = $this->createAdmin($db, $adminName, $adminEmail, $adminPass);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            if (str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'existe neste banco')) {
                // Banco já tem administrador. Pula criação e login, mas finaliza instalação com sucesso.
                $skipLogin = true;
            } else {
                $this->log('step3-admin', $e);
                return $this->renderStep('step2', 'Não foi possível criar o administrador: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->log('step3-admin', $e);
            $msg = ($e instanceof \PDOException && ($e->errorInfo[0] ?? '') === '23000')
                ? 'Já existe um usuário com este e-mail.'
                : 'Não foi possível criar o administrador: ' . $e->getMessage();
            return $this->renderStep('step2', $msg);
        }

        // --- Etapa E: login automático (best-effort, não derruba a instalação)
        if (!$skipLogin) {
            try {
                $session = $this->container->make(SessionManagerInterface::class);
                $session->regenerate();
                $session->set('user_id', $userId);
                $session->set('user_name', $adminName);
                $session->set('user_role', 'admin');
                $session->remove('auth_error');
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $this->log('step3-login', $e);
            }
        }

        // --- Etapa F: trava o instalador -----------------------------------
        // Sem o lock, /setup continuaria aberto e qualquer um poderia trocar o admin.
        if (@file_put_contents($lockFile, date('Y-m-d H:i:s')) === false) {
            return $this->renderStep('step2', 'Instalação concluída, mas não foi possível criar config/installed.lock. Crie esse arquivo manualmente (vazio) antes de usar o sistema, senão o instalador continuará aberto.');
        }

        return $this->renderStep('success', null, ['existingAdmin' => $skipLogin]);
    }

    // =====================================================================
    // Internos
    // =====================================================================

    /**
     * Roda o activate() de cada plugin com um OsRuntime real.
     *
     * É o único ponto do sistema que cria o schema (users, roles, pages, settings...).
     * Replica a Fase 1 do PluginBootstrapper (osRegister → LinkRegistry) porque
     * OsRuntime::getLink() só libera links que o plugin declarou, e 'core.db.schema'
     * é fornecido pelo plugin Database.
     *
     * @return array<string,string> plugin => mensagem de erro
     */
    private function activatePlugins(): array
    {
        $failures = [];
        $rank = static function ($plugin): int {
            $class = get_class($plugin);
            if ($class === 'DomainSystem\\SystemApps\\auth\\Plugin') return 0; // cria users/roles/capabilities
            if (str_starts_with($class, 'DomainSystem\\SystemApps\\')) return 1;
            return 2; // plugins de usuário (dependem das tabelas acima)
        };

        $plugins = $this->manager->getPlugins();
        uasort($plugins, static fn($a, $b) => $rank($a) <=> $rank($b));

        $linkRegistry = new LinkRegistry($this->container);
        $dispatcher   = $this->container->make(EventDispatcherInterface::class);

        // Fase 1: manifestos (quem requer / quem fornece cada link)
        $connectors = [];
        foreach ($plugins as $name => $plugin) {
            $connector = new OsConnector();
            try {
                if ($plugin instanceof OsExtensionInterface) {
                    $plugin->osRegister($connector);
                    $linkRegistry->registerConnector($name, $connector);
                }
                $connectors[$name] = $connector;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $failures[$name] = 'osRegister: ' . $e->getMessage();
            }
        }

        // Fase 2: activate() na ordem de dependência
        foreach ($plugins as $name => $plugin) {
            if (!isset($connectors[$name])) continue;
            $namespace = implode('\\', array_slice(explode('\\', get_class($plugin)), 0, 3));
            $runtime = new OsRuntime($this->container, $connectors[$name], $linkRegistry, $dispatcher, $namespace);
            try {
                $plugin->activate($runtime);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $failures[$name] = 'activate: ' . $e->getMessage();
            }
        }

        return $failures;
    }

    /** Cria (ou substitui) o administrador e o vincula ao papel RBAC 'admin'. */
    private function createAdmin(\PDO $db, string $name, string $email, string $password): int
    {
        $db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            // SEGURANÇA CRÍTICA: Bloqueia a criação se já existir um admin!
            // Evita que um invasor ou um erro de lock resete o administrador.
            $existingAdmin = $db->query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' LIMIT 1")->fetchColumn();
            if ($existingAdmin) {
                throw new \RuntimeException("Um administrador já existe neste banco de dados. Instalação bloqueada por segurança.");
            }

            $stmt = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'admin')");
            $stmt->execute([$name, $email, password_hash($password, PASSWORD_BCRYPT)]);
            $userId = (int) $db->lastInsertId();

            // O ACL (IdentityManager::hasRole) lê user_roles, não users.role. A role foi semeada
            // em activate(), antes deste usuário existir; sem este vínculo o admin ficaria sem permissões.
            $roleId = $db->query("SELECT id FROM roles WHERE slug = 'admin'")->fetchColumn();
            if ($roleId) {
                $db->prepare("INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES (?, ?)")->execute([$userId, $roleId]);
            }

            $db->commit();
            return $userId;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($db->inTransaction()) {
                $db->rollBack();
            }
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    /** @return string[] tabelas que não existem */
    private function missingTables(\PDO $db, array $tables): array
    {
        $missing = [];
        foreach ($tables as $table) {
            try {
                $db->query("SELECT 1 FROM {$table} LIMIT 1");
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $missing[] = $table;
            }
        }
        return $missing;
    }

    /** Requisitos do servidor. Retorna a lista de problemas (vazia = tudo certo). */
    private function preflight(): array
    {
        $problems = [];
        if (PHP_VERSION_ID < 80000) {
            $problems[] = 'PHP 8.0 ou superior é necessário (versão atual: ' . PHP_VERSION . ').';
        }
        foreach (['pdo', 'mbstring', 'openssl', 'json'] as $ext) {
            if (!extension_loaded($ext)) {
                $problems[] = "Extensão PHP ausente: {$ext}.";
            }
        }

        $env = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/.env';
        if (file_exists($env) ? !is_writable($env) : !is_writable(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT)) {
            $problems[] = 'Sem permissão de escrita para criar/atualizar o arquivo .env na raiz do projeto.';
        }
        foreach (['config', 'temp'] as $dir) {
            $path = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/' . $dir;
            if (!is_dir($path) && !@mkdir($path, 0755, true)) {
                $problems[] = "Não foi possível criar a pasta /{$dir}.";
            } elseif (!is_writable($path)) {
                $problems[] = "A pasta /{$dir} não tem permissão de escrita.";
            }
        }
        return $problems;
    }

    /**
     * Atualiza/insere chaves no .env sem apagar as demais (APP_KEY, EMERGENCY_KEY, comentários...).
     *
     * @param array<string,string> $values        sempre gravadas
     * @param array<string,string> $onlyIfMissing gravadas apenas se a chave ainda não existir
     */
    private function writeEnv(array $values, array $onlyIfMissing = []): bool
    {
        $file  = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/.env';
        $lines = file_exists($file) ? preg_split('/\R/', rtrim((string) file_get_contents($file))) : [];
        if ($lines === [''] || $lines === false) {
            $lines = [];
        }

        $seen = [];
        foreach ($lines as $i => $line) {
            if (preg_match('/^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=/', $line, $m)) {
                $seen[$m[1]] = true;
                if (array_key_exists($m[1], $values)) {
                    $lines[$i] = $m[1] . '="' . $values[$m[1]] . '"';
                }
            }
        }
        foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
            if (!isset($seen[$key])) {
                $lines[] = $key . '="' . $value . '"';
            }
        }
        foreach ($onlyIfMissing as $key => $value) {
            if (!isset($seen[$key])) {
                $lines[] = $key . '="' . $value . '"';
            }
        }

        return @file_put_contents($file, implode(PHP_EOL, $lines) . PHP_EOL, LOCK_EX) !== false;
    }

    /** Lê uma chave do .env exatamente como o bootstrap.php faz (mantenha em sincronia). */
    private function readEnvValue(string $key): ?string
    {
        $vars = @parse_ini_file(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/.env', false, INI_SCANNER_RAW);
        if (!is_array($vars) || !array_key_exists($key, $vars)) {
            return null;
        }
        $value = (string) $vars[$key];
        if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && substr($value, -1) === $value[0]) {
            $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
        }
        return $value;
    }

    /** Traduz erros comuns do MySQL para algo acionável. */
    private function explainPdoError(\PDOException $e): string
    {
        $message = $e->getMessage();
        $code = preg_match('/\[(\d{4})\]/', $message, $m) ? (int) $m[1] : 0;

        $hint = match ($code) {
            1045 => 'Usuário ou senha do banco incorretos.',
            1049 => 'O banco informado não existe. Na Hostinger o nome costuma ter prefixo (ex.: u123456789_nome).',
            2002, 2003, 2006 => 'Não foi possível alcançar o servidor MySQL. Na Hostinger o host normalmente é "localhost".',
            default => '',
        };

        return $hint !== '' ? "{$hint} ({$message})" : $message;
    }

    private function renderStep(string $view, ?string $error = null, array $data = []): Response
    {
        $preflight = $this->preflight();
        extract($data);
        ob_start();
        include dirname(__DIR__) . '/views/' . $view . '.php';
        return new Response(ob_get_clean());
    }

    /** Registra a falha em temp/install.log (nunca grava senhas). */
    private function log(string $stage, \Throwable $e): void
    {
        $dir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp';
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            @mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }
        @file_put_contents(
            $dir . '/install.log',
            sprintf("[%s] [%s] %s: %s (%s:%d)\n", date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $stage, get_class($e), $e->getMessage(), basename($e->getFile()), $e->getLine()),
            FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX
        );
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/installer/Plugin.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Controllers\SetupController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    private bool $isInstalled = false;

    public function register(): void {}

    // ==========================================
    // 1. FASE DE NEGOCIAÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('router.before_dispatch');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // 2. FASE DE EXECUÇÃO (OS 2.0)
    // ==========================================
    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->singleton(
            \DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Contracts\InstallerServiceInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Services\InstallerService::class
        );

        // Verifica se o arquivo de proteção existe. Se não existir, MODO SETUP.
        if (file_exists(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config/installed.lock')) {
            $this->isInstalled = true;
        }

        if (!$this->isInstalled) {
            // Prioridade máxima (-1000) para barrar qualquer outro plugin (ex: SystemAdmin/Auth)
            $runtime->onHook('router.before_dispatch', function(string $uri) {
                // Permite apenas as rotas do setup
                if (!str_starts_with($uri, '/setup') && !str_starts_with($uri, '/assets')) {
                    $base = defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
                    throw new \DomainSystem\Core\Exceptions\HttpResponseException(
                        \DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::redirect($base . "/setup")
                    );
                }
            }, \DomainSystem\Core\Events\HookPriority::HIGHEST);

            $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
                $router->addRoute('GET', '/setup', [SetupController::class, 'step1']);
                $router->addRoute('POST', '/setup/database', [SetupController::class, 'step2_database']);
                $router->addRoute('POST', '/setup/install', [SetupController::class, 'step3_install']);
            });
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/installer/Services/InstallerService.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Services;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\installer\Contracts\InstallerServiceInterface;

class InstallerService implements InstallerServiceInterface
{
    private string $tokenFile;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->tokenFile = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/token/setup.token';
    }

    /**
     * Gera um token de segurança único para o Setup, garantindo que
     * apenas quem tem acesso aos arquivos (Hostinger/FTP) instale.
     */
    public function getOrCreateSetupToken(): string
    {
        if (file_exists($this->tokenFile)) {
            return trim(file_get_contents($this->tokenFile));
        }

        return $this->regenerateSetupToken();
    }

    /**
     * Força a criação ou recriação do token de instalação e garante a pasta/permissões.
     */
    public function regenerateSetupToken(): string
    {
        // Garante que a pasta existe
        $tokenDir = dirname($this->tokenFile);
        if (!is_dir($tokenDir)) {
            if (!@mkdir($tokenDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($tokenDir)) {
                throw new \RuntimeException("Não foi possível criar a pasta token/ no servidor. Verifique as permissões de escrita do diretório raiz.");
            }
            @file_put_contents($tokenDir . '/.htaccess', 'Deny from all');
        }

        // Gera um token no formato XXXX-XXXX
        $token = strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(2)) . '-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(2)));
        
        // Tenta salvar o token
        if (@file_put_contents($this->tokenFile, $token) === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Não foi possível gravar o arquivo token/setup.token. Verifique as permissões de escrita na pasta token/.");
        }

        return $token;
    }

    public function validateSetupToken(string $inputToken): bool
    {
        if (!file_exists($this->tokenFile)) {
            return false;
        }

        $realToken = trim(file_get_contents($this->tokenFile));
        return hash_equals($realToken, trim(strtoupper($inputToken)));
    }

    public function checkRequirements(): array
    {
        $reqs = [
            'php' => version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.0.0', '>='),
            'pdo' => extension_loaded('pdo'),
            'pdo_mysql' => extension_loaded('pdo_mysql'),
            'pdo_sqlite' => extension_loaded('pdo_sqlite'),
            'temp_writable' => is_writable(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp'),
            'config_writable' => is_writable(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config') || is_writable(dirname(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/config')),
        ];

        return $reqs;
    }

    public function testConnection(string $driver, string $host, string $port, string $dbname, string $user, string $pass): array
    {
        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            $dsn  = 'sqlite:' . DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/database.sqlite';
            $user = '';
            $pass = '';
        } else {
            // Validações básicas contra injeção de DSN
            if (!preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$/', $host)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Host inválido.");
            }
            if (!ctype_digit($port)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Porta inválida.");
            }
            if (!preg_match('/^[\w$-]+$/', $dbname)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Nome do banco inválido.");
            }
            $dsn = "mysql:host={$host};port={$port};dbname={$dbname};charset=utf8mb4";
        }

        try {
            $pdo = new \PDO($dsn, $user, $pass, [
                \PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => \PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                \PDO::ATTR_TIMEOUT => 5
            ]);
            return ['success' => true, 'pdo' => $pdo, 'dsn' => $dsn];
        } catch (\PDOException $e) {
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function writeEnvFile(string $dsn, string $user, string $pass): void
    {
        $envPath = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/.env';
        
        // Lê as variáveis existentes (para não apagar EMERGENCY_KEY ou APP_KEY)
        $existing = [];
        if (file_exists($envPath)) {
            $parsed = parse_ini_file($envPath, false, INI_SCANNER_RAW) ?: [];
            foreach ($parsed as $k => $v) {
                $existing[$k] = $v;
            }
        }
        
        // Sobrescreve apenas as de banco, estado inicial e tema
        $existing['DB_DSN'] = $dsn;
        $existing['DB_USER'] = $user;
        $existing['DB_PASS'] = $pass;
        $existing['SITE_STATUS'] = $existing['SITE_STATUS'] ?? 'coming_soon';
        $existing['ACTIVE_THEME'] = $existing['ACTIVE_THEME'] ?? '';
        
        // Garante a APP_KEY
        if (empty($existing['APP_KEY'])) {
            $existing['APP_KEY'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        }

        // Garante a EMERGENCY_KEY para chave de recuperação do sistema
        if (empty($existing['EMERGENCY_KEY'])) {
            $existing['EMERGENCY_KEY'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(24));
        }

        $lines = [];
        foreach ($existing as $k => $v) {
            // Remove aspas internas
            $v = trim($v, '"\'');
            $lines[] = "{$k}=\"{$v}\"";
        }
        
        if (file_put_contents($envPath, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n") === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Falha ao gravar arquivo .env. Verifique permissões na raiz do projeto.");
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts;

interface MenuRepositoryInterface
{
    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}>
     */
    public function getMenus(): array;

    /**
     * @return array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}|null
     */
    public function getMenuById(int $id): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array{id: int, name: string, location: string, created_at?: string}|null
     */
    public function getMenuByLocation(string $location): ?array;

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: int, menu_id: int, parent_id?: ?int, depth?: int, title: string, url: ?string, page_id: ?int, target?: string, css_classes?: ?string, order_index: int}>
     */
    public function getMenuItems(int $menuId): array;

    /**
     * Salva ou atualiza um menu.
     * @return array{success: bool, message: string, id?: int}
     */
    public function saveMenu(string $name, string $location, ?int $id = null): array;

    /**
     * Substitui itens de um menu de forma estritamente transacional (com rollback em falhas),
     * preservando a hierarquia de submenus (parent_id e depth).
     * @param array<int, array{id?: int|string, parent_id?: int|string|null, depth?: int, title: string, url?: ?string, page_id?: ?int, target?: string, css_classes?: ?string}> $items
     */
    public function replaceMenuItems(int $menuId, array $items): bool;

    /**
     * Exclui um menu e seus itens vinculados.
     */
    public function deleteMenu(int $id): bool;

    /**
     * Garante a existência das tabelas de menus e o auto-seed dos locais básicos ('header', 'footer').
     */
    public function ensureTables(): void;
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Controllers/MenuAdminController.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Controllers;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ResponseInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\MenuRenderer;

class MenuAdminController
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo;
    private ThemeManagerInterface $theme;
    private ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup;
    private ?MenuRenderer $menuRenderer;

    public function __construct(
        MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo,
        ThemeManagerInterface $theme,
        ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup = null,
        ?MenuRenderer $menuRenderer = null
    ) {
        $this->menuRepo = $menuRepo;
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->pageLookup = $pageLookup;
        $this->menuRenderer = $menuRenderer ?? new MenuRenderer($menuRepo, $pageLookup);
    }

    public function index(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $menus = $this->menuRepo->getMenus();

        $pages = $this->pageLookup !== null ? $this->pageLookup->getSelectablePages() : [];

        // Injeta a Home (Início) no topo para facilitar seleção pelo usuário
        array_unshift($pages, [
            'id' => null,
            'title' => 'Início (Home)',
            'slug' => '/',
            'is_home' => true
        ]);

        $activeMenuIdRaw = $request->input('menu_id');

        if ($activeMenuIdRaw === 'new') {
            $activeMenuId = null;
        } elseif ($activeMenuIdRaw) {
            $activeMenuId = (int)$activeMenuIdRaw;
        } else {
            // Prioriza sempre o Menu Principal (header) como padrão ao entrar na tela
            $headerMenuId = null;
            foreach ($menus as $m) {
                if (($m['location'] ?? '') === 'header') {
                    $headerMenuId = (int)$m['id'];
                    break;
                }
            }
            $activeMenuId = $headerMenuId ?? (isset($menus[0]['id']) ? (int)$menus[0]['id'] : null);
        }

        $menuItems = [];
        $activeMenu = null;
        if ($activeMenuId !== null) {
            $activeMenu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuById((int)$activeMenuId);
            if ($activeMenu !== null) {
                $menuItems = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems((int)$activeMenuId);
            }
        }

        $html = $this->theme->render('admin_menus', [
            'menus' => $menus,
            'pages' => $pages,
            'activeMenuId' => $activeMenuId,
            'activeMenu' => $activeMenu,
            'menuItems' => $menuItems
        ], dirname(__DIR__) . '/views');

        return new ViewResponse($html);
    }

    public function storeMenu(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $name = (string)$request->input('name', '');
        $location = (string)$request->input('location', '');
        $id = $request->input('id') ? (int)$request->input('id') : null;

        if (empty($name) || empty($location)) {
            return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Nome e Localização são obrigatórios.'], 400);
        }

        $result = $this->menuRepo->saveMenu($name, $location, $id);
        $status = $result['success'] ? 200 : 400;

        return Response::json($result, $status);
    }

    public function storeItems(Request $request): ResponseInterface
    {
        $menuId = $request->input('menu_id');
        $items = $request->input('items', []);

        if (!$menuId) {
            return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'ID do menu não informado.'], 400);
        }

        $success = $this->menuRepo->replaceMenuItems((int)$menuId, (array)$items);

        if ($success) {
            return Response::json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Estrutura do menu salva com sucesso!']);
        }

        return Response::json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Erro ao salvar a estrutura do menu.'], 500);
    }

    public function deleteMenu(Request $request, string $id): ResponseInterface
    {
        $this->menuRepo->deleteMenu((int)$id);
        return Response::json(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu excluído com sucesso.']);
    }

    /**
     * Mantido para compatibilidade com eventuais chamadas diretas legadas.
     */
    public function renderNavMenu(string $location): string
    {
        return $this->menuRenderer->render($location);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus;

use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\AbstractPlugin;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Router;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsExtensionInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsConnectorInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Repositories\PdoMenuRepository;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\MenuRenderer;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Controllers\MenuAdminController;

class Plugin extends AbstractPlugin implements OsExtensionInterface
{
    public function register(): void {}

    public function osRegister(OsConnectorInterface $os): void
    {
        $os->requireLink('core.db.schema');
        $os->requireLink('core.db');
        $os->listenHook('router.register');
        $os->listenHook('shortcodes.register');
        $os->listenHook('admin.menu');
    }

    public function osBoot(OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->bind(MenuRepositoryInterface::class, PdoMenuRepository::class);
        $runtime->bind(
            \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuTreeBuilderInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\MenuTreeBuilder::class
        );
        $runtime->bind(
            \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface::class,
            \DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services\NavMenuProviderAdapter::class
        );

        // Interceptar o menu admin para adicionar o submenu "Menus" em "Temas"
        // Prioridade 99 para rodar APÓS o SystemAdmin (que cria o item "Temas")
        $runtime->onHook('admin.menu', function($menus, $role = 'admin') {
            if ($role === 'admin' || $role === 'manager') {
                foreach ($menus as &$menu) {
                    if ($menu['title'] === 'Temas') {
                        if (!isset($menu['submenu'])) {
                            $menu['submenu'] = [];
                        }
                        $menu['submenu'][] = [
                            'title' => 'Menus (Navegação)',
                            'url' => '/admin/themes/menus',
                            'icon' => '<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"></line></svg>'
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }
            return $menus;
        }, 99);

        $runtime->onHook('router.register', function(Router $router) {
            // Rotas Admin para Menus
            $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/themes/menus', [MenuAdminController::class, 'index'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/store', [MenuAdminController::class, 'storeMenu'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/items', [MenuAdminController::class, 'storeItems'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
            $router->addRoute('POST', '/admin/themes/menus/delete/{id}', [MenuAdminController::class, 'deleteMenu'], 'nav_menus', ['admin']);
        });

        $runtime->onHook('shortcodes.register', function(\DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager $sm) use ($runtime) {
            // Shortcode desacoplado do controller admin
            $sm->add('nav_menu', function($attrs) use ($runtime) {
                $location = $attrs['location'] ?? 'header';
                $renderer = $runtime->make(MenuRenderer::class);
                return $renderer->render($location);
            }, 'Renderiza um menu criado no painel. Ex: [nav_menu location="header"]');
        });
    }

    public function activate(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\OsRuntimeInterface $runtime): void
    {
        $runtime->bind(MenuRepositoryInterface::class, PdoMenuRepository::class);
        $repo = $runtime->make(MenuRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repo->ensureTables();
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Repositories/PdoMenuRepository.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Repositories;

use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Connection;
use PDO;
use PDOException;
use Throwable;

class PdoMenuRepository implements MenuRepositoryInterface
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private bool $tablesEnsured = false;

    public function __construct(Connection|PDO $connection)
    {
        $this->pdo = $connection instanceof Connection ? $connection->getPdo() : $connection;
    }

    public function ensureTables(): void
    {
        if ($this->tablesEnsured) {
            return;
        }

        $driver = $this->pdo->getAttribute(PDO::ATTR_DRIVER_NAME);
        $autoIncrement = ($driver === 'sqlite') ? 'AUTOINCREMENT' : 'AUTO_INCREMENT';

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theme_menus (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY $autoIncrement,
                name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                location VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theme_menu_items (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY $autoIncrement,
                menu_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                parent_id INTEGER NULL,
                depth INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                url TEXT NULL,
                page_id INTEGER NULL,
                target VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT '_self',
                css_classes VARCHAR(255) NULL,
                order_index INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        // Auto-migração resiliente para bancos existentes que ainda não possuem as colunas de hierarquia
        $extraColumns = [
            'parent_id'   => 'INTEGER NULL',
            'depth'       => 'INTEGER DEFAULT 0',
            'target'      => "VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT '_self'",
            'css_classes' => 'VARCHAR(255) NULL',
        ];
        foreach ($extraColumns as $colName => $colDef) {
            try {
                $this->pdo->exec("ALTER TABLE theme_menu_items ADD COLUMN {$colName} {$colDef}");
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                // Coluna já existe
            }
        }

        // Auto-seed: locais padrão ('header' e 'footer')
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("SELECT location FROM theme_menus");
        $existing = $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN) : [];

        if (!in_array('header', $existing, true)) {
            $insert = $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)");
            $insert->execute(['Menu Principal', 'header']);
        }

        if (!in_array('footer', $existing, true)) {
            $insert = $this->pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)");
            $insert->execute(['Menu do Rodapé', 'footer']);
        }

        $this->tablesEnsured = true;
    }

    public function getMenus(): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->query("
            SELECT * FROM theme_menus
            ORDER BY CASE
                WHEN location = 'header' THEN 0
                WHEN location = 'footer' THEN 1
                ELSE 2
            END ASC, id ASC
        ");
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
    }

    public function getMenuById(int $id): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menus WHERE id = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$id]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getMenuByLocation(string $location): ?array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menus WHERE location = ?");
        $stmt->execute([$location]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $row ?: null;
    }

    public function getMenuItems(int $menuId): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ? ORDER BY order_index ASC");
        $stmt->execute([$menuId]);
        return $stmt ? $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) : [];
    }

    public function saveMenu(string $name, string $location, ?int $id = null): array
    {
        $this->ensureTables();
        $name = trim($name);
        $location = trim($location);

        if (empty($name) || empty($location)) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Nome e Localização são obrigatórios.'];
        }

        if ($id !== null && $id > 0) {
            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE theme_menus SET name = ?, location = ? WHERE id = ?');
            $stmt->execute([$name, $location, $id]);
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu atualizado com sucesso.', 'id' => $id];
        }

        $check = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT id FROM theme_menus WHERE location = ?');
        $check->execute([$location]);
        if ($check->fetch()) {
            return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Já existe um menu atribuído a esta localização.'];
        }

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO theme_menus (name, location) VALUES (?, ?)');
        $stmt->execute([$name, $location]);
        $newId = (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
        return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Menu criado com sucesso.', 'id' => $newId];
    }

    public function replaceMenuItems(int $menuId, array $items): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();

        $startedTransaction = false;
        if (!$this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            $startedTransaction = true;
        }

        try {
            $deleteStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ?');
            $deleteStmt->execute([$menuId]);

            if (!empty($items)) {
                $insertStmt = $this->pdo->prepare('
                    INSERT INTO theme_menu_items (menu_id, parent_id, depth, title, url, page_id, target, css_classes, order_index)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ');

                // Mapa de último ID inserido por nível de profundidade (para resolver parent_id via depth estilo wpNavMenu)
                /** @var array<int, int> $lastDbIdByDepth */
                $lastDbIdByDepth = [];
                // Mapa de temp_id/client_id -> db_id real
                /** @var array<string, int> $clientToDbId */
                $clientToDbId = [];

                foreach (array_values($items) as $index => $item) {
                    $title = trim((string)($item['title'] ?? ''));
                    if ($title === '') {
                        continue;
                    }
                    $url = !empty($item['url']) ? (string)$item['url'] : null;
                    $pageId = !empty($item['page_id']) ? (int)$item['page_id'] : null;
                    $depth = isset($item['depth']) ? max(0, (int)$item['depth']) : 0;
                    $target = in_array(($item['target'] ?? '_self'), ['_self', '_blank'], true)
                        ? (string)$item['target']
                        : '_self';
                    $cssClasses = !empty($item['css_classes']) ? trim((string)$item['css_classes']) : null;

                    $resolvedParentDbId = null;
                    $rawParentId = $item['parent_id'] ?? null;

                    if ($rawParentId !== null && $rawParentId !== '' && $rawParentId !== 0 && $rawParentId !== '0') {
                        $rawKey = (string)$rawParentId;
                        if (isset($clientToDbId[$rawKey])) {
                            $resolvedParentDbId = $clientToDbId[$rawKey];
                        } elseif (is_numeric($rawParentId) && (int)$rawParentId > 0) {
                            $resolvedParentDbId = (int)$rawParentId;
                        }
                    }

                    // Se não veio parent_id explícito mas depth > 0 (arraste horizontal wpNavMenu),
                    // vincula automaticamente ao último item de profundidade (depth - 1)
                    if ($resolvedParentDbId === null && $depth > 0) {
                        for ($d = $depth - 1; $d >= 0; $d--) {
                            if (isset($lastDbIdByDepth[$d])) {
                                $resolvedParentDbId = $lastDbIdByDepth[$d];
                                $depth = $d + 1;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if ($resolvedParentDbId === null) {
                            $depth = 0;
                        }
                    }

                    $insertStmt->execute([
                        $menuId,
                        $resolvedParentDbId,
                        $depth,
                        $title,
                        $url,
                        $pageId,
                        $target,
                        $cssClasses,
                        (int)$index
                    ]);

                    $insertedId = (int)$this->pdo->lastInsertId();
                    $lastDbIdByDepth[$depth] = $insertedId;
                    // Limpa níveis mais profundos que o atual para não herdar pais antigos
                    foreach (array_keys($lastDbIdByDepth) as $existingDepth) {
                        if ($existingDepth > $depth) {
                            unset($lastDbIdByDepth[$existingDepth]);
                        }
                    }

                    if (!empty($item['id'])) {
                        $clientToDbId[(string)$item['id']] = $insertedId;
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($startedTransaction) {
                $this->pdo->commit();
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            if ($startedTransaction && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function deleteMenu(int $id): bool
    {
        $this->ensureTables();

        $startedTransaction = false;
        if (!$this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
            $this->pdo->beginTransaction();
            $startedTransaction = true;
        }

        try {
            $stmtItems = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menu_items WHERE menu_id = ?');
            $stmtItems->execute([$id]);

            $stmtMenu = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM theme_menus WHERE id = ?');
            $stmtMenu->execute([$id]);

            if ($startedTransaction) {
                $this->pdo->commit();
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            if ($startedTransaction && $this->pdo->inTransaction()) {
                $this->pdo->rollBack();
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Services/MenuRenderer.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuTreeBuilderInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\MenuTreeBuilder;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;
use Throwable;

class MenuRenderer
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo;
    private ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup;
    private MenuTreeBuilderInterface $treeBuilder;

    public function __construct(
        MenuRepositoryInterface $menuRepo,
        ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup = null,
        ?MenuTreeBuilderInterface $treeBuilder = null
    ) {
        $this->menuRepo = $menuRepo;
        $this->pageLookup = $pageLookup;
        $this->treeBuilder = $treeBuilder ?? new MenuTreeBuilder();
    }

    public function render(string $location): string
    {
        try {
            $menu = $this->menuRepo->getMenuByLocation($location);
            if (!$menu) {
                return '';
            }

            $items = $this->menuRepo->getMenuItems((int)$menu['id']);
            if (empty($items)) {
                return '';
            }

            $pagesById = [];
            if ($this->pageLookup !== null) {
                $pages = $this->pageLookup->getSelectablePages();
                foreach ($pages as $p) {
                    $pagesById[(int)$p['id']] = (string)$p['slug'];
                }
            }

            $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? BASE_URL : '';
            $currentUri = (string)parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ?? '/', PHP_URL_PATH);

            $tree = $this->treeBuilder->buildTree($items);

            return '<ul class="nav-links" style="list-style: none; gap: 30px; display: flex; flex-direction: inherit; margin: 0; padding: 0;">'
                . $this->renderTreeNodes($tree, $pagesById, $baseUrl, $currentUri, 0)
                . '</ul>';
        } catch (Throwable $t) {
            return '';
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $nodes
     * @param array<int, string> $pagesById
     */
    private function renderTreeNodes(array $nodes, array $pagesById, string $baseUrl, string $currentUri, int $level): string
    {
        $html = '';
        foreach ($nodes as $item) {
            $pageId = !empty($item['page_id']) ? (int)$item['page_id'] : null;

            if ($pageId !== null && isset($pagesById[$pageId])) {
                $pageSlug = $pagesById[$pageId];
                $url = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($pageSlug, '/');
            } else {
                $rawUrl = (string)($item['url'] ?? '');
                if (str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'http://') || str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'https://') || str_starts_with($rawUrl, '#')) {
                    $url = $rawUrl;
                } elseif ($rawUrl === '/' || $rawUrl === '') {
                    $url = $baseUrl !== '' ? $baseUrl : '/';
                } else {
                    $url = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawUrl, '/');
                }
            }

            $path = parse_url($url, PHP_URL_PATH);
            $isActive = ($currentUri === $path) ? 'color: var(--primary);' : '';
            $safeUrl = htmlspecialchars($url, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $safeTitle = htmlspecialchars((string)$item['title'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            $targetAttr = (($item['target'] ?? '_self') === '_blank') ? ' target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"' : '';
            $children = !empty($item['children']) && is_array($item['children']) ? $item['children'] : [];
            $hasChildrenClass = !empty($children) ? ' menu-item-has-children' : '';
            $extraClasses = !empty($item['css_classes']) ? ' ' . htmlspecialchars((string)$item['css_classes'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';

            $html .= '<li class="menu-item' . $hasChildrenClass . $extraClasses . '" style="position: relative;">';
            $chevron = !empty($children) ? ' <span style="font-size:0.7em; opacity:0.75; margin-left:4px;">▾</span>' : '';
            $html .= '<a href="' . $safeUrl . '"' . $targetAttr . ' class="nav-link" style="' . $isActive . '">' . $safeTitle . $chevron . '</a>';

            if (!empty($children)) {
                $html .= '<ul class="sub-menu">'
                    . $this->renderTreeNodes($children, $pagesById, $baseUrl, $currentUri, $level + 1)
                    . '</ul>';
            }

            $html .= '</li>';
        }

        return $html;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/src/SystemApps/nav_menus/Services/NavMenuProviderAdapter.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Services;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\PageLookupInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MenuProviderInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\nav_menus\Contracts\MenuRepositoryInterface;

/**
 * Adaptador que conecta o repositório de nav_menus ao contrato Ring 0 MenuProviderInterface,
 * resolvendo URLs de páginas dinâmicas (PageLookupInterface) e preservando hierarquia de submenus.
 */
class NavMenuProviderAdapter implements MenuProviderInterface
{
    private MenuRepositoryInterface $repo;
    private ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup;

    public function __construct(MenuRepositoryInterface $repo, ?PageLookupInterface $pageLookup = null)
    {
        $this->repo = $repo;
        $this->pageLookup = $pageLookup;
    }

    public function getMenus(): array
    {
        try {
            return $this->repo->getMenus();
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    public function getMenuItems(string $location = 'header', ?int $menuId = null): array
    {
        try {
            $menu = null;
            if ($menuId !== null && $menuId > 0) {
                $menu = $this->repo->getMenuById($menuId);
            }
            if ($menu === null && $location !== '') {
                $menu = $this->repo->getMenuByLocation($location);
            }
            if ($menu !== null && isset($menu['id'])) {
                $rawItems = $this->repo->getMenuItems((int)$menu['id']);
                return $this->hydratePageUrls($rawItems);
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {}

        return [];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function hydratePageUrls(array $items): array
    {
        if (empty($items)) {
            return [];
        }

        $pagesById = [];
        if ($this->pageLookup !== null) {
            try {
                foreach ($this->pageLookup->getSelectablePages() as $p) {
                    if (isset($p['id'], $p['slug'])) {
                        $pagesById[(int)$p['id']] = (string)$p['slug'];
                    }
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
        }

        $baseUrl = defined('BASE_URL') ? (string)BASE_URL : '';

        foreach ($items as &$item) {
            $pageId = !empty($item['page_id']) ? (int)$item['page_id'] : null;
            $rawUrl = (string)($item['url'] ?? '');

            if ($pageId !== null && isset($pagesById[$pageId]) && ($rawUrl === '' || $rawUrl === '#')) {
                $slug = ltrim($pagesById[$pageId], '/');
                $item['url'] = $baseUrl . '/' . $slug;
            } elseif ($rawUrl !== '' && !str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'http://') && !str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'https://') && !str_starts_with($rawUrl, '#') && !str_starts_with($rawUrl, 'javascript:')) {
                if ($rawUrl === '/') {
                    $item['url'] = $baseUrl !== '' ? $baseUrl . '/' : '/';
                } elseif ($baseUrl !== '' && !str_starts_with($rawUrl, $baseUrl)) {
                    $item['url'] = $baseUrl . '/' . ltrim($rawUrl, '/');
                }
            }
        }
        unset($item);

        return $items;
    }
}
