<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@latest/Sortable.min.js"></script>
<script>
    const MENU_DEPTH_PX = 32;
    const MAX_MENU_DEPTH = 5;
    let dragStartX = 0;
    let dragStartDepth = 0;
    let draggedChildren = [];
    let itemCounter = 1000;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (!list) return;

        refreshHierarchyMetadata();

        new Sortable(list, {
            animation: 150,
            handle: '.menu-item-bar',
            ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
            onStart: function(evt) {
                const item = evt.item;
                dragStartX = (evt.originalEvent && evt.originalEvent.clientX) ? evt.originalEvent.clientX : 0;
                dragStartDepth = getItemDepth(item);
                // Coleta os sub-itens filhos para movê-los junto com o pai (igual ao childMenuItems do wpNavMenu)
                draggedChildren = getChildMenuItems(item);
                draggedChildren.forEach(ch => ch.classList.add('dragging-child- companion'));
            },
            onEnd: function(evt) {
                const item = evt.item;
                const endX = (evt.originalEvent && evt.originalEvent.clientX) ? evt.originalEvent.clientX : dragStartX;
                const deltaX = endX - dragStartX;
                const depthDelta = Math.round(deltaX / MENU_DEPTH_PX);

                // Reposiciona os filhos imediatamente abaixo do item pai na nova posição
                if (draggedChildren.length > 0) {
                    let refNode = item;
                    draggedChildren.forEach(ch => {
                        ch.classList.remove('dragging-child-companion');
                        refNode.after(ch);
                        refNode = ch;
                    });
                }

                if (depthDelta !== 0) {
                    setItemAndChildrenDepth(item, dragStartDepth + depthDelta);
                } else {
                    refreshHierarchyMetadata();
                }

                draggedChildren = [];
            }
        });
    });

    function getItemDepth(li) {
        return Math.max(0, parseInt(li.dataset.depth || '0', 10) || 0);
    }

    function setItemDepth(li, newDepth) {
        const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_MENU_DEPTH, newDepth));
        const prev = getItemDepth(li);
        li.classList.remove('menu-item-depth-' + prev);
        li.classList.add('menu-item-depth-' + clamped);
        li.dataset.depth = String(clamped);
        li.style.marginLeft = (clamped * MENU_DEPTH_PX) + 'px';
    }

    function getChildMenuItems(parentLi) {
        const children = [];
        const baseDepth = getItemDepth(parentLi);
        let next = parentLi.nextElementSibling;
        while (next && next.classList.contains('menu-item')) {
            if (getItemDepth(next) > baseDepth) {
                children.push(next);
                next = next.nextElementSibling;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return children;
    }

    function setItemAndChildrenDepth(li, targetDepth) {
        const curDepth = getItemDepth(li);
        const children = getChildMenuItems(li);
        const maxAllowed = getMaxAllowedDepthForItem(li);
        const finalDepth = Math.max(0, Math.min(maxAllowed, targetDepth));
        const diff = finalDepth - curDepth;

        setItemDepth(li, finalDepth);
        children.forEach(ch => {
            setItemDepth(ch, getItemDepth(ch) + diff);
        });

        refreshHierarchyMetadata();
    }

    function getMaxAllowedDepthForItem(li) {
        const prev = li.previousElementSibling;
        if (!prev || !prev.classList.contains('menu-item')) {
            return 0; // O primeiro item da lista sempre deve ser nível 0 (Raiz)
        }
        return Math.min(MAX_MENU_DEPTH, getItemDepth(prev) + 1);
    }

    function shiftItemDepth(btn, delta) {
        const li = btn.closest('.menu-item');
        if (!li) return;
        const cur = getItemDepth(li);
        setItemAndChildrenDepth(li, cur + delta);
    }

    function refreshHierarchyMetadata() {
        const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#menu-items-list .menu-item'));
        const lastItemByDepth = {};

        items.forEach((li, index) => {
            if (!li.dataset.itemId) {
                li.dataset.itemId = 'item_new_' + (++itemCounter);
            }

            let depth = getItemDepth(li);
            if (index === 0) {
                depth = 0;
            } else {
                const prevDepth = getItemDepth(items[index - 1]);
                if (depth > prevDepth + 1) {
                    depth = prevDepth + 1;
                }
            }
            setItemDepth(li, depth);

            const badge = li.querySelector('.is-submenu-badge');
            const hint = li.querySelector('.item-parent-hint');

            if (depth > 0 && lastItemByDepth[depth - 1]) {
                const parentLi = lastItemByDepth[depth - 1];
                li.dataset.parentId = parentLi.dataset.itemId;
                if (badge) {
                    badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
                    badge.textContent = '↳ Submenu' + (depth > 1 ? ' (Nível ' + depth + ')' : '');
                }
                if (hint) {
                    hint.textContent = 'de "' + (parentLi.dataset.title || 'Item') + '"';
                }
            } else {
                li.dataset.parentId = '0';
                if (badge) badge.style.display = 'none';
                if (hint) hint.textContent = '';
            }

            lastItemByDepth[depth] = li;
        });

        updateParentDropdowns(items);
    }

    function updateParentDropdowns(items) {
        items.forEach((li, idx) => {
            const select = li.querySelector('.edit-menu-item-parent');
            if (!select) return;
            const myId = li.dataset.itemId;
            const myParentId = li.dataset.parentId || '0';
            const myChildrenIds = new Set(getChildMenuItems(li).map(c => c.dataset.itemId));

            select.innerHTML = '<option value="0">— Item Principal (Sem Pai) —</option>';
            items.forEach(candidate => {
                const cId = candidate.dataset.itemId;
                if (cId === myId || myChildrenIds.has(cId)) return;
                const cDepth = getItemDepth(candidate);
                const prefix = '— '.repeat(cDepth);
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = cId;
                opt.textContent = prefix + (candidate.dataset.title || 'Item');
                if (cId === myParentId) opt.selected = true;
                select.appendChild(opt);
            });
        });
    }

    function onParentDropdownChange(selectEl) {
        const li = selectEl.closest('.menu-item');
        if (!li) return;
        const targetParentId = selectEl.value;
        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        const children = getChildMenuItems(li);

        if (!targetParentId || targetParentId === '0') {
            setItemAndChildrenDepth(li, 0);
            return;
        }

        const parentLi = list.querySelector(`.menu-item[data-item-id="${targetParentId}"]`);
        if (!parentLi) return;

        // Move o item (e seus filhos) para logo abaixo da subárvore do novo pai
        const parentSubtree = getChildMenuItems(parentLi);
        const insertAfterNode = parentSubtree.length > 0 ? parentSubtree[parentSubtree.length - 1] : parentLi;
        insertAfterNode.after(li);
        let ref = li;
        children.forEach(ch => {
            ref.after(ch);
            ref = ch;
        });

        setItemAndChildrenDepth(li, getItemDepth(parentLi) + 1);
    }

    function toggleItemSettings(btn) {
        const li = btn.closest('.menu-item');
        if (!li) return;
        const panel = li.querySelector('.menu-item-settings');
        if (!panel) return;
        const isOpen = panel.style.display !== 'none';
        panel.style.display = isOpen ? 'none' : 'block';
        btn.textContent = isOpen ? '▼ Editar' : '▲ Fechar';
    }

    function syncItemField(inputEl, fieldKey) {
        const li = inputEl.closest('.menu-item');
        if (!li) return;
        const val = inputEl.value;
        li.dataset[fieldKey] = val;
        if (fieldKey === 'title') {
            const titleStrong = li.querySelector('.item-title-display');
            if (titleStrong) titleStrong.textContent = val || 'Sem título';
            refreshHierarchyMetadata();
        }
    }

    function removeMenuItem(btn) {
        const li = btn.closest('.menu-item');
        if (!li) return;
        // Promove filhos diretos um nível acima antes de remover o pai (comportamento WordPress)
        const children = getChildMenuItems(li);
        children.forEach(ch => {
            setItemDepth(ch, Math.max(0, getItemDepth(ch) - 1));
        });
        li.remove();
        refreshHierarchyMetadata();
    }

    function buildMenuItemElement(data) {
        const id = 'item_new_' + (++itemCounter);
        const depth = Math.max(0, parseInt(data.depth || 0, 10));
        const title = data.title || 'Novo Item';
        const url = data.url || '/';
        const pageId = data.pageId || '';
        const target = data.target || '_self';
        const cssClasses = data.cssClasses || '';
        const typeLabel = pageId ? 'Página Dinâmica' : 'Link Personalizado';

        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'menu-item menu-item-depth-' + depth;
        li.dataset.itemId = id;
        li.dataset.parentId = '0';
        li.dataset.depth = String(depth);
        li.dataset.title = title;
        li.dataset.url = url;
        li.dataset.pageId = pageId;
        li.dataset.target = target;
        li.dataset.cssClasses = cssClasses;
        li.style.marginLeft = (depth * MENU_DEPTH_PX) + 'px';

        li.innerHTML = `
            <div class="menu-item-bar">
                <div class="menu-item-handle">
                    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <span class="drag-grip" title="Arraste para ordenar ou arraste para a direita para criar Submenu">⠿</span>
                        <strong class="item-title-display" style="color: #fff; font-size: 14px;"></strong>
                        <span class="is-submenu-badge" style="display:none;">↳ Submenu</span>
                        <span class="item-parent-hint" style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted);"></span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="menu-item-actions">
                        <span class="item-type-label">${typeLabel}</span>
                        <button type="button" class="indent-btn" onclick="shiftItemDepth(this, -1)" title="Recuar para a esquerda (Promover nível)">⬅️</button>
                        <button type="button" class="indent-btn" onclick="shiftItemDepth(this, 1)" title="Avançar para a direita (Tornar Submenu do item acima)">➡️</button>
                        <button type="button" class="edit-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleItemSettings(this)">▼ Editar</button>
                        <button type="button" class="delete-item-btn" onclick="removeMenuItem(this)" title="Remover item">✕</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="menu-item-settings" style="display: none;">
                <div class="settings-grid">
                    <div>
                        <label>Rótulo de Navegação (Título)</label>
                        <input type="text" class="edit-menu-item-title" oninput="syncItemField(this, 'title')">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label>URL / Link</label>
                        <input type="text" class="edit-menu-item-url" oninput="syncItemField(this, 'url')">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label>Item Pai (Hierarquia)</label>
                        <select class="edit-menu-item-parent" onchange="onParentDropdownChange(this)">
                            <option value="0">— Item Principal (Raiz) —</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label>Destino ao Clicar (Target)</label>
                        <select class="edit-menu-item-target" onchange="syncItemField(this, 'target')">
                            <option value="_self">Mesma Janela (_self)</option>
                            <option value="_blank">Nova Aba (_blank)</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
                        <label>Classes CSS Opcionais</label>
                        <input type="text" class="edit-menu-item-classes" placeholder="Ex: destaque-menu btn-nav" oninput="syncItemField(this, 'cssClasses')">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:10px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted);">
                    <span>Dica: Use ⬅️ e ➡️ ou arraste o bloco para a direita para criar submenus.</span>
                    <button type="button" style="background:transparent; border:none; color:#ef4444; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;" onclick="removeMenuItem(this)">🗑️ Remover Este Item</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;

        li.querySelector('.item-title-display').textContent = title;
        li.querySelector('.edit-menu-item-title').value = title;
        li.querySelector('.edit-menu-item-url').value = url;
        return li;
    }

    function addSelectedPages() {
        const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.page-checkbox:checked');
        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (!list) {
            OS.notify('Você precisa criar ou selecionar um menu antes de adicionar itens.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
            const title = cb.getAttribute('data-title') || 'Página';
            const pageId = cb.getAttribute('data-id') || '';
            const slug = cb.getAttribute('data-slug') || '/';
            const li = buildMenuItemElement({
                title: title,
                pageId: pageId,
                url: pageId ? ('/' + slug.replace(/^\/+/, '')) : slug,
                depth: 0
            });
            list.appendChild(li);
            cb.checked = false;
        });

        const selectAll = document.getElementById('select-all-pages-cb');
        if (selectAll) selectAll.checked = false;
        refreshHierarchyMetadata();
    }

    function addCustomLink() {
        const urlInput = document.getElementById('custom-link-url');
        const textInput = document.getElementById('custom-link-text');
        const depthSelect = document.getElementById('custom-link-as-sub');

        const url = urlInput.value.trim();
        const text = textInput.value.trim();
        const requestedDepth = depthSelect ? parseInt(depthSelect.value || '0', 10) : 0;

        if (!url || !text) {
            OS.notify('Preencha a URL e o texto do link.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const list = document.getElementById('menu-items-list');
        if (!list) {
            OS.notify('Você precisa criar ou selecionar um menu antes de adicionar itens.', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const li = buildMenuItemElement({
            title: text,
            pageId: '',
            url: url,
            depth: requestedDepth
        });
        list.appendChild(li);
        refreshHierarchyMetadata();

        urlInput.value = '#';
        textInput.value = '';
        if (depthSelect) depthSelect.value = '0';
    }

    async function saveMenuSettings(e, url) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const form = e.target;
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data = Object.fromEntries(formData.entries());
        const csrf = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]')?.value || '';

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrf
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(data)
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
                if (!data.id) {
                    setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '?menu_id=' + resData.id, 1000);
                }
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao salvar as configurações.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function saveMenuItems(url) {
        refreshHierarchyMetadata();
        const listItems = document.querySelectorAll('#menu-items-list .menu-item');
        const items = [];
        listItems.forEach(li => {
            items.push({
                id: li.dataset.itemId,
                parent_id: li.dataset.parentId && li.dataset.parentId !== '0' ? li.dataset.parentId : null,
                depth: getItemDepth(li),
                title: li.dataset.title,
                url: li.dataset.url,
                page_id: li.dataset.pageId,
                target: li.dataset.target || '_self',
                css_classes: li.dataset.cssClasses || ''
            });
        });

        const menuId = document.querySelector('input[name="menu_id"]').value;
        const csrf = document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]').value;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': csrf
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ menu_id: menuId, items: items, csrf_token: csrf })
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao salvar a estrutura do menu.', 'error');
        }
    }

    async function deleteMenuData(event, url) {
        const btn = event.currentTarget;
        if (!btn.dataset.confirmed) {
            OS.confirm('Tem certeza absoluta que deseja excluir este menu?', () => {
                btn.dataset.confirmed = 'true';
                btn.click();
            });
            return;
        }

        try {
            const response = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'X-CSRF-Token': document.querySelector('input[name="csrf_token"]').value
                }
            });
            const resData = await response.json();
            if (resData.success) {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'success');
                setTimeout(() => window.location.href = '?deleted=1', 1000);
            } else {
                OS.notify(resData.message, 'error');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            OS.notify('Erro ao excluir.', 'error');
        }
    }
</script>

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/FilesAreValidUtf8Test.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;

/**
 * Garante que todo arquivo PHP do projeto seja UTF-8 valido.
 * Bytes invalidos (ex.: "Configuraes" no lugar de "Configuracoes") quebram menus e JSON.
 */
final class FilesAreValidUtf8Test extends TestCase
{
    public function test_all_php_sources_are_valid_utf8(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $invalid = [];

        foreach (['src', 'themes'] as $dir) {
            $it = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator("$root/$dir", RecursiveDirectoryIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
            foreach ($it as $file) {
                if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!mb_check_encoding((string) file_get_contents($file->getPathname()), 'UTF-8')) {
                    $invalid[] = str_replace($root . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR, '', $file->getPathname());
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame([], $invalid, "Arquivos com bytes UTF-8 invalidos:\n" . implode("\n", $invalid));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/LayoutXssProtectionTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class LayoutXssProtectionTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAdminLayoutDoesNotUseInnerHTMLForMessages()
    {
        $layoutPath = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/themes/admin/layout.php';
        $this->assertFileExists($layoutPath);
        
        $content = file_get_contents($layoutPath);
        
        // Em addToHub, não podemos ter a variável message sendo interpolada dentro de innerHTML
        // Ex: item.innerHTML = `... ${message} ...`
        
        // Verifica se a função addToHub usa textContent para definir a mensagem
        $hasTextContent = strpos($content, ".textContent = message;") !== false || strpos($content, ".innerText = message;") !== false;
        
        $this->assertTrue(
            $hasTextContent, 
            'O arquivo layout.php está vulnerável a XSS. Ele deve usar textContent para injetar a variável "message" no DOM.'
        );
        
        // Adicionalmente, verificar se não há `${message}` logo após innerHTML
        preg_match('/innerHTML\s*=\s*`[^`]*\$\{message\}[^`]*`/i', $content, $matches);
        $this->assertEmpty($matches, 'Foi detectada injeção direta da variável message via innerHTML (Risco de XSS).');
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class NoBinariesTrackedTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testNoBinariesAreTrackedInGit()
    {
        exec('git ls-files', $output, $returnVar);
        
        $this->assertEquals(0, $returnVar, "Git command failed");

        $violations = [];
        foreach ($output as $file) {
            if (preg_match('/\.(phar|zip|sqlite|env)$/i', $file)) {
                $violations[] = $file;
            }
        }

        $this->assertEmpty(
            $violations, 
            "The following binaries or sensitive files are tracked in Git, which is a security/hygiene risk:\n" . implode("\n", $violations)
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/NoExitOrHeaderTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class NoExitOrHeaderTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testControllersDoNotUseHeaderOrExit()
    {
        $baseDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src';
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($baseDir));
        
        $violatingFiles = [];
        
        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if ($file->isFile() && $file->getExtension() === 'php' && strpos($file->getPathname(), 'Controllers') !== false) {
                $content = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
                
                // Matches header("Location: ...") or exit; or die;
                if (preg_match('/\bheader\s*\(\s*["\']Location:/i', $content) || preg_match('/\b(?:exit|die)\s*[\(;]/', $content)) {
                    $violatingFiles[] = $file->getPathname();
                }
            }
        }
        
        $this->assertEmpty(
            $violatingFiles, 
            "Os seguintes controllers usam header() ou exit()/die() em vez de retornar Response::redirect():\n" . implode("\n", $violatingFiles)
        );
    }

    public function testPluginsDoNotUseHeaderOrExit()
    {
        $baseDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src';
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($baseDir));

        $violatingFiles = [];

        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if ($file->isFile() && $file->getFilename() === 'Plugin.php') {
                $content = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
                // Remove comments before checking
                $stripped = preg_replace('!/\*.*?\*/!s', '', $content);
                $stripped = preg_replace('!//.*$!m', '', $stripped);

                if (preg_match('/\bheader\s*\(\s*["\']Location:/i', $stripped) || preg_match('/\b(?:exit|die)\s*[\(;]/', $stripped)) {
                    $violatingFiles[] = $file->getPathname();
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertEmpty(
            $violatingFiles,
            "Os seguintes Plugin.php usam header() ou exit()/die() em vez de HttpResponseException / Response::redirect():\n" . implode("\n", $violatingFiles)
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/NoSuperglobalsInControllersTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class NoSuperglobalsInControllersTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testControllersDoNotUseSessionSuperglobal()
    {
        $violationFound = false;
        $violatingFiles = [];

        $directories = [
            __DIR__ . '/../../src/SystemApps',
            __DIR__ . '/../../src/Plugins'
        ];

        foreach ($directories as $dir) {
            $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir));
            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                if ($file->isFile() && $file->getExtension() === 'php' && strpos($file->getPathname(), 'Controllers') !== false) {
                    $content = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
                    
                    if (preg_match('/\$_SESSION\b/', $content) || preg_match('/\$_POST\b/', $content) || preg_match('/\$_GET\b/', $content)) {
                        $violationFound = true;
                        $violatingFiles[] = $file->getFilename();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertFalse(
            $violationFound,
            "Architecture violation: Superglobals (\$_SESSION, \$_POST, \$_GET) found in controllers: " . implode(', ', $violatingFiles) . ". Use SessionManagerInterface and Request instead."
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/NoUndefinedVariablesTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\UndefinedVariableScanner;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Garante que nenhum método/closure do sistema leia variáveis que nunca foram
 * declaradas. Pega os bugs "Undefined variable $runtime" (closure aninhado sem
 * use) e "Undefined variable $session" (usado sem parâmetro no construtor),
 * que antes só apareciam em tempo de execução, no navegador.
 */
class NoUndefinedVariablesTest extends TestCase
{
    // ---------- Provas de que o scanner funciona (bugs reais de hoje) ----------

    public function testScannerDetectsNestedClosureMissingUse(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
<?php
class P {
    public function osBoot($runtime): void {
        $runtime->onHook('x', function($sm) use ($runtime) {
            $sm->add('nav', function($attrs) {
                return $runtime->make('Y');
            });
        });
    }
}
PHP;
        $vars = array_column(UndefinedVariableScanner::scan($code), 'var');
        $this->assertSame(['runtime'], $vars);
    }

    public function testScannerDetectsConstructorUsingUndeclaredParameter(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
<?php
class C {
    public function __construct($theme) {
        $this->theme = $theme;
        $this->session = $session;
    }
}
PHP;
        $vars = array_column(UndefinedVariableScanner::scan($code), 'var');
        $this->assertSame(['session'], $vars);
    }

    public function testScannerAcceptsValidPatterns(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
<?php
class OK {
    public function __construct(private $a, $b = 1) {}
    public function run($request, &$out) {
        $x = 1; $arr = [];
        $arr['k'][] = $x;
        foreach ($arr as $k => $v) { echo $k, $v; }
        try { throw new \Exception(); } catch (\Exception $e) { echo $e; }
        preg_match('/a/', 'a', $m); echo $m[0];
        [$p, $q] = [1, 2]; echo $p, $q;
        $fn = fn($z) => $z + $x;
        $cb = function($n) use ($x) { return $n + $x; };
        if (isset($maybe) && !empty($nothing)) {}
        $y = $unset ?? 5;
        static $cache; echo $cache;
        echo "Valor: $x {$y}";
        $out = $request;
    }
}
PHP;
        $this->assertSame([], UndefinedVariableScanner::scan($code));
    }

    // ---------- Varredura real do código-fonte ----------

    public function testNoUndefinedVariablesInSource(): void
    {
        $root = realpath(__DIR__ . '/../../src');
        $violations = [];

        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($root, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = str_replace('\\', '/', $file->getPathname());
            if (str_contains($path, '/views/')) {
                continue; // templates usam variáveis injetadas via extract()
            }
            foreach (UndefinedVariableScanner::scan(file_get_contents($file->getPathname())) as $f) {
                $violations[] = substr($path, strlen(str_replace('\\', '/', $root)) + 1) . ':' . $f['line'] . '  $' . $f['var'];
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(
            [],
            $violations,
            "Variáveis indefinidas detectadas:\n" . implode("\n", $violations)
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/NoUnresolvedClassNamesTest.php

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use DomainSystem\Tests\Support\UnresolvedClassScanner;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Garante que todo nome de classe usado no src/ é resolvível (import, mesmo
 * arquivo ou mesmo namespace). Pega erros como
 * `Class "...\Controllers\ViewResponse" not found`, causados por esquecer o `use`.
 */
class NoUnresolvedClassNamesTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $srcRoot;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->srcRoot = str_replace('\\', '/', realpath(__DIR__ . '/../../src'));
    }

    public function testScannerDetectsMissingImport(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Plugins\settings\Controllers;
class C {
    public function index() {
        return new ViewResponse('x', false);
    }
}
PHP;
        $found = array_column(UnresolvedClassScanner::scan($code, $this->srcRoot), 'name');
        $this->assertSame(['ViewResponse'], $found);
    }

    public function testScannerAcceptsImportedDeclaredAndSameNamespaceClasses(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
<?php
namespace DomainSystem\Core\Http;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Responses\ViewResponse;
use Exception as Ex;
class Local {}
class C {
    public function a(Request $r, Local $l, int $n, ?Ex $e = null) {
        $x = new ViewResponse('x');
        $y = new Local();
        return self::class . static::class . parent::class;
    }
}
PHP;
        $this->assertSame([], UnresolvedClassScanner::scan($code, $this->srcRoot));
    }

    public function testNoUnresolvedClassNamesInSource(): void
    {
        $violations = [];
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($this->srcRoot, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                continue;
            }
            $path = str_replace('\\', '/', $file->getPathname());
            if (str_contains($path, '/views/')) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach (UnresolvedClassScanner::scan(file_get_contents($file->getPathname()), $this->srcRoot) as $f) {
                $violations[] = substr($path, strlen($this->srcRoot) + 1) . ':' . $f['line'] . '  ' . $f['name'];
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame([], $violations, "Classes usadas sem import:\n" . implode("\n", $violations));
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/Psr4CaseSensitivityTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Compatibilidade Windows -> Linux (Hostinger).
 *
 * O Windows ignora maiúsculas/minúsculas em caminhos; o Linux não. O autoload
 * PSR-4 monta o caminho a partir do namespace, então o caminho REAL do arquivo
 * precisa bater EXATAMENTE (inclusive caixa) com namespace + nome da classe.
 * Este teste compara strings (não depende do sistema de arquivos), por isso
 * detecta o problema mesmo rodando no Windows.
 */
class Psr4CaseSensitivityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testClassPathsMatchNamespacesExactlyIncludingCase(): void
    {
        $srcRoot = str_replace('\\', '/', realpath(__DIR__ . '/../../src'));
        $mismatches = [];

        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($srcRoot, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                continue;
            }
            $code = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
            if (!preg_match('/^namespace\s+([^;]+);/m', $code, $ns)
                || !preg_match('/^(?:final\s+|abstract\s+)*(?:class|interface|trait|enum)\s+(\w+)/m', $code, $cls)) {
                continue;
            }

            $fqcn = trim($ns[1]) . '\\' . $cls[1];
            if (!str_starts_with($fqcn, 'DomainSystem\\')) {
                continue;
            }

            $expected = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($fqcn, strlen('DomainSystem\\'))) . '.php';
            $actual = substr(str_replace('\\', '/', $file->getPathname()), strlen($srcRoot) + 1);

            // Só é problema quando difere APENAS na caixa das letras.
            if ($expected !== $actual && strcasecmp($expected, $actual) === 0) {
                $mismatches[] = "$actual  (esperado pelo namespace: $expected)";
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(
            [],
            $mismatches,
            "Arquivos que quebram no Linux por diferença de maiúsculas/minúsculas:\n" . implode("\n", $mismatches)
        );
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Architecture/UpdateArchitectureTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Architecture;

use FilesystemIterator;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use ReflectionClass;

final class UpdateArchitectureTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testContractsUpdateContainsOnlyInterfaces(): void
    {
        $contractsDir = dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/src/Core/Contracts/Update';
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($contractsDir);

        $files = glob($contractsDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
        $this->assertNotEmpty($files, 'src/Core/Contracts/Update deve conter os contratos do atualizador.');

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $className = 'DomainSystem\\Core\\Contracts\\Update\\' . basename($file, '.php');
            $this->assertTrue(
                interface_exists($className),
                "Arquivo {$file} em Contracts/Update deve declarar exclusivamente a interface {$className}"
            );
            $ref = new ReflectionClass($className);
            $this->assertTrue($ref->isInterface(), "{$className} deve ser uma interface");
        }
    }

    public function testUpdateServicesAndSystemUpdaterDoNotContainForbiddenInfrastructureOrSuperglobals(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $directories = [
            $root . '/src/Core/Update/Service',
            $root . '/src/SystemApps/SystemUpdater',
        ];

        $forbiddenTokens = [
            'PDO',
            'sqlite',
            'mysql',
            'curl_',
            'ZipArchive',
            'file_put_contents',
            'unlink(',
            'rename(',
            'exec(',
            '$_SESSION',
            '$_GET',
            '$_POST',
            '$_SERVER',
            'new Curl',
            'new Zip',
            'new Pdo',
        ];

        $violations = [];

        foreach ($directories as $dir) {
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                continue;
            }

            $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
                new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)
            );

            foreach ($iterator as $file) {
                if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                    continue;
                }

                $raw = (string)file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
                $stripped = $this->stripComments($raw);

                foreach ($forbiddenTokens as $token) {
                    if (stripos($stripped, $token) !== false) {
                        $relPath = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen($root) + 1));
                        $violations[] = "{$relPath} contém token proibido '{$token}'";
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame(
            [],
            $violations,
            "Violações de arquitetura Ring 0 / Contratos no atualizador:\n" . implode("\n", $violations)
        );
    }

    public function testValueObjectsDoNotImportInfrastructureOrDatabase(): void
    {
        $root = dirname(__DIR__, 2);
        $valueDir = $root . '/src/Core/Update/Value';
        $this->assertDirectoryExists($valueDir);

        $files = glob($valueDir . '/*.php') ?: [];
        $this->assertNotEmpty($files);

        $violations = [];
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $raw = (string)file_get_contents($file);
            $stripped = $this->stripComments($raw);

            if (
                preg_match('/\\\\Infrastructure\\\\/i', $stripped) === 1
                || preg_match('/\\\\Database\\\\/i', $stripped) === 1
            ) {
                $relPath = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file, strlen($root) + 1));
                $violations[] = "{$relPath} importa camada de Infrastructure ou Database";
            }
        }

        $this->assertSame([], $violations, implode("\n", $violations));
    }

    private function stripComments(string $source): string
    {
        $tokens = token_get_all($source);
        $output = '';
        foreach ($tokens as $token) {
            if (is_array($token)) {
                if (in_array($token[0], [T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $output .= $token[1];
            } else {
                $output .= $token;
            }
        }
        return $output;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Integration;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\PackageIntegrityException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\CoreProtectedPaths;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\Sha256PackageVerifier;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipPackageExtractor;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Service\JsonUpdateManifestParser;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use DomainSystem\Tools\Release\ReleaseBuilder;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once dirname(__DIR__, 2) . '/tools/release/ReleaseBuilder.php';

final class ReleaseBuilderRoundTripTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = str_replace('\\', '/', sys_get_temp_dir()) . '/ds_rel_builder_' . uniqid('', true);
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testReleaseBuilderGeneratesPackageAcceptedBySha256PackageVerifierAndRejectsTamperedByte(): void
    {
        $fixtureRoot = $this->tempDir . '/repo';
        $distDir = $this->tempDir . '/dist';
        $quarantineBase = $this->tempDir . '/quarantine';

        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/vendor', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/src/Core/Database/migrations', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/src/Plugins/academy/migrations', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/public', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/config', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/release', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/tests', 0777, true);
        mkdir($fixtureRoot . '/storage', 0777, true);

        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/bootstrap.php', "<?php\ndefine('DS_VERSION', '2.4.0');\ndefine('DS_OS_VERSION', '2.3');\n");
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/composer.json', json_encode(['name' => 'domain-system/core', 'version' => '2.4.0']));
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/vendor/autoload.php', "<?php // autoload\n");
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/public/index.php', "<?php echo 'ok';\n");
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/src/Core/Application.php', "<?php namespace DomainSystem\\Core; class Application {}\n");
        file_put_contents(
            $fixtureRoot . '/src/Core/Database/migrations/2026_11_01_000001_core_init.php',
            "<?php return ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo): void {}];\n"
        );
        file_put_contents(
            $fixtureRoot . '/src/Plugins/academy/migrations/2026_10_15_000002_create_academy_structure.php',
            "<?php return ['up' => function (\\PDO \$pdo): void {}];\n"
        );
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/config/update.json', json_encode(['channel' => 'stable']));
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/release/exclude.txt', ".git*\ntests/\nstorage/\n*.sqlite\n.env\n");
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/release/schema-expects.json', json_encode([
            'academy_modules' => ['folder_slug'],
            'academy_lessons' => ['mobile_profile'],
        ]));

        // Arquivos que jamais devem entrar no pacote
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/.env', "APP_KEY=secret\n");
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/database.sqlite', 'sqlite-binary');
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/tests/SecretTest.php', '<?php // test');
        file_put_contents($fixtureRoot . '/storage/state.json', '{}');

        $builder = new ReleaseBuilder($fixtureRoot);
        $buildResult = $builder->build($distDir);

        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $buildResult['version']);
        $this->assertFileExists($buildResult['zipPath']);
        $this->assertFileExists($buildResult['sha256Path']);
        $this->assertSame(2, $buildResult['migrationCount']);

        $releaseInfo = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: '2.4.0',
            tag: 'v2.4.0',
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T18:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Release de teste',
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v2.4.0/domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-2.4.0.zip',
            sizeBytes: (int)filesize($buildResult['zipPath']),
            sha256: $buildResult['sha256'],
        );

        $verifier = new Sha256PackageVerifier(
            new JsonUpdateManifestParser(),
            new CoreProtectedPaths(),
            new ZipPackageExtractor(),
            $quarantineBase,
        );

        $downloaded = new DownloadedPackage(
            release: $releaseInfo,
            archivePath: $buildResult['zipPath'],
            sizeBytes: $releaseInfo->sizeBytes,
        );

        $verified = $verifier->verify($downloaded);
        $this->assertSame('2.4.0', $verified->manifest->version);
        $this->assertSame(['folder_slug'], $verified->manifest->expects['academy_modules'] ?? []);
        $this->assertFileExists($verified->extractedPath . '/bootstrap.php');
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($verified->extractedPath . '/.env');
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($verified->extractedPath . '/database.sqlite');
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($verified->extractedPath . '/tests/SecretTest.php');

        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($verified->extractedPath);

        // Adulterar 1 byte no arquivo ZIP gerado => Sha256PackageVerifier deve rejeitar
        $bytes = (string)file_get_contents($buildResult['zipPath']);
        $pos = (int)floor(strlen($bytes) / 2);
        $bytes[$pos] = chr((ord($bytes[$pos]) ^ 0xFF));
        file_put_contents($buildResult['zipPath'], $bytes);

        $this->expectException(PackageIntegrityException::class);
        $verifier->verify($downloaded);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Support/ArrayHttpClient.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Support;

use Closure;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\Update\HttpClientInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Exception\TransportException;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\HttpResponse;

final class ArrayHttpClient implements HttpClientInterface
{
    /**
     * @var array<string, HttpResponse|Closure(string, array<string, string>): HttpResponse>
     */
    private array $routes = [];

    /**
     * @var list<array{method: string, url: string, headers: array<string, string>}>
     */
    private array $requests = [];

    /**
     * @param array<string, HttpResponse|Closure(string, array<string, string>): HttpResponse> $routes
     */
    public function __construct(array $routes = [])
    {
        $this->routes = $routes;
    }

    /**
     * @param HttpResponse|Closure(string, array<string, string>): HttpResponse $handler
     */
    public function when(string $url, HttpResponse|Closure $handler): void
    {
        $this->routes[$url] = $handler;
    }

    public function get(string $url, array $headers = [], int $timeoutSeconds = 10): HttpResponse
    {
        $this->requests[] = ['method' => 'GET', 'url' => $url, 'headers' => $headers];

        return $this->resolve($url, $headers);
    }

    public function download(
        string $url,
        string $destinationFile,
        int $maxBytes,
        array $headers = [],
        int $timeoutSeconds = 60,
    ): HttpResponse {
        $this->requests[] = ['method' => 'DOWNLOAD', 'url' => $url, 'headers' => $headers];

        $response = $this->resolve($url, $headers);
        if ($response->statusCode >= 400) {
            return $response;
        }

        if (strlen($response->body) > $maxBytes) {
            if (is_file($destinationFile)) {
                @unlink($destinationFile);
            }
            throw new TransportException("Download excedeu o limite máximo de {$maxBytes} bytes.");
        }

        $dir = dirname($destinationFile);
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            mkdir($dir, 0755, true);
        }
        file_put_contents($destinationFile, $response->body);

        return $response;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{method: string, url: string, headers: array<string, string>}>
     */
    public function recordedRequests(): array
    {
        return $this->requests;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $headers
     */
    private function resolve(string $url, array $headers): HttpResponse
    {
        if (!array_key_exists($url, $this->routes)) {
            throw new TransportException("Nenhuma resposta falsa configurada para a URL: {$url}");
        }

        $entry = $this->routes[$url];
        if ($entry instanceof Closure) {
            return $entry($url, $headers);
        }

        return $entry;
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Support/PackageBuilder.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Support;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\DownloadedPackage;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\ReleaseInfo;
use RuntimeException;
use ZipArchive;

/**
 * Utilitário de testes para construir pacotes ZIP + manifest.json em diretório temporário.
 */
final class PackageBuilder
{
    private int $protocol = 1;
    private int $minUpdaterProtocol = 1;
    private UpdateKind $kind = UpdateKind::Core;
    private string $slug = 'core';
    private string $version = '2.4.0';

    /** @var array{php: string, extensions: list<string>, osVersion: string} */
    private array $requires = [
        'php' => '8.1',
        'extensions' => ['pdo', 'zip', 'mbstring', 'openssl', 'json', 'curl'],
        'osVersion' => '2.3',
    ];

    /** @var list<array{path: string, content: string, mode: string, sha256: string, size: int}> */
    private array $files = [];

    /** @var list<array{path: string, content: string}> */
    private array $extraZipFiles = [];

    /** @var list<array{path: string, sha256: string, size: int, mode: string}> */
    private array $missingDiskFiles = [];

    /** @var list<array{entryName: string, target: string}> */
    private array $symlinks = [];

    /** @var list<string> */
    private array $removed = [];

    /** @var list<array{scope: string, name: string, sha256: string, type: string}> */
    private array $migrations = [];

    /** @var array<string, list<string>> */
    private array $expects = [];

    /** @var array<string, mixed>|string|null */
    private array|string|null $rawManifestOverride = null;

    private bool $omitManifestFile = false;

    public static function create(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    public function withProtocol(int $protocol, int $minUpdaterProtocol = 1): self
    {
        $this->protocol = $protocol;
        $this->minUpdaterProtocol = $minUpdaterProtocol;
        return $this;
    }

    public function withKind(UpdateKind $kind, string $slug = 'core'): self
    {
        $this->kind = $kind;
        $this->slug = $slug;
        return $this;
    }

    public function withVersion(string $version): self
    {
        $this->version = $version;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @param array{php: string, extensions: list<string>, osVersion: string} $requires
     */
    public function withRequires(array $requires): self
    {
        $this->requires = $requires;
        return $this;
    }

    public function withFile(
        string $path,
        string $content,
        string $mode = 'replace',
        ?string $overrideSha256 = null,
        ?int $overrideSize = null,
    ): self {
        $this->files[] = [
            'path' => $path,
            'content' => $content,
            'mode' => $mode,
            'sha256' => $overrideSha256 ?? hash('sha256', $content),
            'size' => $overrideSize ?? strlen($content),
        ];
        return $this;
    }

    public function withExtraZipFile(string $path, string $content): self
    {
        $this->extraZipFiles[] = [
            'path' => $path,
            'content' => $content,
        ];
        return $this;
    }

    public function withMissingDiskFile(
        string $path,
        ?string $sha256 = null,
        int $size = 42,
        string $mode = 'replace',
    ): self {
        $this->missingDiskFiles[] = [
            'path' => $path,
            'sha256' => $sha256 ?? str_repeat('a', 64),
            'size' => $size,
            'mode' => $mode,
        ];
        return $this;
    }

    public function withSymlink(string $entryName, string $target = '/etc/passwd'): self
    {
        $this->symlinks[] = [
            'entryName' => $entryName,
            'target' => $target,
        ];
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $removed
     */
    public function withRemoved(array $removed): self
    {
        $this->removed = $removed;
        return $this;
    }

    public function withMigration(
        string $scope,
        string $name,
        string $content,
        string $type = 'additive',
        ?string $overrideSha256 = null,
        bool $includeMigrationFile = true,
    ): self {
        $relPath = $scope === '__core__'
            ? 'src/Core/Database/migrations/' . $name . '.php'
            : 'src/Plugins/' . $scope . '/migrations/' . $name . '.php';

        $actualSha = hash('sha256', $content);

        if ($includeMigrationFile) {
            $this->withFile($relPath, $content);
        }

        $this->migrations[] = [
            'scope' => $scope,
            'name' => $name,
            'sha256' => $overrideSha256 ?? $actualSha,
            'type' => $type,
        ];

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, list<string>> $expects
     */
    public function withExpects(array $expects): self
    {
        $this->expects = $expects;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed>|string $rawManifest
     */
    public function withRawManifest(array|string $rawManifest): self
    {
        $this->rawManifestOverride = $rawManifest;
        return $this;
    }

    public function withoutManifestFile(): self
    {
        $this->omitManifestFile = true;
        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toManifestArray(): array
    {
        $manifestFiles = [];
        foreach ($this->files as $f) {
            $manifestFiles[] = [
                'path' => $f['path'],
                'sha256' => $f['sha256'],
                'size' => $f['size'],
                'mode' => $f['mode'],
            ];
        }
        foreach ($this->missingDiskFiles as $mf) {
            $manifestFiles[] = [
                'path' => $mf['path'],
                'sha256' => $mf['sha256'],
                'size' => $mf['size'],
                'mode' => $mf['mode'],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'protocol' => $this->protocol,
            'minUpdaterProtocol' => $this->minUpdaterProtocol,
            'kind' => $this->kind->value,
            'slug' => $this->slug,
            'version' => $this->version,
            'requires' => $this->requires,
            'files' => $manifestFiles,
            'removed' => $this->removed,
            'migrations' => $this->migrations,
            'expects' => (object)$this->expects,
        ];
    }

    public function build(
        string $targetDir,
        ?string $overrideReleaseSha256 = null,
        ?string $overrideReleaseVersion = null,
    ): DownloadedPackage {
        if (!is_dir($targetDir) && !@mkdir($targetDir, 0755, true) && !is_dir($targetDir)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Não foi possível criar diretório temporário: ' . $targetDir);
        }

        $zipPath = rtrim($targetDir, '/\\')
            . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR
            . 'domain-system-' . $this->version . '-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.zip';

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        if ($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Falha ao criar arquivo ZIP em ' . $zipPath);
        }

        if (!$this->omitManifestFile) {
            if (is_string($this->rawManifestOverride)) {
                $manifestJson = $this->rawManifestOverride;
            } elseif (is_array($this->rawManifestOverride)) {
                $manifestJson = (string)json_encode($this->rawManifestOverride, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
            } else {
                $manifestJson = (string)json_encode($this->toManifestArray(), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
            }
            $zip->addFromString('manifest.json', $manifestJson);
        }

        foreach ($this->files as $file) {
            $zip->addFromString($file['path'], $file['content']);
        }

        foreach ($this->extraZipFiles as $extra) {
            $zip->addFromString($extra['path'], $extra['content']);
        }

        foreach ($this->symlinks as $symlink) {
            $zip->addFromString($symlink['entryName'], $symlink['target']);
            // Atributo Unix S_IFLNK (0120000 = 0xA000) + 0777 (0x01FF) = 0xA1FF nos 16 bits superiores
            $zip->setExternalAttributesName(
                $symlink['entryName'],
                ZipArchive::OPSYS_UNIX,
                (0xA1FF << 16)
            );
        }

        $zip->close();

        $actualZipSha = (string)hash_file('sha256', $zipPath);
        $sizeBytes = (int)filesize($zipPath);
        $releaseVersion = $overrideReleaseVersion ?? $this->version;

        $release = new ReleaseInfo(
            version: $releaseVersion,
            tag: 'v' . $releaseVersion,
            publishedAt: '2026-10-19T12:00:00Z',
            changelog: 'Release de teste ' . $releaseVersion,
            assetUrl: 'https://github.com/hadelrachid/domain-system/releases/download/v' . $releaseVersion . '/domain-system-' . $releaseVersion . '.zip',
            assetName: 'domain-system-' . $releaseVersion . '.zip',
            sizeBytes: $sizeBytes,
            sha256: $overrideReleaseSha256 ?? $actualZipSha,
            etag: '"etag-' . $releaseVersion . '"',
        );

        return new DownloadedPackage(
            release: $release,
            archivePath: $zipPath,
            sizeBytes: $sizeBytes,
        );
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Support/UndefinedVariableScanner.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Support;

/**
 * Detector estático de "Undefined variable".
 *
 * Analisa cada função/método/closure de forma isolada (como o PHP faz) e reporta
 * variáveis LIDAS que nunca foram definidas naquele escopo (parâmetro, use(),
 * atribuição, foreach, catch, global, static, list(), by-ref).
 *
 * É propositalmente permissivo (não considera a ordem do fluxo) para evitar
 * falsos positivos: o objetivo é pegar erros estruturais, como esquecer o
 * `use ($runtime)` em um closure aninhado ou usar `$session` sem declará-lo.
 */
final class UndefinedVariableScanner
{
    private const IGNORED = [
        'this', 'GLOBALS', '_GET', '_POST', '_SERVER', '_SESSION', '_COOKIE',
        '_FILES', '_REQUEST', '_ENV', 'argv', 'argc', 'http_response_header',
    ];

    /** Funções que preenchem variáveis passadas por referência. */
    private const BYREF_FUNCS = [
        'preg_match', 'preg_match_all', 'exec', 'parse_str', 'getimagesize',
        'similar_text', 'openssl_sign', 'proc_open', 'stream_select', 'sscanf',
        'str_replace', 'preg_replace', 'preg_replace_callback', 'is_callable',
        'openssl_random_pseudo_bytes', 'stream_socket_client', 'fsockopen',
        'pfsockopen', 'stream_socket_server', 'getmxrr', 'dns_get_record',
        'mb_parse_str', 'array_multisort', 'passthru', 'system',
    ];

    private const ASSIGN_OPS = [
        '=', T_PLUS_EQUAL, T_MINUS_EQUAL, T_MUL_EQUAL, T_DIV_EQUAL, T_CONCAT_EQUAL,
        T_MOD_EQUAL, T_POW_EQUAL, T_AND_EQUAL, T_OR_EQUAL, T_XOR_EQUAL,
        T_SL_EQUAL, T_SR_EQUAL, T_COALESCE_EQUAL,
    ];

    /** @var array<int, array{id:int|string, text:string, line:int}> */
    private array $t = [];

    /** @var array<int, array{line:int, var:string}> */
    private array $findings = [];

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{line:int, var:string}>
     */
    public static function scan(string $code): array
    {
        $scanner = new self();
        $scanner->load($code);
        $scanner->walkTopLevel();
        return $scanner->findings;
    }

    private function load(string $code): void
    {
        foreach (token_get_all($code) as $tok) {
            if (is_array($tok)) {
                if (in_array($tok[0], [T_WHITESPACE, T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT, T_OPEN_TAG, T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO, T_CLOSE_TAG], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $this->t[] = ['id' => $tok[0], 'text' => $tok[1], 'line' => $tok[2]];
            } else {
                $line = $this->t ? end($this->t)['line'] : 1;
                $this->t[] = ['id' => $tok, 'text' => $tok, 'line' => $line];
            }
        }
    }

    private function walkTopLevel(): void
    {
        $n = count($this->t);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n;) {
            if ($this->t[$i]['id'] === T_FUNCTION && !$this->isUseImport($i)) {
                [$i] = $this->parseFunction($i);
                continue;
            }
            $i++;
        }
    }

    private function isUseImport(int $i): bool
    {
        return $i > 0 && $this->t[$i - 1]['id'] === T_USE;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0:int, 1:array<int, array{line:int, var:string}>} [próximo índice, variáveis do use()]
     */
    private function parseFunction(int $i): array
    {
        $j = $i + 1;
        if ($this->t[$j]['id'] === '&') {
            $j++;
        }
        if ($this->t[$j]['id'] !== '(') {
            $j++; // nome da função/método
        }

        $params = [];
        $j = $this->collectParenVars($j, $params);

        $uses = [];
        if (($this->t[$j]['id'] ?? null) === T_USE) {
            $j++;
            $j = $this->collectParenVars($j, $uses);
        }

        $n = count($this->t);
        while ($j < $n && $this->t[$j]['id'] !== '{' && $this->t[$j]['id'] !== ';') {
            $j++;
        }
        if ($j >= $n || $this->t[$j]['id'] === ';') {
            return [$j + 1, $this->toReads($uses)]; // abstrata/interface
        }

        $close = $this->findClose($j);
        $defined = array_merge(array_column($params, 'var'), array_column($uses, 'var'));
        $this->analyzeBody($j + 1, $close, $defined);

        return [$close + 1, $this->toReads($uses)];
    }

    /** @param array<int, array{line:int, var:string}> $uses */
    private function toReads(array $uses): array
    {
        return $uses;
    }

    private function analyzeBody(int $from, int $to, array $defined): void
    {
        $defs = array_fill_keys($defined, true);
        $reads = [];
        $defIdx = [];      // índices de tokens que são definições
        $lenientIdx = [];  // índices dentro de isset()/empty()/unset()
        $skip = false;
        $anonBodies = []; // [índice do '{'] => índice do '}' de classes anônimas

        for ($i = $from; $i < $to;) {
            $tk = $this->t[$i];
            $id = $tk['id'];

            // Corpo de classe anônima: só os métodos têm escopo próprio a analisar.
            if (isset($anonBodies[$i])) {
                $end = $anonBodies[$i];
                for ($j = $i + 1; $j < $end;) {
                    if ($this->t[$j]['id'] === T_FUNCTION && !$this->isUseImport($j)) {
                        [$j] = $this->parseFunction($j);
                        continue;
                    }
                    $j++;
                }
                $i = $end + 1;
                continue;
            }

            if ($id === T_CLASS && ($this->t[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null) === T_NEW) {
                for ($k = $i + 1; $k < $to; $k++) {
                    if ($this->t[$k]['id'] === '(') {
                        $k = $this->findClose($k);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if ($this->t[$k]['id'] === '{') {
                        $anonBodies[$k] = $this->findClose($k);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Closure/função aninhada: escopo próprio. As variáveis do use() são LEITURAS aqui.
            if ($id === T_FUNCTION && !$this->isUseImport($i)) {
                [$next, $uses] = $this->parseFunction($i);
                foreach ($uses as $u) {
                    $reads[] = $u;
                }
                $i = $next;
                continue;
            }

            // Arrow fn: parâmetros viram definições (aproximação permissiva).
            if ($id === T_FN) {
                $j = $i + 1;
                if ($this->t[$j]['id'] === '&') {
                    $j++;
                }
                $p = [];
                $j = $this->collectParenVars($j, $p);
                foreach ($p as $pv) {
                    $defs[$pv['var']] = true;
                }
                $i = $j;
                continue;
            }

            if (in_array($id, [T_INCLUDE, T_INCLUDE_ONCE, T_REQUIRE, T_REQUIRE_ONCE, T_EVAL], true)
                || $id === '$'
                || ($id === T_STRING && in_array(strtolower($tk['text']), ['extract', 'get_defined_vars'], true))) {
                $skip = true;
            }

            if ($id === T_FOREACH) {
                $open = $i + 1;
                $close = $this->findClose($open);
                $as = null;
                for ($k = $open; $k < $close; $k++) {
                    if ($this->t[$k]['id'] === T_AS) {
                        $as = $k;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if ($as !== null) {
                    for ($k = $as; $k < $close; $k++) {
                        $defIdx[$k] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($id === T_CATCH) {
                $open = $i + 1;
                $close = $this->findClose($open);
                for ($k = $open; $k < $close; $k++) {
                    $defIdx[$k] = true;
                }
            }

            if ($id === T_GLOBAL) {
                for ($k = $i; $k < $to && $this->t[$k]['id'] !== ';'; $k++) {
                    $defIdx[$k] = true;
                }
            }

            if ($id === T_LIST && ($this->t[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === '(') {
                $close = $this->findClose($i + 1);
                for ($k = $i + 1; $k < $close; $k++) {
                    $defIdx[$k] = true;
                }
            }

            if ($id === '[') {
                $prev = $this->t[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;
                $isOffset = in_array($prev, [T_VARIABLE, ']', ')', T_STRING, '}', T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_DOUBLE_COLON], true);
                $close = $this->findClose($i);
                if (!$isOffset && ($this->t[$close + 1]['id'] ?? null) === '=') {
                    for ($k = $i; $k < $close; $k++) {
                        $defIdx[$k] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (in_array($id, [T_ISSET, T_EMPTY, T_UNSET], true) && ($this->t[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === '(') {
                $close = $this->findClose($i + 1);
                for ($k = $i + 1; $k < $close; $k++) {
                    $lenientIdx[$k] = true;
                }
            }

            if ($id === T_STRING && ($this->t[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === '('
                && in_array(strtolower($tk['text']), self::BYREF_FUNCS, true)) {
                $close = $this->findClose($i + 1);
                for ($k = $i + 1; $k < $close; $k++) {
                    $defIdx[$k] = true;
                }
            }

            if ($id === T_VARIABLE) {
                $name = substr($tk['text'], 1);
                $prevId = $this->t[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;

                if (in_array($name, self::IGNORED, true) || $prevId === T_DOUBLE_COLON) {
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($prevId === T_STATIC) {
                    $defs[$name] = true;
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }
                if ($prevId === '&' && in_array($this->t[$i - 2]['id'] ?? null, ['(', ','], true)) {
                    $defs[$name] = true;
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }
                if (isset($defIdx[$i])) {
                    $defs[$name] = true;
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }

                // $x = ...  |  $x['a'][] = ...
                $k = $i + 1;
                while (($this->t[$k]['id'] ?? null) === '[') {
                    $k = $this->findClose($k) + 1;
                }
                $nextId = $this->t[$k]['id'] ?? null;
                if (in_array($nextId, self::ASSIGN_OPS, true)) {
                    $defs[$name] = true;
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }

                if (isset($lenientIdx[$i]) || ($this->t[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === T_COALESCE) {
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }

                $reads[] = ['line' => $tk['line'], 'var' => $name];
            }

            $i++;
        }

        if ($skip) {
            return;
        }
        foreach ($reads as $r) {
            if (!isset($defs[$r['var']])) {
                $this->findings[] = $r;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Coleta variáveis dentro de um par de parênteses que começa em $j.
     * @param array<int, array{line:int, var:string}> $out
     */
    private function collectParenVars(int $j, array &$out): int
    {
        if (($this->t[$j]['id'] ?? null) !== '(') {
            return $j;
        }
        $close = $this->findClose($j);
        for ($k = $j + 1; $k < $close; $k++) {
            if ($this->t[$k]['id'] === T_VARIABLE) {
                $out[] = ['line' => $this->t[$k]['line'], 'var' => substr($this->t[$k]['text'], 1)];
            }
        }
        return $close + 1;
    }

    private function findClose(int $open): int
    {
        $depth = 0;
        $n = count($this->t);
        for ($i = $open; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $id = $this->t[$i]['id'];
            if (in_array($id, ['(', '[', '{', T_CURLY_OPEN, T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES], true)) {
                $depth++;
            } elseif (in_array($id, [')', ']', '}'], true)) {
                $depth--;
                if ($depth === 0) {
                    return $i;
                }
            }
        }
        return $n - 1;
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Support/UnresolvedClassScanner.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Support;

/**
 * Detector estático de "Class not found" por falta de `use`.
 *
 * Para cada nome de classe NÃO qualificado usado em `new X`, `X::`, `instanceof X`
 * ou como tipo antes de uma variável (`X $param`), verifica se ele é resolvível:
 *   1. está importado por `use`;
 *   2. é declarado no próprio arquivo;
 *   3. existe um arquivo X.php no mesmo namespace (PSR-4 sob src/).
 * Caso contrário o PHP procuraria "Namespace\X" e falharia em tempo de execução.
 */
final class UnresolvedClassScanner
{
    private const BUILTIN_TYPES = [
        'int', 'float', 'string', 'bool', 'array', 'callable', 'iterable', 'object',
        'mixed', 'void', 'null', 'never', 'false', 'true', 'self', 'static', 'parent',
    ];

    /** @var array<string, array<string, true>> cache: dir => [nome minúsculo => true] */
    private static array $dirCache = [];

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{line:int, name:string}>
     */
    public static function scan(string $code, string $srcRoot): array
    {
        $tokens = [];
        foreach (token_get_all($code) as $tok) {
            if (is_array($tok)) {
                if (in_array($tok[0], [T_WHITESPACE, T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT, T_OPEN_TAG], true)) {
                    continue;
                }
                $tokens[] = ['id' => $tok[0], 'text' => $tok[1], 'line' => $tok[2]];
            } else {
                $tokens[] = ['id' => $tok, 'text' => $tok, 'line' => $tokens ? end($tokens)['line'] : 1];
            }
        }

        $n = count($tokens);
        $namespace = null;
        $imports = [];   // alias minúsculo => true
        $declared = [];  // nomes declarados no arquivo (minúsculo)
        $inImport = [];  // índices que pertencem a instruções use de topo
        $depth = 0;

        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $id = $tokens[$i]['id'];

            if ($id === T_NAMESPACE && isset($tokens[$i + 1]) && in_array($tokens[$i + 1]['id'], [T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED], true)) {
                $namespace = $tokens[$i + 1]['text'];
            }

            if ($id === '{' || $id === T_CURLY_OPEN || $id === T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES) {
                $depth++;
            } elseif ($id === '}') {
                $depth--;
            }

            if ($id === T_USE && $depth === 0) {
                $isFnOrConst = isset($tokens[$i + 1]) && in_array($tokens[$i + 1]['id'], [T_FUNCTION, T_CONST], true);
                for ($k = $i; $k < $n && $tokens[$k]['id'] !== ';'; $k++) {
                    $inImport[$k] = true;
                    if ($isFnOrConst) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (in_array($tokens[$k]['id'], [T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED, T_NAME_FULLY_QUALIFIED], true)) {
                        $parts = explode('\\', $tokens[$k]['text']);
                        $imports[strtolower(end($parts))] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (in_array($id, [T_CLASS, T_INTERFACE, T_TRAIT], true) || (defined('T_ENUM') && $id === T_ENUM)) {
                $prev = $tokens[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;
                if ($prev !== T_NEW && $prev !== T_DOUBLE_COLON && ($tokens[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null) === T_STRING) {
                    $declared[strtolower($tokens[$i + 1]['text'])] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if ($namespace === null) {
            return []; // sem namespace: nomes resolvem no global
        }

        $findings = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if (isset($inImport[$i]) || $tokens[$i]['id'] !== T_STRING) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = $tokens[$i]['text'];
            $prev = $tokens[$i - 1]['id'] ?? null;
            $next = $tokens[$i + 1]['id'] ?? null;

            $isClassRef =
                $prev === T_NEW
                || $prev === T_INSTANCEOF
                || ($next === T_DOUBLE_COLON && !in_array($prev, [T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_DOUBLE_COLON, T_NS_SEPARATOR, T_NULLSAFE_OBJECT_OPERATOR], true))
                || ($next === T_VARIABLE && !in_array($prev, [T_OBJECT_OPERATOR, T_DOUBLE_COLON], true))
                || ($next === '&' && ($tokens[$i + 2]['id'] ?? null) === T_VARIABLE)
                || ($next === T_ELLIPSIS && ($tokens[$i + 2]['id'] ?? null) === T_VARIABLE);

            if (!$isClassRef) {
                continue;
            }
            $lower = strtolower($name);
            if (in_array($lower, self::BUILTIN_TYPES, true) || isset($imports[$lower]) || isset($declared[$lower])) {
                continue;
            }
            if (self::existsInNamespace($namespace, $name, $srcRoot)) {
                continue;
            }
            $findings[] = ['line' => $tokens[$i]['line'], 'name' => $name];
        }

        return $findings;
    }

    private static function existsInNamespace(string $namespace, string $name, string $srcRoot): bool
    {
        if (!str_starts_with($namespace, 'DomainSystem\\') && $namespace !== 'DomainSystem') {
            return false;
        }
        $relative = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($namespace, strlen('DomainSystem')));
        $dir = rtrim($srcRoot . $relative, '/');

        if (!isset(self::$dirCache[$dir])) {
            self::$dirCache[$dir] = [];
            if (is_dir($dir)) {
                foreach (scandir($dir) as $entry) {
                    if (str_ends_with($entry, '.php')) {
                        self::$dirCache[$dir][strtolower(substr($entry, 0, -4))] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return isset(self::$dirCache[$dir][strtolower($name)]);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/TDD_CYCLE_RECIPE.md
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

# Receita de Desenvolvimento Incremental & TDD

Este roteiro **DEVE** ser seguido rigorosamente pelo Antigravity (ou qualquer engenheiro) durante a evolução do Web OS. É a garantia de que não haverá quebras arquiteturais ou esquecimento de testes.

## Ciclo de Produção

### 1. 📋 Planejamento & Contrato (Design)
- Entender a necessidade de negócio.
- Se for criar uma classe nova, desenhar primeiro a Interface (Contrato).
- Identificar quais componentes (Ring 0 ou Ring 3) serão afetados.

### 2. 🔴 O Teste Vem Primeiro (Red)
- **Antes** (ou imediatamente junto) da codificação principal, escrever o teste unitário ou arquitetural (`tests/Unit/`, `tests/Architecture/`).
- O teste DEVE falhar primeiramente (vermelho). Isso prova que a proteção está ativa e que estamos cobrindo um buraco real.

### 3. 🟢 Implementação (Green)
- Codificar a refatoração ou a feature no core/plugin correspondente.
- Rodar o teste isolado que acabou de ser criado (`php phpunit.phar tests/.../NomeDoTeste.php`).
- Ajustar até a barra ficar **Verde**.

### 4. 🛠️ Limpeza & SOLID (Refactor)
- O código funciona? Ótimo. Agora limpe.
- Existem variáveis soltas? Acoplamento? Classes com dupla responsabilidade (SRP quebrado)? 
- Corrija e mantenha o teste passando.

### 5. 🛡️ Bateria de Regressão
- Rodar a bateria **INTEIRA** de testes (`php phpunit.phar`).
- Garantir que a refatoração atual não causou Efeito Dominó ou disparou o *No-Break Shield* acidentalmente em outros módulos.

### 6. ✍️ Checkpoint & Documentação
- Atualizar `.md` caso regras de negócio mudem.
- Só então pedir autorização para ir ao próximo passo.

> *"Devagar, sem pressa, desde que façamos os testes após a refatoração ou correção."* - Regra de Ouro.
