<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

class AdminControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempThemesPath;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempThemesPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/domain_system_themes_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($this->tempThemesPath);
        mkdir($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        
        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/layout.php', 
            '<html><?= $content ?? "" ?></html>'
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/dashboard.php', 
            '<?php ob_start(); ?><h1>Dashboard</h1><?php $content = ob_get_clean(); require __DIR__ . "/layout.php"; ?>'
        );

        file_put_contents(
            $this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/plugins.php', 
            '<?php ob_start(); foreach($plugins as $p) { echo $p["name"] . ":" . ($p["is_active"] ? "1" : "0") . ";"; } $content = ob_get_clean(); require __DIR__ . "/layout.php"; ?>'
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        unlink($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/layout.php');
        unlink($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/dashboard.php');
        unlink($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin/plugins.php');
        rmdir($this->tempThemesPath . '/admin');
        rmdir($this->tempThemesPath);
    }

        public function testListPlugins()

        $requestMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request::class);

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $controller = new AdminController($pluginManagerMock, $themeManager, $shortcodesMock, $dispatcherMock, $sessionMock);
        $html = $controller->listPlugins($requestMock);
        
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<html>', $html);
    }

    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\ClickBankGateway;

class AffiliateWebhooksAndInstallmentsTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        // Cria tabela de usuários para os testes de provisionamento
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                password TEXT NOT NULL,
                role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        // Cria tabela de cursos
        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE academy_courses (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                thumbnail TEXT NULL,
                description TEXT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
                link TEXT NULL,
                price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
                is_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                max_installments INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12,
                external_platform TEXT NULL,
                external_product_id TEXT NULL,
                external_checkout_url TEXT NULL,
                created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
        ");

        $orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
        $orderRepo->ensureTable();

    public function testCourseRepositoryPersistsInstallmentsAndAffiliatePlatform(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo, false);

        $courseId = $repo->create([
            'title'                 => 'Formação Especialista PHP',
            'slug'                  => 'formacao-especialista-php',
            'description'           => 'Curso avançado',
            'status'                => 'published',
            'price'                 => 297.00,
            'is_free'               => 0,
            'max_installments'      => 12,
            'external_platform'     => 'hotmart',
            'external_product_id'   => 'HOT-998877',
            'external_checkout_url' => 'https://pay.hotmart.com/HOT998877',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $courseId);

        $course = $repo->findById($courseId);
        $this->assertNotNull($course);
        $this->assertSame('Formação Especialista PHP', $course['title']);
        $this->assertEquals(297.00, (float)$course['price']);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int)$course['is_free']);
        $this->assertSame(12, (int)$course['max_installments']);
        $this->assertSame('hotmart', $course['external_platform']);
        $this->assertSame('HOT-998877', $course['external_product_id']);
        $this->assertSame('https://pay.hotmart.com/HOT998877', $course['external_checkout_url']);

        // Busca por external_product_id
        $foundByProd = $repo->findByExternalProductId('HOT-998877');
        $this->assertNotNull($foundByProd);
        $this->assertSame($courseId, (int)$foundByProd['id']);

        // Atualização
        $updated = $repo->update($courseId, [
            'title'                 => 'Formação Especialista PHP v2',
            'slug'                  => 'formacao-especialista-php-v2',
            'description'           => 'Atualizado',
            'status'                => 'published',
            'price'                 => 397.00,
            'is_free'               => 0,
            'max_installments'      => 10,
            'external_platform'     => 'eduzz',
            'external_product_id'   => 'EDZ-5544',
            'external_checkout_url' => 'https://sun.eduzz.com/5544',
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $fresh = $repo->findById($courseId);
        $this->assertSame(10, (int)$fresh['max_installments']);
        $this->assertEquals(397.00, (float)$fresh['price']);
        $this->assertSame('eduzz', $fresh['external_platform']);
    }

    public function testCourseCatalogRendererFormatsInstallmentsAndNormalizesSubdirectoryUrls(): void
    {
        $repo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo, false);

        // Curso 1: Pago com 12x
        $repo->create([
            'title'            => 'Curso de Python Pro',
            'slug'             => 'curso-de-python-pro',
            'description'      => 'Aprenda Python do zero',
            'status'           => 'published',
            'price'            => 197.00,
            'is_free'          => 0,
            'max_installments' => 12,
            'link'             => null, // link padrão deve usar BASE_URL sem 404
        ]);

        // Curso 2: Gratuito
        $repo->create([
            'title'            => 'Tutorial Git Básico',
            'slug'             => 'tutorial-git-basico',
            'description'      => 'Comandos essenciais',
            'status'           => 'published',
            'price'            => 0.00,
            'is_free'          => 1,
            'max_installments' => 1,
            'link'             => '/tutoriais/git', // link relativo
        ]);

        $renderer = new CourseCatalogRenderer($repo);
        $html = $renderer->render(['limit' => 10]);

        // Deve conter a exibição das parcelas: 197 / 12 = 16.42
        $this->assertStringContainsString('R$ 197,00', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('12x de R$ 16,42', $html);

        // Deve conter o selo GRATUITO para o curso 2
        $this->assertStringContainsString('GRATUITO', $html);

        // Se BASE_URL estiver definido, deve estar prefixado no link
        if (defined('BASE_URL') && BASE_URL !== '') {
            $this->assertStringContainsString(rtrim(BASE_URL, '/') . '/cursos/curso-de-python-pro', $html);
        } else {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('/cursos/curso-de-python-pro', $html);
        }
    }

    public function testHotmartGatewayWebhookParsingAndVerification(): void
    {
        $settingsMock = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settingsMock->method('get')->with('hotmart_hottok')->willReturn('SECRET_HOTTOK_123');

        $gateway = new HotmartGateway(settings: $settingsMock);
        $this->assertSame('hotmart', $gateway->getId());
        $this->assertTrue($gateway->isConfigured());

        // Teste de rejeição por token inválido
        $invalidReq = new Request([], $invalidPayload = ['hottok' => 'WRONG_TOKEN'], [], [], [], $invalidPayload);
        $this->assertNull($gateway->handleWebhook($invalidReq));

        // Teste de sucesso com payload Hotmart v2 (PURCHASE_APPROVED)
        $validPayload = [
            'event'  => 'PURCHASE_APPROVED',
            'hottok' => 'SECRET_HOTTOK_123',
            'data'   => [
                'buyer'    => [
                    'email' => 'aluno@hotmart.com',
                    'name'  => 'Carlos Hotmart',
                ],
                'product'  => [
                    'id' => 'HOT_PROD_8899',
                ],
                'purchase' => [
                    'transaction' => 'HP1234567890',
                    'price'       => ['value' => 197.00],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $validReq = new Request([], $validPayload, [], [], [], $validPayload);
        $result = $gateway->handleWebhook($validReq);

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame('HOTMART_HP1234567890', $result['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $result['status']);
        $this->assertSame('HP1234567890', $result['transaction_id']);
        $this->assertSame('aluno@hotmart.com', $result['student_email']);
        $this->assertSame('Carlos Hotmart', $result['student_name']);
        $this->assertSame('HOT_PROD_8899', $result['product_id']);
        $this->assertEquals(197.00, $result['total']);
    }

    public function testClickBankGatewayWebhookParsingAndVerification(): void
    {
        $settingsMock = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);

            'customer'         => [
                'billing' => [
                    'email'    => 'john@clickbank.com',
                    'fullName' => 'John Doe',
                ],
            ],
            'lineItems'        => [
                [
                    'itemNo' => 'CB_ITEM_1',
                ],
            ],
            'totalOrderAmount' => 97.00,
        ];

        $req = new Request([], $payload, [], [], [], $payload);
        $result = $gateway->handleWebhook($req);

        $this->assertNotNull($result);
        $this->assertSame('CLICKBANK_CBK_RC_12345', $result['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $result['status']);
        $this->assertSame('john@clickbank.com', $result['student_email']);
        $this->assertSame('John Doe', $result['student_name']);
        $this->assertSame('CB_ITEM_1', $result['product_id']);
        $this->assertEquals(97.00, $result['total']);
    }

    public function testWebhookControllerAutoProvisionsStudentAndFulfillsCourse(): void
    {
        // 1. Cadastra curso vinculado à Hotmart
        $courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($this->pdo, false);
        $courseId = $courseRepo->create([
            'title'               => 'Curso de Inteligência Artificial',
            'slug'                => 'curso-de-ia',
            'description'         => 'Do básico ao avançado',
            'status'              => 'published',
            'price'               => 497.00,
            'is_free'             => 0,
            'max_installments'    => 12,
            'external_platform'   => 'hotmart',
            'external_product_id' => 'HOT-IA-100',
        ]);

        $orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);

        $gatewayRegistry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $settingsMock = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settingsMock->method('get')->with('hotmart_hottok')->willReturn('SECRET_TEST_HOTTOK');
        $gatewayRegistry->register(new HotmartGateway(settings: $settingsMock));

        // Event Dispatcher fake para capturar o evento disparado
        $capturedEvents = [];
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function ($eventName, $payload) use (&$capturedEvents) {
            $capturedEvents[$eventName] = $payload;
            return null;
        });

        $controller = new WebhookController(
            $orderRepo,
            $gatewayRegistry,
            $dispatcher,
            $this->pdo
        );

        // Simula webhook da Hotmart de aluno que NÃO existe previamente no banco
        $payload = [
            'event'  => 'PURCHASE_APPROVED',
            'hottok' => 'SECRET_TEST_HOTTOK',
            'data'   => [
                'buyer'    => [
                    'email' => 'novato@alunohotmart.com',
                    'name'  => 'Novo Aluno Hotmart',
                ],
                'product'  => [
                    'id' => 'HOT-IA-100',
                ],
                'purchase' => [
                    'transaction' => 'HP_AUTO_999',
                    'price'       => ['value' => 497.00],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $request = new Request([], $payload, [], [], [], $payload);
        $response = $controller->handle($request, 'hotmart');

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($body['received']);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $body['order_status']);
        $this->assertTrue($body['provisioned']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $body['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame($courseId, $body['course_id']);

        // Verifica se o usuário foi criado na tabela users
        $stmtUser = $this->pdo->prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?");
        $stmtUser->execute(['novato@alunohotmart.com']);
        $user = $stmtUser->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($user);
        $this->assertSame('Novo Aluno Hotmart', $user['name']);

        // Verifica se o pedido foi gravado como pago
        $order = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef('HOTMART_HP_AUTO_999');
        $this->assertNotNull($order);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $order['status']);
        $this->assertSame('hotmart', $order['gateway']);
        $this->assertEquals(497.00, (float)$order['total']);

        // Verifica se o evento 'payment.approved' foi disparado com os dados exatos para matricular o aluno
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('payment.approved', $capturedEvents);
        $this->assertSame((int)$user['id'], $capturedEvents['payment.approved']['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame($courseId, $capturedEvents['payment.approved']['course_id']);
        $this->assertSame('HOTMART_HP_AUTO_999', $capturedEvents['payment.approved']['order_ref']);
    }

    public function testWebhookWithUnknownProductDoesNotCreateOrderOrEnrollment(): void
    {
        $orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
        $gatewayRegistry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settings->method('get')->willReturnCallback(fn($k) => match ($k) {
            'hotmart_hottok' => 'SECRET_TEST_HOTTOK',
            default => null,
        });
        $gatewayRegistry->register(new HotmartGateway(settings: $settings));

        $capturedEvents = [];
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function ($event, $data) use (&$capturedEvents) {
            $capturedEvents[$event] = $data;
            return null;
        });

        $controller = new WebhookController(
            $orderRepo,
            $gatewayRegistry,
            $dispatcher,
            $this->pdo
        );

        $payload = [
            'event'  => 'PURCHASE_APPROVED',
            'hottok' => 'SECRET_TEST_HOTTOK',
            'data'   => [
                'buyer'    => [
                    'email' => 'estranho@qualquer.com',
                    'name'  => 'Comprador Desconhecido',
                ],
                'product'  => ['id' => 'PRODUTO_INEXISTENTE_NO_SISTEMA'],
                'purchase' => [
                    'transaction'         => 'HOTMART_ORPHAN_001',
                    'order_date'          => 1600000000000,
                    'price'               => ['value' => 150.00],
                    'recurrent'           => false,
                    'payment'             => ['type' => 'CREDIT_CARD', 'installments_number' => 1],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        $request = new Request([], $payload, [], [], [], $payload);
        $response = $controller->handle($request, 'hotmart');

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $body = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($body['received']);
        $this->assertSame('orphan', $body['action'] ?? null);

        // Não dispara evento de aprovação de matrícula nem cria pedido
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('payment.approved', $capturedEvents);
        $this->assertNull($orderRepo->findByOrderRef('HOTMART_ORPHAN_001'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ApplicationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Application;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use DomainSystem\Core\Events\EventDispatcher;

class ApplicationTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_app_test_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(5));
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0777, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testApplicationInitialization()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        
        $app = new Application($container, $dispatcher, $this->tempDir);
        
        $this->assertSame($container, $app->getContainer());
        $this->assertSame($dispatcher, $app->getDispatcher());
    }

    public function testApplicationSingleton()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        
        $app = new Application($container, $dispatcher, $this->tempDir);
        
        $this->assertSame($app, Application::getInstance());
    }

    public function testPluginInitializationHooks()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        
        $app = new Application($container, $dispatcher, $this->tempDir);
        
        $called = false;
        $dispatcher->addListener('init', function() use (&$called) {
            $called = true;
        });

        // Simulating the kernel boot process
        $app->boot();

        $this->assertTrue($called, "The 'init' hook should be dispatched during application boot.");
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir), ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AuthMiddlewareTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Middlewares\AuthMiddleware;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\SessionManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\IdentityManager;

class AuthMiddlewareTest extends TestCase
{
    private $sessionMock;
    private $identityMock;
    private $requestMock;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManager::class);
        $this->identityMock = $this->createMock(IdentityManager::class);
        $this->requestMock = $this->createMock(Request::class);
    }

    public function testMiddlewareAllowsPublicRoutes()
    {
        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($this->sessionMock, $this->identityMock);
        
        $called = false;
        $next = function($req) use (&$called) {
            $called = true;
            return 'passed';
        };

        // Rota pública (capabilities vazio)
        $result = $middleware->handle($this->requestMock, $next, ['capabilities' => []]);
        
        $this->assertTrue($called);
        $this->assertEquals('passed', $result);
    }
    
    public function testMiddlewareBlocksAccessWhenDenied()
    {
        $this->sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnMap([
            ['user_id', null, 5],
            ['user_name', 'Usuário 5', 'Tester']
        ]);
        
        $this->identityMock->method('userCan')->willReturn(false);
        $this->identityMock->method('hasRole')->willReturn(false);
        
        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($this->sessionMock, $this->identityMock);
        
        $called = false;
        $next = function($req) use (&$called) {
            $called = true;
            return 'passed';
        };

        $result = $middleware->handle($this->requestMock, $next, ['capabilities' => ['core.manage']]);
        
        $this->assertFalse($called);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $result);
        $this->assertEquals(403, $result->getStatusCode());
    }
    
    public function testMiddlewareAllowsAccessWhenUserHasCapability()
    {
        $this->sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnMap([
            ['user_id', null, 5] // User is logged in
        ]);
        
        // Identidade diz que ele PODE
        $this->identityMock->method('userCan')->with(5, 'core.manage')->willReturn(true);
        
        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($this->sessionMock, $this->identityMock);
        
        $called = false;
        $next = function($req) use (&$called) {
            $called = true;
            return 'passed';
        };

        $result = $middleware->handle($this->requestMock, $next, ['capabilities' => ['core.manage']]);
        
        $this->assertTrue($called);
    }

    public function testMiddlewareFallbacksToLegacyRoles()
    {
        $this->sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnMap([
            ['user_id', null, 10]
        ]);
        
        // Simulando um plugin legado que não usa capabilities, e sim roles (cargo puro)
        // userCan vai retornar falso, mas hasRole vai retornar verdadeiro
        $this->identityMock->method('userCan')->willReturn(false);
        $this->identityMock->method('hasRole')->with(10, 'editor')->willReturn(true);
        
        $middleware = new AuthMiddleware($this->sessionMock, $this->identityMock);
        
        $called = false;
        $next = function($req) use (&$called) {
            $called = true;
            return 'passed';
        };

        // Rota legada usando 'roles'
        $result = $middleware->handle($this->requestMock, $next, ['roles' => ['editor']]);
        
        $this->assertTrue($called);
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/AuthThrottlingAndTimingSecurityTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\CockpitRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\StudentAuthController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\StudentAuthService;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\LoginThrottleInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Contracts\UserRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Controllers\AuthController;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Services\PdoLoginThrottle;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\auth\Services\TwoFactorService;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class AuthThrottlingAndTimingSecurityTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $this->pdo->exec("
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                username VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NULL,
                email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                role VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'user',
                status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'active',
                created_at DATETIME,
                updated_at DATETIME
            )
        ");
    }

    public function testPdoLoginThrottleLocksAfterConfiguredAttemptsAndClears(): void
    {
        $throttle = new PdoLoginThrottle($this->pdo, 3, 5);
        $key = 'test@example.com|127.0.0.1';

        $this->assertFalse($throttle->tooManyAttempts($key));

        $throttle->hit($key);
        $this->assertFalse($throttle->tooManyAttempts($key));

        $throttle->hit($key);
        $this->assertFalse($throttle->tooManyAttempts($key));

        $throttle->hit($key); // 3ª tentativa atinge o limite
        $this->assertTrue($throttle->tooManyAttempts($key));

        $throttle->clear($key);
        $this->assertFalse($throttle->tooManyAttempts($key));
    }

    public function testStudentAuthBlocksAfterTooManyFailedAttempts(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf');

        $throttle = $this->createMock(LoginThrottleInterface::class);
        $throttle->method('tooManyAttempts')->willReturn(true);

        $studentAuth = $this->createMock(StudentAuthService::class);
        $studentAuth->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('error', 'Muitas tentativas de login incorretas. Aguarde alguns minutos antes de tentar novamente.');

        $controller = new StudentAuthController(
            $session,
            $this->pdo,
            $studentAuth,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            $throttle
        );

        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'valid_csrf',
            'email'      => 'aluno@teste.com',
            'password'   => 'QualquerSenha123',
        ], [], [], ['REMOTE_ADDR' => '127.0.0.1']);

        $response = $controller->authenticate($request);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function testStudentAuthTimingMitigationOnNonExistentEmail(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf');

        $throttle = $this->createMock(LoginThrottleInterface::class);
        $throttle->method('tooManyAttempts')->willReturn(false);
        $throttle->expects($this->once())->method('hit');

        $studentAuth = $this->createMock(StudentAuthService::class);
        $studentAuth->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('error', 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.');

        $controller = new StudentAuthController(
            $session,
            $this->pdo,
            $studentAuth,
            null,
            null,
            null,
            $throttle
        );

        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'valid_csrf',
            'email'      => 'inexistente@teste.com',
            'password'   => 'SenhaIncorreta!123',
        ], [], [], ['REMOTE_ADDR' => '127.0.0.1']);

        $response = $controller->authenticate($request);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
    }

    public function testStudentRegistrationGracefulUniqueConstraintHandling(): void
    {
        // Insere usuário inicial
        $this->pdo->exec("INSERT INTO users (name, username, email, password, role) VALUES ('Existente', 'existente', 'duplicado@teste.com', 'hash', 'user')");

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_csrf');

        $studentAuth = $this->createMock(StudentAuthService::class);
        // O flash deve ser amigável e NÃO conter SQLSTATE ou tabela
        $studentAuth->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('error', 'Este e-mail já possui cadastro. Faça login para continuar.');

        $controller = new StudentAuthController(
            $session,
            $this->pdo,
            $studentAuth
        );

        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'       => 'valid_csrf',
            'name'             => 'Novo Aluno',
            'username'         => 'novoaluno',
            'email'            => 'duplicado@teste.com',
            'password'              => 'SenhaSegura!123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'SenhaSegura!123',
        ]);

        $response = $controller->register($request);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
    }
}

    public function testDesignTokensTertiaryFontAndBorderPalette(): void

        $tokens = new DesignTokens($tmpFile);

        $css = $tokens->generateCssVariables();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--font-tertiary:', $css);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--color-border:', $css);

        if (file_exists($tmpFile)) {
            @unlink($tmpFile);
        }
    }

    public function testButtonAndCtaMobileDrawerAbsorbAttributes(): void
    {
        $buttonBlock = new ButtonBlock();
        $defaultHtml = $buttonBlock->render(['label' => 'Clique Aqui']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="true"', $defaultHtml);

        $notAbsorbedHtml = $buttonBlock->render(['label' => 'Fixo na Barra', 'absorb_in_mobile' => false]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="false"', $notAbsorbedHtml);

        $ctaBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\CtaButtonBlock();
        $ctaDefaultHtml = $ctaBlock->render(['label' => 'Começar']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="true"', $ctaDefaultHtml);

        $ctaNotAbsorbedHtml = $ctaBlock->render(['label' => 'Começar', 'absorb_in_mobile' => false]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="false"', $ctaNotAbsorbedHtml);

        $userAuthBlock = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\UserAuthBlock();
        $userAuthDefault = $userAuthBlock->render([]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="true"', $userAuthDefault);

        $userAuthNotAbsorbed = $userAuthBlock->render(['absorb_in_mobile' => false]);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('data-mobile-absorb="false"', $userAuthNotAbsorbed);
    }

    public function testLogoBlockResponsiveDesktopAndMobileStyles(): void
    {
        $logo = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\LogoBlock();
        $this->assertSame('logo', $logo->getType());

        // Render padrão Desktop
        $defaultHtml = $logo->render([
            '_id'        => 'test_logo_1',
            'brand_text' => 'DomainSystem',
            'align'      => 'center',
            'height'     => '40px',
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('id="test_logo_1"', $defaultHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainSystem', $defaultHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('justify-content: center !important;', $defaultHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('text-align: center !important;', $defaultHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('height: 40px', $defaultHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('@media (max-width: 768px)', $defaultHtml);

        // Render com customizações responsivas para Mobile (centralizado, coluna, menor altura, texto mobile)
        $responsiveHtml = $logo->render([
            '_id'                   => 'test_logo_resp',
            'brand_text'            => 'DomainSystem Desktop',
            'text_mobile'           => 'DS Mobile',
            'align'                 => 'left',
            'align_mobile'          => 'center',
            'flex_direction'        => 'row',
            'flex_direction_mobile' => 'column',
            'height'                => '44px',
            'height_mobile'         => '26px',
            'font_size'             => '1.5rem',
            'font_size_mobile'      => '1.0rem',
            'font_weight'           => '800',
            'font_weight_mobile'    => '500',
        ]);

        // Verifica regras do Desktop
        $this->assertStringContainsString('justify-content: flex-start', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('flex-direction: row', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('height: 44px', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-weight: 800', $responsiveHtml);

        // Verifica regras de Mobile dentro da Media Query 768px
        $this->assertStringContainsString('@media (max-width: 768px)', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('justify-content: center !important;', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('flex-direction: column !important;', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('height: 26px !important;', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-size: 1.0rem !important;', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('font-weight: 500 !important;', $responsiveHtml);

        // Verifica classes de alternância de texto
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-logo-text-desktop', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-logo-text-mobile', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainSystem Desktop', $responsiveHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DS Mobile', $responsiveHtml);

        // Verifica Schema com campos responsivos
        $schema = $logo->getSchema();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('align_mobile', $schema['fields']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('flex_direction_mobile', $schema['fields']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('height_mobile', $schema['fields']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('text_mobile', $schema['fields']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('font_weight_mobile', $schema['fields']);
    }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CachePolicyTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\CachePolicy;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response;

class CachePolicyTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSensitivePathsReceiveNoCacheHeaders(): void
    {
        $policy = new CachePolicy();

        foreach (['/admin', '/admin/settings', '/login', '/setup', '/api/data'] as $path) {
            $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'GET';
            $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = $path;

            $request = Request::capture();
            $response = new Response('OK', 200);

            $modifiedResponse = $policy->apply($request, $response);

            $cacheControl = $modifiedResponse->getHeader('Cache-Control');
            $this->assertNotNull($cacheControl, "Cache-Control deve existir para {$path}");
            $this->assertStringContainsString('no-store', $cacheControl);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('no-cache', $cacheControl);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('private', $cacheControl);

            $this->assertEquals('no-cache', $modifiedResponse->getHeader('Pragma'));
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Cookie', (string)$modifiedResponse->getHeader('Vary'));
        }
    }

    public function testLogoutReceivesClearSiteData(): void
    {
        $policy = new CachePolicy();

        $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'GET';
        $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = '/logout';

        $request = Request::capture();
        $response = new Response('Redirecting', 302);

        $modifiedResponse = $policy->apply($request, $response);

        $clearSiteData = $modifiedResponse->getHeader('Clear-Site-Data');
        $this->assertNotNull($clearSiteData, 'Clear-Site-Data deve existir no logout.');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('"cache"', $clearSiteData);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CheckoutSecurityTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\OrderRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CheckoutSecurityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testUnconfiguredGatewayCannotCreatePaidOrder(): void
    {
        $gateway = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayInterface::class);
        $gateway->method('getId')->willReturn('stripe');
        $gateway->method('isConfigured')->willReturn(false);
        $gateway->expects($this->never())->method('processPayment');

        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('stripe')->willReturn($gateway);

        $orderRepo = $this->createMock(OrderRepositoryInterface::class);
        $orderRepo->expects($this->never())->method('createOrder');

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($key) {
            return match ($key) {
                'academy_student_id', 'user_id' => 10,
                default => null,
            };
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('valid_token');

        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(1)->willReturn([
            'id'     => 1,
            'title'  => 'Curso PHP Avançado',
            'price'  => 199.90,
            'status' => 'published',
        ]);

        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settings->method('get')->with('commerce_demo_mode', false)->willReturn(false);

        $controller = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $courseRepo,
            null,
            null,
            $settings
        );

        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token'     => 'valid_token',
            'course_id'      => 1,
            'gateway'        => 'stripe',
            'payment_method' => 'credit_card',
        ], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']);

        $response = $controller->process($request);

        $this->assertSame(409, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertFalse($data['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('não está disponível no momento', $data['message']);
    }

    public function testInvalidGatewayReturns422(): void
    {
        $registry = $this->createMock(PaymentGatewayRegistryInterface::class);
        $registry->method('get')->with('invalid_gw')->willReturn(null);

        $orderRepo = $this->createMock(OrderRepositoryInterface::class);
        $orderRepo->expects($this->never())->method('createOrder');

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(fn($k) => match ($k) {
            'academy_student_id' => 5,
            default => null,
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token');

        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(1)->willReturn([
            'id'     => 1,
            'title'  => 'Curso Básico',
            'price'  => 50.00,
            'status' => 'published',
        ]);

        $controller = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $courseRepo
        );

        $request = new Request([], [
            'csrf_token' => 'token',
            'course_id'  => 1,
            'gateway'    => 'invalid_gw',
        ], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']);

        $response = $controller->process($request);
        $this->assertSame(422, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertSame('Meio de pagamento inválido.', $data['message']);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CommerceAcademyBridgeSimulationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Adapters\CoursePurchasableAdapter;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseNavigationInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseStructureRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Controllers\CourseFrontController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Repositories\PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\AcademyCourseFulfillment;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\CourseEnrollmentService;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PurchasableItemResolver;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * Teste de Simulação Completa da Conexão entre o Commerce ("WooCommerce do Domain System")
 * e o LMS Academy através de Interfaces e Contratos Formais (DIP / SOLID / Padrão Adapter).
 */
final class CommerceAcademyBridgeSimulationTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
    }

    public function testCommerceCanSellAcademyCourseViaInterfaceAndFulfillEnrollmentSeamlessly(): void
    {
        // =========================================================================
        // 1. O ACADEMY DISPONIBILIZA O CURSO COMO UM ADAPTADOR (PurchasableItemInterface)
        // =========================================================================
        $rawCourseData = [
            'id'          => 404,
            'title'       => 'Curso Avançado de SOLID e Micro-Kernels',
            'slug'        => 'curso-solid-avancado',
            'price'       => 249.90,
            'status'      => 'published',
            'description' => 'Aprenda a construir CMSs ultra-rápidos e modulares.',
            'image'       => 'https://cdn.meusite.com/capa-curso.png',
        ];

        // O Academy adapta o seu curso para a interface que o Commerce entende:
        $purchasableCourse = new CoursePurchasableAdapter($rawCourseData);

        $this->assertSame(404, $purchasableCourse->getId());
        $this->assertSame('course', $purchasableCourse->getItemType());
        $this->assertSame('Curso Avançado de SOLID e Micro-Kernels', $purchasableCourse->getTitle());
        $this->assertEquals(249.90, $purchasableCourse->getPrice());
        $this->assertTrue($purchasableCourse->isAvailable());

        // =========================================================================
        // 2. O COMMERCE RESOLVE O PRODUTO VIA CONTRATO (PurchasableItemResolverInterface)
        // =========================================================================
        $itemResolver = new PurchasableItemResolver();
        $itemResolver->registerResolver('course', function (int $id) use ($purchasableCourse) {
            return $id === 404 ? $purchasableCourse : null;
        });

        // O Commerce pergunta para a interface: "Qual é o produto 'course' com ID 404?"
        $resolvedItem = $itemResolver->resolve('course', 404);
        $this->assertNotNull($resolvedItem);
        $this->assertSame('Curso Avançado de SOLID e Micro-Kernels', $resolvedItem->getTitle());
        $this->assertEquals(249.90, $resolvedItem->getPrice());

        // =========================================================================
        // 3. O ALUNO CONCLUI O PEDIDO NO CHECKOUT DO COMMERCE (PIX)
        // =========================================================================
        $orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
        $settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $settings->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = null) {
            if ($k === 'commerce_demo_mode') {
                return true;
            }
            return $def;
        });

        $gatewayRegistry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $mercadoPago = new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $settings);
        $gatewayRegistry->register($mercadoPago);

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k) {
            return match ($k) {
                'user_id'    => 100, // ID do Aluno comprador
                'user_name'  => 'Ana Desenvolvedora',
                'user_email' => 'ana@dev.com',
                default      => null,
            };
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('csrf_token_seguro');

        $eventsDispatched = [];
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function ($eventName, $payload = null) use (&$eventsDispatched) {
            $eventsDispatched[] = ['event' => $eventName, 'payload' => $payload];
            return null;
        });

        $checkoutController = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $orderRepo,
            $gatewayRegistry,
            null, // CourseRepo é null porque o Commerce usa o itemResolver desacoplado!
            $dispatcher,
            $itemResolver,
            $settings
        );

        $checkoutRequest = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'csrf_token'     => 'csrf_token_seguro',
                'course_id'      => 404,
                'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
                'payment_method' => 'pix',
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $checkoutResponse = $checkoutController->process($checkoutRequest);
        $this->assertSame(200, $checkoutResponse->getStatusCode());
        $checkoutJson = json_decode($checkoutResponse->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($checkoutJson['success']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $checkoutJson['status']);
        $orderRef = $checkoutJson['order_ref'];
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ORD_', $orderRef);

        // O pedido foi salvo no banco do Commerce como 'pending'
        $orderInDb = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $orderInDb['status']);
        $this->assertEquals(249.90, (float)$orderInDb['total']);

        // =========================================================================
        // 4. ANTES DO PAGAMENTO: A AULA ESTÁ BLOQUEADA NO ACADEMY
        // =========================================================================
        $enrollmentRepo = new PdoCourseEnrollmentRepository($this->pdo);
        $enrollmentService = new CourseEnrollmentService($enrollmentRepo);

        // Aluno 100 ainda NÃO tem matrícula ativa
        $this->assertFalse($enrollmentService->hasActiveEnrollment(100, 404));

        // =========================================================================
        // 5. O BANCO ENVIA O WEBHOOK: COMMERCE LIQUIDA E O FULFILLMENT ENTREGA A MATRÍCULA
        // =========================================================================
        $webhookController = new WebhookController($orderRepo, $gatewayRegistry, $dispatcher);

        $webhookRequest = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'id'        => 'MP_TX_888999',
                'type'      => 'payment',
                'order_ref' => $orderRef,
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $webhookResponse = $webhookController->handle($webhookRequest, 'mercadopago');
        $this->assertSame(200, $webhookResponse->getStatusCode());

        // Pedido atualizado no Commerce para 'paid'
        $paidOrder = $orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $paidOrder['status']);

        // O evento 'payment.approved' foi disparado
        $this->assertCount(1, $eventsDispatched);
        $this->assertSame('payment.approved', $eventsDispatched[0]['event']);
        $this->assertSame(100, $eventsDispatched[0]['payload']['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame(404, $eventsDispatched[0]['payload']['course_id']);

        // O despachante de entrega do Academy (AcademyCourseFulfillment) atende a matrícula via interface:
        $fulfillment = new AcademyCourseFulfillment($enrollmentService);
        $this->assertTrue($fulfillment->supports('course'));

        $delivered = $fulfillment->fulfill(100, 404, $orderRef);
        $this->assertTrue($delivered);

        // =========================================================================
        // 6. APÓS O PAGAMENTO: AULA RESTAURADA E ACESSO 100% LIBERADO PARA O ALUNO
        // =========================================================================
        $this->assertTrue($enrollmentService->hasActiveEnrollment(100, 404));
        $this->assertContains(404, $enrollmentService->getActiveCourseIds(100));

        // Teste de exibição da aula real no CourseFrontController do Academy
        $courseMock = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseMock->method('findBySlug')->with('curso-solid-avancado')->willReturn($rawCourseData);

        $structureMock = $this->createMock(CourseStructureRepositoryInterface::class);
        $structureMock->method('getPublishedLessonBySlug')->with(404, 'aula-01')->willReturn([
            'id'        => 1,
            'course_id' => 404,
            'title'     => 'Aula Magna',
            'slug'      => 'aula-01',
            'status'    => 'published',
            'content'   => json_encode(['blocks' => [['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Bem-vindo ao Curso! Conteúdo 100% Desbloqueado.']]]]),
        ]);

        $navMock = $this->createMock(CourseNavigationInterface::class);
        $navMock->method('renderCourseNav')->willReturn('<nav>sidebar</nav>');
        $navMock->method('getAdjacentLessons')->willReturn(['prev' => null, 'next' => null]);

        $frontController = new CourseFrontController(
            $courseMock,
            $structureMock,
            $navMock,
            $this->createMock(\DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseCatalogRendererInterface::class),
            null,
            null,
            new \DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Services\LessonBlockRenderer(),
            null,
            $enrollmentService,
            $session
        );

        $lessonResponse = $frontController->showLesson('curso-solid-avancado', 'aula-01');
        $lessonHtml = $lessonResponse->getContent();

        // A aula NÃO exibe mais a tela de bloqueio com botão de compra
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteúdo Exclusivo para Alunos Matriculados', $lessonHtml);
        // O conteúdo foi renderizado com sucesso para o aluno!
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Bem-vindo ao Curso! Conteúdo 100% Desbloqueado.', $lessonHtml);

        // =========================================================================
        // 7. SIMULAÇÃO DE REEMBOLSO (T13): MATRÍCULA REVOGADA BLOQUEIA O ACESSO
        // =========================================================================
        $enrollmentRepo->updateStatus(100, 404, 'cancelled');
        $this->assertFalse($enrollmentService->hasActiveEnrollment(100, 404));

        $revokedResponse = $frontController->showLesson('curso-solid-avancado', 'aula-01');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteúdo Exclusivo para Alunos Matriculados', $revokedResponse->getContent());
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/CommercePaymentGatewayTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\academy\Contracts\CourseRepositoryInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Contracts\CommerceSettingsInterface;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\WebhookController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\DTO\PaymentResult;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CommercePaymentGatewayTest extends TestCase
{
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;
    private CommerceSettingsInterface $settings;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);

        $this->settings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $this->settings->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k, $def = null) {
            if ($k === 'commerce_demo_mode') {
                return true;
            }
            return $def;
        });
    }

    public function testOrderRepositoryLifecycleCreateFindUpdate(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 10,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 5,
            'total'          => 150.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_TEST_1001',
        ]);

        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $orderId);

        // Busca por ID
        $order = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertNotNull($order);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_TEST_1001', $order['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $order['status']);
        $this->assertEquals(150.00, (float)$order['total']);

        // Busca por Ref
        $orderRef = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef('ORD_TEST_1001');
        $this->assertNotNull($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame($orderId, (int)$orderRef['id']);

        // Atualiza status para pago
        $updated = $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, 'paid', 'TX_MP_999');
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        $orderPaid = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $orderPaid['status']);
        $this->assertSame('TX_MP_999', $orderPaid['transaction_id']);

        // Histórico de pedidos do aluno
        $userOrders = $this->orderRepo->getUserOrders(10);
        $this->assertCount(1, $userOrders);
    }

    public function testCheckoutControllerAndWebhookDispatchesPaymentApprovedEvent(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function ($k) {
            return match ($k) {
                'user_id'    => 25,
                'user_name'  => 'Carlos Aluno',
                'user_email' => 'carlos@aluno.com',
                default      => null,
            };
        });
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_checkout_valido');

        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $courseRepo->method('findById')->with(8)->willReturn([
            'id'     => 8,
            'title'  => 'Curso de Arquitetura PHP',
            'price'  => 297.00,
            'status' => 'published',
        ]);

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway(settings: $this->settings);
        $registry->register($mp);

        $dispatchedEvents = [];
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $dispatcher->method('dispatch')->willReturnCallback(function ($event, $payload = null) use (&$dispatchedEvents) {
            $dispatchedEvents[] = ['event' => $event, 'payload' => $payload];
            return null;
        });

        $checkoutController = new CheckoutController(
            $session,
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $courseRepo,
            $dispatcher,
            null,
            $this->settings
        );

        // 1. Processa pedido Pix via Checkout
        $requestCheckout = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'csrf_token'     => 'token_checkout_valido',
                'course_id'      => 8,
                'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
                'payment_method' => 'pix',
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $checkoutResponse = $checkoutController->process($requestCheckout);
        $this->assertSame(200, $checkoutResponse->getStatusCode());
        $checkoutData = json_decode($checkoutResponse->getContent(), true);

        $this->assertTrue($checkoutData['success']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $checkoutData['status']);
        $orderRef = $checkoutData['order_ref'];
        $this->assertNotEmpty($orderRef);

        // Pedido criado com status 'pending'
        $orderInDb = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $orderInDb['status']);

        // 2. Banco confirma o Pix e envia Webhook oficial para o Domain System
        $webhookController = new WebhookController(
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $dispatcher
        );

        $requestWebhook = new Request(
            [],
            [
                'id'        => '123456789',
                'type'      => 'payment',
                'order_ref' => $orderRef,
            ],
            ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']
        );

        $webhookResponse = $webhookController->handle($requestWebhook, 'mercadopago');
        $this->assertSame(200, $webhookResponse->getStatusCode());

        // 3. O pedido foi atualizado para 'paid'
        $orderPaid = $this->orderRepo->findByOrderRef($orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $orderPaid['status']);

        // 4. O evento 'payment.approved' foi disparado no Kernel para matricular o aluno no Academy
        $this->assertCount(1, $dispatchedEvents);
        $this->assertSame('payment.approved', $dispatchedEvents[0]['event']);
        $this->assertSame(25, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['user_id']);
        $this->assertSame(8, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['course_id']);
        $this->assertSame($orderRef, $dispatchedEvents[0]['payload']['order_ref']);
    }

        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway();

    }

    public function testRegistryPreventsSilentOverwriteUnlessExplicit(): void
    {
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $g1 = new MercadoPagoGateway();
        $g2 = new MercadoPagoGateway();

        $registry->register($g1);

        $this->expectException(\DomainException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage("O gateway de pagamento com identificador 'mercadopago' já está registrado.");

        // Segunda tentativa sem overwrite => exceção
        $registry->register($g2);
    }

    public function testRegistryAllowsOverwriteWhenExplicitlyEnabled(): void
    {
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $g1 = new MercadoPagoGateway();
        $g2 = new MercadoPagoGateway();

        $registry->register($g1);
        $registry->register($g2, overwrite: true);

        $this->assertSame($g2, $registry->get('mercadopago'));
    }

    public function testMercadoPagoRequiresCpfAndEmailInProduction(): void
    {
        // Gateway com access_token de produção (sem prefixo TEST-) e sandbox desativado
        $prodSettings = $this->createMock(CommerceSettingsInterface::class);
        $prodSettings->method('get')->willReturnMap([
            ['mercadopago_access_token', '', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-TOKEN'],
            ['mercadopago_public_key', '', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-KEY'],
            ['mercadopago_sandbox', false, false],
        ]);

        $mp = new MercadoPagoGateway('APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-TOKEN', 'APP_USR-1234567890-PROD-KEY', $prodSettings);
        $this->assertFalse($mp->isSandbox());

        // 1. Falha sem CPF informado
        $resultNoCpf = $mp->processPayment(
            ['order_ref' => 'ORD_PROD_1', 'total' => 50.00, 'student_email' => 'cliente@real.com', 'student_name' => 'Cliente Real'],
            ['method' => 'pix']
        );
        $this->assertFalse($resultNoCpf->success);
        $this->assertSame('failed', $resultNoCpf->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('CPF do pagador obrigatório', $resultNoCpf->message);

        // 2. Falha sem e-mail válido
        $resultNoEmail = $mp->processPayment(
            ['order_ref' => 'ORD_PROD_2', 'total' => 50.00, 'student_name' => 'Cliente Real'],
            ['method' => 'pix', 'payer_cpf' => '12345678901']
        );
        $this->assertFalse($resultNoEmail->success);
        $this->assertSame('failed', $resultNoEmail->status);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('E-mail válido do pagador é obrigatório', $resultNoEmail->message);
    }

    public function testCheckoutControllerCheckStatusReturnsPendingAndPaidStatus(): void
    {
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 55,
            'item_type'      => 'course',
            'item_id'        => 1,
            'total'          => 100.0,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_POLL_123',
        ]);

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $courseRepo = $this->createMock(CourseRepositoryInterface::class);
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $controller = new CheckoutController($session, $this->orderRepo, $registry, $courseRepo);

        // 1. Consulta pedido pendente
        $request = new Request([], [], [], [], [], []);
        $respPending = $controller->checkStatus($request, 'ORD_POLL_123');
        $this->assertSame(200, $respPending->getStatusCode());
        $dataPending = json_decode((string)$respPending->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPending['success']);
        $this->assertFalse($dataPending['paid']);
        $this->assertSame('pending', $dataPending['status']);

        // 2. Atualiza status para pago
        $this->orderRepo->updateStatus($orderId, 'paid', 'TX_PIX_777');
        $respPaid = $controller->checkStatus($request, 'ORD_POLL_123');
        $this->assertSame(200, $respPaid->getStatusCode());
        $dataPaid = json_decode((string)$respPaid->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPaid['success']);
        $this->assertTrue($dataPaid['paid']);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $dataPaid['status']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/aluno/painel', $dataPaid['redirect_url']);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\OrdersAdminController;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Repositories\PdoOrderRepository;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\MercadoPagoGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\PayPalGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\Gateways\StripeGateway;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\JsonCommerceSettings;
use DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Services\PaymentGatewayRegistry;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class CommerceSettingsAndStripeGatewayTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempSettingsFile;
    private PDO $pdo;
    private PdoOrderRepository $orderRepo;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempSettingsFile = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_test_settings_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4)) . '.json';
        $this->pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $this->pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $this->orderRepo = new PdoOrderRepository($this->pdo);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if (is_file($this->tempSettingsFile)) {
            @unlink($this->tempSettingsFile);
        }
    }

    public function testJsonCommerceSettingsCanSaveAndRetrieveSettings(): void
    {
        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $this->assertNull($settings->get('non_existent'));
        $this->assertSame('default_val', $settings->get('non_existent', 'default_val'));

        $settings->set('mercadopago_enabled', true);
        $settings->set('active_currency', 'BRL');

        $this->assertTrue($settings->get('mercadopago_enabled'));
        $this->assertSame('BRL', $settings->get('active_currency'));

        // Salvar em lote
        $saved = $settings->save([
            'mercadopago_access_token' => 'TEST_TOKEN_123',
            'paypal_client_id'         => 'PAYPAL_CLIENT_999',
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($saved);

        // Recarrega instância separada apontando para o mesmo arquivo
        $fresh = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $this->assertSame('TEST_TOKEN_123', $fresh->get('mercadopago_access_token'));
        $this->assertSame('PAYPAL_CLIENT_999', $fresh->get('paypal_client_id'));
        $this->assertTrue($fresh->get('mercadopago_enabled'));
    }

    public function testStripeGatewaySimulationAndWebhook(): void
    {
        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $settings->set('commerce_demo_mode', true);
        $stripe = new StripeGateway(settings: $settings);

        $this->assertSame('stripe', $stripe->getId());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Stripe', $stripe->getTitle());
        $this->assertFalse($stripe->isConfigured());

        // Processa pagamento em modo sandbox / simulação
        $result = $stripe->processPayment([
            'order_ref'     => 'ORD_STRIPE_1',
            'total'         => 199.90,
            'student_name'  => 'Maria Aluna',
            'student_email' => 'maria@teste.com',
        ], ['method' => 'credit_card']);

        $this->assertTrue($result->isApproved());
        $this->assertSame('ORD_STRIPE_1', $result->orderRef);
        $this->assertSame('stripe', $result->paymentMethod);

        // Webhook do Stripe com assinatura válida (checkout.session.completed)
        $secret = 'whsec_test_secret';
        $settings->set('stripe_webhook_secret', $secret);

        $webhookPayload = [
            'type' => 'checkout.session.completed',
            'data' => [
                'object' => [
                    'id'                  => 'cs_test_123456',
                    'client_reference_id' => 'ORD_STRIPE_1',
                ],
            ],
        ];
        $rawJson = (string)json_encode($webhookPayload);
        $ts = time();
        $sig = 't=' . $ts . ',v1=' . hash_hmac('sha256', $ts . '.' . $rawJson, $secret);

        $requestWebhook = new Request([], $webhookPayload, ['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE' => $sig], [], [], $webhookPayload, $rawJson);

        $webhookResult = $stripe->handleWebhook($requestWebhook);
        $this->assertNotNull($webhookResult);
        $this->assertSame('ORD_STRIPE_1', $webhookResult['order_ref']);
        $this->assertSame('approved', $webhookResult['status']);
        $this->assertSame('cs_test_123456', $webhookResult['transaction_id']);

        // Webhook ignorado para eventos desconhecidos
        $requestIgnore = new Request([], ['type' => 'customer.created'], ['HTTP_STRIPE_SIGNATURE' => $sig], [], [], ['type' => 'customer.created'], (string)json_encode(['type' => 'customer.created']));
        $this->assertNull($stripe->handleWebhook($requestIgnore));
    }

    public function testOrderRepositoryGetAllOrdersAndMetrics(): void

        ]);

        $this->orderRepo->createOrder([

    public function testOrdersAdminControllerDashboardAndSettingsWorkflow(): void
    {
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_admin_csrf_123');

        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $registry->register(new MercadoPagoGateway());
        $registry->register(new PayPalGateway());
        $registry->register(new StripeGateway());

        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);

        $controller = new OrdersAdminController(
            $session,
            $this->orderRepo,
            $registry,
            $settings,
            $dispatcher
        );

        $request = new Request();

        // 1. Renderiza Dashboard
        $indexResponse = $controller->index($request);
        $this->assertSame(200, $indexResponse->getStatusCode());
        $indexContent = $indexResponse->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('DomainCommerce', $indexContent);

        // 2. Renderiza Configurações
        $settingsResponse = $controller->settings($request);
        $this->assertSame(200, $settingsResponse->getStatusCode());
        $settingsContent = $settingsResponse->getContent();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Configurações de Pagamentos', $settingsContent);

        // 3. Salva Configurações via POST
        $saveRequest = new Request(request: [
            'csrf_token'               => 'token_admin_csrf_123',
            'mercadopago_enabled'      => '1',
            'mercadopago_access_token' => 'TOKEN_MP_LIVE_ABC',
            'paypal_enabled'           => '1',
            'active_currency'          => 'BRL',
        ]);

        $saveResponse = $controller->saveSettings($saveRequest);
        $this->assertSame(302, $saveResponse->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('TOKEN_MP_LIVE_ABC', $settings->get('mercadopago_access_token'));
        $this->assertTrue($settings->get('mercadopago_enabled'));

        // 4. Cria pedido pendente e aprova manualmente via Admin
        $orderId = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 55,
            'item_id'        => 22,
            'total'          => 250.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'mercadopago',
            'payment_method' => 'pix',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_MANUAL_APPROVE',
        ]);

        $dispatcher->expects($this->once())
            ->method('dispatch')
            ->with('payment.approved', [
                'user_id'   => 55,
                'course_id' => 22,
                'order_ref' => 'ORD_MANUAL_APPROVE',
            ]);

        $approveRequest = new Request(request: [
            'csrf_token' => 'token_admin_csrf_123',
            'status'     => 'paid',
        ]);

        $approveResponse = $controller->updateOrderStatus($approveRequest, $orderId);
        $this->assertSame(200, $approveResponse->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($approveResponse->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);

        $updatedOrder = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderId);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $updatedOrder['status']);
    }

    public function testStripeAndPayPalTestCredentialsValidation(): void

    public function testCheckoutControllerStripeAndPayPalSuccessCallbacks(): void
    {
        $orderIdStripe = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 70,
            'item_id'        => 15,
            'total'          => 180.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'stripe',
            'payment_method' => 'stripe',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_STRIPE_CALLBACK',
        ]);

        $orderIdPp = $this->orderRepo->createOrder([
            'user_id'        => 80,
            'item_id'        => 16,
            'total'          => 220.00,
            'status'         => 'pending',
            'gateway'        => 'paypal',
            'payment_method' => 'paypal',
            'order_ref'      => 'ORD_PAYPAL_CALLBACK',
        ]);

        $settings = new JsonCommerceSettings($this->tempSettingsFile);
        $settings->set('commerce_demo_mode', true);

        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $registry = new PaymentGatewayRegistry();
        $registry->register(new StripeGateway(settings: $settings));
        $registry->register(new PayPalGateway(settings: $settings));

        $controller = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\commerce\Controllers\CheckoutController(
            session: $session,
            orderRepo: $this->orderRepo,
            gatewayRegistry: $registry,
            dispatcher: $dispatcher,
            settings: $settings
        );

        // 1. Stripe Success Callback
        $reqStripe = new Request(query: ['order_ref' => 'ORD_STRIPE_CALLBACK', 'session_id' => 'cs_test_mock']);
        $respStripe = $controller->stripeSuccess($reqStripe);
        $this->assertSame(302, $respStripe->getStatusCode());

        $paidStripeOrder = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderIdStripe);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $paidStripeOrder['status']);

        // 2. PayPal Success Callback
        $reqPp = new Request(query: ['order_ref' => 'ORD_PAYPAL_CALLBACK', 'token' => 'PP_ORDER_MOCK']);
        $respPp = $controller->paypalSuccess($reqPp);
        $this->assertSame(302, $respPp->getStatusCode());

        $paidPpOrder = $this->orderRepo->findById($orderIdPp);
        $this->assertSame('paid', $paidPpOrder['status']);
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ContainerTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Container\Container;
use Exception;

class DummyDependency {}
class DummyService {
    public DummyDependency $dep;
    public function __construct(DummyDependency $dep) {
        $this->dep = $dep;
    }
}

class DummyWithUnionType {
    public DummyDependency|string $dep;
    public function __construct(DummyDependency|string $dep) {
        $this->dep = $dep;
    }
}

class ContainerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testAutoWiringWithUnionType()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $service = $container->make(DummyWithUnionType::class);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyWithUnionType::class, $service);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyDependency::class, $service->dep);
    }

    public function testBindAndMake()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $container->bind('foo', function() {
            return 'bar';
        });

        $this->assertEquals('bar', $container->make('foo'));
    }

    public function testSingleton()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $container->singleton('random', function() {
            return rand(1, 1000);
        });

        $val1 = $container->make('random');
        $val2 = $container->make('random');

        $this->assertEquals($val1, $val2, "Singleton should return the exact same instance/value.");
    }

    public function testAutoWiring()
    {
        $container = new Container();
        
        // Should automatically instantiate DummyDependency and inject it into DummyService
        $service = $container->make(DummyService::class);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyService::class, $service);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(DummyDependency::class, $service->dep);
    }

    public function testThrowsExceptionOnUnresolvable()
    {
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $container = new Container();
        $container->make('NonExistentInterface');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Core;

use DomainSystem\Core\Utils\SlugHelper;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class SlugHelperTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSlugifyConvertsAccentsAndSpecialCharacters(): void
    {
        $input = 'Programação Avançada em PHP & SOLID: Boas Práticas!';
        $expected = 'programacao-avancada-em-php-solid-boas-praticas';

        $this->assertSame($expected, SlugHelper::slugify($input));
    }

    public function testSlugifyReturnsFallbackWhenEmpty(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('item', SlugHelper::slugify(''));
        $this->assertSame('pagina', SlugHelper::slugify('   ', 'pagina'));
        $this->assertSame('aula-sem-titulo', SlugHelper::slugify('???@@@###', 'aula-sem-titulo'));
    }

    public function testSlugifyTrimsHyphens(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame('modulo-1', SlugHelper::slugify('--modulo--1--'));
    }
}
