// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ThemeActivationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\SafeThemeResolver;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeActivator;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\EnvSiteState;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\SystemAdmin\Controllers\AdminController;
use DomainSystem\Core\Plugin\PluginManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\ThemeManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ShortcodeManager;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\EventDispatcherInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Contracts\SessionManagerInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Http\Request;

class ThemeActivationTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempConfigDir;
    private array $originalEnv;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->originalEnv = [
            'ACTIVE_THEME' => getenv('ACTIVE_THEME') ?: null,
            'SITE_STATUS'  => getenv('SITE_STATUS') ?: null,
        ];
        $this->tempConfigDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/temp/test_themes_' . uniqid();
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/config', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default', 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Tema Alpha']));
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Tema Beta']));
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes/default/theme.json', json_encode(['name' => 'Default']));
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if ($this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME'] !== null) {
            putenv("ACTIVE_THEME={$this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME']}");
            $_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME'] = $this->originalEnv['ACTIVE_THEME'];
        } else {
            putenv('ACTIVE_THEME');
            unset($_ENV['ACTIVE_THEME']);
        }
        if ($this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS'] !== null) {
            putenv("SITE_STATUS={$this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS']}");
            $_ENV['SITE_STATUS'] = $this->originalEnv['SITE_STATUS'];
        } else {
            putenv('SITE_STATUS');
            unset($_ENV['SITE_STATUS']);
        }
        $this->recursiveDelete($this->tempConfigDir);
    }

    private function recursiveDelete(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $p = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $file;
            is_dir($p) ? $this->recursiveDelete($p) : @unlink($p);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testSafeThemeResolverDiscoversThemesInMultipleRoots(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('tema_alpha'));
        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('tema_beta'));
        $this->assertTrue($resolver->themeExists('default'));
        $this->assertFalse($resolver->themeExists('tema_fantasma'));

        $pathAlpha = $resolver->resolveThemePath('tema_alpha');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('tema_alpha', $pathAlpha);

        $pathDefault = $resolver->resolveThemePath('default');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('default', $pathDefault);

        // Fallback resiliente quando solicitado tema inexistente
        $fallback = $resolver->resolveThemePath('inexistente');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('default', $fallback);
    }

    public function testThemeActivatorActivatesExistingThemeAndPersistsState(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);

        // Estado inicial
        $this->assertEquals('default', $activator->getActiveTheme());

        // Ativa tema_beta
        $result = $activator->activate('tema_beta');
        $this->assertTrue($result['success']);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $result['theme']);

        // Verifica persistência
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $activator->getActiveTheme());

        $configFile = $this->tempConfigDir . '/config/active_theme.json';
        $this->assertFileExists($configFile);

        $saved = json_decode((string)file_get_contents($configFile), true);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_beta', $saved['active_theme']);
        $this->assertEquals('live', $saved['status']);
    }

    public function testThemeActivatorRejectsNonexistentTheme(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);

        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);
        $result = $activator->activate('tema_fantasma');

        $this->assertFalse($result['success']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('não foi encontrado', $result['message']);
    }

    public function testEnvSiteStateReadsThemeFromActiveThemeJson(): void
    {
        $configFile = $this->tempConfigDir . '/config/active_theme.json';
        file_put_contents($configFile, json_encode([
            'active_theme' => 'tema_alpha',
            'status' => 'live'
        ]));

        $siteState = new EnvSiteState(null, null, $this->tempConfigDir);

        $this->assertEquals('tema_alpha', $siteState->getActiveTheme());
        $this->assertTrue($siteState->isLive());
        $this->assertFalse($siteState->isComingSoon());
    }

    public function testAdminControllerActivateThemeEndpoint(): void
    {
        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);
        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);

        $pluginManager = $this->createMock(PluginManager::class);
        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $shortcodes = $this->createMock(ShortcodeManager::class);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);

        $session->expects($this->once())
            ->method('setFlash')
            ->with('success', $this->stringContains('tema_alpha'));

        $controller = new AdminController($pluginManager, $themeManager, $shortcodes, $dispatcher, $session, $activator);

        $request = new Request([], ['theme_folder' => 'tema_alpha'], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST']);
        $response = $controller->activateTheme($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertEquals('tema_alpha', $activator->getActiveTheme());
    }

    public function testAdminControllerPreviewThemeRendersRequestedTheme(): void
    {
        // 1. Cria index.php específico para tema_alpha e tema_beta
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_alpha/index.php', '<h1>Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Alpha</h1>');
        file_put_contents($this->tempConfigDir . '/themes/tema_beta/index.php', '<h1>Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Beta</h1>');

        $resolver = new SafeThemeResolver([
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/themes',
            $this->tempConfigDir . '/src/Plugins/flextheme/themes'
        ]);
        $activator = new ThemeActivator($this->tempConfigDir, $resolver);
        
        // Define tema_beta como ATIVO
        $activator->activate('tema_beta');

        $pluginManager = $this->createMock(PluginManager::class);
        $themeManager = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $shortcodes = $this->createMock(ShortcodeManager::class);
        $shortcodes->method('parse')->willReturnArgument(0);
        $dispatcher = $this->createMock(EventDispatcherInterface::class);
        $session = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $session->method('getCsrfToken')->willReturn('token_teste_123');

        $controller = new AdminController($pluginManager, $themeManager, $shortcodes, $dispatcher, $session, $activator);

        // 2. Solicita preview de tema_alpha (que NÃO está ativo)
        $request = new Request(['theme' => 'tema_alpha']);
        $response = $controller->previewTheme($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(\DomainSystem\Core\Http\Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        
        $body = $response->getContent();
        // Deve renderizar tema_alpha, NUNCA tema_beta
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Alpha', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Conteudo Exclusivo do Tema Beta', $body);
        
        // Deve conter a barra de preview com o botão de ativação
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-preview-topbar', $body);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('tema_alpha', $body);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Ativar este Tema', $body);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemeDiscoveryService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ThemeDiscoveryServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_theme_discovery_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/themes/rachidd', 0755, true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/themes/admin', 0755, true); // deve ser ignorado
        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/config', 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/themes/rachidd/theme.json', json_encode([
            'name' => 'Rachid Theme Pro',
        ]));

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/config/active_theme.json', json_encode([
            'active' => 'rachidd',
        ]));
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testGetAvailableThemesDiscoversThemesAndSkipsAdmin(): void
    {
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $themes = $service->getAvailableThemes();

        $this->assertCount(1, $themes);
        $this->assertSame('rachidd', $themes[0]['folder']);
        $this->assertSame('Rachid Theme Pro', $themes[0]['name']);
    }

    public function testGetActiveThemeFolderResolvesConfiguredTheme(): void
    {
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertSame('rachidd', $service->getActiveThemeFolder());
    }

    public function testGetActiveThemeFolderReturnsDefaultWhenMissing(): void
    {
        @unlink($this->tempDir . '/config/active_theme.json');
        $service = new ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $this->assertSame('default', $service->getActiveThemeFolder());
    }
}

<?php

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\ThemeManager;
use Exception;

class ThemeManagerTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $dummyThemePath = __DIR__ . '/../UI/dummy_theme';

    public function testRenderTemplate()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);

        // Rendering 'index' passing variables
        $html = $themeManager->render('index', [
            'title' => 'Test Title',
            'content' => 'Test Content'
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('<header>Header: Test Title</header>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<main>Content: Test Content</main>', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('<footer>Footer</footer>', $html);
    }

    public function testFallbackTemplate()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);

        // Try to render a non-existent template, it should look for index.php as fallback
        // Or throw exception depending on design. Let's make it throw exception if not found, 
        // but render has a strict mode and fallback mode. We'll stick to simple file inclusion for now.
        $this->expectException(Exception::class);
        $themeManager->render('non_existent');
    }

    public function testGetHeaderFunction()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);
        
        ob_start();
        $themeManager->get_header(['title' => 'Header Only']);
        $html = ob_get_clean();
        
        $this->assertEquals('<header>Header: Header Only</header>', trim($html));
    }

    public function testGetFooterFunction()
    {
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->dummyThemePath);
        
        ob_start();
        $themeManager->get_footer();
        $html = ob_get_clean();
        
        $this->assertEquals('<footer>Footer</footer>', trim($html));
    }
}

            $this->layoutGrid,
            $blockRegistry,
            $this->tokens,
            $this->tempDir
        );

        $themeManagerMock = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $discovery = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemeDiscoveryService($this->tempDir);
        $uploader = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\MediaUploadService($this->tempDir);
        $styleRenderer = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Styles\ElementStyleRenderer();
        $previewService = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemePartPreviewService($this->renderer);
        $managementService = new \DomainSystem\Plugins\flextheme\Services\ThemePartManagementService(
            $this->partRepo,
            $this->partAssoc,
            $discovery,
            new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Validation\ThemePartValidator($blockRegistry, $this->layoutGrid)
        );
        $urlResolver = new \DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Support\BaseUrlResolver();

        $this->controller = new ThemePartsAdminController(
            $this->partRepo,
            $this->partAssoc,
            $this->tokens,
            $blockRegistry,
            $this->layoutGrid,
            $this->renderer,
            $themeManagerMock,
            $this->shortcodeManager,
            null,
            null,
            $this->tempDir,
            $discovery,
            $uploader,
            null,
            $styleRenderer,
            $previewService,
            $managementService,
            $urlResolver
        );
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) return;
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testSavePartPersistsAndUpdatesAssociations(): void
    {
        $payload = [
            'id'                  => 'header_novo_123',
            'type'                => 'header',
            'title'               => 'Header Teste Ajax',
            'layout_preset'       => '3_cols_header',
            'container_settings'  => ['max_width' => '1200px'],
            'columns_data'        => [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Bem-vindo', 'level' => 'h2']]],
            ],
            'mobile_toggle_style' => MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL,
            'is_default'          => true,
            'assigned_theme'      => 'default',
        ];

        $request = new Request([], $payload, ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/builder/save-part']);
        $response = $this->controller->savePart($request);

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $data['id']);

        // Verifica se persistiu no repositório
        $saved = $this->partRepo->findById('header_novo_123');
        $this->assertNotNull($saved);
        $this->assertSame('Header Teste Ajax', $saved->getTitle());
        $this->assertSame(MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_MINIMAL, $saved->getMobileToggleStyle());

        // Verifica se associou como padrão global e ao tema default
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault('header'));
        $this->assertSame('header_novo_123', $this->partAssoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header'));
    }

    public function testDeletePartRemovesFromRepository(): void
    {
        $part = new ThemePart('part_to_delete', ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, 'Footer Antigo');
        $this->partRepo->save($part);
        $this->assertNotNull($this->partRepo->findById('part_to_delete'));

        $request = new Request([], ['id' => 'part_to_delete'], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',
            'REQUEST_URI'    => '/admin/builder/delete-part',
            'HTTP_ACCEPT'    => 'application/json',
        ]);
        $response = $this->controller->deletePart($request);

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertNull($this->partRepo->findById('part_to_delete'));
    }

    public function testAssignPartUpdatesThemeAndGlobal(): void
    {
        $request = new Request([], [

        ], [
            'REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST',

            'HTTP_ACCEPT'    => 'application/json',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('f_global_1', $this->partAssoc->getGlobalDefault('footer'));
    }

    public function testUploadImageDelegatesToMediaUploadService(): void
    {
        $pngBytes = base64_decode('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==');
        $tmp = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'ctrl_upload_');
        file_put_contents($tmp, $pngBytes);

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/builder/upload-image'], [], [
            'image' => [
                'name'     => 'ctrl_logo.png',
                'type'     => 'image/png',
                'tmp_name' => $tmp,
                'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
                'size'     => strlen($pngBytes),
            ],
        ]);

        $response = $this->controller->uploadImage($request);
        @unlink($tmp);

        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $data = json_decode($response->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($data['success']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('url', $data);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('filename', $data);
    }

    public function testLayoutGridRendererPresetsAndOutput(): void
    {
        $grid = new LayoutGridRenderer();
        $presets = $grid->getPresets();

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('1_col', $presets);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('2_cols_equal', $presets);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('2_cols_split', $presets);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('3_cols_header', $presets);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('3_cols_equal', $presets);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('4_cols_footer', $presets);

        // Renderiza seção 3 colunas (Header Pro)
        $cols = [
            '<div>Logo</div>',
            '<div>Menu</div>',
            '<div>CTA</div>',
        ];
        $html = $grid->renderSection('3_cols_header', $cols, [
            'boxed'       => true,
            'max_width'   => '1200px',
            'gap'         => 'medium',
            'align_items' => 'center',
            'padding'     => '15px 20px',
        ]);

        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-section-wrapper', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('max-width: 1200px', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('gap: 24px', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Logo', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Menu', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('CTA', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('@media (max-width: 480px)', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('@media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px)', $html);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('@media (min-width: 769px) and (max-width: 1024px)', $html);
    }

    public function testDefaultBlockRegistryFactoryContainsAll12Blocks(): void
    {

        $this->assertNotNull($registry->get('copyright'));

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ThemePartsFoundationTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\MobileToggleStyleInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\DesignTokens;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Repositories\JsonThemePartAssociation;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Repositories\JsonThemePartRepository;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ThemePartsFoundationTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_theme_parts_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testThemePartModelValidationAndSerialization(): void
    {
        $part = new ThemePart(
            'header_principal',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            'Header Principal Pro',
            '3_cols_header',
            ['boxed' => true, 'gap' => 'medium'],
            [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'nav_menu', 'data' => ['menu_id' => 1]]],
                2 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Acessar']]],
            ],
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL,
            true
        );

        $this->assertSame('header_principal', $part->getId());
        $this->assertSame(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, $part->getType());
        $this->assertSame('Header Principal Pro', $part->getTitle());
        $this->assertSame('3_cols_header', $part->getLayoutPreset());
        $this->assertSame(MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL, $part->getMobileToggleStyle());
        $this->assertSame('right', $part->getMobileToggleAlign());
        $this->assertTrue($part->isDefault());
        $this->assertCount(3, $part->getColumnsData());

        $serialized = $part->toArray();
        $this->assertIsArray($serialized);
        $this->assertSame('header_principal', $serialized['id']);
        $this->assertSame('right', $serialized['mobile_toggle_align']);

        $serialized['mobile_toggle_align'] = 'center';
        $restored = ThemePart::fromArray($serialized);
        $this->assertSame($part->getId(), $restored->getId());
        $this->assertSame($part->getTitle(), $restored->getTitle());
        $this->assertSame($part->getLayoutPreset(), $restored->getLayoutPreset());
        $this->assertSame($part->getMobileToggleStyle(), $restored->getMobileToggleStyle());
        $this->assertSame('center', $restored->getMobileToggleAlign());
    }

    public function testThemePartModelThrowsOnInvalidType(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
        new ThemePart('id_invalido', 'tipo_inexistente', 'Titulo');
    }

    public function testDesignTokensGenerationAndPersistence(): void
    {
        $storage = $this->tempDir . '/design_tokens.json';
        $tokens = new DesignTokens($storage);

        // 1. Valores padrão
        $palette = $tokens->getColorPalette();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('primary', $palette);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('background', $palette);

        $typography = $tokens->getTypography();
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('primary_font', $typography);

        // 2. Geração de CSS Variables
        $css = $tokens->generateCssVariables();
        $this->assertStringContainsString(':root {', $css);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--primary: #45f3ff;', $css);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--font-primary: Inter', $css);

        // 3. Atualização e persistência
        $updated = $tokens->updateTokens([
            'palette' => ['primary' => '#ff0055'],
            'typography' => ['primary_font' => 'Poppins, sans-serif'],
        ]);
        $this->assertTrue($updated);

        // 4. Recarrega do arquivo
        $tokensReloaded = new DesignTokens($storage);
        $newCss = $tokensReloaded->generateCssVariables();
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--primary: #ff0055;', $newCss);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--font-primary: Poppins', $newCss);
    }

    public function testJsonThemePartRepositoryCrud(): void
    {
        $repoDir = $this->tempDir . '/parts';
        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($repoDir);

        $header = new ThemePart('header_1', ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, 'Header 1');
        $footer = new ThemePart('footer_1', ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, 'Footer 1');

        $this->assertTrue($repo->save($header));
        $this->assertTrue($repo->save($footer));

        $this->assertCount(2, $repo->all());
        $this->assertCount(1, $repo->findByType(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER));
        $this->assertCount(1, $repo->findByType(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER));

        $found = $repo->findById('header_1');
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('Header 1', $found->getTitle());

        $this->assertTrue($repo->delete('header_1'));
        $this->assertNull($repo->findById('header_1'));
        $this->assertCount(1, $repo->all());
    }

    public function testJsonThemePartAssociationResolutionAndFallback(): void
    {
        $assocFile = $this->tempDir . '/associations.json';
        $assoc = new JsonThemePartAssociation($assocFile);

        // Inicialmente nada atribuído (retorna null -> aciona fallback nativo)
        $this->assertNull($assoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header'));

        // Atribui global default
        $this->assertTrue($assoc->setGlobalDefault('header', 'header_global'));
        $this->assertSame('header_global', $assoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header'));

        // Atribui header específico ao tema 'flextheme_dark' (sobrescreve o global)
        $this->assertTrue($assoc->assignPart('flextheme_dark', 'header', 'header_dark_exclusivo'));
        $this->assertSame('header_dark_exclusivo', $assoc->getAssignedPartId('flextheme_dark', 'header'));
        $this->assertSame('header_global', $assoc->getAssignedPartId('default', 'header')); // default continua com o global

        // Remove a associação específica do tema (restaura o global)
        $this->assertTrue($assoc->assignPart('flextheme_dark', 'header', null));
        $this->assertSame('header_global', $assoc->getAssignedPartId('flextheme_dark', 'header'));

        // Remove o global (restaura null / fallback nativo de arquivo)
        $this->assertTrue($assoc->setGlobalDefault('header', null));
        $this->assertNull($assoc->getAssignedPartId('flextheme_dark', 'header'));
    }
}

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/ThemePartsLayerTreeTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\BlockRegistry;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\HeadingBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\LogoBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Blocks\NavMenuBlock;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\LayerTreeInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Contracts\ThemePartInterface;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Grid\LayoutGridRenderer;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Models\ThemePart;
use DomainSystem\Core\Theme\Parts\Tree\LayerTreeBuilder;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class ThemePartsLayerTreeTest extends TestCase
{
    private LayerTreeBuilder $builder;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $registry = new BlockRegistry();
        $registry->register(new LogoBlock());
        $registry->register(new NavMenuBlock());
        $registry->register(new HeadingBlock());

        $grid = new LayoutGridRenderer();
        $this->builder = new LayerTreeBuilder($grid, $registry);
    }

    public function testBuildTreeGeneratesStandardizedHierarchy(): void
    {
        $part = ThemePart::fromArray([
            'id'    => 'header_main',
            'title' => 'Header Principal Pro',
            'type'  => ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            'sections' => [
                [
                    'id'            => 'sec_topbar',
                    'title'         => 'Topbar',
                    'layout_preset' => '2_cols_equal',
                    'columns_data'  => [
                        0 => [['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Bem-vindo!']]],
                        1 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Login']]],
                    ],
                ],
                [
                    'id'            => 'sec_nav',
                    'title'         => 'Navegação Principal',
                    'layout_preset' => '3_cols_header',
                    'columns_data'  => [
                        0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['text' => 'DomainSystem']]],
                        1 => [['type' => 'nav_menu', 'data' => ['menu_location' => 'header']]],
                        2 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Cadastre-se']]],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        $tree = $this->builder->buildTree($part);

        $this->assertSame('part_header_main', $tree['id']);
        $this->assertSame('root', $tree['type']);
        $this->assertSame('Header Principal Pro', $tree['name']);
        $this->assertSame(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, $tree['category']);

        $counts = $tree['counts'];
        $this->assertSame(2, $counts['sections']);
        $this->assertSame(5, $counts['columns']); // 2 cols in topbar + 3 cols in main
        $this->assertSame(5, $counts['blocks']);

        $this->assertCount(2, $tree['children']);
        $sec0 = $tree['children'][0];
        $this->assertSame('sec_topbar', $sec0['id']);
        $this->assertSame('Topbar', $sec0['name']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $sec0['children']);

        // Check first column of second section
        $sec1 = $tree['children'][1];
        $this->assertSame('sec_nav', $sec1['id']);
        $this->assertSame('3_cols_header', $sec1['preset']);
        $this->assertCount(3, $sec1['children']);

        $logoCol = $sec1['children'][0];
        $this->assertSame('Célula 1', $logoCol['name']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $logoCol['children']);

        $logoBlock = $logoCol['children'][0];
        $this->assertSame('block', $logoBlock['type']);
        $this->assertSame('logo', $logoBlock['block_type']);
        $this->assertSame('Logotipo / Marca', $logoBlock['name']);
    }

    public function testGetCountsReturnsAccurateSummary(): void
    {
        $part = ThemePart::fromArray([
            'id'    => 'footer_simple',
            'title' => 'Rodapé Simples',
            'type'  => ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER,
            'sections' => [
                [
                    'layout_preset' => '1_col',
                    'columns_data'  => [
                        0 => [
                            ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Texto 1']],
                            ['type' => 'copyright', 'data' => ['site_name' => 'DS']],
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        $counts = $this->builder->getCounts($part);
        $this->assertSame(1, $counts['sections']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $counts['columns']);
        $this->assertSame(2, $counts['blocks']);
    }

    public function testValidateDepthRespectsPartVerticalLimits(): void
    {
        $this->assertTrue($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, 1));
        $this->assertTrue($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, 3));
        $this->assertFalse($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER, 4));

        $this->assertTrue($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, 3));
        $this->assertFalse($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER, 4));

        $this->assertTrue($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION, 8));
        $this->assertFalse($this->builder->validateDepth(ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION, 15));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

class ThemePartsRendererTest extends TestCase

    private string $tempDir;

    {

        @mkdir($this->tempDir . '/config/theme_parts', 0755, true);
        
        // Cria um tema mock para testar o fallback nativo
        $this->themeMockDir = $this->tempDir . '/themes/test_theme';
        @mkdir($this->themeMockDir . '/partials', 0755, true);
        file_put_contents($this->themeMockDir . '/partials/header.php', '<header id="native-header">Native Header File</header>');
        file_put_contents($this->themeMockDir . '/partials/footer.php', '<footer id="native-footer">Native Footer File</footer>');
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    private function removeDirectory(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        $files = array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']);
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $path = $dir . '/' . $file;
            is_dir($path) ? $this->removeDirectory($path) : @unlink($path);
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    public function testRenderHeaderAndFooterWithDynamicParts(): void
    {
        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($this->tempDir . '/config/theme_parts');
        $assoc = new JsonThemePartAssociation($this->tempDir . '/config/associations.json');
        $grid = new LayoutGridRenderer();
        $tokens = new DesignTokens($this->tempDir . '/config/design_tokens.json');
        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();

        // 1. Cria Header Pro 3 colunas
        $headerPart = new ThemePart(
            'header_pro_1',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_HEADER,
            'Header Pro Test',
            '3_cols_header',
            ['boxed' => true, 'gap' => 'medium'],
            [
                0 => [['type' => 'logo', 'data' => ['brand_text' => 'Domain<b>OS</b>']]],
                1 => [['type' => 'nav_menu', 'data' => ['menu_location' => 'header', 'toggle_style' => 'pill']]],
                2 => [['type' => 'cta_button', 'data' => ['label' => 'Entrar', 'url' => '/login']]],
            ],
            MobileToggleStyleInterface::STYLE_PILL
        );
        $repo->save($headerPart);

        // 2. Cria Footer Pro 1 coluna
        $footerPart = new ThemePart(
            'footer_pro_1',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_FOOTER,
            'Footer Pro Test',
            '1_col',
            ['boxed' => true],
            [
                0 => [
                    ['type' => 'copyright', 'data' => ['text' => '© {year} Empresa Teste', 'show_lgpd_links' => true]],
                    ['type' => 'social_icons', 'data' => ['networks' => ['github' => 'https://github.com']]],
                ],
            ]
        );
        $repo->save($footerPart);

        // 3. Atribui ao tema 'test_theme'
        $assoc->assignPart('test_theme', 'header', 'header_pro_1');
        $assoc->assignPart('test_theme', 'footer', 'footer_pro_1');

        $renderer = new ThemePartRenderer($repo, $assoc, $grid, $registry, $tokens, $this->tempDir);

        // 4. Renderiza Header
        $headerHtml = $renderer->renderHeader('test_theme');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('id="ds-design-tokens"', $headerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('--primary:', $headerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Domain<b>OS</b>', $headerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-toggle-pill', $headerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Entrar', $headerHtml);

        // 5. Renderiza Footer
        $footerHtml = $renderer->renderFooter('test_theme');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Empresa Teste', $footerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('/privacidade', $footerHtml);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('GitHub', $footerHtml);
    }

    public function testRenderHeaderAndFooterGracefulFallbackToFile(): void

        $renderer = new ThemePartRenderer($repo, $assoc, $grid, $registry, $tokens, $this->tempDir);

    public function testNavMenuProviderAdapterConnectsToRepository(): void
    {
        $repoMock = $this->createMock(MenuRepositoryInterface::class);
        $repoMock->method('getMenuByLocation')->with('header')->willReturn([

        ]);

    public function testThemeManagerIntegratesWithThemePartRenderer(): void
    {
        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($this->tempDir . '/config/theme_parts');
        $assoc = new JsonThemePartAssociation($this->tempDir . '/config/associations.json');

    public function testSemanticWrapperAndCssIsolation(): void

    public function testRenderTemplateSectionAndFallback(): void
    {
        ThemePartRenderer::resetInjectedState();

        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($this->tempDir . '/config/theme_parts');
        $assoc = new JsonThemePartAssociation($this->tempDir . '/config/associations.json');
        $grid = new LayoutGridRenderer();
        $tokens = new DesignTokens($this->tempDir . '/config/design_tokens.json');
        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();

        $sectionPart = new ThemePart(
            'sec_home_custom',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
            'Seção Home Customizada',
            '1_col',
            [],
            [
                0 => [
                    ['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Bem-vindo à Home Dinâmica', 'level' => 'h1']],
                    ['type' => 'paragraph', 'data' => ['text' => 'Conteúdo central modularizado via FlexBuilder.']],
                ],
            ]
        );
        $repo->save($sectionPart);

        // Atribui a seção ao template 'home'
        $assoc->assignPart('test_theme', 'template:home', 'sec_home_custom');

        $renderer = new ThemePartRenderer($repo, $assoc, $grid, $registry, $tokens, $this->tempDir);

        // 1. Template com seção atribuída
        $htmlHome = $renderer->renderTemplateSection('test_theme', 'home');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Bem-vindo à Home Dinâmica', $htmlHome);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('ds-theme-section', $htmlHome);

        // 2. Com sufixo .php ou templates/
        $htmlHomePhp = $renderer->renderTemplateSection('test_theme', 'templates/home.php');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Bem-vindo à Home Dinâmica', $htmlHomePhp);

        // 3. Template sem seção atribuída -> Retorna vazio (permitindo fallback gracioso)
        $htmlSobre = $renderer->renderTemplateSection('test_theme', 'sobre');
        $this->assertSame('', $htmlSobre);
    }

    public function testThemeManagerConcatenatesAssignedSectionBelowNativeTemplate(): void
    {
        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($this->tempDir . '/config/theme_parts');
        $assoc = new JsonThemePartAssociation($this->tempDir . '/config/associations.json');
        $grid = new LayoutGridRenderer();
        $tokens = new DesignTokens($this->tempDir . '/config/design_tokens.json');
        $registry = DefaultBlockRegistryFactory::create();

        $sectionPart = new ThemePart(
            'sec_concat_test',
            ThemePartInterface::TYPE_SECTION,
            'Seção Concatenada Teste',
            '1_col',
            [],
            [
                0 => [
                    ['type' => 'heading', 'data' => ['text' => 'Seção Abaixo do Conteúdo', 'level' => 'h2']],
                ],
            ]
        );
        $repo->save($sectionPart);

        $themeFolder = basename($this->themeMockDir);
        $assoc->assignPart($themeFolder, 'template:home', 'sec_concat_test');

        @mkdir($this->themeMockDir . '/templates', 0755, true);
        file_put_contents(
            $this->themeMockDir . '/templates/home.php',
            "<div class='native-hero'><h1>Hero Nativo Antigo</h1></div>"
        );

        $renderer = new ThemePartRenderer($repo, $assoc, $grid, $registry, $tokens, $this->tempDir);
        $themeManager = new ThemeManager($this->themeMockDir, null, $renderer);

        $output = $themeManager->render('templates/home');

        // Ambos devem estar presentes (concatenados)
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Hero Nativo Antigo', $output);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Seção Abaixo do Conteúdo', $output);

        // A seção dinâmica deve vir abaixo do conteúdo nativo
        $nativePos = strpos($output, 'Hero Nativo Antigo');
        $customPos = strpos($output, 'Seção Abaixo do Conteúdo');
        $this->assertGreaterThan($nativePos, $customPos);
    }

    {
        $repo = new JsonThemePartRepository($this->tempDir . '/theme_parts');

                0 => [

        );
        $repo->save($part);

        $renderer = new ThemePartRenderer($repo, $assoc, $grid, $registry, $tokens, $this->tempDir);

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('ds-block-video', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('youtube.com/embed', $html);
    }

<?php

class TrackAStabilizationAuditTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_track_a_' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        if (!is_dir($this->tempDir)) {
            mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);
        }
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->cleanupDir($this->tempDir);
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    private function cleanupDir(string $dir): void
    {
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return;
        }
        foreach (array_diff(scandir($dir) ?: [], ['.', '..']) as $item) {
            $path = $dir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $item;
            if (is_dir($path)) {
                $this->cleanupDir($path);
            } else {
                @unlink($path);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($dir);
    }

    /**
     * N-6: Previne bypass por query string (/?x=/login) ou falso prefixo (/blog/admin-dicas)
     * e integra SiteStateInterface::isMaintenance().
     */
    public function testMaintenancePolicyBlocksQueryStringAndSubstringBypassesAndHonorsSiteState(): void
    {
        // 1. Bypass clássico via query string (/?x=/login ou /cursos?next=/admin)
        $normQueryBypass = MaintenancePolicy::normalizePath('/?x=/login', '/domain-system', '/domain-system/public');
        $this->assertSame('/', $normQueryBypass);
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath($normQueryBypass));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock($normQueryBypass, true));

        // 2. Bypass via substring no meio da URL (/blog/admin-dicas ou /login-fake)
        $normSubstring = MaintenancePolicy::normalizePath('/blog/admin-dicas');
        $this->assertSame('/blog/admin-dicas', $normSubstring);
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath($normSubstring));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock($normSubstring, true));

        $normFakePrefix = MaintenancePolicy::normalizePath('/login-fake');
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath($normFakePrefix));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock($normFakePrefix, true));

        // 3. Rotas legítimas com ou sem subpasta do XAMPP são liberadas
        $normAdminXampp = MaintenancePolicy::normalizePath('/domain-system/admin/monitor?tab=1', '/domain-system');
        $this->assertSame('/admin/monitor', $normAdminXampp);
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath($normAdminXampp));
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock($normAdminXampp, true));

        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/login'));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/logout'));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/api/os/monitor/stack'));
        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::isExemptPath('/setup/database'));

        // 4. SiteStateInterface com status = maintenance bloqueia visitantes mas libera role admin
        $siteStateMaint = $this->createMock(SiteStateInterface::class);
        $siteStateMaint->method('isMaintenance')->willReturn(true);

        $this->assertTrue(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock('/cursos', false, $siteStateMaint, 'guest'));
        $this->assertFalse(MaintenancePolicy::shouldBlock('/cursos', false, $siteStateMaint, 'admin'));
    }

    /**
     * H-03: Reset de fábrica exige reautenticação com senha do admin, usa SessionManagerInterface::destroy()
     * e apaga apenas tabelas gerenciadas (preservando tabelas de terceiros no mesmo banco).
     */
    public function testFactoryResetRequiresAdminPasswordAndOnlyDropsManagedTables(): void
    {
        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        // Cria tabelas do sistema + uma tabela externa de outra aplicação no mesmo schema
        $pdo->exec("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT, email TEXT, password TEXT, role TEXT)");
        $pdo->exec("CREATE TABLE settings (key_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, key_value TEXT)");
        $pdo->exec("CREATE TABLE external_erp_clients (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, company TEXT)");

        $hash = password_hash('AdminSecret#2026', PASSWORD_BCRYPT);
        $stmt = $pdo->prepare("INSERT INTO users (name, email, password, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'admin')");
        $stmt->execute(['Rachid Admin', 'admin@example.com', $hash]);
        $adminId = (int)$pdo->lastInsertId();

        $pdo->exec("INSERT INTO external_erp_clients (company) VALUES ('Acme Corp')");

        $connMock = $this->createMock(Connection::class);
        $connMock->method('getPdo')->willReturn($pdo);

        $themeMock = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $settingRepoMock = $this->createMock(SettingRepositoryInterface::class);

        $sessionMock = $this->createMock(SessionManagerInterface::class);
        $sessionMock->method('get')->willReturnCallback(function (string $key, $default = null) use ($adminId) {
            if ($key === 'user_id') {
                return $adminId;
            }
            if ($key === 'user_role') {
                return 'admin';
            }
            return $default;
        });

        // O método destroy() da sessão só deve ser chamado uma única vez (no sucesso)
        $sessionMock->expects($this->once())->method('destroy');

        $controller = new SettingsController($themeMock, $settingRepoMock, $connMock, $sessionMock, $this->tempDir);

        // 1. Sem senha -> 403
        $resNoPass = $controller->executeFactoryReset(new Request([], []));
        $this->assertSame(403, $resNoPass->getStatusCode());
        $dataNoPass = json_decode($resNoPass->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertFalse($dataNoPass['success']);

        // 2. Com senha incorreta -> 403 e tabelas intactas
        $resWrongPass = $controller->executeFactoryReset(new Request([], ['admin_password' => 'SenhaErrada123']));
        $this->assertSame(403, $resWrongPass->getStatusCode());
        $tablesBefore = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
        $this->assertContains('users', $tablesBefore);
        $this->assertContains('settings', $tablesBefore);
        $this->assertContains('external_erp_clients', $tablesBefore);

        // 3. Com senha correta -> 200, tabelas do sistema removidas, tabela externa preservada!
        $resOk = $controller->executeFactoryReset(new Request([], ['admin_password' => 'AdminSecret#2026']));
        $this->assertSame(200, $resOk->getStatusCode());
        $dataOk = json_decode($resOk->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($dataOk['success']);

        $tablesAfter = $pdo->query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
        $this->assertNotContains('users', $tablesAfter);
        $this->assertNotContains('settings', $tablesAfter);
        $this->assertContains('external_erp_clients', $tablesAfter, 'Tabelas não gerenciadas pelo Domain System jamais devem ser apagadas');
    }

    /**

    }

    /**
     * N-4: nav_menus\Plugin::activate() resolve MenuRepositoryInterface via container e não engole exceções.
     */
    public function testNavMenusActivateUsesContainerAndPropagatesErrors(): void

    /**
     * M-01: renderThemeFile exige separador de diretório após realpath($themePath) para impedir
     * leitura de pasta irmã com mesmo prefixo (ex: theme_active vs theme_active-evil).
     */
    public function testCourseFrontControllerRejectsSiblingThemeDirectoryPrefix(): void
    {
        $activeThemeDir = $this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'theme_active';
        $evilSiblingDir = $this->tempDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'theme_active-evil';
        mkdir($activeThemeDir, 0755, true);
        mkdir($evilSiblingDir, 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($evilSiblingDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'pwn.php', '<?php echo "PWNED_SIBLING";');

        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);

        $courseRepo = new PdoCourseRepository($pdo);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($pdo);
        $navService = new CourseNavigationService($courseRepo, $structureRepo, '');
        $catalogRenderer = new CourseCatalogRenderer($courseRepo);

        $themeMock = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $themeMock->method('getActiveThemePath')->willReturn($activeThemeDir);

        $controller = new CourseFrontController($courseRepo, $structureRepo, $navService, $catalogRenderer, null, $themeMock);

        $courseId = $courseRepo->create([
            'title'  => 'Curso Teste M01',
            'slug'   => 'curso-m01',
            'status' => 'published',
        ]);
        $modId = $structureRepo->createModule($courseId, 'Módulo 1', 1);
        $structureRepo->createLesson([
            'course_id'   => $courseId,
            'module_id'   => $modId,
            'title'       => 'Aula Traverse',
            'slug'        => 'aula-traverse',
            'source_type' => 'theme_file',
            'source'      => '../theme_active-evil/pwn.php',
            'status'      => 'published',
        ]);

        $response = $controller->showLesson('curso-m01', 'aula-traverse');
        $this->assertSame(200, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('PWNED_SIBLING', $response->getContent());
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Arquivo do tema não encontrado ou inacessível', $response->getContent());
    }

    /**
     * H-04 & M-10: syncCourseStructure preserva IDs existentes de módulos e aulas,
     * deduplica slugs no mesmo curso e rejeita status/source_type fora da whitelist.
     */
    public function testCourseStructureSyncPreservesIdsAndValidatesLessonInputs(): void
    {
        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite::memory:');
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $structureRepo = new PdoCourseStructureRepository($pdo);

        $courseId = 42;
        $structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, [
            [
                'title'   => 'Módulo Base',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'title'       => 'Aula 01 Intro',
                        'slug'        => 'aula-01-intro',
                        'source_type' => 'content',
                        'content'     => '<p>Texto original da aula 1</p>',
                        'status'      => 'published',
                    ],
                    [
                        'title'       => 'Aula 02 Config',
                        'slug'        => 'aula-02-config',
                        'source_type' => 'content',
                        'content'     => '<p>Texto original da aula 2</p>',
                        'status'      => 'draft',
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        $initialModules = $structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $initialLessons = $structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);
        $this->assertCount(1, $initialModules);
        $this->assertCount(2, $initialLessons);

        $mod1Id = (int)$initialModules[0]['id'];
        $lesson1Id = (int)$initialLessons[0]['id'];
        $lesson2Id = (int)$initialLessons[1]['id'];

        // 1. Atualiza estrutura preservando IDs (mesmo passando IDs explícitos + adicionando uma 3ª aula com slug repetido)
        $structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, [
            [
                'id'      => $mod1Id,
                'title'   => 'Módulo Base Renomeado',
                'lessons' => [
                    [
                        'id'          => $lesson1Id,
                        'title'       => 'Aula 01 Intro Atualizada',
                        'slug'        => 'aula-01-intro',
                        'source_type' => 'content',
                        'content'     => '<p>Texto atualizado</p>',
                        'status'      => 'published',
                    ],
                    [
                        'id'          => $lesson2Id,
                        'title'       => 'Aula 02 Config Publicada',
                        'slug'        => 'aula-02-config',
                        'source_type' => 'content',
                        'status'      => 'published',
                    ],
                    [
                        'title'       => 'Nova Aula com Slug Duplicado',
                        'slug'        => 'aula-01-intro',
                        'source_type' => 'content',
                        'content'     => '<p>Aula 3</p>',
                        'status'      => 'published',
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        $updatedModules = $structureRepo->getModules($courseId);
        $updatedLessons = $structureRepo->getLessons($courseId);

        $this->assertCount(1, $updatedModules);
        $this->assertSame($mod1Id, (int)$updatedModules[0]['id'], 'O ID do módulo deve ser preservado');
        $this->assertSame('Módulo Base Renomeado', $updatedModules[0]['title']);

        $this->assertCount(3, $updatedLessons);
        $this->assertSame($lesson1Id, (int)$updatedLessons[0]['id'], 'O ID da aula 1 deve ser preservado');
        $this->assertSame($lesson2Id, (int)$updatedLessons[1]['id'], 'O ID da aula 2 deve ser preservado');
        // Conteúdo da aula 2 foi preservado mesmo não sendo reenviado no payload
        $this->assertSame('<p>Texto original da aula 2</p>', $updatedLessons[1]['content']);
        // Slug duplicado foi desambiguado automaticamente
        $this->assertSame('aula-01-intro-1', $updatedLessons[2]['slug']);

        // 2. Status inválido deve lançar InvalidArgumentException e fazer rollback
        try {
            $structureRepo->replaceCourseStructure($courseId, [
                [
                    'id'      => $mod1Id,
                    'title'   => 'Módulo Corrompido',
                    'lessons' => [
                        [
                            'title'       => 'Aula Inválida',
                            'slug'        => 'aula-invalida',
                            'source_type' => 'content',
                            'status'      => 'hacked_status',
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ]);
            $this->fail('Deveria rejeitar status de aula inválido');
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
            $this->assertStringContainsString('Status de aula inválido', $e->getMessage());
        }

        // Verifica que o rollback manteve as 3 aulas intactas
        $this->assertCount(3, $structureRepo->getLessons($courseId));
    }

    /**
     * H-05 & M-05: MonitorController separa Limpar Logs de Reiniciar Ciclo do Kernel
     * e agrega picos reais de memória via RequestMetricsRecorder.
     */
    public function testMonitorControllerSeparatesClearLogsFromRestartKernelAndAggregatesMetrics(): void
    {
        $tempRoot = $this->tempDir . '/monitor_root';
        mkdir($tempRoot . '/temp', 0755, true);

        ProcessRegistry::killSingleton($tempRoot);
        $registry = new ProcessRegistry($tempRoot);
        $registry->startProcess('database', true);
        $initialSingletonId = $registry->getSingletonId();
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('KRN-', $initialSingletonId);

        file_put_contents($tempRoot . '/temp/error_logs.json', json_encode([['message' => 'Erro teste']]));

        $recorder = new RequestMetricsRecorder($tempRoot);
        $recorder->record('/cursos/arquitetura', 'GET', 54.25, 32.0, 120.5);

        $themeMock = $this->createMock(ThemeManagerInterface::class);
        $notifMock = $this->createMock(NotificationManagerInterface::class);

        $controller = new MonitorController($themeMock, $notifMock, $recorder, $tempRoot);

        // 1. getStackApi inclui o pico recente real (54.25 MB)
        $stackRes = $controller->getStackApi();
        $payload = json_decode($stackRes->getContent(), true);
        $this->assertTrue($payload['success']);
        $this->assertSame(54.25, $payload['system_memory']['recent_peak_mb']);
        $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(54.25, $payload['system_memory']['peak_mb']);

        // 2. clear() apaga logs e métricas, MAS preserva o ciclo do Kernel Singleton!
        $clearRes = $controller->clear();
        $this->assertSame(302, $clearRes->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertFileDoesNotExist($tempRoot . '/temp/error_logs.json');
        $this->assertSame(0.0, $recorder->getMaxRecentPeakMb());
        $this->assertSame($initialSingletonId, ProcessRegistry::getActiveSingletonId(), 'Limpar logs não deve matar o Kernel Singleton');

        // 3. restartKernel() encerra o ciclo do Kernel Singleton e gera um novo ID no próximo boot
        $restartRes = $controller->restartKernel();
        $this->assertSame(302, $restartRes->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertNull(ProcessRegistry::getActiveSingletonId());

        $newRegistry = new ProcessRegistry($tempRoot);
        $newRegistry->startProcess('database', true);
        $this->assertNotSame($initialSingletonId, $newRegistry->getSingletonId());
    }
}

    /**
     * DeepSeek PR #3: MigrationRunner executa migrações versionadas de forma idempotente
     */
    public function testMigrationRunnerExecutesAndTracksVersionedMigrationsIdempotently(): void
    {
        $conn = new Connection('sqlite::memory:');
        $runner = new \DomainSystem\Core\Database\MigrationRunner($conn);

        $tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_migrations_test_' . uniqid();
        mkdir($tempDir, 0777, true);

        $migrationFile = $tempDir . '/2026_10_16_000001_create_sample_items.php';
        file_put_contents($migrationFile, <<<'PHP'
<?php
return [
    'up' => function(\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("CREATE TABLE sample_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL)");
    },
    'down' => function(\PDO $db) {
        $db->exec("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_items");
    }
];
PHP);

        try {
            // 1ª execução: deve rodar a migration
            $firstRun = $runner->runForPlugin('sample_plugin', $tempDir);
            $this->assertSame(['2026_10_16_000001_create_sample_items'], $firstRun['executed']);
            $this->assertEmpty($firstRun['errors']);

            // 2ª execução: idempotente (não deve rodar novamente)
            $secondRun = $runner->runForPlugin('sample_plugin', $tempDir);
            $this->assertEmpty($secondRun['executed']);
            $this->assertEmpty($secondRun['errors']);

            $executedList = $runner->getExecutedMigrations('sample_plugin');
            $this->assertCount(1, $executedList);
            $this->assertSame('2026_10_16_000001_create_sample_items', $executedList[0]['migration']);
        } finally {
            @unlink($migrationFile);
            @rmdir($tempDir);
        }
    }

    /**
     * M-04: Router intercepta HttpResponseException em router.before_dispatch sem precisar de header()/exit
     */
    public function testRouterCatchesHttpResponseExceptionFromBeforeDispatchHook(): void
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();
        $router = new Router($container, $dispatcher);

        $dispatcher->addListener('router.before_dispatch', function (string $uri) {
            if (str_starts_with($uri, '/admin')) {
                throw new \DomainSystem\Core\Exceptions\HttpResponseException(
                    Response::redirect('/login')
                );
            }
        });

        $router->addRoute('GET', '/admin/dashboard', fn() => new Response('secreto'));

        $request = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'GET', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/admin/dashboard']);
        $response = $router->dispatch($request);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Response::class, $response);
        $this->assertSame(302, $response->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertSame('/login', $response->getHeader('Location'));
    }

    /**
     * N-5: HttpKernel processa POST /logout com proteção CSRF ponta a ponta
     */
    public function testHttpKernelDispatchesPostLogoutWithCsrfProtectionEndToEnd(): void
    {
        $container = new Container();
        $dispatcher = new EventDispatcher();

        $session = new class implements SessionManagerInterface {
            private array $store = ['user_id' => 7, 'csrf_token' => 'valid-csrf-token-123'];
            public bool $destroyed = false;
            public function start(): void {}
            public function getCsrfToken(): string { return $this->store['csrf_token'] ?? ''; }
            public function validateCsrfToken(?string $token): bool { return hash_equals($this->getCsrfToken(), (string)$token); }
            public function get(string $key, $default = null) { return $this->store[$key] ?? $default; }
            public function set(string $key, $value): void { $this->store[$key] = $value; }
            public function remove(string $key): void { unset($this->store[$key]); }
            public function has(string $key): bool { return isset($this->store[$key]); }
            public function destroy(): void { $this->store = []; $this->destroyed = true; }
            public function setFlash(string $type, string $message): void {}
            public function getFlash(): ?array { return null; }
            public function regenerate(): void {}
        };

        $container->singleton(SessionManagerInterface::class, fn() => $session);
        $container->singleton(\DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager::class, fn() => new \DomainSystem\Core\Security\SessionManager());

        $router = new Router($container, $dispatcher);
        $router->addGlobalMiddleware(\DomainSystem\Core\Routing\Middlewares\CsrfMiddleware::class);
        $router->addRoute('POST', '/logout', function () use ($session) {
            $session->destroy();
            return Response::redirect('/login');
        });

        $httpKernel = new \DomainSystem\Core\Http\HttpKernel($router, $container);

        // 1. Sem CSRF -> 403
        $badReq = new Request([], [], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/logout']);
        $badRes = $httpKernel->handle($badReq);
        $this->assertSame(403, $badRes->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertFalse($session->destroyed);

        // 2. Com CSRF válido -> 302 e sessão destruída
        $goodReq = new Request([], ['csrf_token' => 'valid-csrf-token-123'], ['REQUEST_METHOD' => 'POST', 'REQUEST_URI' => '/logout']);
        $goodRes = $httpKernel->handle($goodReq);
        $this->assertSame(302, $goodRes->getStatusCode());
        $this->assertTrue($session->destroyed);
    }

    /**
     * H-02: Ring 0 (src/Core) não referencia diretamente classes concretas de DomainSystem\SystemApps\*
     */
    public function testCoreRingZeroDoesNotDependDirectlyOnSystemAppsClasses(): void
    {
        $coreDir = DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT . '/src/Core';
        $iterator = new \RecursiveIteratorIterator(new \RecursiveDirectoryIterator($coreDir, \FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS));
        $violations = [];

        foreach ($iterator as $file) {
            if (!$file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                continue;
            }
            $content = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
            // Remove comentários para checar apenas código executável
            $stripped = preg_replace('!/\*.*?\*/!s', '', $content);
            $stripped = preg_replace('!//.*$!m', '', $stripped);

            if (preg_match('/DomainSystem\\\\SystemApps\\\\/', $stripped)) {
                $violations[] = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($file->getPathname(), strlen(DOMAIN_SYSTEM_ROOT) + 1));
            }
        }

        $this->assertEmpty(
            $violations,
            "Arquivos de src/Core (Ring 0) não devem acoplar diretamente a DomainSystem\\SystemApps\\*:\n" . implode("\n", $violations)
        );
    }

// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/TranslatorTest.php

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit;

use DomainSystem\Core\I18n\Translator;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class TranslatorTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/ds_i18n_test_' . uniqid('', true);
        @mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/pt_BR.json', json_encode([
            'hello'     => 'Olá, :name!',
            'welcome'   => 'Bem-vindo ao sistema',
            'save'      => 'Salvar',
        ]));

        file_put_contents($this->tempDir . '/en_US.json', json_encode([
            'hello'     => 'Hello, :name!',
            'welcome'   => 'Welcome to the system',
        ]));
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $files = glob($this->tempDir . '/*');
        if (is_array($files)) {
            foreach ($files as $file) {
                @unlink($file);
            }
        }
        @rmdir($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testTranslatesInDefaultLocale(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'pt_BR');
        $this->assertSame('Bem-vindo ao sistema', $translator->trans('welcome'));
    }

    public function testTranslatesInEnglishLocale(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'en_US');
        $this->assertSame('Welcome to the system', $translator->trans('welcome'));
    }

    public function testInterpolatesVariables(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'en_US');
        $this->assertSame('Hello, Rachid!', $translator->trans('hello', ['name' => 'Rachid']));
    }

    public function testFallsBackToDefaultLocaleWhenKeyMissing(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'en_US');
        // 'save' existe em pt_BR mas não em en_US
        $this->assertSame('Salvar', $translator->trans('save'));
    }

    public function testReturnsKeyWhenTranslationNotFoundAnywhere(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'en_US');
        $this->assertSame('untranslated_key', $translator->trans('untranslated_key'));
    }

    public function testNormalizesLocalePrefix(): void
    {
        $translator = new Translator($this->tempDir, 'en');
        $this->assertSame('en_US', $translator->getLocale());

        $translator->setLocale('es');
        $this->assertSame('es_ES', $translator->getLocale());

        $translator->setLocale('zh');
        $this->assertSame('zh_CN', $translator->getLocale());
    }
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
// Arquivo: domain-system/tests/Unit/Update/BackupTest.php
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DomainSystem\Tests\Unit\Update;

use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Enum\UpdateKind;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipDirectoryBackup;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Infrastructure\ZipPackageExtractor;
use DomainSystem\Core\Update\Value\BackupScope;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Backup\DatabaseBackupFactory;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Backup\MysqlDatabaseBackup;
use DomainSystem\SystemApps\Database\Backup\SqliteDatabaseBackup;
use PDO;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use ZipArchive;

final class BackupTest extends TestCase
{
    private string $tempDir;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->tempDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'ds-backup-test-' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6));
        mkdir($this->tempDir, 0755, true);
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        ZipPackageExtractor::removeDirectory($this->tempDir);
    }

    public function testZipDirectoryBackupCreatesRestoresRespectsExclusionsAndPrunes(): void
    {
        $root = $this->tempDir . '/project';
        mkdir($root . '/src/Core', 0755, true);
        mkdir($root . '/public/uploads', 0755, true);
        mkdir($root . '/config', 0755, true);
        mkdir($root . '/storage/logs', 0755, true);
        mkdir($root . '/temp', 0755, true);

        file_put_contents($root . '/bootstrap.php', "<?php // v2.3.0\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/Core/Kernel.php', "<?php // kernel original\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/config/plugins.json', '{"seo":true}');
        file_put_contents($root . '/.env', 'DB_PASS=secret');
        file_put_contents($root . '/database.sqlite', 'sqlite-bytes');
        file_put_contents($root . '/public/index.php', "<?php // index\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/public/uploads/foto.jpg', 'img-bytes');
        file_put_contents($root . '/storage/logs/app.log', 'log-bytes');

        $backup = new ZipDirectoryBackup($root);
        $scope = new BackupScope(UpdateKind::Core, 'core');

        $record1 = $backup->create($scope, 'pre-update-2.4.0');
        $this->assertFileExists($record1->codePath);
        $this->assertFileExists($root . '/storage/backups/.htaccess');

        // Verifica o que entrou e o que foi excluído no ZIP
        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $this->assertTrue($zip->open($record1->codePath));
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->locateName('bootstrap.php'));
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->locateName('src/Core/Kernel.php'));
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->locateName('config/plugins.json'));
        $this->assertNotFalse($zip->locateName('public/index.php'));
        $this->assertFalse($zip->locateName('.env'));
        $this->assertFalse($zip->locateName('database.sqlite'));
        $this->assertFalse($zip->locateName('public/uploads/foto.jpg'));
        $this->assertFalse($zip->locateName('storage/logs/app.log'));
        $zip->close();

        // Modifica arquivos do projeto e depois restaura o backup
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/Core/Kernel.php', "<?php // corrompido\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/bootstrap.php', "<?php // v2.4.0 quebrado\n");

        $backup->restore($record1);

        $this->assertSame("<?php // kernel original\n", file_get_contents($root . '/src/Core/Kernel.php'));
        $this->assertSame("<?php // v2.3.0\n", file_get_contents($root . '/bootstrap.php'));
        $this->assertSame('DB_PASS=secret', file_get_contents($root . '/.env'));

        // Testa list() e prune($scope, 2)
        $record2 = $backup->create($scope, 'backup-2');
        $record3 = $backup->create($scope, 'backup-3');

        $this->assertCount(3, $backup->list($scope));
        $removed = $backup->prune($scope, 2);
        $this->assertSame(1, $removed);
        $this->assertCount(2, $backup->list($scope));
    }

    public function testSqliteDatabaseBackupRoundTrip(): void
    {
        $dbFile = $this->tempDir . '/test.sqlite';
        $dumpFile = $this->tempDir . '/dumps/db.sqlite.bak';

        $pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $dbFile);
        $pdo->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)');
        $pdo->exec("INSERT INTO items (name) VALUES ('original_1'), ('original_2')");

        $adapter = DatabaseBackupFactory::create($pdo, $dbFile);
        $this->assertInstanceOf(SqliteDatabaseBackup::class, $adapter);
        $this->assertTrue($adapter->isSupported());

        $dumpResult = $adapter->dump($dumpFile);
        $this->assertFileExists($dumpResult->dumpPath);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $dumpResult->sizeBytes);
        $this->assertSame(1, $dumpResult->tablesCount);

        // Altera o banco após o dump
        $pdo->exec("DELETE FROM items WHERE name = 'original_2'");
        $pdo->exec("INSERT INTO items (name) VALUES ('corrupted_after_update')");
        unset($pdo);

        // Restaura a partir do dump
        $restorePdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $dbFile);
        $restoreAdapter = new SqliteDatabaseBackup($restorePdo, $dbFile);
        $restoreAdapter->restore($dumpFile);
        unset($restorePdo);

        $verifyPdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $dbFile);
        $names = $verifyPdo->query('SELECT name FROM items ORDER BY id ASC')->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN, 0);
        $this->assertSame(['original_1', 'original_2'], $names);
        unset($verifyPdo);
    }

    #[Group('mysql')]
    public function testMysqlDatabaseBackupRoundTripWhenEnvIsProvided(): void
    {
        $dsn = getenv('DS_TEST_MYSQL_DSN');
        if (!is_string($dsn) || trim($dsn) === '') {
            $this->markTestSkipped('Defina DS_TEST_MYSQL_DSN para executar o teste de integração MySQL.');
        }

        $user = (string)(getenv('DS_TEST_MYSQL_USER') ?: 'root');
        $pass = (string)(getenv('DS_TEST_MYSQL_PASS') ?: '');

        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $user, $pass, [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]);
        $pdo->exec('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ds_backup_test_tbl');
        $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE ds_backup_test_tbl (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL)');
        $pdo->exec("INSERT INTO ds_backup_test_tbl (label) VALUES ('alpha'), ('beta')");

        $backup = new MysqlDatabaseBackup($pdo);
        $this->assertTrue($backup->isSupported());

        $dumpPath = $this->tempDir . '/mysql_dump.sql';
        $result = $backup->dump($dumpPath);
        $this->assertFileExists($result->dumpPath);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $result->sizeBytes);

        $pdo->exec("DELETE FROM ds_backup_test_tbl WHERE label = 'beta'");
        $backup->restore($dumpPath);

        $labels = $pdo->query('SELECT label FROM ds_backup_test_tbl ORDER BY id ASC')->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN, 0);
        $this->assertSame(['alpha', 'beta'], $labels);

        $pdo->exec('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ds_backup_test_tbl');
    }
}
